example.en: The booking for the conference room is confirmed.
example.zh: 會議室的預訂已經確認。

example.en: Please check the availability of the room first.
example.zh: 請先確認房間有沒有空檔。

derived.link: reserve + -ation，把「預訂」變成名詞，像 organize → organization

example.en: We will reserve a hotel room for each guest.
example.zh: 我們會替每位賓客預訂一間飯店房間。

example.en: The company keeps a cash reserve for emergencies.
example.zh: 公司留有一筆現金儲備以備緊急之用。

senses.en: to arrange to keep a place for later use

example.en: Please reserve a table for the client dinner.
example.zh: 請替客戶晚宴訂位。

senses.en: to keep something for a special use
senses.distinguish: 後面接 the right to 或 time 等抽象名詞時，指「保留」而不是訂位。

example.en: We reserve Friday afternoons for team planning.
example.zh: 我們把星期五下午留給團隊規劃。

extra_vocab.en: only if a certain condition is met
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，provided that 引導的是對方必須配合的條件：只要團隊在明天中午前把設備搬過去，就會替對方預訂 B 會議室。語氣正式，常見於合約與通知。
extra_vocab.pattern: S + V, provided that + S + V（現在式）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: provided that 引導的條件子句，用現在式表示未來（provided that your team moves…），不要用 will。

examples.en: We can finish the project on time, provided that the budget is approved.
examples.zh: 只要預算獲准，我們就能準時完成專案。

examples.en: The supplier will refund the deposit, provided that the order is canceled early.
examples.zh: 只要提早取消訂單，供應商就會退還訂金。

examples.en: You may use the room, provided that you leave it clean.
examples.zh: 只要你把房間保持乾淨，就可以使用。

similar.diff: as long as 較口語；provided that 較正式，常見於合約和公告。

example.en: You can park here as long as you show your badge.
example.zh: 只要出示識別證，你就可以停在這裡。

similar.diff: on the condition that 更強調「這是必要條件」，語氣最正式也最重。

example.en: He agreed on the condition that the schedule stays flexible.
example.zh: 他同意，條件是時程要保持彈性。

confusable.diff: unless 是「除非」，帶出例外；provided that 是「只要」，帶出必要條件，兩者意思相反。

example.en: The meeting will go ahead unless the client cancels it.
example.zh: 除非客戶取消，否則會議照常舉行。

extra_vocab.en: not yet final; may be changed later
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the booking is only tentative 表示會議室的預訂只是「暫時保留」，還沒正式確定，所以請對方在下午前確認。語氣客氣但有時間壓力。

example.en: Here is a tentative schedule for next week's visit.
example.zh: 這是下週來訪的暫定時程。

example.en: Both sides reached a tentative agreement on the price.
example.zh: 雙方就價格達成了初步協議。

example.en: A tentative booking will be released if you do not confirm.
example.zh: 如果你沒有確認，暫時預訂就會被釋出。

example.en: Our tentative plan is to open the new branch in May.
example.zh: 我們的暫定計畫是五月開設新分公司。

examples.en: The interview date is tentative until we hear from the candidate.
examples.zh: 在收到應徵者回覆前，面試日期都是暫定的。

examples.en: These figures are tentative and may change after the audit.
examples.zh: 這些數字是暫定的，稽核後可能會改變。

confusable.diff: attentive 是「專注的、周到的」，拼法像 tentative，但完全不同意思。

example.en: The hotel staff were very attentive to our needs.
example.zh: 飯店人員非常留心我們的需求。

similar.diff: provisional 更正式，指「暫時有效、之後會被取代」的安排。

example.en: The provisional budget will be replaced next month.
example.zh: 暫定預算下個月會被取代。

similar.diff: temporary 指「短期、非永久」，不一定是未確定；tentative 強調「還沒定案」。

example.en: We set up a temporary office during the repairs.
example.zh: 維修期間，我們設了一間臨時辦公室。

example.en: Your request is still pending approval.
example.zh: 你的申請仍在等待核准。

example.en: Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前確認你會出席。

derived.link: tentative + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: not final and may change

example.en: The tentative date for the launch is June 5.
example.zh: 上市的暫定日期是六月五日。

senses.en: not sure or not confident
senses.distinguish: 描述人的態度或表情（a tentative smile）時，指「猶豫」。

example.en: He made a tentative suggestion during the meeting.
example.zh: 他在會議中提出一個試探性的建議。

extra_vocab.en: to find out the facts after checking or testing
extra_vocab.note: determined 在文章裡是過去式動詞，意思是技術人員「查明、判定」故障原因。語氣客觀正式，常用於報告或通知中說明調查結果。注意：determined 當形容詞時是「堅決的」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「查明」的 determine 常接 that／whether／what 子句（determine that the fault was…）；be determined to + V 才是「下定決心要…」。

example.en: The inspection report determines who will pay for the repairs.
example.zh: 檢查報告會判定由誰支付維修費用。

example.en: We are still determining which vendor offers the best price.
example.zh: 我們還在判定哪一家供應商的價格最好。

example.en: The engineers are testing the machine to determine the cause.
example.zh: 工程師正在測試機器以查明原因。

example.en: We must determine whether the repair is covered by the warranty.
example.zh: 我們必須判定這次維修是否在保固範圍內。

example.en: The final price will be determined by the order size.
example.zh: 最後的價格將由訂購量決定。

example.en: Please determine the cost of the repair before we approve it.
example.zh: 在我們核准前，請先確定維修的成本。

examples.en: The team determined that the delay was caused by a shipping error.
examples.zh: 團隊判定延誤是因為出貨錯誤造成的。

examples.en: Customer feedback will determine which design we choose for the launch.
examples.zh: 客戶回饋將決定我們為上市選擇哪一種設計。

examples.en: We have not yet determined when the new equipment will arrive.
examples.zh: 我們還沒確定新設備何時會到。

confusable.diff: detect 是「偵測到、發現」某個存在的東西；determine 是「查明結論、判定」。

example.en: The sensor can detect small changes in room temperature.
example.zh: 這個感應器可以偵測到室溫的小變化。

confusable.diff: deter 是「阻止、使打消念頭」，拼法接近但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: deter 是及物動詞，常用 deter + 人 + from + V-ing；determine 是「查明、決定」。

example.en: High shipping fees may deter customers from ordering online.
example.zh: 高額運費可能使客戶不想在網路上訂購。

similar.diff: find out 比較口語、日常；determine 較正式，常有調查或測試的過程。

example.en: I will find out when the new part will arrive.
example.zh: 我會查明新零件何時會到。

similar.diff: establish 強調「確立事實、建立證據」，語氣更正式；determine 重點在查出結論。

example.en: The inspection established that the sensor was already damaged.
example.zh: 檢查確認了感應器原本就已損壞。

example.en: We will decide on the new supplier next week.
example.zh: 我們下週會決定新的供應商。

example.en: The review concluded that the process needs more training.
example.zh: 這次檢討的結論是流程需要更多訓練。

example.en: The team identified three problems in the current system.
example.zh: 團隊找出目前系統中的三個問題。

example.en: Technicians will assess the damage before starting any repairs.
example.zh: 技術人員會在開始任何維修前評估損壞情況。

derived.link: determine + -ation，把動作變成名詞，像 organize → organization。
un-（未）+ determined，像 unknown、unfinished。
pre-（事先）+ determined，像 prepay（預付）、preview（預覽）。

example.en: Inspectors determined that the machine was not safe to use.
example.zh: 檢查人員判定這台機器使用起來不安全。

example.en: She is determined to finish the report before the deadline.
example.zh: 她下定決心要在期限前完成報告。

senses.en: to find out the facts after checking or testing
senses.distinguish: 後面接 that／whether／what 子句，並且有調查、測試的過程。

example.en: The audit determined that the invoices were entered twice.
example.zh: 這次稽核查明這些發票被重複輸入。

senses.en: to control or decide what will happen
senses.distinguish: 主詞是條件或因素，常用被動 be determined by，表示由某因素決定結果。

example.en: Market demand will determine how many units we produce.
example.zh: 市場需求將決定我們生產多少台。

extra_vocab.en: to say that you do not agree or do not like something
extra_vocab.note: Unless you object 是客氣的說法，意思是「如果你沒有意見的話」。Daniel 先提出替代方案（改訂二樓的會議室 B），表示不回覆就視為同意，語氣禮貌但直接。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: object（動詞）是不及物動詞，要接受詞時加 to：object to the plan。這個 to 是介系詞，後面接 N 或 V-ing，如 object to working late，不接原形。

example.en: If anyone objects to the new schedule, please tell me today.
example.zh: 如果有人反對新的時程，請今天告訴我。

example.en: Two team members objected to the late meeting time yesterday.
example.zh: 有兩位組員昨天反對那個太晚的會議時間。

example.en: Some staff are objecting to the plan to shorten lunch breaks.
example.zh: 有些員工正在反對縮短午休時間的計畫。

example.en: Please keep personal objects off the shared desks in the open office.
example.zh: 請不要把個人物品放在開放辦公室的共用桌上。

example.en: Several managers objected to the plan to move the office.
example.zh: 幾位經理反對搬遷辦公室的計畫。

example.en: If you don't object, we will start the meeting at nine.
example.zh: 如果你沒意見，我們會在九點開始會議。

example.en: The client objected strongly when we changed the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們更改交貨日期時，客戶強烈反對。

examples.en: Unless you object, we will send the revised contract tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 如果你沒有意見，我們明天早上會寄出修改後的合約。

examples.en: No one objected when the director suggested a shorter schedule.
examples.zh: 主任提議縮短時程時，沒有人反對。

examples.en: Please tell us now if you object to the new terms.
examples.zh: 如果你反對新條款，請現在告訴我們。

confusable.diff: reject 是「拒絕、駁回」，態度更強；object 是「提出反對意見」。
confusable.usage: reject 是及物動詞，直接接受詞（reject the offer）；object 是不及物動詞，要加 to（object to the offer）。

example.en: The committee rejected the proposal because the cost was too high.
example.zh: 委員會因成本太高而駁回了這項提案。

confusable.diff: subject 是「主題、科目」，拼法結尾相同，意思不同。

example.en: The subject of today's meeting is the new schedule.
example.zh: 今天會議的主題是新的時程。

similar.diff: oppose 是及物動詞，直接接受詞（oppose the plan），語氣比 object 更強烈、更正式。

example.en: Many employees oppose the decision to cut the budget.
example.zh: 許多員工反對削減預算的決定。

similar.diff: disagree with 單純表示意見不同，語氣比 object 更日常，後面接 with + 人或意見。

example.en: I disagree with the idea of delaying the launch.
example.zh: 我不同意延後上市的想法。

example.en: The workers held a protest over the new schedule.
example.zh: 員工針對新的班表舉行了抗議。

example.en: Several customers complained about the late delivery this month.
example.zh: 好幾位客戶本月投訴交貨延遲。

example.en: The manager approved the request without any changes.
example.zh: 經理沒有做任何修改就批准了這項申請。

derived.link: object + -ion，把動作變名詞，像 act → action，常說 raise an objection。
object + -ive，和 object 當名詞的「目標」有關，像 act → active。
objective + -ly，變成副詞，像 clear → clearly。
objection + -able，「會引起反對的」，像 comfortable。

example.en: Nobody objected when the manager suggested starting the meeting earlier.
example.zh: 經理提議提早開會時，沒有人反對。

example.en: Please remove all large objects from the storage room before inspection.
example.zh: 檢查前，請把倉庫裡所有大型物品搬走。

extra_vocab.text: provided that your team moves its equipment there by noon tomorrow
extra_vocab.zh: 前提是你的團隊明天中午前把設備搬到那裡
extra_vocab.note: 這是 Daniel 保留會議室 B 的條件。他先主動幫對方訂了替代會議室，再附上一個明確的期限條件，語氣禮貌但清楚，讓對方知道必須配合才能保住這個安排。
extra_vocab.structure: provided that + 主詞（your team）＋ 動詞（現在式 moves）＋ 受詞（its equipment）＋ 地點（there）＋ by + 時間

grammar.point: provided that = 只要…／在…條件下
grammar.explain: provided that 引導條件子句，意思接近 as long as 或 on the condition that；that 常可省略。比 if 更強調「必須滿足這個條件」。

grammar.point: 條件子句用現在式表示未來
grammar.explain: 雖然搬設備是明天的事，子句仍用現在式 moves，不用 will move，這是時間與條件子句的基本規則。

grammar.point: by + 時間 = 最遲在…之前
grammar.explain: by noon tomorrow 表示截止時間，在中午以前完成即可；不同於 until（持續到某時）。

extra_vocab.pattern: provided that + 人 + V（現在式）+ N + by + 時間

paraphrase.en: as long as your team brings its equipment there before noon tomorrow
paraphrase.zh: 只要你的團隊在明天中午前把設備帶到那裡

paraphrase.en: on the condition that your team has moved its equipment there by noon tomorrow
paraphrase.zh: 條件是你的團隊在明天中午前已把設備搬到那裡

examples.en: We will approve the order, provided that the payment arrives by Friday.
examples.zh: 只要款項在星期五前到帳，我們就會核准訂單。

examples.en: You may use the room, provided that you clean it afterward.
examples.zh: 你可以使用這間房間，前提是事後要整理乾淨。

items.tag: 客戶晚宴訂位人數變更與取消規定語音留言

level.why: 語音留言使用 Should that arrangement be acceptable 倒裝條件句、contingent upon our receiving 動名詞結構與被動語態，並需整合人數變更、最低消費、過敏需求、菜單截止時間與取消費用等多項資訊。干擾項多取自文中出現過的條件與數字。

items.passage: Good afternoon, this is Maria Santos from Riverside Bistro, calling regarding your reservation for Friday evening. Since your party has grown from eight to twelve guests, we would need to move you to the private dining room, which carries a minimum charge of 600 dollars. Should that arrangement be acceptable, we will gladly accommodate the two guests with nut allergies, contingent upon our receiving the final menu selections no later than Wednesday noon. Please be advised that any cancellation made within forty-eight hours of the reservation will incur a fee. I look forward to hearing from you.
items.zh: 午安，我是河畔小館的瑪麗亞．桑托斯，來電是想談談您週五晚上的訂位。由於您的賓客人數已從八位增加到十二位，我們需要將您移至包廂，而包廂設有 600 美元的最低消費。如果這項安排可以接受，我們很樂意照顧兩位對堅果過敏的賓客，但前提是我們最晚要在週三中午前收到最終的菜單選擇。請注意，凡是在訂位時間前四十八小時內提出的取消，都將收取費用。期待您的回覆。

vocab.col: accommodate a request / accommodate large groups
incur a fee / incur additional costs
no later than noon / no later than Friday

questions.q: Why does the restaurant suggest a different room?
opts: The Friday evening schedule is already full.
The minimum charge must be met.
why: 文中沒有說週五晚上已經客滿。
過敏賓客需要特別安排，但這不是更換包廂的原因。
正解：賓客人數從八位增加到十二位，所以需要移到包廂。
最低消費是包廂的條件，不是建議換房的原因。

questions.q: What is the customer asked to provide no later than Wednesday noon?
opts: The final menu choices for the group
A deposit covering the minimum charge
The names of guests with nut allergies
why: 正解：餐廳需要在週三中午前收到最終的菜單選擇，才能照顧過敏賓客。
文中提到最低消費 600 美元，但沒有要求預付訂金。
文中提到有兩位賓客對堅果過敏，但沒有要求提供姓名。
取消費用的規定與四十八小時有關，並非週三中午的期限。

questions.q: Please inform the restaurant of any dietary ______ at least two days before the event.
why: restrict 是動詞，不能放在 dietary 之後作名詞。
restricted 是過去分詞或形容詞，不能充當 inform of 後的受詞。
restricting 是動名詞或現在分詞，語意與此處的飲食限制不符。
正解：restrictions 是複數名詞，與 any dietary 搭配，表示飲食上的限制。

questions.q: Travelers must submit their expense reports ______ the end of the month to be reimbursed.
why: until 表示動作持續到某時間點，但 submit 是一次性動作，不適用。
正解：by 表示最遲在某時間點之前完成，符合繳交期限的語意。
during 後面通常接一段期間，不能表示截止時間。
since 表示自某時間點起，與此句語意不符。

extra_vocab.en: to give someone what they need or have enough space for them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是「滿足、照顧（特殊需求）」的意思：餐廳願意為兩位對堅果過敏的客人準備合適的餐點。語氣禮貌正式，常見於服務業與客服用語。

example.en: The new conference hall accommodates up to two hundred guests.
example.zh: 新的會議廳最多可容納兩百位賓客。

example.en: The airline accommodated every passenger on the later flight.
example.zh: 航空公司把每位乘客都安排到較晚的班機上。

example.en: The hotel is accommodating several delegations during the summit this week.
example.zh: 飯店本週在高峰會期間正在接待好幾個代表團。

example.en: Our accommodating host moved the dinner to a larger room.
example.zh: 我們樂於配合的主人把晚餐改到較大的房間。

forms.label: 名詞
forms.zh: 住宿；（空間或需求的）安排

example.en: Please book your accommodation at least one month before the conference.
example.zh: 請在會議前至少一個月預訂您的住宿。

example.en: We will try to accommodate your request for a later date.
example.zh: 我們會盡量配合您延後日期的要求。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate guests with special needs.
example.zh: 這間飯店能照顧有特殊需求的客人。

example.en: This room can accommodate a large group of up to fifty people.
example.zh: 這個房間最多可容納五十人的大團體。

example.en: We changed the meeting time to accommodate her schedule.
example.zh: 我們更改了會議時間以配合她的行程。

examples.en: Our restaurant can accommodate guests with food allergies.
examples.zh: 我們餐廳能照顧有食物過敏的客人。

examples.en: The conference room is too small to accommodate everyone.
examples.zh: 這間會議室太小，容納不下所有人。

examples.en: We apologize that we cannot accommodate your request this time.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，這次我們無法配合您的要求。

examples.en: The hotel accommodated our team even though it was fully booked.
examples.zh: 雖然客滿，飯店還是為我們的團隊安排了房間。

confusable.diff: accommodation 是名詞，常指「住宿」；accommodate 是動詞，指「容納、配合」。兩者都是雙 c、雙 m，拼字要小心。

example.en: The company will pay for your hotel accommodation in Berlin.
example.zh: 公司會支付你在柏林的飯店住宿費。

confusable.diff: adapt 是自己調整以適應環境；accommodate 是提供空間或配合別人的需求。

example.en: Our staff had to adapt quickly to the new booking system.
example.zh: 我們的員工必須很快適應新的訂位系統。

example.en: The company will pay for your hotel accommodation.
example.zh: 公司會支付你的飯店住宿費用。

example.en: The staff were very accommodating about our schedule change.
example.zh: 員工對我們更改行程非常願意配合。

derived.zh: 住宿；（空間或需求的）安排
derived.link: accommodate + -ion，把「容納、配合」變成名詞，像 decide → decision

senses.en: to give someone what they need or ask for

example.en: The hotel can accommodate guests with special diets.
example.zh: 這間飯店能照顧有特殊飲食需求的客人。

senses.en: to have enough space for a number of people or things
senses.distinguish: 主詞是場地或空間，後面接人數或物品時，指容納。

example.en: The hall can accommodate about three hundred people.
example.zh: 這間禮堂可以容納大約三百人。

senses.en: to provide a place to stay for someone
senses.distinguish: 受詞是來訪者、員工，後面常接 in / at 住宿地點。

example.en: The company will accommodate visitors in a nearby hotel.
example.zh: 公司會安排訪客住在附近的飯店。

extra_vocab.en: to have to pay a cost because of something you do
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言中，incur a fee 指「因為在期限內取消而被收取費用」。incur 的主詞通常是行為或事件（cancellation），不是人，語氣正式，常見於合約與通知。

example.en: Each late delivery incurs a penalty under the supply contract.
example.zh: 依供貨合約，每次延遲交貨都會被罰款。

example.en: The delay incurred extra shipping charges of two hundred dollars.
example.zh: 這次延誤產生了兩百美元的額外運費。

example.en: We should avoid incurring unnecessary travel costs this quarter.
example.zh: 本季我們應避免產生不必要的差旅費用。

example.en: Late payments will incur a fee of ten dollars.
example.zh: 逾期付款將被收取十美元的費用。

example.en: The company incurred high costs during the move.
example.zh: 公司在搬遷期間產生了高額成本。

example.en: Missing the deadline may incur a penalty.
example.zh: 錯過截止日期可能會被罰款。

example.en: Employees must report any expenses incurred on business trips.
example.zh: 員工必須申報出差時產生的任何費用。

examples.en: Changes made after Monday will incur an extra charge.
examples.zh: 週一之後的更改將產生額外費用。

examples.en: We should avoid delays that could incur additional costs.
examples.zh: 我們應該避免可能產生額外成本的延誤。

examples.en: Any damage to the rental car will incur a repair fee.
examples.zh: 租用車輛的任何損壞都會被收取維修費。

examples.en: The firm incurred a small loss in the last quarter.
examples.zh: 這家公司上一季出現了小額虧損。

confusable.diff: occur /əˈkɜːr/ 是「發生」，不接受詞；incur 是「招致」，後面要接費用、損失等受詞。拼字與發音都很像，要小心。

example.en: The error did not occur again after we updated the software.
example.zh: 更新軟體之後，這個錯誤就沒有再發生了。

confusable.diff: pay 是「付錢」的動作；incur 是「因而產生需要付的費用」，重點在費用的產生，不是付款本身。

example.en: Customers must pay the full amount before the order ships.
example.zh: 顧客必須在訂單出貨前付清全額。

example.en: Travel expenses will be paid by the company.
example.zh: 差旅費用將由公司支付。

example.en: There is a penalty for late delivery.
example.zh: 延遲交貨會有罰款。

example.en: There is no charge for the first hour.
example.zh: 第一個小時不收費。

example.en: The hotel adds a small service fee to every bill.
example.zh: 飯店在每張帳單上加收少許服務費。

extra_vocab.en: the act of deciding that something planned will not happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言中，any cancellation made within forty-eight hours 指「在訂位前四十八小時內提出的取消」。cancellation 是可數名詞，常與 fee、policy、notice 搭配，出現在訂位、機票與合約通知中。

example.en: Too many cancellations have left the training room half empty this month.
example.zh: 太多人取消，讓培訓教室這個月有一半是空的。

example.en: You can cancel your booking online until noon on Friday.
example.zh: 您可以在線上取消訂位，期限到星期五中午。

example.en: If the client cancels the order, we will issue a credit.
example.zh: 如果客戶取消訂單，我們會開立抵用額。

example.en: The airline canceled our flight, so we took the train.
example.zh: 航空公司取消了我們的班機，所以我們改搭火車。

example.en: We are canceling tomorrow's meeting because the speaker is ill.
example.zh: 因為講者生病，我們要取消明天的會議。

example.en: The hotel charges a cancellation fee after noon.
example.zh: 飯店在中午之後取消會收取取消費。

example.en: Please read our cancellation policy before you book.
example.zh: 預訂前請先閱讀我們的取消規定。

example.en: A last-minute cancellation left us with an empty table.
example.zh: 臨時取消讓我們空出一張桌子。

example.en: We sent a cancellation notice to all the guests.
example.zh: 我們已向所有賓客寄出取消通知。

examples.en: We received your cancellation and have updated the schedule.
examples.zh: 我們已收到您的取消通知並更新了行程。

examples.en: Flight cancellations caused long delays at the airport.
examples.zh: 航班取消造成機場嚴重延誤。

examples.en: The cancellation of the meeting was announced this morning.
examples.zh: 會議取消的消息今天早上已經公布。

examples.en: Free cancellation is available up to two days before arrival.
examples.zh: 抵達前兩天以前都可以免費取消。

confusable.diff: postponement 是「延期」，活動之後仍會舉行；cancellation 是「取消」，活動不再舉行。

example.en: The postponement of the event gave us time to find a larger venue.
example.zh: 活動延期讓我們有時間找到更大的場地。

confusable.diff: refund 是「退款」，是取消後可能拿回的錢；cancellation 指取消這個動作本身。

example.en: The hotel will send a full refund within five working days.
example.zh: 飯店會在五個工作天內寄出全額退款。

example.en: I need to cancel my appointment for Friday.
example.zh: 我需要取消週五的預約。

example.en: You will get a full refund if you cancel today.
example.zh: 如果您今天取消，將獲得全額退款。

example.en: I would like to change my dinner reservation.
example.zh: 我想更改我的晚餐訂位。

example.en: A deposit is required to hold the room.
example.zh: 需要付訂金才能保留房間。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞詞幹；cancel + -ation（l 重複）變成名詞，像 relate → relation

senses.en: the act of deciding that something planned will not happen

example.en: The cancellation of the flight caused many problems.
example.zh: 航班的取消造成了許多問題。

senses.en: a place that is free because someone has canceled
senses.distinguish: 常見 have a cancellation，指有人取消後空出來的位子或時段。

example.en: We had a cancellation, so there is a table at eight.
example.zh: 我們有人取消，所以八點有一張空桌。

extra_vocab.en: the smallest amount that is allowed or needed
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，minimum charge 是私人包廂的「最低消費」，也就是人數增加後，至少要消費 600 美元。餐廳通知時常用這個說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: minimum 當形容詞放在名詞前（minimum charge）；當名詞時常用 a minimum of + 數字 或 at a minimum。

example.en: Each restaurant sets its own minimums for private events.
example.zh: 每家餐廳對包場活動都有自己的最低要求。

example.en: Engineers recorded the daily minima for temperature in the storage room.
example.zh: 工程師記錄了儲藏室每日的最低溫度。

example.en: The minimum charge for the banquet hall is $1,000.
example.zh: 宴會廳的最低消費是一千美元。

example.en: The supplier has a minimum order of fifty units.
example.zh: 這家供應商的最低訂購量是五十件。

example.en: The minimum wage will increase at the start of next year.
example.zh: 基本工資會在明年初調漲。

example.en: At a minimum, you should confirm the booking by phone.
example.zh: 你至少應該用電話確認訂位。

examples.en: A minimum of ten guests is required for the private room.
examples.zh: 包廂至少需要十位賓客。

examples.en: Please keep costs to a minimum while we review the budget.
examples.zh: 在我們檢討預算期間，請把成本壓到最低。

confusable.diff: minimal 是「極少的、微小的」，描述程度很小；minimum 是「最低的」，指一個規定的下限。

example.en: The delay caused only minimal disruption to our schedule.
example.zh: 這次延誤對我們的時程只造成極小的影響。

similar.diff: at least 是副詞片語，口語自然；minimum 是形容詞或名詞，多用於規定與合約。

example.en: You must order at least ten sets to get the discount.
example.zh: 你至少要訂十組才能享有折扣。

example.en: The maximum capacity of the room is forty people.
example.zh: 這間房間的最大容量是四十人。

example.en: There is a limit of two guests per member.
example.zh: 每位會員限帶兩位賓客。

example.en: A small service fee applies to all bookings.
example.zh: 所有預訂都要收一筆小額服務費。

derived.link: minim- 表示「最小」，加 -al 變形容詞，像 additional
minim- + -ize，把事情「變到最小」，像 organize、realize

example.en: There is a minimum age requirement for this program.
example.zh: 這個計畫有最低年齡限制。

example.en: We try to keep waste to a minimum.
example.zh: 我們盡量把浪費減到最低。

extra_vocab.en: the things that someone has chosen, or the act of choosing
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，final menu selections 是賓客「最後選定的餐點」。餐廳需要在期限前拿到名單，才能為過敏賓客做準備。

example.en: Please email your meal selections to the host by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把你的餐點選擇用電子郵件寄給主辦人。

example.en: Please send your menu selection by email this week.
example.zh: 請在本週用電子郵件寄來你選定的餐點。

example.en: The caterer offers a wide selection of vegetarian dishes.
example.zh: 這家外燴業者提供種類豐富的素食餐點。

example.en: Guests must make a selection before the deadline.
example.zh: 賓客必須在截止日前做出選擇。

example.en: The final selection will be announced on Friday.
example.zh: 最終的選擇會在星期五公布。

examples.en: The restaurant has an excellent selection of local wines.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有很棒的在地葡萄酒選擇。

examples.en: The selection of the new manager will take two weeks.
examples.zh: 挑選新經理需要兩週時間。

confusable.diff: election 是「選舉」，用於投票選出人；selection 是一般的「挑選」。

example.en: The election of the new board chair is next month.
example.zh: 新任董事長的選舉在下個月。

similar.diff: choice 指「選擇的行為或選項」，較口語；selection 常指「挑出來的一組項目」。

example.en: Your choice of entrée must be confirmed in advance.
example.zh: 你選的主餐必須事先確認。

similar.diff: option 強調「可以選的方案」；selection 強調「選出來的結果」或「可選的種類」。

example.en: We have three payment options for you.
example.zh: 我們提供你三種付款選項。

example.en: You have a choice between fish and chicken.
example.zh: 你可以在魚和雞肉之間選擇。

example.en: Which option do you prefer for the venue?
example.zh: 場地你比較喜歡哪個選項？

derived.link: 詞幹 select（挑選）；加 -ion 變名詞 selection，像 collect → collection
select + -ive，「傾向挑選的」，像 active、creative

senses.en: the things that someone has chosen

example.en: Please confirm your selection before the end of the day.
example.zh: 請在今天結束前確認你的選擇。

senses.en: a group of things that you can choose from
senses.distinguish: 常和 wide、large、good 連用（a wide selection），指商店或菜單的品項多寡。

example.en: The store carries a large selection of office furniture.
example.zh: 這家店販售種類眾多的辦公家具。

extra_vocab.en: not after a certain time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，餐廳要求最遲在星期三中午前拿到最終餐點選擇，才能為兩位堅果過敏的賓客做準備。語氣正式，是明確的截止時間。
extra_vocab.pattern: no later than + 時間
extra_vocab.grammar_note: no later than 後面接時間點，並且包含該時間點本身（no later than noon 就是中午前都算）；數量上的「不超過」要用 no more than。

examples.en: Please send your reply no later than Friday at noon.
examples.zh: 請最遲在星期五中午前回覆。

examples.en: Guests must check out no later than eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 房客最遲必須在十一點前退房。

examples.en: We need the revised quotation no later than the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我們最遲需要在本週末前拿到修正後的報價。

similar.diff: by 比較簡短口語；no later than 語氣更正式，強調「不可晚於」。

example.en: Please submit the form by Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 請在星期二早上前交出表格。

similar.diff: at the latest 放在時間後面，語氣口語，意思是「最晚」。

example.en: I need your answer by Monday at the latest.
example.zh: 我最晚星期一要拿到你的答覆。

confusable.diff: no more than 用在數量，表示「不超過」；no later than 用在時間，表示「不晚於」。

example.en: Each guest may bring no more than one companion.
example.zh: 每位賓客最多只能帶一位同伴。

extra_vocab.en: a health problem where nuts make a person sick
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言裡指兩位賓客對堅果過敏，所以餐廳必須讓菜單避開堅果。with nut allergies 放在 guests 後面，說明是哪一種賓客；餐飲業很常在訂位時確認這類需求。
extra_vocab.pattern: 人 + with + 食物 + allergies
extra_vocab.grammar_note: allergy 的後面接 to（an allergy to nuts）；nut 在 nut allergies 裡是形容詞，不加 s，複數的 s 加在 allergies。

examples.en: Please tell the chef if any guest has a nut allergy.
examples.zh: 如果有任何賓客對堅果過敏，請告訴主廚。

examples.en: Several attendees listed nut allergies on the registration form.
examples.zh: 幾位出席者在報名表上填寫了堅果過敏。

examples.en: This dessert contains no nuts, so it is safe for people with nut allergies.
examples.zh: 這道甜點不含堅果，所以對堅果過敏的人也能安心食用。

examples.en: We chose a caterer that can handle nut allergies safely.
examples.zh: 我們選了一家能安全處理堅果過敏的外燴業者。

similar.diff: food allergies 泛指各種食物過敏；nut allergies 只指堅果。

example.en: The menu clearly marks dishes that may cause food allergies.
example.zh: 菜單上清楚標示了可能引起食物過敏的菜色。

similar.diff: dietary restrictions 範圍更廣，包含素食、宗教或健康因素的飲食限制，不一定是過敏。

example.en: Please let us know about any dietary restrictions before the event.
example.zh: 活動前請告知我們任何飲食限制。

confusable.diff: allergic 是形容詞，allergy 是名詞，兩者後面都接 to。
confusable.usage: 形容詞用 be allergic to nuts，名詞用 have an allergy to nuts 或 nut allergies，不要說 be allergy。

example.en: One of our guests is allergic to nuts, so please check the sauces.
example.zh: 我們的一位賓客對堅果過敏，所以請檢查一下醬料。

extra_vocab.en: a formal way to begin telling someone important information
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言裡，餐廳用它引出取消規定（48 小時內取消要收費）。語氣客氣但正式，提醒對方接下來的內容很重要，常見於公告、電子郵件與語音留言。
extra_vocab.pattern: Please be advised that + 子句
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be advised 是被動語態，後面接 that 子句；Please advise 是「請給我建議」，意思不同，不能互換。

examples.en: Please be advised that the office will close early on Friday.
examples.zh: 敬請注意，辦公室星期五會提早關閉。

examples.en: Please be advised that all invoices must be paid within thirty days.
examples.zh: 敬請注意，所有請款單都必須在三十天內付清。

examples.en: Please be advised that prices may change without prior notice.
examples.zh: 敬請注意，價格可能不另行通知而調整。

examples.en: Please be advised that your flight may be delayed because of weather.
examples.zh: 敬請注意，您的班機可能因天氣而延誤。

similar.diff: Please note that 更常見、語氣較輕；Please be advised that 更正式。

example.en: Please note that the meeting room is booked until noon.
example.zh: 請注意，會議室已被預約到中午。

similar.phrase: We would like to inform you that
similar.diff: 語氣同樣正式，但主詞是 we，比較像寫信或公告的開頭。

example.en: We would like to inform you that the shipment has arrived.
example.zh: 我們要通知您，貨物已經到了。

confusable.diff: advice 是名詞「建議」，advised 是動詞 advise 的過去分詞。
confusable.usage: advice 是不可數名詞，不加 s，發音 /ədˈvaɪs/；advise 是動詞，發音 /ədˈvaɪz/。

example.en: I would like your advice before we sign the contract.
example.zh: 簽約之前，我想聽聽你的建議。

extra_vocab.en: in a happy and willing way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言裡，we will gladly accommodate 表示餐廳很樂意配合有過敏的賓客，語氣友善、有服務精神。gladly 放在 will 和動詞之間，是服務業常用的客氣說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: gladly 是副詞，通常放在助動詞與動詞之間（will gladly + V）；形容詞 glad 則用 be glad to + V。

example.en: We would gladly accept your invitation to the opening event.
example.zh: 我們很樂意接受您參加開幕活動的邀請。

example.en: Our staff will gladly help you choose the right plan.
example.zh: 我們的員工很樂意幫您選擇合適的方案。

example.en: The company will gladly provide references upon request.
example.zh: 公司樂意在需要時提供推薦人資料。

examples.en: Please call us anytime, and we will gladly answer your questions.
examples.zh: 歡迎隨時來電，我們很樂意回答您的問題。

examples.en: I would gladly attend the seminar if my schedule allows.
examples.zh: 如果行程允許，我很樂意參加這場研討會。

examples.en: The chef gladly changed the menu for our vegetarian guest.
examples.zh: 主廚欣然為我們的素食賓客更改了菜單。

examples.en: She gladly took on the extra project last month.
examples.zh: 她上個月欣然接下了額外的專案。

confusable.diff: glad 是形容詞，gladly 是副詞，詞性不同。
confusable.usage: glad 用在 be glad to + V 或 be glad that…；gladly 修飾動詞，如 will gladly help。

example.en: I am glad to confirm your booking for Friday evening.
example.zh: 我很高興確認您星期五晚上的訂位。

similar.diff: happily 也能表示樂意，但更常指「開心地」；gladly 更強調願意配合對方的要求。

example.en: The team happily agreed to move the meeting to Friday.
example.zh: 團隊欣然同意把會議改到星期五。

similar.diff: willingly 強調出於自願、不勉強；gladly 多了高興的語氣。

example.en: The staff willingly worked overtime to finish the order.
example.zh: 員工自願加班完成這筆訂單。

example.en: We are glad to inform you that your order has shipped.
example.zh: 我們很高興通知您，您的訂單已經出貨。

example.en: The client was pleased with the quick response from our team.
example.zh: 客戶對我們團隊的快速回應感到滿意。

example.en: We are delighted to welcome you to our new restaurant.
example.zh: 我們很高興歡迎您蒞臨我們的新餐廳。

example.en: Are you willing to work on the weekend for this project?
example.zh: 你願意為這個專案週末加班嗎？

extra_vocab.en: people who come to an event, a hotel, or a restaurant
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言裡，your party has grown from eight to twelve guests 是指晚宴的人數從八位增加到十二位，所以要換到包廂。餐廳與飯店常用 guests 來計算人數。

example.en: Please send me the final guest list by Thursday noon.
example.zh: 請在星期四中午前把最終的賓客名單寄給我。

example.en: Hotel guests can use the fitness center free of charge.
example.zh: 飯店房客可以免費使用健身中心。

example.en: A guest speaker from Tokyo will open the conference.
example.zh: 一位來自東京的特邀講者將為會議開場。

example.en: Only invited guests may enter the VIP lounge.
example.zh: 只有受邀賓客可以進入貴賓休息室。

examples.en: We expect about forty guests at the client dinner on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們預計星期五的客戶晚宴大約有四十位賓客。

examples.en: The hotel offers free breakfast to all guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店提供所有房客免費早餐。

examples.en: Guests are asked to register at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請賓客在櫃檯登記。

examples.en: Thank you for informing us that two more guests will attend.
examples.zh: 謝謝您通知我們還會有兩位賓客出席。

confusable.diff: customer 是付錢購買商品或服務的顧客；guest 是被邀請或受招待的客人。

example.en: The store gave every customer a small gift with the purchase.
example.zh: 商店送給每位顧客一份小禮物作為購物贈品。

confusable.diff: visitor 是來訪的人，例如來公司拜訪；guest 強調被招待、住宿或用餐。

example.en: All visitors must sign in at the reception desk.
example.zh: 所有訪客都必須在接待櫃檯簽到。

similar.diff: attendee 專指出席會議、研討會等活動的人；guest 則強調被邀請或受招待。

example.en: Each attendee will receive a name tag and a program.
example.zh: 每位出席者都會拿到名牌和節目表。

example.en: Our host arranged a private dinner for the visiting clients.
example.zh: 我們的主辦人為來訪客戶安排了一場私人晚宴。

example.en: The hotel is known for its warm hospitality.
example.zh: 這間飯店以親切的款待聞名。

example.en: I would like to change my reservation from eight to twelve people.
example.zh: 我想把訂位人數從八人改成十二人。

example.en: Please reply to the invitation by the end of this week.
example.zh: 請在本週結束前回覆這份邀請。

senses.en: a person who is invited to an event or meal

example.en: Each guest at the dinner received a small gift from the company.
example.zh: 晚宴上的每位賓客都收到公司送的小禮物。

senses.en: a person who pays to stay in a hotel
senses.distinguish: 出現在飯店、住宿的情境時，指住房的客人。

example.en: The hotel asks every guest to leave the room key at the desk.
example.zh: 飯店要求每位房客把房間鑰匙留在櫃檯。

senses.en: a special person who joins a show or an event
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 special 或接 speaker，指被邀請來參與的嘉賓。

example.en: The special guest at the launch was a well-known chef.
example.zh: 這場發表會的特別來賓是一位知名主廚。

extra_vocab.en: depending on something that must happen first
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇留言裡，餐廳願意配合過敏賓客，但有一個條件：必須在週三中午前收到最終菜單。contingent upon 語氣很正式，常見於合約、通知與商務信件。
extra_vocab.pattern: 主要子句, contingent upon + 名詞／所有格 + V-ing
extra_vocab.grammar_note: contingent upon（也可寫 contingent on）後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接完整子句；要接子句時改用 provided that 或 depends on whether。

examples.en: The final payment is contingent upon the client's approval of the work.
examples.zh: 最後一筆款項要視客戶是否核准工作成果而定。

examples.en: Our offer is contingent upon receiving your signed contract by Monday.
examples.zh: 我們的報價以在星期一前收到您簽署的合約為條件。

examples.en: The promotion is contingent upon passing the annual performance review.
examples.zh: 這次升遷取決於是否通過年度績效考核。

examples.en: The outdoor event is contingent upon good weather on Saturday.
examples.zh: 戶外活動要視星期六的天氣是否良好而定。

similar.diff: depending on 較口語，後面也可接 whether 子句；contingent upon 更正式。

example.en: We will decide on the budget depending on next quarter's sales.
example.zh: 我們會視下一季的銷售狀況來決定預算。

similar.diff: subject to 常見於合約，意思是「須經…」或「受…約束」，語氣同樣正式。

example.en: All orders are subject to availability and final approval.
example.zh: 所有訂單都須視供貨情況及最終核准而定。

similar.diff: provided that 後面接完整子句，意思是「只要…就」。

example.en: We will ship the goods provided that payment is received.
example.zh: 只要收到款項，我們就會出貨。

confusable.diff: contingency 是名詞，指可能發生的意外或應變準備；contingent 是形容詞，意思是「視…而定」。

example.en: We set aside money as a contingency for unexpected costs.
example.zh: 我們預留一筆錢，以應付意外的費用。

extra_vocab.text: contingent upon our receiving the final menu selections no later than Wednesday noon.
extra_vocab.zh: 條件是我們必須在週三中午之前收到最終的菜單選擇。
extra_vocab.note: 這是原句後半的附加條件，語氣正式客氣，提醒對方要在期限前送出餐點選擇，餐廳才能配合過敏的需求。
extra_vocab.structure: contingent upon + 所有格 + V-ing + 受詞 + no later than + 時間

grammar.explain: contingent upon 是介系詞片語，後面接名詞或 V-ing，表示「以…為條件」，用來為前面的主要子句加上條件。
V-ing 前面的 our 表示收到的人是「我們」，這是較正式的寫法；口語也可說 us receiving。
表示最晚的期限，no later than Wednesday noon 就是「最晚週三中午」，含當時在內。

extra_vocab.pattern: （主要子句）, contingent upon + 所有格 + V-ing + N + no later than + 時間

paraphrase.en: but only if we receive the final menu selections by noon on Wednesday.
paraphrase.zh: 但前提是我們在週三中午前收到最終的菜單選擇。

paraphrase.en: provided that we receive the final menu selections by Wednesday at noon.
paraphrase.zh: 只要我們在週三中午前收到最終的菜單選擇。

examples.en: The discount is contingent upon our receiving full payment no later than May 30.
examples.zh: 這項折扣的條件是我們最晚在五月三十日前收到全額款項。

examples.en: Your reservation is contingent upon your confirming the guest count by Thursday.
examples.zh: 您的訂位須以您在星期四前確認賓客人數為條件。

extra_vocab.en: to happen
extra_vocab.note: 這個字沒有直接出現在文章裡，但文章最後的 incur a fee（招致費用）拼法和發音都很像它，容易搞混。occur 是「發生」，incur 是「承擔（費用、損失）」，兩者要分清楚。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: occur 是不及物動詞，不能用被動，要說 The error occurred，不說 was occurred；變化時最後的 r 要重複，寫成 occurred、occurring。

example.en: A short delay occurs whenever the system updates its database.
example.zh: 每次系統更新資料庫時，都會出現短暫的延遲。

example.en: The error occurred while the staff were entering the orders.
example.zh: 員工在輸入訂單時發生了錯誤。

example.en: Please report any problems occurring during the installation.
example.zh: 安裝期間如有任何問題發生，請回報。

example.en: If any problems occur, please contact the IT hotline.
example.zh: 如果發生任何問題，請聯絡資訊部門專線。

example.en: Mistakes occur frequently when data is entered by hand.
example.zh: 用手輸入資料時，錯誤經常發生。

example.en: It never occurred to me that the invoice might be wrong.
example.zh: 我從沒想過這張請款單可能有錯。

examples.en: When did the system failure first occur during the test?
examples.zh: 系統故障在測試中是什麼時候第一次發生的？

examples.en: Coverage applies only to damage that occurs during transport.
examples.zh: 保障範圍只適用於運送過程中發生的損壞。

examples.en: Most accidents occur because workers skip the safety checks.
examples.zh: 大多數意外是因為工人省略安全檢查才發生。

confusable.diff: incur 是「招致、承擔」費用或損失；occur 是事情「發生」。
confusable.usage: incur 是及物動詞，後面接費用、損失等受詞（incur a fee）；occur 是不及物動詞，後面不接受詞。

example.en: The company may incur extra costs if the order is changed.
example.zh: 如果訂單被更改，公司可能要承擔額外的費用。

confusable.diff: occupy 是「佔用、佔據」場所或時間，發音和拼法都與 occur 相近，但意思不同。

example.en: The sales team occupies the entire third floor of the building.
example.zh: 業務團隊佔用了大樓的整個三樓。

similar.diff: happen 較口語、最通用；occur 比較正式，常用於報告與通知。

example.en: What happened to the shipment that was due on Monday?
example.zh: 星期一應該到的那批貨出了什麼狀況？

similar.diff: take place 用於預定的活動或會議，不用於意外；occur 兩者都可以。

example.en: The annual meeting will take place in the main hall.
example.zh: 年度會議將在大廳舉行。

similar.diff: arise 強調問題或情況「出現」，常和 problem、issue 搭配。

example.en: Problems may arise if the schedule changes at the last minute.
example.zh: 如果時程在最後一刻更動，可能會出現問題。

example.en: The incident was reported to the safety manager right away.
example.zh: 這起事件立刻被通報給安全經理。

example.en: We will look into the issue and call you back tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們會調查這個問題，明天回電給您。

example.en: The company holds a networking event every spring.
example.zh: 公司每年春天都會舉辦一場交流活動。

derived.link: occur + -rence（r 要多寫一個），變成名詞，像 prefer → preference、refer → reference
re-（再次）+ occur，像 rewrite、return，再發生一次

senses.en: to happen, often without a plan

example.en: A power failure occurred during the final test of the machine.
example.zh: 機器最後測試時發生了停電。

senses.en: to come into someone's mind
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 to + 人，主詞多半是 it 或 an idea，不是事件發生。

example.en: It occurred to the manager that the deadline was too tight.
example.zh: 經理突然想到這個期限太趕了。

items.tag: 面試邀請電子郵件

level.why: 電子郵件以單句與簡單複合句為主，僅有一處 who 關係子句與被動語態（have been shortlisted），資訊為面試時間、地點、攜帶物品與改期規定，字彙屬常見人資用語，干擾項與文中資訊的差距較明顯。

items.passage:
To: Olivia Chen
Subject: Interview for Marketing Coordinator Position

Dear Ms. Chen,

Thank you for applying for the Marketing Coordinator position. Your qualifications impressed our team, and you are one of five candidates who have been shortlisted. We would like to invite you for an interview on Tuesday, March 12, at 10:00 A.M.

The interview will take place at our main office, where you will meet a panel of three managers. Please bring a copy of your résumé and a photo ID. If you need to reschedule, please contact us at least two days in advance.

Sincerely,
Kevin Brooks
Human Resources
items.zh:
收件人：歐莉薇亞．陳
主旨：行銷專員職位面試

陳小姐您好：

感謝您應徵行銷專員一職。您的資歷令我們的團隊印象深刻，您是入圍的五位候選人之一。我們誠摯邀請您於 3 月 12 日星期二上午 10:00 前來面試。

面試將在我們的總公司舉行，屆時您將與三位主管組成的面試小組會面。請攜帶一份履歷及附照片的身分證件。如果需要改期，請至少提前兩天與我們聯絡。

敬祝順心
凱文．布魯克斯
人力資源部

vocab.col: interview panel / a panel of experts
reschedule a meeting / reschedule an interview

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To offer Ms. Chen the position
To invite her to an interview
why: 信中只是邀請面試，並沒有表示已錄取。
信中提醒她攜帶履歷，而不是要求她另外寄送更新版本。
正解：信中說明她已入圍，並邀請她於指定時間前來面試。
改期只是附帶說明，若她需要才須聯絡公司，並非這封信的目的。

questions.q: What is Ms. Chen asked to bring to the interview?
opts: Her résumé and a photo ID
A letter from a former manager
Two copies of her application form
why: 正解：信中請她攜帶一份履歷以及附照片的身分證件。
文中沒有要求她攜帶前任主管的推薦信。
文中沒有提到要帶行銷作品樣本。
文中要求的是一份履歷，並未提到兩份申請表。

questions.q: Ms. Chen was shortlisted ______ her strong experience in digital marketing.
why: because 後面需接完整子句，這裡接的是名詞片語 her strong experience。
although 表示讓步，且後面也要接子句，語意不符。
whereas 表示對比，不能表示原因。
正解：due to 是介系詞片語，後接名詞片語，表示「由於」。

questions.q: Each candidate will be ______ by a panel of three managers.
why: will be 後面不能接動詞原形。
正解：will be interviewed 是被動語態，表示應徵者被面試小組面試。
will be interviewing 是進行式，主詞變成面試者，與句意不符。
interviews 是名詞複數或第三人稱單數動詞，放在 will be 之後文法不正確。

extra_vocab.en: to change the time or date of something that was planned
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，If you need to reschedule 的意思是「如果你需要改面試時間」，受詞被省略，因為從上下文就知道是指面試。reschedule 可以改到更晚或更早的時間，不一定是延後；通知中常搭配「提前多久聯絡」的要求。

example.en: Whenever the client reschedules, our team updates the shared calendar.
example.zh: 每當客戶改期，我們的團隊就會更新共用行事曆。

example.en: Ms. Lee rescheduled her interview after her train was delayed.
example.zh: 李小姐的火車誤點後，把她的面試改了期。

example.en: Rescheduling the workshop will cost us a small deposit.
example.zh: 把工作坊改期會讓我們損失一小筆訂金。

example.en: Can we reschedule the meeting for Thursday afternoon?
example.zh: 我們可以把會議改到星期四下午嗎？

collocations.zh: 重新預約、改約診或約會時間

example.en: I called the clinic to reschedule my appointment.
example.zh: 我打電話給診所，想改我的預約時間。

example.en: The company agreed to reschedule the interview for next week.
example.zh: 公司同意把面試改到下週。

example.en: The training session was rescheduled for Monday morning.
example.zh: 培訓課程已改到星期一上午。

examples.en: I'm sorry, but I need to reschedule our call to tomorrow.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我需要把我們的通話改到明天。

examples.en: Bad weather forced us to reschedule the client visit.
examples.zh: 天氣不好，我們只好重新安排拜訪客戶的時間。

examples.en: You can reschedule your delivery on our website at no cost.
examples.zh: 您可以在我們的網站上免費更改送貨時間。

confusable.diff: postpone 專指「延後」到之後的時間，不一定已決定新時間；reschedule 是重新訂一個新時間，可以更晚也可以更早。

example.en: We decided to postpone the interview until the manager returns.
example.zh: 我們決定把面試延到經理回來之後。

confusable.diff: cancel 是取消，活動不再舉行；reschedule 是活動仍會舉行，只是改時間。

example.en: Please cancel the interview if you can no longer attend.
example.zh: 如果你無法再出席，請取消這場面試。

example.en: Please check the schedule before you book a room.
example.zh: 預訂會議室之前，請先看時間表。

example.en: I have an appointment with a client at noon.
example.zh: 我中午和客戶有約。

example.en: We had to postpone the event because of the rain.
example.zh: 因為下雨，我們必須延後活動。

example.en: Please cancel my reservation for Friday night.
example.zh: 請取消我星期五晚上的訂位。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；re-（再次）+ schedule 就是重新安排，像 rewrite、return
schedule + -er，做事的人或工具，像 printer、worker
un-（不）+ scheduled，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: the education, skills, or experience that make a person right for a job
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Your qualifications 指應徵者的學歷、經歷與能力，給面試官留下好印象，所以進入入圍名單。這種用法在求職信和面試通知裡很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「資歷」時常用複數 qualifications；後面接 for + 職位（qualifications for the job），不用 of。

example.en: Applicants should attach copies of their qualifications to the form.
example.zh: 應徵者應在表格上附上資歷證明的影本。

example.en: Her academic qualifications include a master's degree in finance.
example.zh: 她的學歷資格包含財務碩士學位。

example.en: Only applicants who meet the qualifications will be contacted.
example.zh: 只有符合資格條件的應徵者才會被聯絡。

example.en: The required qualifications are listed in the job notice.
example.zh: 必備資格列在職缺公告裡。

example.en: A professional qualification in accounting is a big advantage.
example.zh: 擁有會計專業資格是一大優勢。

examples.en: We were impressed by your qualifications and work experience.
examples.zh: 你的資歷和工作經驗讓我們印象深刻。

examples.en: Please list your qualifications at the top of your résumé.
examples.zh: 請把你的資歷列在履歷最上方。

confusable.diff: quality 是「品質、特質」，拼法前半很像，但意思不同。

example.en: The quality of the product is our top priority.
example.zh: 產品品質是我們的第一優先。

similar.diff: skills 指「具體的能力」；qualifications 還包含學歷、證照等正式資格。

example.en: Strong communication skills are important for this job.
example.zh: 良好的溝通能力對這份工作很重要。

similar.diff: background 指整體的「背景、經歷」，範圍比 qualifications 更廣、更不正式。

example.en: He has a strong background in marketing.
example.zh: 他有深厚的行銷背景。

example.en: A college degree is a requirement for this position.
example.zh: 大學學歷是這個職位的必要條件。

example.en: She has five years of experience in sales.
example.zh: 她有五年的業務經驗。

derived.link: 詞幹 qualify（有資格）；去 y 加 -ication 變名詞 qualification
qualify + -ed，「被認定合格的」，像 skilled、experienced
un-（不）+ qualified
over-（過度）+ qualified，資歷超過職位所需

extra_vocab.en: a person who is being considered for a job or position
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，candidates 指進入徵才流程的「應徵者」。one of five candidates 表示對方是經過初步篩選後，留下的五位人選之一。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: candidate for + 職位或職務（a candidate for the position），不用 candidate of。

example.en: Several candidates asked about the salary during the second interview.
example.zh: 有幾位應徵者在第二輪面試時詢問了薪資。

example.en: Each job candidate will meet the department head.
example.zh: 每位求職者都會見到部門主管。

example.en: She is a strong candidate for the manager position.
example.zh: 她是經理職位的有力人選。

example.en: We have not found a qualified candidate yet.
example.zh: 我們還沒找到合格的人選。

example.en: He is the best candidate for the sales role.
example.zh: 他是業務職位的最佳人選。

examples.en: All candidates must complete a short written test.
examples.zh: 所有應徵者都必須完成一份簡短的筆試。

examples.en: The panel will interview three more candidates tomorrow.
examples.zh: 評審小組明天會再面試三位應徵者。

similar.diff: applicant 是「提出申請的人」，剛投履歷就算；candidate 通常是被考慮或通過篩選的人選。

example.en: More than two hundred applicants sent in their résumés.
example.zh: 超過兩百位應徵者寄來了履歷。

example.en: Every applicant will receive an email reply.
example.zh: 每位申請人都會收到電子郵件回覆。

example.en: The interviewer asked about my previous job.
example.zh: 面試官問了我先前的工作。

example.en: The position will be filled by the end of May.
example.zh: 這個職缺會在五月底前補齊。

senses.en: a person who is being considered for a job

example.en: The top candidate will receive an offer this week.
example.zh: 最優秀的人選本週會收到錄用通知。

senses.en: a person who is trying to win an election or pass an exam
senses.distinguish: 出現 election、vote、exam 等字時，指候選人或考生。

example.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the vote.
example.zh: 每位候選人在投票前都做了簡短演說。

extra_vocab.en: to put someone on a short list of the best people for a job or prize
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動式 have been shortlisted，表示應徵者從所有申請人中，被挑進最後的五人名單。這是徵才信裡的好消息語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: shortlist 多用被動：be shortlisted for + 職位或獎項（被列入…入圍名單）。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數／複數
forms.zh: 列入入圍名單；入圍名單（複數）

example.en: The committee shortlists two vendors after each review round.
example.zh: 委員會在每輪審查後會把兩家廠商列入入圍名單。

example.en: Only four applicants were shortlisted for the final round.
example.zh: 只有四位申請人進入最後一輪的入圍名單。

example.en: Shortlisting takes time because we read every application carefully.
example.zh: 因為我們仔細閱讀每份申請，所以篩選入圍名單很花時間。

example.en: Three engineers were shortlisted for the project leader role.
example.zh: 三位工程師入圍專案負責人的職位。

example.en: We have prepared a shortlist of four suppliers.
example.zh: 我們已準備好四家供應商的入圍名單。

example.en: Only two proposals made the shortlist this year.
example.zh: 今年只有兩份提案進入入圍名單。

example.en: The final shortlist will be announced on Monday.
example.zh: 最終入圍名單會在星期一公布。

examples.en: We are pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted.
examples.zh: 我們很高興通知你，你已入圍名單。

examples.en: The team shortlisted five applicants out of over one hundred.
examples.zh: 團隊從一百多位申請人中挑出五位入圍。

similar.diff: select 是「挑選」，不一定是從名單中進一步縮小；shortlist 特指挑出少數最佳人選進入下一輪。

example.en: We will select one candidate after the final interview.
example.zh: 最後一輪面試後，我們會選出一位應徵者。

similar.diff: narrow down 較口語，指「把範圍縮小」；shortlist 是正式的徵才或評選用語。

example.en: We need to narrow down the list by Friday.
example.zh: 我們需要在星期五前縮小名單範圍。

example.en: Please select the best option from the list.
example.zh: 請從名單中選出最好的選項。

example.en: The HR team will screen all applications first.
example.zh: 人資團隊會先篩選所有申請。

example.en: The committee shortlisted six companies for the contract.
example.zh: 委員會把六家公司列入合約的入圍名單。

example.en: Your name is on the shortlist for the award.
example.zh: 你的名字在這個獎項的入圍名單上。

extra_vocab.en: a small group of people who meet to make a decision or judge something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a panel of three managers 是由三位經理組成的面試小組，一起面試應徵者。這是面試通知常見的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: a panel of 後面接複數名詞（a panel of three managers）；美式英文中 panel 當一個整體時，動詞常用單數。

example.en: The company has set up two interview panels for next week.
example.zh: 公司已為下週設立了兩個面試小組。

example.en: The interview panel includes two managers and one director.
example.zh: 面試小組包括兩位經理和一位主任。

example.en: A panel of experts will review every proposal.
example.zh: 一個專家小組會審查每一份提案。

example.en: The panel discussion starts at two o'clock in Hall B.
example.zh: 座談會兩點在 B 廳開始。

example.en: You can adjust the settings on the control panel.
example.zh: 你可以在控制面板上調整設定。

examples.en: You will be interviewed by a panel of senior managers.
examples.zh: 你會由一個資深經理小組面試。

examples.en: The panel will announce its decision next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 小組會在下週三公布決定。

similar.diff: committee 是正式、較長期的「委員會」；panel 常是為某件事臨時組成的小組。

example.en: The budget committee meets every month.
example.zh: 預算委員會每個月開會。

example.en: The committee approved the new hiring plan.
example.zh: 委員會核准了新的招聘計畫。

example.en: Each interviewer has a list of questions.
example.zh: 每位面試官都有一份問題清單。

derived.link: panel + -ist，「小組裡的人」，像 artist、specialist

senses.en: a group of people chosen to judge or discuss something

example.en: A panel of judges will choose the winner.
example.zh: 評審團會選出優勝者。

senses.en: a flat board or surface with controls or a special use
senses.distinguish: 出現 control、solar、wall 等字時，指面板或板片。

example.en: The company installed solar panels on the roof.
example.zh: 公司在屋頂裝了太陽能板。

extra_vocab.en: to put someone on a short list of the best choices
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇電子郵件裡，have been shortlisted 表示五位應徵者已通過初步篩選，進入面試名單。這是好消息，但還不是錄取，所以後面接著邀請面試。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: shortlist 多半用被動語態，說 be shortlisted for + 職位（shortlisted for the job）；表示「入圍」的介系詞用 for。

example.en: The hiring team shortlists five applicants after reading every résumé.
example.zh: 招募團隊讀完每份履歷後，會列出五位候選人。

example.en: Both shortlists were sent to the department head on Monday.
example.zh: 兩份候選名單星期一都送給了部門主管。

example.en: We are shortlisting candidates for the sales manager position this week.
example.zh: 我們這週正在為業務經理職位挑選入圍的候選人。

example.en: Three designers were shortlisted for the final stage of the contest.
example.zh: 三位設計師入圍了比賽的最後階段。

example.en: All shortlisted candidates will receive an e-mail by Friday.
example.zh: 所有入圍的候選人星期五前都會收到電子郵件。

example.en: We made a shortlist of four suppliers after the first review.
example.zh: 第一輪審查後，我們列出了四家供應商的候選名單。

examples.en: Only six applicants were shortlisted out of more than two hundred.
examples.zh: 兩百多位應徵者中，只有六位入圍。

examples.en: We are pleased to tell you that you have been shortlisted.
examples.zh: 我們很高興通知您，您已入圍。

examples.en: Two vendors were shortlisted for the new catering contract.
examples.zh: 兩家廠商入圍了新的外燴合約。

confusable.diff: selected 是最後被選中；shortlisted 只是進入候選名單，還沒有決定。

example.en: After the interviews, only one candidate was selected for the job.
example.zh: 面試結束後，只有一位候選人被選中這份工作。

similar.diff: narrow down 是把人數或選項慢慢縮小的動作，後面常接 to + 數字；shortlist 強調列出最後名單。

example.en: We narrowed down the applicants to five names by Friday.
example.zh: 我們在星期五前把應徵者縮減到五個人。

example.en: The best candidate has five years of marketing experience.
example.zh: 最佳候選人有五年的行銷經驗。

example.en: Each applicant must submit a résumé and a cover letter.
example.zh: 每位應徵者都必須繳交履歷和求職信。

example.en: The interview will take place in the main office.
example.zh: 面試將在總公司舉行。

example.en: Her qualifications match the requirements of the position.
example.zh: 她的資歷符合這個職位的要求。

example.en: The committee will shortlist three projects for the final vote.
example.zh: 委員會會挑出三個專案進入最後投票。

example.en: Your name is on the shortlist for the sales award.
example.zh: 你的名字在業務獎的候選名單上。

extra_vocab.en: a short document that lists your education and work experience
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇電子郵件裡，面試時要帶一份履歷（a copy of your résumé）的影本，讓三位面試主管參考。résumé 是求職時最常見的文件，美式英文常用，英式英文多說 CV。
extra_vocab.pattern: bring／send／submit + a copy of + your résumé
extra_vocab.grammar_note: résumé 是可數名詞，複數是 résumés；書寫時常省略重音符號，寫成 resume，但要和動詞 resume（/rɪˈzuːm/，重新開始）區分。

examples.en: Please send your résumé to the HR department by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前把你的履歷寄給人資部門。

examples.en: The manager read my résumé carefully before the interview.
examples.zh: 經理在面試前仔細讀了我的履歷。

examples.en: I have attached my résumé and a short cover letter.
examples.zh: 我已附上我的履歷和一封簡短的求職信。

examples.en: Update your résumé regularly so it shows your latest skills.
examples.zh: 請定期更新履歷，讓它呈現你最新的技能。

similar.diff: CV 是英式英文常用的說法，內容通常更長、更完整；résumé 是美式英文，多為一到兩頁。

example.en: Candidates in London are asked to send a CV instead.
example.zh: 倫敦的應徵者被要求改寄履歷表。

similar.diff: cover letter 是附在履歷前的求職信，說明你為什麼適合這個職位；résumé 是列出經歷的清單。

example.en: Please include a cover letter along with your résumé.
example.zh: 請在履歷之外附上一封求職信。

confusable.diff: 沒有重音符號的 resume 也可以是動詞，意思是「重新開始」，發音不同。

example.en: The meeting will resume at two o'clock after lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後會議會在兩點重新開始。

items.tag: 原料短缺與替代材料採購說明

level.why: 口語說明含 since、assuming、compared with 等連接與比較結構，並使用被動與完成被動（have been reviewed），需整合短缺原因、替代材料、交貨期差異與下單前提。干擾項取自文中出現過的時間與動作，需精確區分。

items.passage: Good morning, everyone. As some of you already know, a shortage of aluminum sheets has forced us to look for alternatives, since our usual vendor cannot guarantee delivery before the end of the month. After comparing three quotations, the procurement team has decided to substitute a lower-grade alloy for the current material, assuming it passes our strength tests. The lead time for the new material is only ten days, compared with the three weeks we were quoted earlier. Samples will be tested on Monday, and no order will be placed in bulk until the results have been reviewed. Please hold any further requests until then.
items.zh: 大家早安。有些人可能已經知道，由於鋁板短缺，我們不得不尋找替代方案，因為我們平常合作的廠商無法保證在月底前交貨。比較三份報價單之後，採購團隊決定以較低等級的合金取代現有材料，前提是它能通過我們的強度測試。新材料的前置時間只要十天，相較之下，先前報給我們的是三週。樣品將在週一進行測試，在檢視測試結果之前，不會大量下單。在那之前，請先暫停任何其他請求。

vocab.col: substitute A for B / substitute a part
shorten the lead time / delivery lead time
buy in bulk / order in bulk

questions.q: Why does the company need to find a new material?
opts: The current material was found to be defective.
The usual vendor cannot promise timely delivery.
why: 強度測試是針對新材料將進行的檢驗，並非需要更換材料的原因。
文中只提到比較三份報價，沒有說報價過高。
文中沒有說現有材料有瑕疵，而是供貨短缺。
正解：鋁板短缺，且平常的廠商無法保證在月底前交貨，所以必須找替代材料。

questions.q: What must happen before a large order is placed?
opts: The vendor must reduce its prices.
The three-week lead time must be confirmed.
The test results must be reviewed.
why: 文中沒有提到要求廠商降價。
三週是先前報給公司的前置時間，新材料的前置時間為十天。
正解：在檢視樣品測試結果之前，不會大量下單。
說話者要求暫停其他請求，並沒有要先收集請求。

questions.q: ______ the delivery was delayed, the factory had to suspend production for two days.
why: 正解：Because 是連接詞，後接完整子句，表示原因。
Because of 是介系詞片語，後面要接名詞，不能接完整子句。
Despite 是介系詞，意為「儘管」，後面不接子句，語意也不符。
However 是副詞，不能連接兩個子句。

questions.q: Manufacturers are increasingly concerned about the ______ of their supply chains.
why: reliable 是形容詞，不能直接放在 the 之後、of 之前作名詞。
正解：reliability 是名詞，the reliability of... 表示「…的可靠性」。
reliably 是副詞，不能作 the 的後接名詞。
relies 是動詞第三人稱單數，詞性不符。

extra_vocab.en: a situation in which there is not enough of something that people need
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，a shortage of aluminum sheets 指鋁板供應不足，是公司被迫尋找替代材料的原因。shortage 常和 of 連用，後面接缺少的東西，多用於原料、人力、零件等供應鏈情境。

example.en: Material shortages have raised prices across the whole electronics industry.
example.zh: 原料短缺讓整個電子業的價格都上漲了。

example.en: We are short of packing boxes, so please order more today.
example.zh: 我們的包裝箱不夠了，請今天多訂一些。

example.en: The shortfall in this month's budget must be covered by savings.
example.zh: 這個月預算的缺口必須用積蓄來補。

example.en: A shortage of skilled workers has slowed down the project.
example.zh: 技術人員短缺拖慢了專案進度。

example.en: The factory is facing a labor shortage this summer.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年夏天面臨人力短缺。

example.en: A supply shortage delayed the delivery of the new phones.
example.zh: 供應短缺延誤了新手機的交貨。

example.en: Extra shipments from Asia should ease the shortage by June.
example.zh: 來自亞洲的額外出貨應可在六月前緩解短缺。

examples.en: Because of a shortage of parts, we cannot meet the original deadline.
examples.zh: 由於零件短缺，我們無法趕上原本的截止日。

examples.en: The hospital reported a serious shortage of nurses last year.
examples.zh: 那家醫院去年通報護理人員嚴重短缺。

examples.en: We apologize for the delay, which was caused by a temporary shortage.
examples.zh: 我們為延誤致歉，這是暫時性短缺所造成的。

confusable.diff: lack 可作名詞或動詞，表示缺少某種特質或條件（a lack of experience）；shortage 多指數量上的供應不足，尤其是物資或人力。

example.en: The new hire's lack of experience slowed down the whole project.
example.zh: 新進員工缺乏經驗，拖慢了整個專案。

confusable.diff: scarcity 強調稀少、難以取得，通常是長期現象；shortage 多指一時的供應不足，語氣較常見於商務情境。

example.en: The scarcity of rare metals keeps prices high for electronics makers.
example.zh: 稀有金屬稀少，使電子產品製造商的成本居高不下。

example.en: Our supply of raw materials is limited this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月的原料供應有限。

example.en: Demand for electric cars has grown steadily.
example.zh: 電動車的需求持續成長。

example.en: The budget is insufficient for a new production line.
example.zh: 這筆預算不足以建置新的生產線。

derived.link: 最基礎的形容詞，short + -age 變成名詞「不足」，像 use → usage、store → storage
short + -en，使變短，像 widen、strengthen
short + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully

extra_vocab.en: a document that tells you how much something will cost
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，three quotations 是三家供應商提供的「報價」。採購團隊比較報價後，才決定改用替代材料。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 報價通常說 a quotation for + 商品或服務，向供應商索取則用 request a quotation from + 供應商。

example.en: We asked suppliers to send their quotations before the deadline.
example.zh: 我們請供應商在截止日前寄來他們的報價單。

example.en: We requested a quotation from three different vendors.
example.zh: 我們向三家不同的廠商索取了報價。

example.en: Please submit your quotation by the end of this week.
example.zh: 請在本週末前提交你的報價。

example.en: We cannot place the order without a written quotation.
example.zh: 沒有書面報價，我們無法下單。

example.en: The quotation for the new machines is attached.
example.zh: 新機器的報價單已附上。

examples.en: The lowest quotation came from a supplier in Vietnam.
examples.zh: 最低的報價來自越南的一家供應商。

examples.en: Thank you for your quotation; we will reply by Monday.
examples.zh: 謝謝你的報價，我們星期一前會回覆。

similar.diff: quote 是 quotation 的口語說法（get a quote），意思幾乎相同。

example.en: Can you get a quote for the packaging by noon?
example.zh: 你中午前能拿到包裝的報價嗎？

similar.diff: estimate 是大約的估價，較不具約束力；quotation 通常是供應商正式提出的價格。

example.en: This estimate may change after the final inspection.
example.zh: 最後檢查後，這份估價可能會改變。

example.en: The invoice will be sent after the delivery.
example.zh: 發票會在交貨後寄出。

example.en: Our bid for the contract was accepted.
example.zh: 我們對這份合約的投標被接受了。

derived.link: 詞幹 quote；加 -ation 變名詞 quotation，像 inform → information

senses.en: a statement of the price for goods or services

example.en: The quotation includes shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 這份報價單包含運送與處理費。

senses.en: words from a book or a person that are repeated exactly
senses.distinguish: 出現 book、speech、author 等字時，指引文。

example.en: The report opens with a quotation from the CEO.
example.zh: 報告以執行長的一段引述開頭。

extra_vocab.en: the process of buying goods or services for a company
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the procurement team 是公司的「採購團隊」，負責比較報價、決定改用替代材料。procurement 比 purchasing 更正式，強調從尋找供應商到簽約的整個流程。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: procurement 是不可數名詞，不加 s；放在名詞前當形容詞用（procurement team），不變複數。

example.en: The procurement team is reviewing all supplier contracts.
example.zh: 採購團隊正在審查所有供應商合約。

example.en: The procurement process usually takes about three weeks.
example.zh: 採購流程通常需要大約三週。

example.en: Please send the order details to the procurement manager.
example.zh: 請把訂單細節寄給採購經理。

example.en: The procurement department must approve every purchase over $1,000.
example.zh: 採購部門必須核准超過一千美元的每筆採購。

examples.en: Procurement costs have risen sharply since the shortage began.
examples.zh: 自從短缺開始，採購成本急遽上升。

examples.en: I work in procurement, so I deal with suppliers every day.
examples.zh: 我在採購部門工作，所以每天都和供應商打交道。

confusable.diff: procedure 是「程序、步驟」，拼法前半很像，但意思不同。

example.en: Please follow the standard procedure for safety checks.
example.zh: 請遵守安全檢查的標準程序。

similar.diff: purchasing 較口語，指日常「買東西」的動作；procurement 較正式，包含找供應商、談判、簽約。

example.en: The purchasing department ordered new office chairs.
example.zh: 採購部門訂購了新的辦公椅。

similar.diff: sourcing 強調「尋找貨源或供應商」，是採購流程中的一個環節。

example.en: Sourcing new suppliers is our top task this month.
example.zh: 尋找新供應商是我們這個月的首要任務。

example.en: We have worked with this vendor for ten years.
example.zh: 我們和這家供應商合作了十年。

example.en: The supplier promised to deliver the goods on time.
example.zh: 供應商承諾會準時交貨。

derived.link: 詞幹 procure（取得）；加 -ment 變名詞 procurement，像 manage → management

extra_vocab.en: to use one thing in place of another
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，substitute a lower-grade alloy for the current material 是「改用較低等級的合金，來取代現有材料」，新的材料（alloy）放在前面。語氣正式，常用於採購或生產調整。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: substitute A for B = 用 A 取代 B（新的放前面）；replace B with A 則是相反的語序（B 在前），容易搞混。

example.en: Our supplier substitutes a cheaper part when stock runs low.
example.zh: 庫存不足時，我們的供應商會改用較便宜的零件。

example.en: The vendor substituted a different model without telling us.
example.zh: 廠商沒有告訴我們就換成了另一個型號。

example.en: Substituting cheaper materials may lower the overall product quality.
example.zh: 改用較便宜的材料可能會降低整體產品品質。

example.en: We substituted recycled paper for the usual packaging.
example.zh: 我們用再生紙取代了平常的包裝。

example.en: No product can substitute for good customer service.
example.zh: 沒有任何產品能取代良好的客戶服務。

example.en: This material is a cheaper substitute for steel.
example.zh: 這種材料是比鋼便宜的替代品。

example.en: You may make a substitution if an item is out of stock.
example.zh: 若品項缺貨，你可以做替換。

examples.en: The factory substituted a cheaper metal for aluminum last month.
examples.zh: 工廠上個月用較便宜的金屬取代了鋁。

examples.en: Can I substitute fruit for the dessert in this set?
examples.zh: 我能把這份套餐的甜點換成水果嗎？

confusable.diff: constitute 是「構成、組成」，拼法後半相似，但意思不同。

example.en: Late payments constitute a serious breach of the contract.
example.zh: 延遲付款構成對合約的嚴重違反。

similar.diff: replace B with A 的語序與 substitute A for B 相反；replace 強調「拿走舊的、換上新的」。

example.en: We replaced the old printer with a faster model.
example.zh: 我們把舊印表機換成較快的機型。

similar.diff: switch to 較口語，指「改用」另一個方案，不一定要提到被取代的對象。

example.en: We plan to switch to a new supplier next month.
example.zh: 我們計畫下個月改用新的供應商。

example.en: We are looking for a cheaper alternative.
example.zh: 我們正在找較便宜的替代方案。

example.en: A replacement part will arrive on Thursday.
example.zh: 更換用的零件星期四會到。

derived.link: substitute 去 e 加 -ion，把「替代」變名詞，像 solve → solution

example.en: The chef substituted olive oil for butter in the recipe.
example.zh: 主廚在食譜裡用橄欖油代替奶油。

example.en: A temporary worker will act as a substitute this week.
example.zh: 本週會有一位臨時員工擔任代班。

senses.en: to use a new thing in place of the old one

example.en: We substituted a stronger metal for the old one.
example.zh: 我們用較強的金屬取代了舊的。

senses.en: to do someone else's job for a short time
senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 人（substitute for a colleague）時，指代理他人的工作。

example.en: Mark will substitute for Anna while she is on leave.
example.zh: 安娜休假時，馬克會代她的班。

extra_vocab.en: the time between placing an order and receiving the goods
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，新材料的 lead time 只要十天，比原本報價的三週短很多。lead time 是採購和供應鏈裡的重要概念，決定訂單要多久前下。
extra_vocab.pattern: the lead time for + N + is + 時間
extra_vocab.grammar_note: lead time 常寫成 a lead time of + 時間 或 the lead time for + 商品；複數用 lead times。

examples.en: The lead time for custom orders is about four weeks.
examples.zh: 客製訂單的前置時間大約四週。

examples.en: A shorter lead time would help us respond to customers faster.
examples.zh: 較短的前置時間能幫助我們更快回應客戶。

examples.en: Please tell us the lead time before we place the order.
examples.zh: 下單之前，請告訴我們前置時間。

similar.diff: delivery time 指「出貨到送達」的時間；lead time 從「下訂單」算到收到貨，涵蓋生產與運送。

example.en: The delivery time to our warehouse is two days.
example.zh: 送到我們倉庫的運送時間是兩天。

similar.diff: turnaround time 指一件工作「從收到到完成」所需的時間，常用於服務或維修。

example.en: The turnaround time for repairs is three business days.
example.zh: 維修的處理時間是三個工作天。

confusable.diff: deadline 是一個「截止時間點」；lead time 是一段「所需的時間長度」。

example.en: The deadline for placing orders is next Friday.
example.zh: 下訂單的截止日是下週五。

extra_vocab.en: in large amounts at one time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，no order will be placed in bulk 表示在測試結果出來前，不會「大量下單」。公司想先確認新材料合格，避免大量採購後才發現有問題。
extra_vocab.pattern: buy / order / purchase + N + in bulk
extra_vocab.grammar_note: in bulk 是副詞片語，中間不加 a 或 the（不說 in a bulk）；放在名詞前當形容詞時用 bulk order、bulk purchase。

examples.en: We usually buy office supplies in bulk to save money.
examples.zh: 我們通常大量購買辦公用品以節省開銷。

examples.en: Customers who order in bulk receive a ten percent discount.
examples.zh: 大量訂購的客戶可享有九折優惠。

examples.en: Buying in bulk reduces the cost per unit significantly.
examples.zh: 大量購買能大幅降低每件的成本。

similar.diff: in large quantities 較正式，強調「數量很多」；in bulk 強調「整批一次買」，常和折扣有關。

example.en: The plant uses this material in large quantities.
example.zh: 這間工廠大量使用這種材料。

similar.diff: wholesale 指「批發」，是賣給零售商的交易方式；in bulk 只說明數量大。

example.en: We buy the goods wholesale and sell them in our shops.
example.zh: 我們批發購入商品，再在店裡販售。

confusable.diff: in stock 是「有現貨」，說明庫存狀態；in bulk 是「大量」，說明購買方式。

example.en: The item is in stock and ready to ship today.
example.zh: 這項商品有現貨，今天就能出貨。

extra_vocab.en: a situation when there is not enough of something
extra_vocab.note: 這篇文章實際用的是 shortage（鋁板短缺），scarcity 是意思相近、較正式的說法，常用來描述原料或資源不夠。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: scarcity 後面常接 of + 名詞（scarcity of aluminum），通常當不可數名詞，不加 s。

example.en: Scarcities of raw materials pushed prices up across the industry.
example.zh: 原料的短缺讓整個產業的價格上漲。

example.en: The scarcity of resources forces us to plan carefully.
example.zh: 資源不足迫使我們必須謹慎規劃。

example.en: A scarcity of skilled workers is slowing our hiring plans.
example.zh: 技術人員短缺正在拖慢我們的招募計畫。

example.en: Prices rose due to scarcity of aluminum in the market.
example.zh: 由於市場上鋁的缺乏，價格上漲了。

examples.en: The scarcity of aluminum sheets has delayed our production schedule.
examples.zh: 鋁板的短缺延誤了我們的生產時程。

examples.en: Scarcity of parts is the biggest risk for this quarter.
examples.zh: 零件不足是本季最大的風險。

examples.en: Scarcity often pushes prices higher, so we should buy early.
examples.zh: 缺貨常讓價格上漲，所以我們應該提早採購。

confusable.diff: security 是「安全、保全」，字尾和 scarcity 很像，但意思無關。

example.en: Security checks may delay deliveries at the border.
example.zh: 安全檢查可能會延誤邊境的貨運。

similar.diff: shortage 是較常用的說法，指某物一時不夠；scarcity 較正式，偏向長期稀少。

example.en: A shortage of drivers is delaying our deliveries this week.
example.zh: 司機不足正在延誤我們本週的送貨。

similar.diff: lack of 是片語，後面接名詞，語氣較一般，表示缺少。

example.en: A lack of storage space is limiting our orders.
example.zh: 儲存空間不足正限制我們的訂單量。

example.en: The shortage of materials may delay the launch.
example.zh: 材料短缺可能會延後上市。

example.en: Our supply of aluminum is running low this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月的鋁供應量愈來愈少。

example.en: Demand for the new model is higher than expected.
example.zh: 新款的需求比預期更高。

derived.link: 詞幹 scarce，加 -ity 變名詞 scarcity，像 able → ability
scarce + -ly，變成副詞，像 hardly、rarely

items.tag: 會員感恩週末促銷廣播廣告

level.why: 廣播廣告含 while 對比、signing up 分詞構句、will be given 被動與 unless 條件子句，並需區分一般折扣、點數兌換加碼、新會員贈品與不可併用等多項優惠條件，干擾項皆取自文中出現過的優惠內容。

items.passage: Attention, loyal customers of Brightway Electronics! This weekend only, our Customer Appreciation Sale offers exclusive discounts of up to 40 percent on selected laptops and tablets. Members who redeem their reward points at the register will receive an additional ten percent off, while anyone signing up for a new membership on the spot will be given a complimentary carrying case. Please note that the discounts cannot be combined with other offers, and the sale ends Sunday at six, unless the items sell out sooner. For details, visit our Web site or speak with any sales associate. We look forward to seeing you.
items.zh: 各位布萊特威電子的忠實顧客請注意！僅限本週末，我們的顧客感恩特賣會針對部分筆記型電腦與平板電腦，提供最高六折的專屬優惠。在櫃檯兌換紅利點數的會員，可再享九折優惠；而當場申辦新會員的顧客，則可獲贈免費的攜行保護套。請注意，這些折扣不能與其他優惠合併使用，特賣會將於週日下午六點結束，若商品提前售完則提早結束。欲知詳情，請上我們的網站，或洽詢任何一位銷售人員。期待您的光臨。

vocab.col: redeem a coupon / redeem reward points
decide on the spot / receive a gift on the spot

questions.q: What will customers who redeem their reward points receive?
opts: Up to 40 percent off all products
why: 免費攜行保護套是送給當場申辦新會員的顧客，不是兌換點數的會員。
正解：在櫃檯兌換紅利點數的會員，可再享額外百分之十的折扣。
最高百分之四十的折扣僅適用於部分筆記型電腦與平板電腦，而非所有商品。
文中沒有提到會員升級。

questions.q: What is mentioned as a restriction on the discounts?
opts: They apply only to online purchases.
They are limited to new members.
They cannot be used together with other offers.
why: 文中沒有說折扣只限網路購物，網站只是提供詳細資訊的管道。
折扣的對象包括現有會員，新會員只是額外獲贈保護套。
文中沒有提到最低消費金額。
正解：廣告明確表示這些折扣不能與其他優惠合併使用。

questions.q: The campaign was so ______ that the company decided to extend it for another week.
why: 正解：successful 是形容詞，與 was so 連用，表示「非常成功」。
success 是名詞，不能放在 was so 之後作補語。
succeed 是動詞，詞性不符。
successfully 是副詞，不能作 was 的補語。

questions.q: Customers will receive a free gift ______ they spend more than 100 dollars in a single transaction.
why: although 表示讓步，與贈品的條件語意不符。
unless 意為「除非」，會變成沒消費超過 100 美元才送贈品，語意相反。
正解：as long as 表示「只要」，說明獲得贈品的條件。
whereas 表示對比，無法表達條件關係。

extra_vocab.en: only for one person or group, and not for everyone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇廣告中，exclusive discounts 指「只有會員才能享有的折扣」，用來強調優惠不是人人都有。廣告裡 exclusive 通常帶有「特別、限定」的正面語感。

example.en: This lounge is reserved exclusively for members of our loyalty program.
example.zh: 這間貴賓室專門保留給我們忠誠計畫的會員。

example.en: The contract gives our partner exclusivity in the Asian market for two years.
example.zh: 這份合約讓我們的夥伴在亞洲市場擁有兩年的獨家權。

example.en: The gold card offers more exclusive benefits than the silver one.
example.zh: 金卡提供的專屬福利比銀卡更多。

example.en: The most exclusive seats are reserved for our top customers.
example.zh: 最頂級的專屬座位保留給我們最重要的顧客。

example.en: This exclusive offer is available to new members only.
example.zh: 這項限定優惠只提供給新會員。

example.en: Our company has exclusive rights to sell this product.
example.zh: 我們公司擁有銷售這項產品的獨家權利。

example.en: Members get exclusive access to the online library.
example.zh: 會員可專屬使用線上圖書館。

example.en: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the CEO.
example.zh: 這本雜誌刊出了對執行長的獨家專訪。

examples.en: Subscribers will receive exclusive previews of our new products.
examples.zh: 訂閱者將收到我們新產品的專屬預覽。

examples.en: The room rate is exclusive of tax and service charges.
examples.zh: 房價不含稅金與服務費。

examples.en: The meeting room is for the exclusive use of managers.
examples.zh: 這間會議室僅供經理使用。

examples.en: The restaurant offers an exclusive menu for private events.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳為私人活動提供專屬菜單。

confusable.diff: inclusive 是「包含在內的」，exclusive 是「不含的、專屬的」。price exclusive of tax 是不含稅，price inclusive of tax 是含稅。

example.en: The price is inclusive of tax, so no extra fees apply.
example.zh: 這個價格含稅，所以不會另外收費。

confusable.diff: limited 強調數量或時間有限；exclusive 強調只有特定的人才能享有。

example.en: This is a limited offer, available for only three days.
example.zh: 這是限量優惠，只提供三天。

example.en: The price excludes shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 這個價格不包括運費與手續費。

example.en: The package includes a free one-year warranty.
example.zh: 這個方案包含免費一年保固。

example.en: The fee is inclusive of all meals and drinks.
example.zh: 這筆費用包含所有餐點與飲料。

example.en: This is a limited offer for the first fifty customers.
example.zh: 這是提供前五十位顧客的限量優惠。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞詞幹，ex-（向外）+ clude（關），把人或物關在外面
exclude + -sion，把「排除」變成名詞，像 decide → decision
exclusive + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully
exclusive + -ity，變成名詞，像 active → activity

example.en: This exclusive offer is only for registered members.
example.zh: 這項專屬優惠只提供給已註冊的會員。

example.en: The newspaper ran an exclusive on the company's merger.
example.zh: 這份報紙刊出了公司合併的獨家報導。

senses.en: only for one person or group

example.en: The sale includes exclusive prices for loyalty members.
example.zh: 這次特賣為忠實會員提供專屬價格。

senses.en: belonging to only one company or person
senses.distinguish: 常接 rights、agreement，指只有一方能做某事。

example.en: We hold exclusive rights to sell the product in Asia.
example.zh: 我們擁有該產品在亞洲的獨家銷售權。

senses.en: not including something
senses.distinguish: 固定用 exclusive of + 名詞，和 inclusive of（含）相反。

example.en: The room rate is exclusive of tax and service charges.
example.zh: 房價不含稅金與服務費。

extra_vocab.en: given to customers for free
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇廣告中，complimentary carrying case 指「免費贈送的提袋」，是新會員的贈品。多益裡 complimentary 多半是「免費提供」的意思，語氣比 free 正式，常見於飯店、航空與廣告。

example.en: The manager paid the team a compliment on their quick work.
example.zh: 經理稱讚團隊工作迅速。

example.en: We received many compliments about the new store layout.
example.zh: 我們收到許多對新店面配置的稱讚。

example.en: I want to compliment your staff for their excellent service.
example.zh: 我想稱讚貴公司員工優質的服務。

example.en: The client complimented our designer on the clear presentation.
example.zh: 客戶稱讚我們的設計師簡報清楚。

example.en: She always compliments her team after a successful project.
example.zh: 每次專案成功後，她總會稱讚她的團隊。

example.en: The director is complimenting the staff on their teamwork.
example.zh: 主任正在稱讚員工的團隊合作。

example.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 這家飯店每天早上提供免費早餐。

example.en: Each speaker will receive two complimentary tickets to the show.
example.zh: 每位講者將獲得兩張這場表演的招待券。

example.en: Customers who spend over fifty dollars get a complimentary gift.
example.zh: 消費超過五十美元的顧客可獲得免費贈品。

example.en: We will send you a complimentary copy of the report.
example.zh: 我們會寄給您一份報告的贈閱本。

examples.en: Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the building.
examples.zh: 住客可在整棟建築內使用免費無線網路。

examples.en: Passengers in first class receive complimentary drinks during the flight.
examples.zh: 頭等艙乘客在飛行期間可享用免費飲料。

examples.en: Thank you for your order. A complimentary sample is enclosed.
examples.zh: 感謝您的訂購，隨函附上免費試用品。

examples.en: The reviewer was very complimentary about the new design.
examples.zh: 評論者對新設計讚譽有加。

confusable.diff: complementary /ˌkɑːmpləˈmentri/ 是「互補的」，發音幾乎相同，只差一個字母。complimentary 是「免費的、讚美的」。

example.en: The two products are complementary, so we sell them as a set.
example.zh: 這兩項產品可以互補，所以我們把它們當成一組販售。

confusable.diff: free 是日常用語；complimentary 較正式，常指企業為了服務或表達感謝而免費提供的東西。

example.en: Shipping is free for all orders over fifty dollars.
example.zh: 訂單超過五十美元一律免運費。

example.en: Every new member will receive a small gift.
example.zh: 每位新會員都會收到一份小禮物。

example.en: Shipping is free for orders over one hundred dollars.
example.zh: 訂單超過一百美元可免運費。

example.en: You can use this voucher at any of our stores.
example.zh: 您可以在我們任何一家分店使用這張優惠券。

example.en: Staff members receive a discount on all products.
example.zh: 員工購買所有產品都可享折扣。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，意思是稱讚；compliment + -ary 變形容詞，像 voluntary、temporary

senses.en: given to customers for free

example.en: Guests receive a complimentary drink at the reception.
example.zh: 賓客在接待處可獲得一杯免費飲料。

senses.en: saying good things about someone or something
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人、後面接 about 時，指稱讚；接贈品或服務時才是免費。

example.en: The manager was very complimentary about her report.
example.zh: 經理對她的報告讚不絕口。

extra_vocab.en: to exchange points, a coupon, or a voucher for a discount or a gift
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，redeem their reward points 是會員在櫃檯「用紅利點數兌換」折扣。促銷廣告和會員制度中很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型是 redeem + 點數／優惠券 + for + 贈品或折扣，或 redeem + 點數 + at + 地點。

example.en: Each customer who redeems a coupon receives a free gift.
example.zh: 每位兌換優惠券的顧客都會收到一份免費贈品。

example.en: All unused vouchers must be redeemed before the end of June.
example.zh: 所有未使用的禮券必須在六月底前兌換。

example.en: Customers redeeming points online will see the discount at checkout.
example.zh: 在線上兌換點數的顧客會在結帳時看到折扣。

example.en: You can redeem your points for a free coffee.
example.zh: 你可以用點數兌換一杯免費咖啡。

example.en: Please redeem your coupon before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前使用你的優惠券。

example.en: Guests may redeem the voucher at any of our hotels.
example.zh: 賓客可在我們任何一家飯店兌換這張禮券。

example.en: Customers can redeem ten stamps for a free meal.
example.zh: 顧客可以用十個點數換一份免費餐點。

examples.en: Members may redeem their rewards at the register.
examples.zh: 會員可以在櫃檯兌換他們的回饋。

examples.en: The code can only be redeemed once per customer.
examples.zh: 這組代碼每位顧客只能兌換一次。

confusable.diff: refund 是「退還現金」，redeem 是用點數或憑證「換取」折扣或商品。

example.en: We will refund the full amount within five business days.
example.zh: 我們會在五個工作天內全額退款。

similar.diff: exchange 是一般的「交換、換貨」；redeem 特指用點數、優惠券或憑證換取。

example.en: You may exchange the item within thirty days.
example.zh: 你可以在三十天內換貨。

similar.diff: cash in 較口語，強調把點數或憑證換成現金或好處。

example.en: Many members cash in their points at the end of the year.
example.zh: 許多會員在年底兌換他們的點數。

example.en: Show this coupon to get ten percent off.
example.zh: 出示這張優惠券就能享九折。

example.en: Each guest received a dinner voucher.
example.zh: 每位賓客都收到一張晚餐禮券。

example.en: Loyal customers earn rewards on every purchase.
example.zh: 忠實顧客每次購物都能累積回饋。

derived.link: redeem + -able，「可以被兌換的」，像 comfortable、available

extra_vocab.en: at once, right there and then
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，signing up for a new membership on the spot 是「當場加入新會員」，也就是在店裡現場辦理，就能立刻拿到贈品。語氣帶有促銷的吸引力。
extra_vocab.pattern: V + N + on the spot
extra_vocab.grammar_note: on the spot 是固定片語，the 不能省略（不說 on spot），通常放在句尾修飾動詞。

examples.en: Customers who sign up on the spot receive a free gift.
examples.zh: 當場註冊的顧客可獲得一份免費贈品。

examples.en: The manager made the decision on the spot.
examples.zh: 經理當場做了決定。

examples.en: The technician fixed the problem on the spot.
examples.zh: 技術人員當場解決了問題。

similar.diff: right away 強調「馬上、不拖延」；on the spot 強調「在現場、當下」就完成。

example.en: Please send me the report right away.
example.zh: 請馬上把報告寄給我。

similar.diff: immediately 較正式，單純說「立即」；on the spot 還帶有「在當場」的畫面感。

example.en: Please call the client immediately after the meeting.
example.zh: 會議結束後請立即打電話給客戶。

confusable.diff: on site 是「在現場、在場地」，說明地點；on the spot 是「當場」，說明時間與動作的立即性。

example.en: Our engineers are available on site during the event.
example.zh: 活動期間，我們的工程師會在現場待命。

extra_vocab.en: to join two or more things together
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，cannot be combined with other offers 是促銷廣告常見的限制：這個折扣「不能與其他優惠合併使用」。這裡用被動語態。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: combine A with B 或 combine A and B 都可以；被動用 be combined with，表示「與…結合、合併使用」。

example.en: This package combines a laptop, a mouse, and a one-year warranty.
example.zh: 這個套裝組合包含一台筆電、一個滑鼠和一年保固。

example.en: The two departments combined their budgets to buy new equipment.
example.zh: 兩個部門合併了預算來購買新設備。

example.en: Combining the two reports saved us a lot of time.
example.zh: 把兩份報告合併起來為我們省下許多時間。

collocations.zh: 把 A 和 B 結合

example.en: The new plan combines low prices with fast delivery.
example.zh: 新方案結合了低價和快速送貨。

example.en: This coupon cannot be combined with any other discount.
example.zh: 這張優惠券不能與其他折扣合併使用。

example.en: The combined total of both orders is $3,200.
example.zh: 兩筆訂單合計是 3,200 美元。

example.en: The two firms combined forces to launch the product.
example.zh: 兩家公司聯手推出這項產品。

examples.en: We plan to combine the two departments next year.
examples.zh: 我們計畫明年合併這兩個部門。

examples.en: She combined a business trip with a short vacation.
examples.zh: 她把出差和一段短暫的假期結合在一起。

similar.diff: merge 多指公司、檔案或系統「合併成一個」；combine 是把幾個東西結合，不一定變成一個。

example.en: The two banks will merge in the spring.
example.zh: 這兩家銀行會在春天合併。

similar.diff: mix 較口語，指把東西混在一起，常用於材料或顏色。

example.en: Mix the two samples before you start the test.
example.zh: 開始測試前，先把兩個樣品混合。

example.en: The company merged with a larger competitor.
example.zh: 這家公司與一家較大的競爭對手合併了。

example.en: The bundle includes a laptop and a carrying case.
example.zh: 這個套裝包含一台筆電和一個攜帶包。

derived.link: combine + -ation，「結合」變名詞，像 organize → organization
combine + -d，「被結合的」，如 combined effort（共同努力）

extra_vocab.en: a person who works with you or has a job in a company
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sales associate 是店內的「業務專員」，也就是零售業中負責接待客人的店員。廣告請顧客有問題可詢問任何一位專員。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 動詞 associate 是 associate A with B（把 A 和 B 聯想在一起），with 不能換成 to；常用被動 be associated with。

example.en: Store associates wear name badges so customers can find them easily.
example.zh: 店內專員會配戴名牌，方便顧客找到他們。

example.en: Delays are usually associated with poor communication between teams.
example.zh: 延誤通常與團隊之間溝通不良有關。

example.en: Many shoppers keep associating this brand with low prices.
example.zh: 許多購物者一直把這個品牌和低價聯想在一起。

example.en: A sales associate will help you choose a laptop.
example.zh: 一位銷售專員會協助你挑選筆電。

example.en: I met a business associate at the trade fair.
example.zh: 我在貿易展上見到一位生意夥伴。

example.en: Customers often associate our brand with quality.
example.zh: 顧客常把我們的品牌和品質聯想在一起。

example.en: Several risks are associated with this project.
example.zh: 這個專案有幾項相關風險。

examples.en: Please ask any sales associate for more information.
examples.zh: 想知道更多資訊，請詢問任何一位銷售專員。

examples.en: Our associates will contact you within two business days.
examples.zh: 我們的專員會在兩個工作天內與你聯絡。

confusable.diff: assistant 是「助理」，協助主管做事；associate 是同層級的「專員、夥伴」。
