example.en: My assistant will schedule the meeting for Tuesday.
example.zh: 我的助理會把會議排在星期二。

similar.diff: colleague 指同一間公司、同事務的「同事」；associate 也可指生意往來的夥伴。

example.en: I discussed the plan with a colleague from finance.
example.zh: 我和財務部的一位同事討論了這個計畫。

similar.diff: representative 是「代表」，代表公司與客戶接觸；sales associate 較常用在零售店面。

example.en: A sales representative will visit your office next week.
example.zh: 一位業務代表下週會拜訪你的辦公室。

example.en: A colleague will cover my shift tomorrow.
example.zh: 明天會有一位同事代我的班。

example.en: A customer service representative answered my call.
example.zh: 一位客服代表接了我的電話。

derived.link: associate 去 e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 organize → organization

example.en: The store hired three new sales associates this month.
example.zh: 這家店這個月僱用了三位新的銷售專員。

example.en: People associate this brand with reliable service.
example.zh: 人們把這個品牌和可靠的服務聯想在一起。

example.en: She was promoted to associate director last year.
example.zh: 她去年升任副主任。

senses.en: an employee who helps customers in a store

example.en: Ask the associate at the counter about the discount.
example.zh: 請向櫃檯的專員詢問折扣。

senses.en: a person you work with in business
senses.distinguish: 和 business 連用（business associate）時，指生意往來的夥伴。

example.en: He introduced me to a business associate from Seoul.
example.zh: 他介紹我認識一位來自首爾的生意夥伴。

items.tag: 維護合約到期續約與議價對話

level.why: 兩人對話含 so、but、if 引導的複合句與假設語氣（would accept、might waive），需整合到期時間、漲價幅度、延長合約年限的交換條件與後續分工。干擾項多取自對話中提到的費用與行動，需分辨由誰負責。

items.passage:
Woman: Our maintenance contract expires at the end of this month, so we should decide whether to renew it.

Man: The vendor is asking for a five percent increase, but I suspect they would accept a lower rate if we agreed to a longer term.

Woman: That makes sense. If we signed for three years instead of one, they might even waive the installation fee.

Man: I'll call them tomorrow. Could you check whether canceling early would carry a penalty?

Woman: Sure. I'll review the terms and let you know this afternoon.
items.zh:
女：我們的維護合約在這個月底到期，所以我們應該決定要不要續約。

男：不過，廠商要求漲價百分之五，但我猜如果我們同意較長的合約期限，他們會接受較低的費率。

女：有道理。如果我們簽三年而不是一年，他們甚至可能免收安裝費。

男：我明天會打電話給他們。你可以查一下提前解約是否需要付違約金嗎？

女：沒問題。我會檢視合約條款，今天下午再告訴你。

vocab.col: contract expires / expire at the end of the month
renew a contract / renew a subscription
waive a fee / waive a requirement

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
opts: Whether to continue a service agreement
why: 對話中仍以現有廠商為對象討論續約，沒有提到更換新廠商。
漲價是廠商提出的條件，他們討論的不是增加維修預算。
正解：兩人討論維護合約即將到期，是否要續約以及如何議價。
對話中沒有提到逾期未付的款項。

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
opts: Look into the cost of ending the agreement early
Call the vendor to negotiate a lower rate
Request a waiver of the installation fee
why: 正解：男子請她確認提前解約是否有違約金，她答應檢視條款並於下午回覆。
打電話給廠商議價的人是男子，不是女子。
簽三年約只是假設性的提議，尚未決定，也不是女子接下來要做的事。
免收安裝費是女子提出的可能談判結果，並不是她接下來要採取的行動。

questions.q: Payments received ______ the due date will be subject to a late fee.
why: since 表示自某時間點起，不能用來表達在截止日之後收到款項。
during 後面通常接一段期間，不適合搭配 the due date 表示截止日。
within 表示在期限之內，語意與收取逾期費相反。
正解：after the due date 表示在截止日之後，符合收取逾期費的情境。

questions.q: The auditors requested ______ documentation to support the quarterly expenses.
why: add 是動詞，不能直接修飾名詞 documentation。
正解：additional 是形容詞，修飾名詞 documentation，表示額外的文件。
additionally 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞。
addition 是名詞，不能放在名詞前作修飾語，且文法上不通順。

extra_vocab.en: to end because the time allowed has finished
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，Our maintenance contract expires at the end of this month 表示維護合約本月底就到期，所以兩人要討論是否續約。expire 的主詞通常是合約、證件、優惠等有期限的東西，不用於人，且不接受詞。

example.en: The warranty on this laptop expires after two years of use.
example.zh: 這台筆電的保固在使用兩年後到期。

example.en: My passport expired last week, so I cannot travel on Monday.
example.zh: 我的護照上週到期了，所以星期一無法出差。

example.en: Several expiring contracts need to be reviewed before the end of June.
example.zh: 好幾份即將到期的合約必須在六月底前審閱。

example.en: The expiration of the lease gave us a chance to negotiate.
example.zh: 租約到期讓我們有機會重新議價。

example.en: Your membership will expire on December 31.
example.zh: 您的會員資格將在十二月三十一日到期。

example.en: Please check the expiration date on your passport.
example.zh: 請確認您護照上的有效期限。

example.en: The special offer is about to expire this Friday.
example.zh: 這項特別優惠將在本週五到期。

example.en: An expired contract must be renewed before the service continues.
example.zh: 已到期的合約必須先續約，服務才能繼續。

examples.en: Our lease expires in June, so we need to start looking for a new office.
examples.zh: 我們的租約六月到期，所以必須開始找新辦公室。

examples.en: This is a reminder that your software license will expire next week.
examples.zh: 提醒您，您的軟體授權將在下週到期。

examples.en: The coupon expired yesterday, but we can still offer a small discount.
examples.zh: 這張優惠券昨天已到期，但我們仍可提供小額折扣。

confusable.diff: end 泛指結束，主詞可以是會議、活動、關係等；expire 專指有期限的東西（合約、證件、優惠）時間到而失效。

example.en: The training session will end at noon, followed by lunch.
example.zh: 訓練課程將在中午結束，接著是午餐。

confusable.diff: terminate 指由某一方主動終止合約或關係，語氣正式；expire 是期限自然屆滿，不是任何一方主動結束。

example.en: Either party may terminate the agreement with thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以書面通知三十天後終止協議。

example.en: The expiration of the contract is next month.
example.zh: 合約下個月屆滿。

example.en: The deadline for the application is May 10.
example.zh: 申請截止日是五月十日。

example.en: This ticket is valid for three months.
example.zh: 這張票的有效期限是三個月。

derived.link: expire + -ation，把「到期」變成名詞，像 explore → exploration
expire 的 e 換成 y，變成名詞，英式用法較常見

extra_vocab.en: to continue something for another period of time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，decide whether to renew it 的 it 指維護合約，意思是決定是否要續約一段新的期間。renew 常用於合約、會員、證照、訂閱，表示在到期前延長有效期限。

example.en: The software license renews automatically every year unless you cancel it.
example.zh: 除非你取消，否則這個軟體授權每年會自動續約。

example.en: We renewed our insurance policy yesterday for another twelve months.
example.zh: 我們昨天把保單又續了十二個月。

example.en: Renewing the lease early may help us get a better rate.
example.zh: 提早續租也許能讓我們拿到比較好的價格。

example.en: Your renewal is due next week, so please check the payment details.
example.zh: 您的續約下週到期，請確認付款資料。

example.en: We decided to renew the contract for another year.
example.zh: 我們決定再續簽合約一年。

example.en: You can renew your membership online in just a few minutes.
example.zh: 您可以在線上幾分鐘內完成續辦會員。

example.en: All drivers must renew their licenses every five years.
example.zh: 所有駕駛人都必須每五年更新一次駕照。

example.en: The company sent a renewal notice two months before the deadline.
example.zh: 公司在截止日前兩個月寄出了續約通知。

examples.en: If you renew early, we can offer you a ten percent discount.
examples.zh: 如果您提早續約，我們可以給您九折優惠。

examples.en: I would like to renew my subscription before it ends.
examples.zh: 我想在訂閱期限結束前續訂。

examples.en: We will decide next week whether to renew the supplier agreement.
examples.zh: 我們下週會決定是否續簽供應商協議。

confusable.diff: extend 是把原有期限延長（extend the deadline），不一定重新簽約；renew 通常指簽新的一期，讓合約或資格重新開始計算。

example.en: Can you extend the deadline for the report until Friday?
example.zh: 你可以把報告的截止日延到週五嗎？

confusable.diff: renovate 指整修建築或空間；renew 指延續合約、資格，或使某物恢復新的狀態，兩者意思不同。

example.en: The company will renovate the lobby before the new year.
example.zh: 公司將在新年前整修大廳。

example.en: The renewal fee is due by the end of the month.
example.zh: 續約費用須在月底前繳交。

example.en: Can we extend the contract for six months?
example.zh: 我們可以把合約延長六個月嗎？

example.en: My subscription to the magazine ends in July.
example.zh: 我對那份雜誌的訂閱在七月結束。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，re-（再次）+ new，讓它再度變新
renew + -al，把「續約」變成名詞，像 arrive → arrival
renew + -able，可以被…的，像 available、readable

senses.en: to continue something for another period of time

example.en: You can renew your library card online for a year.
example.zh: 你可以在線上把圖書證續辦一年。

senses.en: to start something again with new energy
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 efforts、interest 等抽象事物時，指重振，與期限無關。

example.en: The two companies agreed to renew their efforts to cut costs.
example.zh: 兩家公司同意重新努力降低成本。

extra_vocab.en: to choose not to ask for a payment or follow a rule
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，they might even waive the installation fee 表示廠商可能會免收安裝費，作為簽三年長約的優惠。waive 的受詞通常是費用、罰款或規定，主詞是有權決定的一方，如公司或廠商。

example.en: Our bank waives the monthly fee when you keep a minimum balance.
example.zh: 只要您維持最低餘額，我們銀行就免收月費。

example.en: The landlord waived the late payment penalty for this month.
example.zh: 房東免除了這個月的逾期付款罰款。

example.en: Waiving the setup fee helped us win several new customers.
example.zh: 免收設定費幫助我們爭取到幾位新客戶。

example.en: The waiver explains which risks the visitor accepts when using the equipment.
example.zh: 這份棄權書說明訪客使用設備時所接受的風險。

example.en: The bank agreed to waive the late fee this time.
example.zh: 銀行同意這次免收逾期費。

example.en: The manager waived the requirement for a deposit.
example.zh: 經理免除了需要繳交訂金的要求。

example.en: They will waive the delivery charge for orders over 100 dollars.
example.zh: 滿一百美元的訂單，他們會免收運費。

example.en: Students can apply for a fee waiver on the website.
example.zh: 學生可以在網站上申請費用豁免。

examples.en: If you call today, we will waive the setup fee.
examples.zh: 如果您今天來電，我們會免收設定費。

examples.en: We are happy to waive the penalty because this was our mistake.
examples.zh: 這是我們的錯，所以我們很樂意免除罰款。

examples.en: The hotel waived the cancellation fee after the flight was canceled.
examples.zh: 班機取消後，飯店免除了取消費。

confusable.diff: refund 是把已付的錢退還；waive 是一開始就不收取費用，不涉及退款。

example.en: The shop gave us a full refund after the order arrived late.
example.zh: 訂單延遲送達後，商店給了我們全額退款。

confusable.diff: cancel 是取消整件事（訂單、合約）；waive 只是免除其中某項費用或要求，合約仍然有效。

example.en: Please cancel my order if it cannot ship before Monday.
example.zh: 如果週一前無法出貨，請取消我的訂單。

example.en: Please sign the waiver before joining the program.
example.zh: 參加課程之前，請先簽署棄權書。

example.en: Some items are exempt from the delivery fee.
example.zh: 部分商品可免收運費。

example.en: We offer a discount for early payment.
example.zh: 提早付款可享折扣。

derived.link: waive + -er，做動作的東西或文件，像 printer；指免除權利或費用的文件

extra_vocab.en: a fixed length of time, such as the length of a contract
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a longer term 是「較長的合約期間」。男子認為只要簽比較久的合約，廠商可能願意降低費率。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指合約「期間」時用單數（a three-year term）；指「條款、條件」時一定用複數 terms（the terms of the contract）。

example.en: The vendor agreed to change several terms of the service contract.
example.zh: 廠商同意更改服務合約的幾項條款。

example.en: We are looking for a long-term partner for this project.
example.zh: 我們在為這個專案尋找長期的合作夥伴。

example.en: A short-term contract gives us more flexibility.
example.zh: 短期合約讓我們更有彈性。

example.en: Please read the terms and conditions before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請先閱讀條款與條件。

example.en: In terms of price, this vendor is the best choice.
example.zh: 就價格而言，這家廠商是最佳選擇。

examples.en: The term of this agreement is two years.
examples.zh: 這份協議的期間是兩年。

examples.en: We should review the terms before we renew.
examples.zh: 續約之前，我們應該先檢視條款。

confusable.diff: team 是「團隊」，拼法和 term 只差一個字母，要小心看清楚。

example.en: The legal team will review the contract terms.
example.zh: 法務團隊會審查合約條款。

similar.diff: period 是一般的「一段期間」；term 特指合約、任期或學期等有固定長度的期間。

example.en: The trial period lasts for thirty days.
example.zh: 試用期為期三十天。

similar.diff: duration 較正式，指「持續多久」；term 強調有固定起訖的期限。

example.en: The duration of the service is twelve months.
example.zh: 這項服務的期間為十二個月。

example.en: The contract will expire at the end of June.
example.zh: 這份合約會在六月底到期。

example.en: The renewal notice was sent last week.
example.zh: 續約通知上週已寄出。

example.en: The duration of the training is three days.
example.zh: 訓練的時間為三天。

senses.en: a fixed length of time

example.en: The term of the lease is three years.
example.zh: 租約的期間是三年。

senses.en: the rules and conditions of an agreement
senses.distinguish: 一定用複數 terms，常搭配 contract、agreement、payment。

example.en: The payment terms are thirty days from the invoice date.
example.zh: 付款條件是發票日起三十天。

senses.en: a word or phrase used for a special subject
senses.distinguish: 常和 technical、legal 連用，指專業術語。

example.en: Please explain this technical term to the client.
example.zh: 請向客戶說明這個技術術語。

extra_vocab.en: money you must pay when you break a rule or agreement
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，carry a penalty 是「附帶罰款」：男子請女子查看提早解約會不會被罰款或收違約金。這是續約或解約討論中很實際的問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 penalty for + 名詞或 V-ing（a penalty for late payment）；「被罰」常說 pay a penalty、incur a penalty，或事情 carry a penalty。

example.en: Late deliveries may result in penalties under this agreement.
example.zh: 依據這份協議，延遲交貨可能會被處以罰款。

example.en: We had to pay a penalty for the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們必須為延遲交貨支付罰款。

example.en: A late penalty of five percent applies after the due date.
example.zh: 逾期後會加收百分之五的罰款。

example.en: The contract includes an early termination penalty of $2,000.
example.zh: 合約包含兩千美元的提前解約違約金。

example.en: You can cancel the booking without penalty before Friday.
example.zh: 星期五前取消預訂不會被罰。

examples.en: Breaking this agreement may result in a heavy penalty.
examples.zh: 違反這份協議可能會被處以重罰。

examples.en: Please note that late payments will incur a penalty.
examples.zh: 請注意，逾期付款會被收取罰款。

similar.diff: fine 常是政府或主管機關開出的「罰金」；penalty 範圍較廣，也包含合約中的違約金。

example.en: The company paid a fine for breaking the safety law.
example.zh: 公司因違反安全法規而繳了罰金。

similar.diff: surcharge 是「額外加收的費用」，不一定是處罰；penalty 帶有「違規被罰」的意思。

example.en: A fuel surcharge was added to the bill.
example.zh: 帳單上加收了燃料附加費。

example.en: A cancellation fee applies after the deadline.
example.zh: 截止日之後取消要收取取消費。

example.en: There is no charge for the first repair.
example.zh: 第一次維修免費。

example.en: The deposit will be returned after the contract ends.
example.zh: 訂金會在合約結束後退還。

derived.link: penal- 表示「處罰」，加 -ize 變動詞，像 organize、realize

items.tag: 簡報／提案：線上培訓平台提案簡報

level.why: 以員工培訓改採線上平台的提案簡報為情境，內容需整合現況問題、解決方案、成本比較與後續步驟。句型含 because、while、although、until 等連接詞與被動語態，字彙屬中高階商務用語，但整體結構清楚，難度略低於上一週 D7。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for making time for today's meeting. I'd like to walk you through our proposal to replace our in-person training workshops with an online learning platform.

As you can see from last year's survey, employees spent an average of twelve working days attending workshops, and many reported that the sessions were difficult to fit around their regular duties. Moreover, because instructors must be hired for each session, the cost of training has risen steadily. To address these concerns, we recommend a platform that would allow staff to complete courses at their own pace, while managers track progress through a single dashboard.

The annual subscription is quoted at 36,000 dollars, which is roughly 30 percent lower than what we currently spend. Although some employees may need time to adjust, we believe the flexibility will outweigh the initial inconvenience.

If the proposal is approved today, the first step will be to select a vendor by the end of this month. I'd like to stress that no agreement will be signed until the legal team has reviewed the draft. That concludes my presentation, and I'd be glad to take any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安，感謝大家撥冗參加今天的會議。我想帶大家了解我們的提案：以線上學習平台取代目前的實體培訓工作坊。

如同大家從去年的問卷調查中所看到的，員工平均花了十二個工作天參加工作坊，而且許多人表示，這些課程很難安排在日常職務之間。此外，由於每場課程都必須聘請講師，培訓成本一直在穩定上升。為了解決這些問題，我們建議採用一個平台，讓員工能依自己的步調完成課程，同時讓主管透過單一儀表板追蹤進度。

年度訂閱費的報價為三萬六千美元，大約比我們目前的支出低百分之三十。雖然有些員工可能需要時間適應，但我們相信這種彈性的好處會超過初期的不便。

如果提案今天獲得核准，第一步就是在本月底前選定廠商。我想特別強調，在法務團隊審閱完草案之前，不會簽署任何協議。以上就是我的簡報，我很樂意回答各位的問題。

items.tag: 1. Introduction — The Evolution of Infant Car Seat Systems

level.why: 口語簡報開場，句子短而清楚，以簡單句與 because、but、so 連接的複合句為主；字彙包含 integrated、baseless、ISOFIX connectors 等產品專有詞，但上下文有明確解釋，屬 B1+ 程度。

items.passage:
Next, I'd like to introduce another infant car seat concept. It's called Pocket Click.

Before I get into the product itself, let me briefly talk about how infant car seat systems have evolved.

First, we have the traditional base system. You install the base in the car, and then you can easily click the infant car seat in and out whenever you need it.

Later, Nuna introduced the PIPA urbn, a baseless infant car seat with integrated LATCH connectors.

With this design, the LATCH connectors are built directly into the car seat, so you don't need to carry a separate base. This makes it more convenient when traveling or using rental cars.

Both systems have their own advantages.

A traditional base is great for everyday use because you can leave it in the car and quickly click the car seat in and out.

But when traveling, carrying a separate base can be inconvenient.

A baseless car seat is easier to travel with, and it can be installed using LATCH instead of relying only on the vehicle's seat belt.

However, without a dedicated base, you need to connect both LATCH connectors each time you install the car seat.

This makes installation less convenient than simply clicking the car seat onto a pre-installed base.

So we started thinking: What if we could combine the everyday convenience of a traditional base with the travel convenience of a baseless car seat?

And that's where the idea for Pocket Click came from.
items.zh:
接下來，我想介紹另一款嬰兒汽車安全座椅的概念，它叫做 Pocket Click。

在正式介紹產品之前，讓我先簡短談談嬰兒汽座系統是如何演變的。

首先是傳統的底座系統。你把底座安裝在車上，之後每當需要時，就能輕鬆地把嬰兒汽座卡進去或取出來。

後來，Nuna 推出了 PIPA urbn，一款整合 LATCH 接頭的無底座嬰兒汽座。

這種設計把 LATCH 接頭直接內建在汽座上，所以你不需要另外攜帶底座。這讓旅行或使用租賃車時更加方便。

這兩種系統各有各的優點。

傳統底座很適合日常使用，因為你可以把它留在車上，快速地把汽座卡進去或取出來。

但是在旅行時，攜帶一個獨立的底座可能會很不方便。

無底座汽座比較方便旅行攜帶，而且可以使用 LATCH 安裝，不必只依靠車子的安全帶。

然而，沒有專用底座的話，每次安裝汽座時，你都需要把兩個 LATCH 接頭都接上。

這讓安裝比起直接把汽座卡到事先裝好的底座上更不方便。

於是我們開始思考：如果我們能把傳統底座的日常便利，與無底座汽座的旅行便利結合在一起呢？

而這就是 Pocket Click 這個點子的由來。

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly doing in this part of the talk?
opts: Comparing the prices of two car seat brands
Introducing a new car seat concept by reviewing how car seat systems developed
Explaining how to install a car seat in a rental car
Announcing a change to the product schedule
why: 講者沒有提到任何品牌的價格比較。
正解：講者先說要介紹 Pocket Click，並在介紹產品前回顧嬰兒汽座系統的演變。
文中只提到無底座汽座在使用租賃車時比較方便，並沒有說明在租賃車裡的安裝步驟。
文中沒有提到任何時程變更。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about a traditional base system when traveling?
opts: It cannot be clicked into the car seat
It is too heavy to leave in the car
It needs special connectors built into the seat
Carrying a separate base can be inconvenient
why: 傳統底座系統正是讓汽座可以卡進去、取出來的設計。
講者說可以把底座留在車上，並沒有說它太重。
把 LATCH 接頭內建在汽座上的是無底座汽座，不是傳統底座。
正解：講者說旅行時攜帶獨立的底座可能會很不方便。

questions.q: What question does the speaker raise before introducing the idea for Pocket Click?
opts: Whether the everyday convenience of a base can be combined with the travel convenience of a baseless seat
Whether LATCH connectors can be made cheaper
Whether rental car companies could provide their own bases
Whether parents prefer car seats that do not click in and out
why: 正解：講者問道，能不能把傳統底座的日常便利與無底座汽座的旅行便利結合起來。
文中沒有討論 LATCH 接頭的成本。
租賃車只在說明無底座汽座的便利時被提到，講者沒有提出租車公司提供底座的想法。
講者沒有提到家長偏好不能卡進去、取出來的汽座。

questions.q: Several airlines now allow passengers to ______ their own car seats on board.
why: 錯誤：bringing 是動名詞或現在分詞，不能接在 allow passengers to 後面。
錯誤：brought 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在不定詞 to 後面。
正解：allow + 人 + to + 原形動詞，所以要用 bring，表示「讓乘客攜帶自己的汽座登機」。
錯誤：brings 是第三人稱單數動詞，不能接在不定詞 to 後面。

questions.q: Please read the manual carefully before you ______ the car seat in your vehicle.
why: 錯誤：installer 是名詞，指安裝的人，不能當動詞用。
正解：before you 後面要接動詞，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 install，表示「安裝」。
錯誤：installation 是名詞，不能直接接在主詞 you 後面。
錯誤：主詞 you 不是第三人稱單數，動詞不能加 s。

questions.q: ______ the seat is lightweight, it is easy to carry through the airport.
why: 錯誤：Unless 表示「除非」，語意不通順。
錯誤：Until 表示「直到」，語意不通順。
錯誤：Although 表示「雖然」，但前後句是因果關係，不是轉折。
正解：Because 表示「因為」，座椅很輕是容易攜帶的原因。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, I'd like to introduce another infant car seat concept.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接下來，我想介紹另一款嬰兒汽座的概念。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報中從一項產品轉到下一項時使用，Next 是轉換訊號，I'd like to introduce 語氣客氣而正式。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Before I get into the product itself, let me briefly talk about how the systems have evolved.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 在正式介紹產品之前，讓我先簡短談談這些系統是如何演變的。
presentation_phrases.usage: 介紹產品前先交代背景時使用，get into 表示「開始談論」，briefly 提醒聽眾背景部分不會太長。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, we have the traditional base system.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 首先是傳統的底座系統。
presentation_phrases.usage: 依序列舉幾種做法或產品時的第一項，後面可接 Later、Next 等字帶出下一項。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Later, Nuna introduced the PIPA urbn, a baseless infant car seat with integrated LATCH connectors.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 後來，Nuna 推出了 PIPA urbn，一款整合 LATCH 接頭的無底座嬰兒汽座。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明產品演進、帶出下一階段的代表產品時使用，Later 銜接前一個階段，introduced 引出新產品，後面接同位語補充產品的特色。

presentation_phrases.phrase: This makes it more convenient when traveling or using rental cars.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這讓旅行或使用租賃車時更加方便。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明某個設計帶來的好處時使用，This makes it + 形容詞 + when... 是常見的好處說明句型。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Both systems have their own advantages.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這兩種系統各有各的優點。
presentation_phrases.usage: 比較兩個選項、提出公平的結論之前使用，語氣中立，常接 But 帶出缺點或限制。

presentation_phrases.phrase: So we started thinking: What if we could combine the two?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 於是我們開始思考：如果我們能把兩者結合起來呢？
presentation_phrases.usage: 從問題導向新構想時使用，What if 引出假設性的問題，能吸引聽眾期待接下來的解決方案。

presentation_phrases.phrase: And that's where the idea for Pocket Click came from.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 而這就是 Pocket Click 這個點子的由來。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明產品靈感或開發原因時的收尾句，that's where... came from 讓背景與產品自然銜接。

extra_vocab.en: to change slowly and develop over time
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡指嬰兒汽座系統隨著時間一步步改良與演變。have evolved 用現在完成式，表示「一路演變到現在」，常用在簡報開場交代背景。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: evolve 是不及物動詞，後面不能直接接受詞；要說「演變成／由…演變而來」時用 evolve into／evolve from。

example.en: Our software evolves as customers give us new feedback.
example.zh: 我們的軟體會隨著客戶給的新意見而不斷演進。

example.en: The company evolved from a small shop into a global brand.
example.zh: 這家公司從一間小店演變成全球品牌。

example.en: Customer needs are evolving quickly in the travel market.
example.zh: 旅遊市場中的客戶需求正快速演變。

example.en: A small project can evolve into a major product line.
example.zh: 一個小專案可能演變成主要的產品線。

example.en: Office rules often evolve over time as the company grows.
example.zh: 公司成長時，辦公室規定常會隨時間演變。

example.en: Good products often evolve from simple customer requests.
example.zh: 好產品往往由簡單的客戶需求演變而來。

examples.en: Our marketing plan has evolved since last year's meeting.
examples.zh: 自從去年的會議以來，我們的行銷計畫已經有所演變。

examples.en: As the project evolves, I will keep you updated by email.
examples.zh: 隨著專案演進，我會用電子郵件隨時向你更新。

examples.en: Let me show how our product has evolved over three years.
examples.zh: 讓我說明我們的產品在三年間是如何演變的。

confusable.diff: involve 是「涉及、包含」，拼法和 evolve 很像，但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: evolve 是不及物動詞，不接受詞；involve 是及物動詞，後面一定要接受詞。

example.en: This job involves meeting clients and writing weekly reports.
example.zh: 這份工作包含會見客戶和撰寫每週報告。

similar.diff: develop 可以接受詞（develop a product），evolve 強調自然、逐步的改變，不接受詞。

example.en: We plan to develop a new mobile app next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年開發一款新的手機應用程式。

example.en: The team will develop a new product this year.
example.zh: 團隊今年會開發一項新產品。

example.en: Our schedule may change if the client calls today.

example.en: We made good progress on the new design.
example.zh: 我們在新設計上有不錯的進展。

derived.link: evolve 去掉 e 再加 -ution，變成「演變的過程」，像 solve → solution

extra_vocab.en: to put equipment or software in place so it can be used
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡指把底座裝在車上。You install the base 的 you 是泛指「使用者」，是產品說明常見的語氣。

install + -er，做安裝的人或東西，像 worker、teacher
re- 表示再一次，像 restart、rewrite
un- 表示相反動作，像 unlock、undo

items.tag: 2. Introducing Pocket Click

level.why: 口語簡報，句子短而清楚，以簡單句為主，並有 with、while 引導的補充說明；字彙包含 compact、portable、ISOFIX connectors 等產品詞彙，且上下文有明確解釋，屬 B1+ 程度。

items.passage:
That's what led us to develop Pocket Click.

It's an infant car seat with a compact, portable mini base that fits neatly with the seat.

We've made the base much smaller and lighter than a traditional one, with the ISOFIX connectors built right into it.

The idea is to give users two options. They can leave the base in the car for everyday use, or attach it to the car seat and take the whole unit with them when traveling.

So, with Pocket Click, you get the convenience of a traditional base in everyday use, while still having the flexibility you need when traveling.
items.zh:
這就是促使我們開發 Pocket Click 的原因。

它是一款嬰兒汽座，搭配小巧、便於攜帶的迷你底座，與汽座能完美貼合。

我們把底座做得比傳統底座小得多、輕得多，並將 ISOFIX 接頭直接內建在底座裡。

我們的構想是提供使用者兩種選擇。他們可以把底座留在車上供日常使用，或是把它接到汽座上，旅行時整組帶著走。

所以有了 Pocket Click，日常使用時能享有傳統底座的便利，旅行時又能保有所需的彈性。

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly doing in this part of the talk?
opts: Comparing the prices of several car seat bases
Reporting a delay in the product schedule
Explaining the design and benefits of a new infant car seat product
Showing customers how to install a car seat in a rental car
why: 錯誤：講者沒有提到任何價格或比較多個底座。
錯誤：文中沒有提到產品時程延誤。
正解：講者說明 Pocket Click 的設計（迷你底座、內建 ISOFIX 接頭），以及日常與旅行兩種使用情境的好處。
錯誤：文中沒有說明安裝步驟，也沒有提到租賃車。

questions.q: According to the speaker, how is the Pocket Click base different from a traditional base?
opts: It is smaller and lighter, and the ISOFIX connectors are built into it.
It must be taken out of the car after every trip.
It is sold separately and cannot be attached to the car seat.
It is larger than a traditional base but easier to install.
why: 正解：講者說底座比傳統底座小得多、輕得多，且 ISOFIX 接頭直接內建其中。
錯誤：使用者可以把底座留在車上供日常使用，不需每次取出。
錯誤：底座可以接到汽座上，旅行時整組帶著走。
錯誤：底座是比傳統底座更小，而不是更大。

questions.q: The company plans to ______ a new line of portable car seats next spring.
why: 錯誤：plans to 後面要接原形動詞，不能用 -ing 形式。
錯誤：plans to 後面要接原形動詞，不能用過去式。
錯誤：不定詞 to 之後不能加第三人稱單數的 -es。
正解：plans to 後面接原形動詞 launch，表示「計畫推出」。

questions.q: Because the new base is ______ than the old model, it takes up less space in the trunk.
why: 錯誤：句中有 than，需使用比較級，原級 small 不適用。
正解：than 前面要用比較級 smaller，表示比舊款更小。
錯誤：最高級 smallest 前面需有 the，且不與 than 連用。
錯誤：smally 不是正確的英文單字，形容詞 small 不需要加 -ly。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That's what led us to develop Pocket Click.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這就是促使我們開發 Pocket Click 的原因。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明產品開發動機或背景時使用，That's what led us to... 把前面講的問題與後面的產品自然連接起來。

presentation_phrases.phrase: It's an infant car seat with a compact, portable mini base.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 它是一款搭配小巧、便於攜帶的迷你底座的嬰兒汽座。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報中用一句話介紹產品的外觀或主要特色時使用，with + 名詞片語可補充產品的組成。

presentation_phrases.phrase: We've made the base much smaller and lighter than a traditional one.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們把底座做得比傳統底座小得多、輕得多。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明改良成果、與舊設計比較時使用，much + 比較級可強調差異幅度，than a traditional one 避免重複名詞。

presentation_phrases.phrase: The idea is to give users two options.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的構想是提供使用者兩種選擇。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計理念或產品策略時使用，The idea is to + 原形動詞 是簡潔的說明句型，後面常接具體的選項。

presentation_phrases.phrase: They can leave the base in the car for everyday use, or attach it to the car seat and take the whole unit with them.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 他們可以把底座留在車上供日常使用，或是把它接到汽座上，整組帶著走。
presentation_phrases.usage: 分別說明兩種使用情境時使用，can + 動詞 ... or + 動詞 ... 讓聽眾清楚看出選項的差別。

presentation_phrases.phrase: With Pocket Click, you get the convenience of a traditional base while still having the flexibility you need when traveling.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 有了 Pocket Click，你既能享有傳統底座的便利，又能保有旅行時所需的彈性。
presentation_phrases.usage: 在簡報中總結產品價值時使用，you get... while still having... 同時強調兩項好處，是常見的賣點句型。

presentation_phrases.phrase: In other words, you no longer have to choose between convenience and portability.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 換句話說，你不必再在便利與可攜性之間二選一。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用來把前面的說明重新整理成一句重點時使用，In other words 是換句話說的轉換訊號，no longer have to 表示不再需要。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me show you how it works.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我示範給各位看它是如何運作的。
presentation_phrases.usage: 介紹完產品概念後，轉入示範或操作說明時使用，Let me + 原形動詞 語氣自然，能順利帶出下一個段落。

extra_vocab.en: small and designed to use little space
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡形容 Pocket Click 的迷你底座小巧、不佔空間。compact 常和 portable 一起出現，強調「小而好帶」。

example.en: The new model is more compact than last year's version.
example.zh: 新款比去年的版本更小巧。

example.en: This is the most compact scanner we have ever produced.
example.zh: 這是我們生產過最小巧的掃描器。

example.en: The parts are packed compactly to save shipping space.
example.zh: 零件被緊湊地包裝起來以節省運送空間。

example.en: The compact size makes this printer easy to place on any desk.
example.zh: 小巧的尺寸讓這台印表機很容易放在任何桌上。

example.en: Customers like the compact design of our new laptop.
example.zh: 客戶喜歡我們新筆電小巧的設計。

example.en: We reserved a compact car for the three-day business trip.
example.zh: 我們為三天的出差預訂了一輛小型車。

examples.en: This compact printer fits easily on a small desk.
examples.zh: 這台小巧的印表機很容易放在小桌上。

examples.en: We chose a compact refrigerator for the break room.
examples.zh: 我們為休息室選了一台小型冰箱。

examples.en: A compact umbrella is useful on rainy business trips.
examples.zh: 小巧的雨傘在下雨的出差途中很有用。

examples.en: Our ads highlight the compact shape of the new speaker.
examples.zh: 我們的廣告強調新喇叭小巧的外型。

confusable.diff: impact 是「影響、衝擊」，字尾和 compact 一樣是 -pact，但意思不同。

example.en: The new policy had a big impact on our sales.
example.zh: 新政策對我們的銷售有很大的影響。

confusable.diff: contact 是「聯絡」，拼法和 compact 很像，意思完全不同。

example.en: Please contact our sales office to order the compact model.
example.zh: 請聯絡我們的業務處訂購小型款。

similar.diff: small 只說大小；compact 強調小巧又能有效利用空間。

example.en: We need a small desk for the new assistant.
example.zh: 我們需要一張小桌子給新來的助理。

similar.diff: space-saving 直接說明「節省空間」的功能，常用來形容家具或設備。

example.en: A space-saving design helps us use the small storage room.
example.zh: 節省空間的設計幫助我們善用小儲藏室。

example.en: The small shop sells parts for baby strollers.
example.zh: 這家小店販售嬰兒推車的零件。

example.en: The new tablet is light enough to carry all day.
example.zh: 這台新平板輕到可以整天帶著走。

example.en: The slim case fits easily into any laptop bag.
example.zh: 這個薄型保護殼很容易放進任何筆電包。

extra_vocab.en: easy to carry or move from place to place
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡形容迷你底座輕巧，可以帶著旅行，呼應「旅行時的彈性」這個賣點。

example.en: The new laptop is more portable than the old one.
example.zh: 新筆電比舊的更便於攜帶。

example.en: This is the most portable projector in our product line.
example.zh: 這是我們產品線中最便於攜帶的投影機。

example.en: Please bring a portable charger on the long flight.
example.zh: 搭長途班機請帶著行動電源。

example.en: Staff may use a portable device to scan the boxes.
example.zh: 員工可以使用可攜式裝置掃描箱子。

example.en: The company gave every sales rep a portable computer.
example.zh: 公司給每位業務代表一台可攜式電腦。

examples.en: This portable speaker works for up to ten hours.
examples.zh: 這個可攜式喇叭最長可使用十小時。

examples.en: A portable scanner is handy when I travel for work.
examples.zh: 出差時，可攜式掃描器很好用。

examples.en: We need a portable screen for the outdoor meeting.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個可攜式螢幕來開戶外會議。

examples.en: Portable heaters are on sale at all our stores.
examples.zh: 可攜式暖氣機在我們所有門市都在特價。

confusable.diff: portal 是「入口網站、入口」，拼法和 portable 前半很像，意思不同。

example.en: Employees can log in through the company portal.
example.zh: 員工可以透過公司入口網站登入。

similar.diff: mobile 強調可移動或隨時隨地使用（mobile phone）；portable 強調容易搬運攜帶。

example.en: Customers can pay with a mobile phone at the counter.
example.zh: 客戶可以在櫃台用手機付款。

similar.diff: easy to carry 是口語說法，意思和 portable 相同，但較不正式。

example.en: The new case is easy to carry and very light.
example.zh: 這個新保護殼很容易攜帶，而且很輕。

example.en: This bag is light even when it is full.
example.zh: 這個包包即使裝滿也很輕。

example.en: The app is handy for checking flight times.
example.zh: 這個應用程式很適合用來查航班時間。

example.en: Most customers use a mobile app to order food.
example.zh: 大多數客戶用行動應用程式訂餐。

derived.link: portable 去掉 -le 加 -ility，變成「可攜帶的特性」，像 able → ability、flexible → flexibility

extra_vocab.en: following ways of doing things that have been used for a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，traditional base 指長久以來常見的傳統汽座底座，用來和 Pocket Click 的迷你底座做比較。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: a traditional one 的 one 是代名詞，代替前面出現過的單數可數名詞 base，避免重複。

example.en: Some customers prefer a more traditional look for their office.
example.zh: 有些客戶偏好更傳統的辦公室風格。

example.en: This is the most traditional restaurant in the old town.
example.zh: 這是舊城區最傳統的餐廳。

example.en: The factory has traditionally made parts for local car makers.
example.zh: 這間工廠傳統上為當地車廠製造零件。

example.en: The traditional method takes longer than the new process.
example.zh: 傳統方法比新流程花更多時間。

example.en: Our company still uses a traditional approach to training.
example.zh: 我們公司仍採用傳統的培訓方式。

example.en: The hotel has a traditional design with wooden floors.
example.zh: 這間飯店有傳統的設計與木地板。

examples.en: We discussed the traditional sales model at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們在會議上討論了傳統的銷售模式。

examples.en: Social media is replacing traditional advertising in many companies.
examples.zh: 社群媒體正在取代許多公司的傳統廣告。

examples.en: Traditional factories need more workers than modern automated ones.
examples.zh: 傳統工廠比現代自動化工廠需要更多工人。

examples.en: The restaurant serves traditional dishes from southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳供應台灣南部的傳統菜餚。

confusable.diff: additional 是「額外的」，字尾和 traditional 一樣是 -itional，意思不同。

example.en: We will charge an additional fee for late delivery.
example.zh: 延遲送達我們會加收額外費用。

similar.diff: conventional 指符合一般慣例或標準；traditional 指代代相傳的做法。

example.en: The conventional way to book a hotel is by phone.
example.zh: 訂飯店的一般做法是打電話。

similar.diff: old-fashioned 帶有「過時」的意思，語氣比 traditional 負面。

example.en: Paper forms feel old-fashioned to many younger employees.
example.zh: 紙本表格對許多年輕員工來說顯得過時。

example.en: Please follow the standard procedure for all orders.
example.zh: 所有訂單請依照標準程序處理。

example.en: The usual delivery time is three business days.
example.zh: 一般的送貨時間是三個工作天。

example.en: Regular customers receive a ten percent discount every month.
example.zh: 常客每個月可享有九折優惠。

derived.link: traditional 去掉 -al 就是名詞 tradition，像 addition → additional
non- 表示不是，像 nonstop、nonfiction

extra_vocab.en: the quality of being easy to use and saving time or effort
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，the convenience of a traditional base 指傳統底座在日常使用時的便利（把底座留在車上，汽座可以快速卡入、取出）。這是整段簡報的賣點句。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: convenience 表示「便利」時是不可數名詞，不加 a；指「便利設施」時才用複數 conveniences。at your convenience 是固定說法。

example.en: The hotel offers modern conveniences like free Wi-Fi and a gym.
example.zh: 這間飯店提供免費無線網路和健身房等現代化便利設施。

example.en: Please call our office back at your convenience this week.
example.zh: 本週請在你方便時回電給我們辦公室。

example.en: Free parking is provided for your convenience at all branches.
example.zh: 為了方便您，所有分店都提供免費停車。

example.en: I bought a bottle of water at the convenience store.
example.zh: 我在便利商店買了一瓶水。

examples.en: Online booking offers great convenience for busy business travelers.
examples.zh: 線上訂位為忙碌的商務旅客帶來很大的便利。

examples.en: Customers pay extra for the convenience of same-day delivery.
examples.zh: 客戶願意為當日送達的便利多付費用。

examples.en: Picking up the car at the airport adds convenience.
examples.zh: 在機場取車增加了便利性。

examples.en: The hotel's location is a real convenience for guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的位置對旅客來說相當方便。

confusable.diff: convention 是「大會、慣例」，拼法和 convenience 前半很像，意思不同。

example.en: The annual sales convention will be held in Chicago.
example.zh: 年度業務大會將在芝加哥舉行。

similar.diff: ease 強調輕鬆、不費力；convenience 強調省時省事。

example.en: Customers value the ease of paying by phone.
example.zh: 客戶重視用手機付款的輕鬆。

example.en: The new seats offer comfort during long meetings.
example.zh: 新座椅在冗長的會議中帶來舒適感。

example.en: A free shuttle is a benefit for hotel guests.
example.zh: 免費接駁車對飯店旅客來說是一項好處。

example.en: Employees have easy access to the printing room.
example.zh: 員工能輕鬆進入列印室。

derived.link: convenience 的 -ce 換成 -t 變形容詞，像 difference → different
in- 表示不，像 incorrect、inactive
in- + convenience，「不便」，像 correct → incorrect

extra_vocab.en: one of the things you can choose from
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，two options 指 Pocket Click 提供的兩種使用方式：底座留在車上，或整組帶著旅行。the idea is to give users... 是在說明設計理念。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: option 是可數名詞，說「提供選擇」要用 an option 或複數 options；option to + V 表示「做…的選擇權」。

example.en: We reviewed three options before choosing the supplier.
example.zh: 我們在選定供應商之前比較了三個選項。

example.en: Credit card is our most popular payment option.
example.zh: 信用卡是我們最受歡迎的付款方式。

example.en: The contract gives us the option to renew for one year.
example.zh: 這份合約讓我們有續約一年的選擇權。

example.en: We should explore options for cutting shipping costs.
example.zh: 我們應該研究降低運費的各種選項。

examples.en: Option two is cheaper, but it takes longer.
examples.zh: 第二個選項比較便宜，但花的時間比較久。

examples.en: The supplier gave us several options for packaging.
examples.zh: 供應商提供我們幾種包裝的選項。

examples.en: Employees have the option to work from home.
examples.zh: 員工可以選擇在家工作。

examples.en: Guests have the option to cancel up to two days before arrival.
examples.zh: 旅客可以選擇在抵達前兩天取消。

confusable.diff: auction 是「拍賣」，拼法和 option 的字尾很像，意思不同。

example.en: The company sold its old machines at an auction.
example.zh: 公司在拍賣會上賣掉了舊機器。

similar.diff: choice 指選擇的行為或結果；option 指可供挑選的具體選項。

example.en: The team made the right choice when it hired her.
example.zh: 團隊雇用她是做了正確的選擇。

similar.diff: alternative 指可以取代原本做法的另一個方案。

example.en: We need an alternative if the supplier cannot deliver.
example.zh: 如果供應商無法交貨，我們需要替代方案。

example.en: Customers have a wide choice of colors and sizes.
example.zh: 客戶可以從多種顏色和尺寸中選擇。

example.en: Is there an alternative to this flight on Friday?
example.zh: 星期五有這班航班的替代班次嗎？

example.en: The store offers a large selection of baby products.
example.zh: 這家店提供多種嬰兒用品可供選擇。

derived.link: option 的詞幹，常說 opt for，意思是選擇某個選項
option + -al，形容詞字尾，像 traditional、additional

extra_vocab.en: one complete piece of equipment, or one part of a larger group
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，the whole unit 指「迷你底座加上汽座」合在一起的整組裝置，旅行時可以整組帶著走。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: unit 是可數名詞，a unit、two units；表示「每單位」常用 per unit，如 price per unit。

example.en: We sold five hundred units during the first week.
example.zh: 第一週我們賣出了五百件。

example.en: Please check that the unit price includes shipping and tax.
example.zh: 請確認單價是否含運費與稅金。

example.en: The business unit will present its results on Monday.
example.zh: 這個事業單位將在星期一報告成果。

example.en: A technician replaced the control unit on the machine.
example.zh: 技術人員更換了機器上的控制裝置。

examples.en: We ordered ten units of the new model today.
examples.zh: 我們今天訂購了十台新款機型。

examples.en: Each unit is tested before it leaves the factory.
examples.zh: 每一台在出廠前都會經過測試。

examples.en: Please confirm that the unit arrived in good condition.
examples.zh: 請確認這台設備是否完好送達。

examples.en: The marketing unit will share its plan next week.
examples.zh: 行銷單位下週會分享它的計畫。

confusable.diff: union 是「工會、聯盟」，拼法和 unit 前半很像，意思不同。

example.en: The union and the company reached an agreement yesterday.
example.zh: 工會與公司昨天達成了協議。

similar.diff: device 泛指小型電子或機械裝置；unit 強調一個完整、獨立的組件或設備。

example.en: The device sends a signal when the battery is low.
example.zh: 電池電量低時，這個裝置會發出訊號。

similar.diff: set 指一套多個物品；unit 指一個完整的單件或組件。

example.en: The set includes a charger and two cables.
example.zh: 這個組合包含一個充電器和兩條電纜。

example.en: Each item in the order was checked twice.
example.zh: 訂單中的每個品項都檢查過兩次。

example.en: This piece of equipment must be cleaned daily.
example.zh: 這件設備必須每天清潔。

example.en: The sales department holds a short meeting every Monday morning.
example.zh: 業務部每週一早上都會開一個短會。

senses.en: one complete piece of equipment or one set of parts

example.en: The air conditioning unit in the meeting room needs repair.
example.zh: 會議室的空調設備需要維修。

senses.en: an amount used for counting or measuring things
senses.distinguish: 常見於 per unit、unit price，指計算數量或價格的基本單位。

example.en: The price per unit drops when you order more.
example.zh: 訂購量越多，每件單價越低。

senses.en: a group within a company that does one kind of job
senses.distinguish: 後面常接公司內的工作，如 research unit、business unit。

example.en: Our research unit is moving to the new building.
example.zh: 我們的研究單位即將搬到新大樓。

senses.en: one apartment or room in a larger building
senses.distinguish: 在房地產或租賃情境中，指一個可出租或出售的住戶。

example.en: The company leases a unit on the third floor.
example.zh: 公司租了三樓的一個單位。

extra_vocab.en: in a tidy way, or in a way that fits well
extra_vocab.note: fits neatly with the seat 表示迷你底座和汽座「剛好貼合、不突兀」地結合在一起，強調外觀簡潔、設計精巧。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: neatly 是副詞，放在動詞後面修飾動作（fits neatly），不要和形容詞 neat 混用：The base is neat（形容詞），The base fits neatly（副詞）。

example.en: The new printer fits neatly under the office desk.
example.zh: 新印表機剛好放得進辦公桌下面。

example.en: The samples were neatly arranged on the display table.
example.zh: 樣品整齊地擺放在展示桌上。

example.en: Each item is neatly packed in a small gift box.
example.zh: 每件商品都整齊地裝在一個小禮盒裡。

example.en: All the sales staff were neatly dressed for the trade show.
example.zh: 所有業務人員都穿著整齊參加展覽。

items.tag: 3. Mode One — Everyday Use

level.why: 口語產品示範，以祈使句與簡單句為主，並有 so、which 引導的補充說明；字彙包含 secure、angle、cushion 等產品操作詞彙，步驟順序清楚，屬 B1+ 程度。

items.passage:
Let's start with everyday use.

First, press the Latch Angle Adjustment button to rotate the LATCH connectors out. Then, use the connectors to secure the mini base to the car seat.

There are two Latch Angle Adjustment buttons, one on each side of the base. They're connected, so you only need to press one to release the mechanism. This means you don't have to reach across to the other side, which can be harder to reach when you're installing the base in the car.

Once the mini base is installed, simply click the infant car seat into place.

You can then press the Latch Angle Adjustment button again to adjust the angle of the base, so it fits better against the car seat cushion and backrest.

When you need to take the baby out, just press the Mini Base Release button at the back of the car seat, then lift the infant car seat off the base.

The mini base stays in the car, ready for next time.

So, you don't have to set up the LATCH connectors every time. You can simply click the infant car seat in and out, just like with a traditional car seat base.
items.zh:
我們先從日常使用開始說明。

首先，按下 Latch Angle Adjustment（接頭角度調整）按鈕，將 LATCH 接頭轉出來。接著，使用這些接頭把迷你底座固定在汽座上。

底座兩側各有一個 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕，共兩個。它們是相連的，所以你只要按其中一個就能釋放機構。這表示你不必伸手到另一側去按，而在車內安裝底座時，另一側可能更難碰到。

迷你底座安裝好之後，只要把嬰兒汽座卡入定位即可。

接著你可以再按一次 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕來調整底座的角度，讓它更貼合汽座的坐墊與椅背。

需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要按下汽座後方的 Mini Base Release（迷你底座釋放）按鈕，再把嬰兒汽座從底座上提起即可。

迷你底座會留在車上，準備好下次使用。

所以，你不必每次都重新設定 LATCH 接頭。你只要把嬰兒汽座卡進、卡出就行了，就像使用傳統汽座底座一樣。

questions.q: Why don't users have to reach across to the other side of the base?
opts: The buttons are located at the back of the car seat.
The mini base is attached to the car seat permanently.
The two buttons are connected, so pressing one is enough.
The car seat can be installed without using any buttons.
why: 錯誤：Mini Base Release 按鈕才在汽座後方，與這兩個角度調整按鈕無關。
錯誤：文中說底座是用接頭固定到汽座上，並非永久固定。
正解：兩個 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕是相連的，只需按其中一個就能釋放機構。
錯誤：文中需要按按鈕才能將接頭轉出，並非不用任何按鈕。

questions.q: How can users take the baby out of the car?
opts: Press the Mini Base Release button on the car seat and lift the car seat off the base.
Press both Latch Angle Adjustment buttons at the same time.
Rotate the LATCH connectors back into the base.
Remove the mini base from the vehicle first.
why: 正解：講者說按下汽座後方的 Mini Base Release 按鈕，再把汽座從底座上提起。
錯誤：Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕用於轉出接頭與調整角度，不是用來取下汽座。
錯誤：取出寶寶時不需要轉回接頭，底座仍留在車上。
錯誤：迷你底座會留在車上，不必先移除。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention pressing the Latch Angle Adjustment button again?
opts: To release the infant car seat from the base
To rotate the LATCH connectors out
To lock the two buttons together
To help the base fit better against the car seat cushion and backrest
why: 錯誤：釋放汽座是靠 Mini Base Release 按鈕，不是這個按鈕。
錯誤：轉出 LATCH 接頭是第一次按按鈕時做的事，不是再按一次的目的。
錯誤：兩個按鈕本來就是相連的，不需要另外鎖在一起。
正解：再按一次按鈕可調整底座角度，讓它更貼合汽座的坐墊與椅背。

questions.q: Parents should check that the car seat is ______ secured before every trip.
why: 錯誤：形容詞 secure 不能修飾過去分詞 secured，需要用副詞。
正解：副詞 securely 修飾過去分詞 secured，表示「牢固地固定好」。
錯誤：securing 是動名詞或現在分詞，無法修飾 secured。
錯誤：security 是名詞，不能放在此處修飾分詞。

questions.q: The base is easy to install ______ it does not require any special tools.
why: 錯誤：although 表讓步，與「不需要特殊工具所以容易安裝」的因果關係不符。
錯誤：despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
正解：because 引導原因子句，說明容易安裝是因為不需要任何特殊工具。
錯誤：unless 表「除非」，語意不通。

questions.q: Customers can choose ______ the standard base and the travel base.
why: 正解：between A and B 表示「在 A 與 B 之間選擇」，用於兩個選項。
錯誤：among 用於三者以上，且不與 and 連接兩個選項搭配。
錯誤：within 表「在……範圍內」，不用於選擇兩項。
錯誤：through 表「穿過、透過」，語意不符。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let's start with everyday use.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們先從日常使用開始說明。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報中進入第一個說明項目時使用，Let's start with... 語氣自然，能清楚標示接下來的主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, press the Latch Angle Adjustment button to rotate the LATCH connectors out.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 首先，按下 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕，將 LATCH 接頭轉出來。
presentation_phrases.usage: 示範操作步驟時使用，First 帶出第一步，press + 按鈕 + to + 原形動詞 說明按鈕的作用。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Then, use the connectors to secure the mini base to the car seat.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接著，使用這些接頭把迷你底座固定在汽座上。
presentation_phrases.usage: 接續上一步驟時使用，Then 是順序轉換詞，use A to + 原形動詞 表示用某物完成某事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: They're connected, so you only need to press one to release the mechanism.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 它們是相連的，所以你只要按其中一個就能釋放機構。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計如何讓操作更簡單時使用，so you only need to... 點出結果，only 強調步驟很少。

presentation_phrases.phrase: This means you don't have to reach across to the other side.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這表示你不必伸手到另一側去按。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計帶來的使用好處時使用，This means... 把設計特色轉為使用者利益，don't have to 表示「不必」。

presentation_phrases.phrase: When you need to take the baby out, just press the Mini Base Release button, then lift the infant car seat off the base.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要按下 Mini Base Release 按鈕，再把嬰兒汽座從底座上提起即可。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明特定情境下的連續操作時使用，When you need to... 點出情境，just ... then ... 讓兩個動作銜接清楚。

presentation_phrases.phrase: So, you don't have to set up the LATCH connectors every time.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 所以，你不必每次都重新設定 LATCH 接頭。
presentation_phrases.usage: 總結產品帶來的便利時使用，So 帶出結論，every time 強調每次都省事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me walk you through the steps.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我帶各位一步步看操作流程。
presentation_phrases.usage: 在示範前引導聽眾進入步驟說明時使用，walk you through 表示「逐步帶著你了解」，常用於產品示範或教學。

extra_vocab.en: to fix something firmly so it cannot move or come loose
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡指用 LATCH 接頭把迷你底座牢牢固定在汽座上。secure A to B 是產品說明常見的動作用語，強調「固定得穩」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: secure A to B 表示把 A 固定在 B 上；secure 後面若接 contract、funding 等，意思就變成「取得、爭取到」，要看受詞判斷。

example.en: A strong lock secures the warehouse door at night.
example.zh: 一把堅固的鎖在夜間固定住倉庫的門。

example.en: The workers secured the boxes with strong tape yesterday.
example.zh: 工人昨天用強力膠帶把箱子固定好了。

example.en: Securing the load properly takes only a few minutes.
example.zh: 把貨物妥善固定只需要幾分鐘。

example.en: The startup is trying to secure funding for its new product.
example.zh: 這家新創公司正努力為新產品取得資金。

example.en: She worked hard to secure a contract with the airline.
example.zh: 她努力爭取到與航空公司的合約。

example.en: Guards secure the building after all employees have left.
example.zh: 員工全部離開後，警衛會鎖好整棟建築。

examples.en: Please secure all windows before you leave the office.
examples.zh: 離開辦公室前，請把所有窗戶關好。

examples.en: Please secure the budget approval before we sign the order.
examples.zh: 簽訂訂單前，請先取得預算核准。

examples.en: We hope to secure a larger order from this client.
examples.zh: 我們希望從這位客戶那裡取得更大的訂單。

examples.en: Make sure you secure the car seat before you drive.
examples.zh: 開車前請確認已經把汽座固定好。

confusable.diff: ensure 是「確保」，發音和 secure 相近，但不是把東西固定住。

example.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked at night.
example.zh: 請確保所有的門在夜間都已上鎖。

confusable.diff: insure 是「投保」，發音也和 secure 相近。

example.en: We need to insure the equipment before shipping it overseas.
example.zh: 我們需要在把設備運往海外前先為它投保。

similar.diff: fasten 強調扣緊、繫上（如安全帶）；secure 強調固定到穩固不動。

example.en: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
example.zh: 飛機起飛前請繫好安全帶。

similar.diff: attach 只表示接上或附上，不一定牢固。

example.en: Please attach the receipt to the expense report.
example.zh: 請把收據附在費用報告上。

example.en: Please lock the door when you leave the room.
example.zh: 離開房間時請把門鎖上。

example.en: This case will protect your laptop during the trip.
example.zh: 這個保護殼會在旅途中保護你的筆電。

example.en: The new design is safe for babies of all ages.
example.zh: 這款新設計對各年齡的嬰兒都很安全。

derived.link: secure + -ly，變成副詞，像 quick → quickly
secure + -ity，變成名詞，像 able → ability

example.en: Please secure the shelf to the wall with two screws.
example.zh: 請用兩根螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

example.en: Use a secure password to protect your online account.
example.zh: 請使用安全的密碼來保護你的網路帳號。

senses.en: to fix something firmly so it will not move

example.en: Workers secure the cargo with strong straps before shipping.
example.zh: 工人在出貨前用堅固的帶子固定貨物。

senses.en: to get something important after some effort
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 contract、funding、order 等抽象的商業成果時，意思是「取得」。

example.en: The sales team hopes to secure a new contract this month.
example.zh: 業務團隊希望這個月能取得一份新合約。

extra_vocab.en: to stretch your arm to touch or take something
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡出現兩次：reach across 指伸手到另一側，harder to reach 指另一側比較不容易搆到。講者用它說明兩個按鈕相連的好處。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: reach 當「到達」時是及物動詞，後面直接接地點，不加 to 或 at：reach the airport，不說 reach to the airport。

example.en: The shuttle bus reaches the airport in thirty minutes.
example.zh: 接駁巴士三十分鐘就會抵達機場。

example.en: Our sales reached a new record last quarter.
example.zh: 我們的銷售額上一季創下新紀錄。

example.en: She is reaching for the phone on the desk.
example.zh: 她正伸手去拿桌上的電話。

example.en: Both sides hope to reach an agreement by Friday.
example.zh: 雙方希望在星期五之前達成協議。

example.en: Please reach out to our support team if you need help.
example.zh: 如果需要協助，請主動聯絡我們的支援團隊。

example.en: We hope to reach the target before the end of June.
example.zh: 我們希望在六月底前達成目標。

examples.en: We should reach the hotel before the rain starts.
examples.zh: 我們應該在下雨之前抵達飯店。

examples.en: Social media helps us reach more young customers.
examples.zh: 社群媒體幫助我們接觸到更多年輕客戶。

examples.en: The two teams could not reach a decision on the budget.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊無法就預算做出決定。

examples.en: Workers need a ladder to reach the highest shelves.
examples.zh: 工人需要梯子才能搆到最高的架子。

similar.diff: arrive 是不及物動詞，後面要接 at／in；reach 是及物動詞，直接接地點。

example.en: Most guests arrive at the hotel before noon on Friday.
example.zh: 大多數旅客會在星期五中午前抵達飯店。

similar.diff: get to 較口語，意思同「到達」，不用於「達成協議」這類抽象用法。

example.en: We should get to the venue by nine.
example.zh: 我們應該在九點前到達會場。

example.en: Please do not touch the screen with wet hands.
example.zh: 請不要用濕手觸碰螢幕。

example.en: Please contact the manager if the printer stops working.
example.zh: 如果印表機故障，請聯絡經理。

example.en: Stretch your arms during long meetings to stay alert.
example.zh: 在冗長的會議中伸展手臂以保持清醒。

derived.link: reach + -able，能被…的，像 portable、comfortable
un- 表示不，像 unlock、unable

example.en: The top shelf is too high for me to reach.
example.zh: 最上層的架子太高了，我搆不到。

example.en: Keep the first aid kit within reach of every worker.
example.zh: 請把急救箱放在每位工人伸手可及之處。

senses.en: to stretch out your arm to touch or take something

example.en: Please reach for the top button on the control panel.
example.zh: 請伸手按控制面板最上方的按鈕。

senses.en: to get to a place

example.en: The package should reach your office by Thursday.
example.zh: 包裹應該會在星期四前送到你的辦公室。

senses.en: to speak to someone by phone or email
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，且常和 by phone、at this number 一起出現。

example.en: You can reach me at this number after five.
example.zh: 五點後你可以用這個號碼聯絡到我。

senses.en: to get to a certain amount or level
senses.distinguish: 受詞是金額、數字或目標等抽象的量。

example.en: Online sales reached one million dollars this year.
example.zh: 今年網路銷售額達到了一百萬美元。

extra_vocab.en: the way something is tilted or turned
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，adjust the angle of the base 指調整底座的傾斜角度，讓它更貼合車用座椅。講者也把按鈕命名為 Latch Angle Adjustment。

example.en: The tablet stand has three adjustable angles for typing.
example.zh: 這個平板支架有三種可調整的打字角度。

example.en: Please adjust the angle of the camera before recording.
example.zh: 錄影前請先調整攝影機的角度。

example.en: The screen stands at an angle on the desk.
example.zh: 螢幕在桌上呈傾斜角度擺放。

example.en: The two walls meet at a right angle.
example.zh: 這兩面牆以直角相接。

example.en: Let's look at the problem from a different angle.
example.zh: 我們從不同的角度來看這個問題吧。

examples.en: The monitor can tilt to any angle you like.
examples.zh: 這台螢幕可以傾斜到你喜歡的任何角度。

examples.en: The camera angle makes the product look larger.
examples.zh: 拍攝角度讓產品看起來比較大。

examples.en: Set the chair at a comfortable angle for your back.
examples.zh: 把椅子調到對背部舒適的角度。

confusable.diff: angel 是「天使」，拼法和 angle 只差字母順序；商業上常說 angel investor（天使投資人）。

example.en: Our angel investor gave the startup its first funding.
example.zh: 我們的天使投資人給了這家新創公司第一筆資金。

similar.diff: viewpoint 只表示「觀點」；angle 除了角度，也可指看事情的切入點。

example.en: Each manager shared a different viewpoint on the plan.
example.zh: 每位經理對這個計畫都分享了不同的觀點。

example.en: The delivery truck stopped at the bottom of the slope.
example.zh: 送貨卡車停在斜坡底部。

example.en: Do not tilt the box when you carry it.
example.zh: 搬運箱子時請不要讓它傾斜。

example.en: The printer is in the corner of the meeting room.
example.zh: 印表機放在會議室的角落。

example.en: Turn the handle ninety degrees to lock the door.
example.zh: 把把手轉九十度就能鎖上門。

derived.link: tri- 表示三，加 angle 就是「三個角」，像 tricycle

senses.en: the amount something is tilted or turned

example.en: Please check the angle of the mirror before driving.
example.zh: 開車前請檢查後照鏡的角度。

senses.en: a way of thinking about something
senses.distinguish: 後面常接抽象的事，如 a new angle on the problem，指看事情的方式。

example.en: A new angle may help us sell this old product.
example.zh: 換個切入點也許能幫我們賣出這個舊產品。

extra_vocab.en: a soft bag used for sitting on or leaning against
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，vehicle seat cushion and backrest 指車用座椅的坐墊與椅背，是底座角度調整後要貼合的位置。

example.en: The hotel replaced all the sofa cushions in the lobby.
example.zh: 飯店更換了大廳所有的沙發坐墊。

example.en: A thick foam layer cushions the glass during shipping.
example.zh: 一層厚厚的泡棉在運送時為玻璃提供緩衝。

example.en: Extra savings cushioned the company during the slow season.
example.zh: 額外的存款在淡季時為公司提供了緩衝。

example.en: The soft packing prevents damage by cushioning the product.
example.zh: 柔軟的包材藉由緩衝產品來避免損壞。

example.en: The new seat cushion makes long meetings more comfortable.
example.zh: 新的座椅坐墊讓冗長的會議更舒適。

example.en: Strong packaging helps cushion the impact during delivery.

example.en: We sell a washable cushion cover for every size.

examples.en: The sofa has soft cushions and a wooden frame.

examples.en: She placed a cushion on her chair for support.

examples.en: A thick cushion keeps the baby comfortable on long trips.

example.en: The hotel provides two pillows for each guest bed.

similar.diff: pad 是較薄的襯墊，常用來保護物品。

example.en: The company ships glasses in boxes filled with foam.
example.zh: 公司用裝滿泡棉的箱子運送玻璃杯。

example.en: Please put a cushion on the chair for the guest.
example.zh: 請在椅子上放個坐墊給客人。

senses.en: a soft bag used for sitting on or leaning against

example.en: A cushion on the chair makes long meetings easier.

senses.en: extra money or time that protects you from problems

example.zh: 一小筆現金緩衝能幫助我們度過淡季。

extra_vocab.en: to move something up from a lower place
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，lift the infant car seat off the base 指把汽座從底座上提起來，是取出寶寶時的最後一個動作。

example.en: Lifting heavy boxes without help can cause injuries.
example.zh: 沒人幫忙獨自搬重箱子可能造成受傷。

example.en: Please lift up the lid and check inside.

example.en: The city plans to lift restrictions on outdoor events.
example.zh: 市政府計畫解除對戶外活動的限制。

example.en: Could you give me a lift to the airport?
example.zh: 你可以載我去機場嗎？

examples.en: Please lift the boxes carefully when you unload the truck.
examples.zh: 卸貨時請小心搬起這些箱子。

similar.diff: raise 常用於提高數字、價格或把東西舉高；lift 強調把東西從下往上抬離。

example.en: Please pick up the package at the front desk.

example.zh: 員工把行李搬到每間客房。

example.en: Please hold the door open for the delivery driver.
example.zh: 請幫送貨司機扶著門。

example.en: The lift is out of order, so please use the stairs.

senses.en: to move something up from a lower place

example.en: Lift the box with your legs, not with your back.
example.zh: 用腿的力量抬箱子，不要用背。

senses.en: to end a rule that stops people from doing something

extra_vocab.en: in a way that is easy, or only
