items.tag: 服務合約修訂通知（費用調降與中斷補償）

level.why: 合約修訂通知含 in exchange for which、which will be capped、failing which 等關係子句與被動結構，並需整合費用、支援次數上限、中斷補償的計算方式與通報義務等多項條款。干擾項取自文中出現過的數字與處理方式（現金退款、費用調降、支援次數），需精確區分。

items.passage:
NOTICE OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT

Effective November 1, the service agreement between Brightline Hosting and Marlow Associates will be amended in three respects. First, the monthly fee will be reduced to 4,800 dollars, in exchange for which Marlow Associates will give up its right to unlimited on-site support visits, which will be capped at six per year. Second, any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours will entitle the client to a credit, which will be deducted from the following month's invoice rather than refunded in cash. Third, Brightline must alert the finance department within twenty-four hours of any outage, failing which the credit will be doubled.

All other provisions remain unchanged. Both parties are asked to sign and return the enclosed addendum by October 23.
items.zh:
合約修訂通知

自 11 月 1 日起，Brightline 主機代管公司與 Marlow 顧問公司之間的服務協議將在三方面進行修訂。第一，月費將降為 4,800 美元，作為交換，Marlow 顧問公司將放棄無限次現場支援服務的權利，現場支援將限制為每年六次。第二，任何持續超過連續四小時的服務中斷，客戶都有權獲得一筆抵用額，該金額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。第三，Brightline 必須在任何當機事件發生後二十四小時內通知財務部門，否則抵用額將加倍。

其他所有條款維持不變。請雙方於 10 月 23 日前簽署並寄回隨附的附加條款。

vocab.col: deduct from payment / deduct a fee
alert the staff / alert someone to a problem
entitle someone to a refund / be entitled to

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To request payment of an overdue invoice
To inform a client of revisions to a service agreement
To announce the opening of a new support center
To propose ending the contract early
why: 文中提到的是下個月發票的抵扣，並沒有要求支付逾期款項。
正解：通知說明服務協議將在費用、支援次數與中斷補償等三方面修訂。
文中完全沒有提到新設支援中心，只有現場支援次數的限制。
通知是要雙方簽署附加條款，其他條款維持不變，並非提前終止合約。

questions.q: How will a credit for a long outage be applied?
opts: It will be refunded in cash within a month.
It will be applied to the annual support visits.
It will be added to the fee for the next quarter.
It will be subtracted from the next invoice.
why: 文中明確說抵用額不是以現金退還，而是從發票扣除。
每年六次的現場支援與抵用額無關，兩者是不同的條款。
抵用額是減少費用，而不是增加下一季的費用。
正解：抵用額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。

questions.q: What will happen if Brightline fails to report an outage within twenty-four hours?
opts: The credit given to the client will be doubled.
The monthly fee will be reduced further.
The number of support visits will increase.
why: 正解：failing which 指未在二十四小時內通報，抵用額將加倍。
月費調降是此次修訂的第一項內容，與未通報的後果無關。
文中沒有提到未通報會終止協議。
現場支援次數是被限制為每年六次，並不會因為未通報而增加。

questions.q: The finance team requested that all expense reports ______ before the end of the month.
why: 主詞 expense reports 是被提交的對象，使用主動的 submit 語意不通。
submits 是第三人稱單數，與複數主詞不一致，且語態也不對。
正解：request that 之後的子句用假設語氣，動詞為 (should) be + 過去分詞，這裡報告是被提交，所以用 be submitted。
submitting 是現在分詞，不能單獨作為子句的動詞。

questions.q: The contractor is ______ for any damages caused by delays in completing the work.
why: liability 是名詞，放在 be 動詞之後不能與 for 構成「負責」的語意。
正解：be liable for 表示「對……負責」，liable 是形容詞，與 is 搭配。
liably 不是常用字，也不能作為 be 動詞後的補語。
liabilities 是名詞複數，與單數主詞和語意都不符。

questions.q: Please review the contract carefully ______ signing it.
why: although 表示讓步，「儘管簽署」語意不符合提醒仔細閱讀合約的目的。
despite 是介系詞，意為「儘管」，語意上不合理。
unless 是「除非」，後面接 signing it 結構與語意都不通。
正解：before signing 表示「簽署之前」，符合提醒先仔細閱讀合約的語意。

extra_vocab.en: without any limit on how much or how many
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，unlimited on-site support visits 指客戶原本享有「不限次數」的到場支援服務，修訂後改為每年最多六次。unlimited 常見於合約與方案條款中，用來說明次數、用量或存取沒有上限。

example.en: The new contract will limit on-site visits to six per year.
example.zh: 新合約會把到場拜訪限制為每年六次。

example.en: The agreement sets clear limits on how often staff can visit.
example.zh: 這份協議對人員可到訪的頻率訂有明確的上限。

forms.label: 過去式／過去分詞／形容詞

example.en: Support hours are limited to weekdays under the new plan.
example.zh: 在新方案下，支援時段僅限於平日。

example.en: Limiting free visits helped the provider lower its monthly fee.
example.zh: 限制免費到訪的次數，讓服務商得以降低月費。

example.en: One limitation of this plan is the cap on support visits.
example.zh: 這個方案的一項限制是支援到訪次數有上限。

example.en: Members get unlimited access to all our training videos.
example.zh: 會員可以不限次數觀看我們所有的培訓影片。

example.en: This phone plan comes with unlimited data every month.
example.zh: 這個手機方案每個月都提供無限流量。

example.en: You can invite an unlimited number of guests to the webinar.
example.zh: 你可以邀請不限人數的來賓參加這場網路研討會。

examples.en: The plan gives you unlimited storage for all your company files.
examples.zh: 這個方案提供無限的儲存空間，讓你存放所有公司檔案。

examples.en: The package includes unlimited phone support for one full year.
examples.zh: 這個套裝方案包含為期一整年、不限次數的電話支援。

examples.en: Our company does not have an unlimited budget for travel.
examples.zh: 我們公司的差旅預算並不是沒有上限的。

confusable.diff: limitless 也是「無限的」，語氣較文學、較誇張，多形容可能性或潛力；unlimited 常用於合約、方案中的次數與用量。

example.en: The CEO spoke about the limitless potential of the new market.
example.zh: 執行長談到了這個新市場無限的潛力。

confusable.diff: unrestricted 強調「不受規定限制」（如不受限制的進出）；unlimited 強調「數量或次數沒有上限」。

example.en: Staff have unrestricted access to the building at all hours.
example.zh: 員工隨時都能不受限制地進出這棟大樓。

example.en: We have to limit the number of guests to fifty.
example.zh: 我們必須把賓客人數限制在五十人以內。

example.en: We have limited time to finish the report.
example.zh: 我們完成報告的時間有限。

example.en: The contract has a limitation on the number of visits.
example.zh: 合約對到訪次數設有限制。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，un-（沒有）+ limit + -ed，沒有上限的
limit + -ation，把「限制」變成名詞，像 explore → exploration
limit + -less（沒有），像 careless、useless

extra_vocab.en: a problem that stops something from continuing in the normal way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours 指服務「中斷」超過連續四小時，客戶就能獲得補償點數。disruption 指讓正常運作被打亂或停止的問題，常用於服務、交通與生產。

example.en: Frequent disruptions to the network upset many of our clients.
example.zh: 網路頻繁中斷，讓我們許多客戶感到不滿。

example.en: Network repairs may disrupt access to our online portal.
example.zh: 網路維修可能會影響我們線上入口網站的存取。

example.en: A power cut disrupts production on the entire factory floor.
example.zh: 停電會使整個工廠生產線的作業中斷。

example.en: Server problems disrupted our online sales for several hours.
example.zh: 伺服器問題讓我們的線上銷售中斷了好幾個小時。

example.en: Please avoid disrupting the meeting with unrelated questions.
example.zh: 請不要用無關的問題打斷會議進行。

example.en: Constant noise from the street is disruptive to our daily work.
example.zh: 街上持續的噪音干擾了我們的日常工作。

example.en: The system update may cause disruption to online orders.
example.zh: 系統更新可能會對線上訂單造成中斷。

example.en: We will work at night to minimize disruption to customers.
example.zh: 我們會在夜間作業，把對客戶的干擾降到最低。

example.en: A service disruption lasted three hours yesterday morning.
example.zh: 昨天早上發生了持續三小時的服務中斷。

example.en: The move to the new office took place with minimal disruption.
example.zh: 搬到新辦公室的過程幾乎沒有造成干擾。

examples.en: Heavy snow led to serious disruption of flights across the region.
examples.zh: 大雪使整個地區的航班嚴重受到影響。

examples.en: A supply disruption forced the factory to stop work for two days.
examples.zh: 供應中斷迫使工廠停工兩天。

examples.en: Construction next door may be a disruption to our afternoon meeting.
examples.zh: 隔壁的施工可能會干擾我們下午的會議。

confusable.diff: interruption 多指短暫的「打斷」（如被電話打斷）；disruption 指讓整體運作被打亂、影響較大。

example.en: After a short interruption, the meeting started again at ten.
example.zh: 短暫中斷之後，會議在十點重新開始。

confusable.diff: outage 專指電力、網路或系統的「停止供應」；disruption 範圍更廣，任何讓正常運作中斷的問題都可以用。

example.en: The power outage left the whole office without internet today.
example.zh: 停電讓整間辦公室今天都沒有網路。

example.en: The strike disrupted deliveries to our stores.
example.zh: 罷工擾亂了我們門市的配送。

example.en: Loud phone calls can be disruptive in an open office.
example.zh: 在開放式辦公室裡，大聲講電話可能會造成干擾。

example.en: Please do not interrupt the speaker during the talk.
example.zh: 演講期間請不要打斷講者。

example.en: After a short interruption, the meeting started again.
example.zh: 短暫中斷之後，會議又重新開始。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；disrupt + -ion 變成名詞，像 decide → decision
disrupt + -ive，有…性質的，像 active、creative

extra_vocab.en: to take away an amount from a total
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，be deducted from the following month's invoice 指補償點數會從下個月的請款單中「扣掉」，而不是退現金。deduct 常用結構是 deduct A from B，用於薪資、帳單和稅務。

example.en: The system deducts the monthly fee from your account automatically.
example.zh: 系統會自動從你的帳戶扣除月費。

example.en: A late fee was deducted from the supplier's final payment.
example.zh: 一筆逾期費用已從供應商的尾款中扣除。

example.en: Deducting the credit from next month's bill is simpler for us.
example.zh: 把補償額從下個月的帳單中扣除，對我們來說比較簡單。

example.en: Please check the deduction on your tax form carefully.
example.zh: 請仔細檢查你稅單上的扣除額。

example.en: Several deductions were listed at the bottom of the pay slip.
example.zh: 薪資單底部列出了幾項扣除額。

example.en: The company may deduct unpaid fees from your salary.
example.zh: 公司可能會從你的薪水中扣除未繳的費用。

example.en: Please deduct the cost of the damaged items from the invoice.
example.zh: 請從請款單上扣除受損商品的費用。

example.en: Business travel may qualify for a tax deduction.
example.zh: 商務差旅可能符合稅額扣除的資格。

examples.en: You can deduct travel expenses when you file your tax return.
examples.zh: 你在申報稅務時可以扣除差旅費用。

examples.en: The store will deduct ten percent if you pay in cash.
examples.zh: 如果你付現，店家會扣掉百分之十。

examples.en: Late fees will be deducted from your deposit.
examples.zh: 逾期費用會從你的押金中扣除。

confusable.diff: subtract 是數學上的「減」，強調計算；deduct 是從金額、薪資、帳單中「扣除」，用於商務與財務。

example.en: Subtract the discount from the total to find the final price.
example.zh: 把折扣從總額中減去，就能算出最後價格。

confusable.diff: reduce 是「降低、減少」整體的量；deduct 是明確「扣掉」某個金額。

example.en: We want to reduce shipping costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們想把運費成本降低百分之十。

example.en: The deduction will appear on your next pay slip.
example.zh: 這筆扣款會出現在你下一張薪資單上。

example.en: Subtract the discount from the total price.
example.zh: 從總價中減去折扣。

example.en: We plan to reduce our monthly costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們打算把每月成本降低百分之十。

example.en: Regular customers receive a five percent discount.
example.zh: 老客戶可享有百分之五的折扣。

derived.link: deduct + -ion，把「扣除」變成名詞，像 introduce → introduction
deduct + -ible，可以被…的，像 flexible、possible

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone about a problem or danger so they can act
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，alert 是動詞，Brightline must alert the finance department 指發生中斷後必須「在二十四小時內通知」財務部。alert 比 tell 更正式，帶有「提醒對方留意並採取行動」的語感。

example.en: The system alerts the team whenever sales drop below the target.
example.zh: 每當銷售額低於目標，系統就會通知團隊。

example.en: A customer alerted us to the error on her invoice.
example.zh: 一位顧客提醒我們她的請款單上有錯誤。

example.en: Alerting staff early helped us avoid a much bigger delay.
example.zh: 及早通知員工，幫助我們避免了更嚴重的延誤。

example.en: The receptionist watched alertly as visitors entered the lobby.
example.zh: 訪客進入大廳時，櫃檯人員保持警覺地留意著。

example.en: Please alert the team to any changes in the schedule.
example.zh: 行程若有任何變動，請通知團隊注意。

example.en: Drivers must stay alert during long business trips.
example.zh: 司機在長途出差途中必須保持警覺。

example.en: We sent a security alert to all users this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上對所有使用者發出了資安警示。

example.en: Hospitals were put on alert after the storm warning.
example.zh: 風暴警報發布後，各醫院進入戒備狀態。

examples.en: The system will alert the IT team if someone tries to log in.
examples.zh: 若有人嘗試登入，系統會通知資訊團隊。

examples.en: Please alert the manager as soon as a customer complains.
examples.zh: 只要有顧客投訴，請立刻通知經理。

examples.en: Travelers received an alert about the flight delay on their phones.
examples.zh: 旅客在手機上收到了航班延誤的通知。

examples.en: The new staff members seem alert and ready to learn.
examples.zh: 新進員工看起來機靈，也準備好要學習。

confusable.diff: warn 強調「警告」有危險或問題（如 warn about the risk）；alert 是「通知對方注意並採取行動」，語氣較中性。

example.en: The manual warns users not to open the machine while it runs.
example.zh: 手冊警告使用者，機器運轉時不要打開它。

confusable.diff: notify 是正式的「通知」某事已發生或將發生；alert 多帶有緊急、需要馬上留意的意味。

example.en: Please notify the manager when the delivery arrives at the dock.
example.zh: 貨物送達碼頭時，請通知經理。

example.en: The email warns users about a new virus.
example.zh: 這封電子郵件警告使用者注意一種新病毒。

example.en: We will notify you when your order ships.
example.zh: 您的訂單出貨時，我們會通知您。

example.en: You will receive a notification by email.
example.zh: 你會收到一封電子郵件通知。

example.en: The fire alarm rang during the morning meeting.
example.zh: 晨會期間，火災警報響了。

derived.link: alert + -ness，變成名詞，像 kindness、happiness

example.en: Please alert the manager as soon as a customer complains.
example.zh: 只要有顧客投訴，請立刻通知經理。

example.en: Everyone received a security alert on their phones.
example.zh: 每個人的手機都收到了資安警示。

example.en: The new staff members seem alert and ready to learn.
example.zh: 新進員工看起來很機靈，也準備好學習了。

senses.en: to tell someone about a problem so they can act

example.en: The system will alert the IT team if a server stops.
example.zh: 如果伺服器停止運作，系統會通知資訊團隊。

senses.en: a message that warns people about a problem
senses.distinguish: 指手機、系統發出的警示訊息。

example.en: The app sends an alert when the price drops.
example.zh: 價格下跌時，這個應用程式會發出提醒通知。

senses.en: a state of being ready for danger
senses.distinguish: 常見 on alert、be on alert，指提高戒備。

example.en: The staff were put on alert after the storm warning.
example.zh: 風暴警報發布後，工作人員進入戒備狀態。

extra_vocab.en: to give someone the right to have or do something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，will entitle the client to a credit 是合約修訂裡的正式用語：服務中斷超過四小時，客戶就「有權」獲得一筆抵扣額度。語氣正式，常見於合約與公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: entitle A to B（B 是名詞）或 entitle A to + V；被動 be entitled to 後面也是接名詞或原形動詞，to 之後不接 V-ing。

example.en: The extended warranty entitles customers to free repairs for two years.
example.zh: 延長保固讓顧客有權享有兩年的免費維修。

example.en: The previous agreement entitled each branch to its own budget.
example.zh: 先前的協議讓每間分公司都有權擁有自己的預算。

example.en: The clause entitling the client to a refund was added last week.
example.zh: 賦予客戶退款權利的條款是上週加進去的。

example.en: All members are entitled to a free annual check-up.
example.zh: 所有會員都有權享有一次免費年度檢查。

example.en: This warranty entitles you to a full refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 這項保固讓你有權在三十天內全額退款。

example.en: Customers with a membership card are entitled to a discount.
example.zh: 持有會員卡的顧客有權享有折扣。

example.en: The contract entitles the client to receive monthly reports.
example.zh: 合約讓客戶有權每月收到報告。

examples.en: Late delivery entitles the buyer to cancel the order.
examples.zh: 延遲交貨讓買方有權取消訂單。

examples.en: Full-time staff are entitled to twenty days of paid leave.
examples.zh: 全職員工有權享有二十天的帶薪假。

confusable.diff: enable 是「使能夠做到」，強調能力或條件；entitle 是「使有權利」，強調資格或法律、合約上的權利。

example.en: The new software enables staff to work from home.
example.zh: 新軟體讓員工能夠在家工作。

similar.diff: qualify for 是主語「符合資格而能取得」；entitle 是某事物「賦予對方權利」，主語通常是合約或規定。

example.en: Employees qualify for a bonus after one year of service.
example.zh: 員工服務滿一年後有資格領取獎金。

similar.diff: authorize 是「授權、批准」某人做某事；entitle 是「賦予享有某利益的權利」。

example.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new equipment.
example.zh: 經理批准了購買新設備。

example.en: Only full-time staff are eligible for this benefit.
example.zh: 只有全職員工有資格享有這項福利。

example.en: You will receive a full refund within ten days.
example.zh: 你會在十天內收到全額退款。

derived.link: 詞幹 title；en-（使成為）+ title，原意是「給某人名分或頭銜」，後來變成「賦予權利」
entitle + -ment，把「賦予權利」變名詞，像 manage → management

senses.en: to give someone the right to get or do something

example.en: A valid receipt entitles you to a free repair.
example.zh: 有效的收據讓你有權免費維修。

senses.en: to give a title to a book, report, or film
senses.distinguish: 常用被動 be entitled + 標題，指書、報告或文件的標題。

example.en: The report is entitled Annual Review of Customer Service.
example.zh: 這份報告的標題是《客戶服務年度回顧》。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：輕量嬰兒推車新產品提案簡報

level.why: 提案簡報含 which 非限定子句、although 讓步結構、分詞與被動（was well received、has not fully recovered），並需整合市場需求、原型設計、供應商風險與建議、時程與預算等多段資訊。干擾項取自文中出現過的材質、月份與測試活動，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone. Today I would like to propose that we develop a new lightweight stroller aimed at urban families. I will begin with the market opportunity, then outline the design, and finally walk you through the timetable and budget.

First, our surveys show that parents increasingly prefer strollers that fold with one hand and weigh under seven kilograms. However, most existing models are either too heavy or too fragile to be considered durable. Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining an aluminum frame with a sleek, elegant fabric finish, which was well received in last month's focus groups.

Second, regarding production, we plan to work with our current supplier, although we must acknowledge a risk. The earthquake last spring damaged part of its plant, and its capacity has not fully recovered. To reduce our exposure, I recommend qualifying a second supplier before the launch.

Finally, the timetable. Testing will be completed by March, and mass production is expected to begin in June. The total development cost is estimated at 450,000 dollars, of which 30 percent has already been approved.

That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安。今天我想提議開發一款針對都會家庭的全新輕量嬰兒推車。我會先從市場機會談起，接著說明設計，最後帶大家看時程與預算。

首先，我們的調查顯示，家長越來越偏好能單手收折、重量低於七公斤的推車。然而，現有的多數款式不是太重，就是太脆弱，稱不上耐用。我們的原型機以鋁製車架搭配俐落優雅的布料表面處理，解決了這兩個疑慮，這一點在上個月的焦點團體中獲得了良好的回響。

其次，關於生產，我們打算與現有供應商合作，不過必須承認其中有風險。去年春天的地震破壞了該供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。為降低我們的風險，我建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

最後是時程。測試將在三月前完成，量產預計在六月開始。總開發成本預估為四十五萬美元，其中百分之三十已經獲得核准。

我的簡報到此結束。我很樂意回答大家的任何問題。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the presentation?
opts: To report on last month's focus group results
To announce the selection of a new supplier
To propose the development of a new product
To request additional funding for an existing product
why: 焦點團體只是用來說明原型獲得好評的佐證，並非簡報主旨。
說話者只是建議認證第二家供應商，並未宣布已選定新供應商。
正解：說話者開頭即表明要提議開發一款新的輕量嬰兒推車，其餘內容是說明市場、設計、風險與時程。
預算中只提到已有百分之三十獲得核准，並非要求為既有產品增加資金。

questions.q: What risk does the speaker mention regarding production?
opts: The supplier's production capacity has not fully recovered.
The prototype failed a safety test in March.
The focus groups disliked the fabric finish.
why: 正解：去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。
三月是測試預計完成的時間，文中沒有說原型安全測試失敗。
文中說家長越來越偏好輕量的推車，並非偏好較重的款式。
焦點團體對布料表面處理的反應良好，並非不喜歡。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend doing before the launch?
opts: Postponing mass production until next year
Replacing the aluminum frame with a lighter material
Conducting additional focus groups with parents
why: 文中說量產預計六月開始，並沒有建議延後到明年。
鋁製車架是原型的設計，說話者沒有建議更換。
焦點團體是上個月已經進行過的活動，說話者並未建議再增加。
正解：為降低風險，說話者建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

questions.q: The committee will ______ the proposal at its next meeting.
why: considerate 是形容詞，意為「體貼的」，不能接在助動詞 will 之後作動詞。
正解：will 之後接原形動詞 consider，表示委員會將審議該提案。
considerably 是副詞，不能單獨作動詞，且後面不能接受詞 the proposal。
considered 是過去式或過去分詞，不能直接接在助動詞 will 之後。

questions.q: Please direct any questions ______ the presentation to Ms. Park in the marketing department.
why: 正解：regarding 在此作介系詞，意為「關於」，後面接 the presentation。
regarded 是過去分詞，語意為「被視為」，不能直接連接 the presentation。
regards 是名詞或第三人稱單數動詞，放在此處結構與語意都不符。
regard 是原形動詞或名詞，不能直接作為介系詞來修飾 questions。

questions.q: The project manager will present the findings ______ the board of directors on Friday.
why: at 通常接地點或時間點，present the findings at the board 語意不通。
from 表示來源，語意是「來自董事會」，與簡報的對象不符。
正解：present ... to 表示向某人報告，對象是董事會。
by 表示「由……」或「在……之前」，無法表示報告的對象。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Today I would like to propose that we develop...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 今天我想提議我們開發……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報開場，直接點出提案主題，that 子句內動詞用原形。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I will begin with..., then outline..., and finally walk you through...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我會先從……開始，接著概述……，最後帶大家看……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於開場後預告簡報架構，幫助聽眾掌握順序。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our surveys show that...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的調查顯示……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明重點，引用調查或數據支持論點。

presentation_phrases.phrase: However, most existing models are either too ... or too ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 然而，現有的多數款式不是太……，就是太……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉折，指出現有產品的不足，帶出自己提案的價值。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的原型機透過結合……解決了這兩個疑慮
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明解決方案，by + 動名詞說明做法。

presentation_phrases.phrase: To reduce our exposure, I recommend...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 為降低我們的風險，我建議……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於提出風險因應建議，帶出下一步行動。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Finally, the timetable.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 最後是時程。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉入最後一個重點，提示聽眾簡報即將進入尾聲。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我的簡報到此結束，我很樂意回答任何問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報結尾並開放問答，語氣禮貌且專業。

extra_vocab.en: a list that shows when things will happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the timetable 指新產品從測試到量產的「時程」，後面接著說明測試與量產的時間點。timetable 是英式用法較常見的字，美式多說 schedule，兩者在簡報中都能用。

example.en: Please send me the timetables for all three production lines.
example.zh: 請把三條生產線的時程表都寄給我。

example.en: We must stick to the timetable to finish before the holiday.
example.zh: 我們必須按照時程進行，才能在假期前完成。

example.en: The team is working to a tight timetable this quarter.
example.zh: 團隊本季的工作時程很緊湊。

example.en: The project timetable has changed because of the delay in testing.
example.zh: 由於測試延誤，專案時程表已經更動。

example.en: We need to revise the timetable after the supplier's response.
example.zh: 收到供應商的回覆後，我們需要修改時程表。

examples.en: Please review the timetable and tell me if any dates are a problem.
examples.zh: 請看一下時程表，若有任何日期有問題請告訴我。

examples.en: The train timetable shows a departure every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 火車時刻表顯示每三十分鐘有一班車出發。

examples.en: The conference timetable will be sent to all participants next week.
examples.zh: 研討會的時間表將於下週寄給所有參加者。

confusable.diff: schedule 是美式較常用的「時程、行程安排」，也可當動詞「安排」；timetable 多指列出時間的「時刻表、時程表」，英式用法較常見。

example.en: Please schedule a meeting with the client for Wednesday afternoon.
example.zh: 請替客戶安排在星期三下午的會議。

confusable.diff: agenda 是會議的「議程」，列的是討論項目；timetable 列的是各項事情發生的時間。

example.en: Please send the agenda to everyone before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請把議程寄給每個人。

example.en: We are behind schedule because of the late delivery.
example.zh: 由於延遲交貨，我們的進度落後了。

example.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
example.zh: 議程上的第一項是預算。

example.en: The deadline for the proposal is next Monday.
example.zh: 提案的截止期限是下週一。

example.en: I added the meeting to the shared calendar.
example.zh: 我把這場會議加進了共用行事曆。

senses.en: a plan that shows when things will happen

example.en: The project timetable has changed because of the testing delay.
example.zh: 由於測試延誤，專案時程表已經更動。

senses.en: a list that shows when trains or buses leave
senses.distinguish: 談火車、公車、航班時，指班次的時刻表。

example.en: The bus timetable shows a departure every twenty minutes.
example.zh: 公車時刻表顯示每二十分鐘有一班車。

extra_vocab.en: beautiful in a simple and attractive way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sleek, elegant fabric finish 形容推車的布料表面質感簡潔又有品味，是在強調產品的外觀賣點。elegant 在商務情境中多用來描述設計、空間或場合，有「簡單卻高雅」的正面語感。

example.en: The new logo looks more elegant than the old one.
example.zh: 新的標誌看起來比舊的更雅緻。

example.en: This is the most elegant design in our current catalog.
example.zh: 這是我們目前型錄中最雅緻的設計。

example.en: The product page presents our new models elegantly and clearly.
example.zh: 這個產品頁面典雅又清楚地展示了我們的新款式。

example.en: The elegance of the packaging impressed our overseas buyers.
example.zh: 包裝的雅緻讓我們的海外買家印象深刻。

example.en: Customers praised the elegant design of the new laptop.
example.zh: 顧客稱讚這台新筆電的設計優雅。

example.en: The engineers found an elegant solution to the heat problem.
example.zh: 工程師找到了一個簡潔巧妙的方法來解決過熱問題。

example.en: The lobby is elegantly designed and very welcoming.
example.zh: 大廳設計典雅，讓人感覺很親切。

examples.en: The brochure has an elegant layout that customers find easy to read.
examples.zh: 這本手冊的版面雅緻，顧客覺得容易閱讀。

examples.en: The hotel restaurant offers an elegant dining room for client dinners.
examples.zh: 飯店餐廳提供雅緻的用餐空間，適合招待客戶晚宴。

examples.en: She gave an elegant speech at the awards dinner.
examples.zh: 她在頒獎晚宴上發表了一場優雅得體的演說。

confusable.diff: stylish 是「時髦的、有流行感的」；elegant 是「高雅、簡潔有品味」，不一定追求流行。

example.en: The new phone looks stylish, but it is not very practical.
example.zh: 這支新手機看起來很時髦，但不太實用。

confusable.diff: luxurious 是「奢華的」，強調昂貴與豪華；elegant 強調簡潔優雅，不一定貴。

example.en: The luxurious hotel suite costs over a thousand dollars a night.
example.zh: 這間奢華的飯店套房一晚要價超過一千美元。

example.en: The elegance of the product made it popular in Europe.
example.zh: 這項產品的雅緻風格使它在歐洲大受歡迎。

example.en: The room was elegantly decorated for the opening event.
example.zh: 這個房間為開幕活動布置得典雅大方。

example.en: The store sells stylish bags at fair prices.
example.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售時髦的包包。

derived.link: elegant 的 -ant 換成 -ance，變成名詞，像 important → importance
elegant + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully

extra_vocab.en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，The earthquake last spring 指去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商的部分工廠，使產能尚未完全恢復，因此提案才建議找第二家供應商。商務文章中常用它來說明供應風險或營運中斷的原因。

example.en: Earthquakes in the region have raised insurance costs for local factories.
example.zh: 該地區的地震使當地工廠的保險費用上升。

example.en: A strong earthquake shook the city early this morning.
example.zh: 今天清晨一場強烈地震震動了這座城市。

example.en: Earthquake damage to the warehouse delayed all shipments this month.
example.zh: 倉庫的地震災損使本月所有貨物出貨都延遲了。

example.en: Does the company carry earthquake insurance for its main factory?
example.zh: 公司有為主要工廠投保地震險嗎？

example.en: The new office building was built to be earthquake-resistant.
example.zh: 這棟新辦公大樓是以耐震為目標興建的。

examples.en: The earthquake forced the airport to close for several hours.
examples.zh: 地震迫使機場關閉了數小時。

examples.en: Our insurance covers damage to the building caused by an earthquake.
examples.zh: 我們的保險涵蓋地震對建築物造成的損害。

examples.en: After the earthquake, many factories had to stop production for weeks.
examples.zh: 地震過後，許多工廠必須停產數週。

confusable.diff: quake 是 earthquake 的簡短說法，常見於新聞標題；正式的商務文件多用 earthquake。

example.en: Reports of a quake near the plant appeared on the news.
example.zh: 新聞上出現了工廠附近發生地震的報導。

confusable.diff: disaster 是「災難」的泛稱，包含地震、水災、火災等；earthquake 只指「地震」這種災害。

example.en: The flood was a disaster for the small local business.
example.zh: 這場水災對這家當地小企業來說是一場災難。

example.en: The company has a plan for natural disasters.
example.zh: 公司對天然災害訂有應變計畫。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
example.zh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重損壞。

example.en: Sales have started to recover after the slow winter.
example.zh: 經過冷清的冬天後，銷售額開始回升。

example.en: Staff should know the exit routes in an emergency.
example.zh: 員工應該知道緊急情況下的逃生路線。

extra_vocab.en: strong and able to last a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，too fragile to be considered durable 指市面上多數推車太脆弱，稱不上耐用，這正是新產品要解決的問題之一。durable 常用來形容產品在長期使用下不易損壞。

example.en: Steel is more durable than plastic for this kind of frame.
example.zh: 這種車架用鋼材比塑膠更耐用。

example.en: This is the most durable fabric we have ever tested.
example.zh: 這是我們測試過最耐用的布料。

example.en: The bags are durably stitched to survive years of heavy use.
example.zh: 這些袋子縫得很牢固，能承受多年的高強度使用。

example.en: Buyers care about durability when they choose a stroller.
example.zh: 買家在挑選嬰兒推車時很在意耐用性。

example.en: Aluminum is a light and durable material for strollers.
example.zh: 鋁是用來製作嬰兒推車的輕巧又耐用的材料。

example.en: Sales of durable goods rose during the holiday season.
example.zh: 耐久財的銷售額在假期期間上升。

example.en: The packaging is highly durable and protects products during shipping.
example.zh: 這種包裝非常耐用，能在運送過程中保護商品。

examples.en: Customers want a durable product that will last for many years.
examples.zh: 顧客想要能使用多年的耐用產品。

examples.en: We chose steel because it is cheap and durable.
examples.zh: 我們選擇鋼材，因為它既便宜又耐用。

examples.en: Our new phone case is light yet very durable.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機殼很輕，卻非常耐用。

confusable.diff: sturdy 強調外型「結實、穩固」（如 sturdy chair）；durable 強調「長期使用不易壞」。

example.en: We need a sturdy table for the heavy printing equipment.
example.zh: 我們需要一張結實的桌子來放這台沉重的印刷設備。

confusable.diff: fragile 是反義字，指「易碎、脆弱的」；durable 是「耐用的」。

example.en: Mark the carton fragile because the glass cups can easily break.
example.zh: 請在紙箱上標示易碎，因為玻璃杯很容易破。

example.en: The tests showed excellent durability under heavy use.
example.zh: 測試顯示它在高強度使用下耐用性極佳。

example.en: The shelf is sturdy enough to hold heavy boxes.
example.zh: 這個架子夠結實，可以放重的箱子。

example.en: Please mark the box as fragile before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨前請在箱子上標示為易碎品。

derived.link: durable 去掉 le 加 -ility，變成名詞，像 able → ability

example.en: This durable case protects the phone for many years.
example.zh: 這個耐用的保護殼能保護手機好幾年。

example.en: Sales of durables rose sharply during the holiday season.
example.zh: 耐久財的銷售額在假期期間大幅上升。

extra_vocab.en: the first model of a product, made to test the design
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報裡，prototype 指推車的第一件試作樣品，用來證明新設計能同時解決「太重」與「不耐用」兩個問題。產品提案中說「Our prototype…」是很常見的開場方式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prototype 是可數名詞，單數前一定要加 a 或 the（或 our 等所有格），例如 a prototype、our prototype。

example.en: The team showed three prototypes to the board on Thursday morning.
example.zh: 團隊在週四早上向董事會展示了三件原型。

example.en: The engineers need two weeks to build a prototype of the new chair.
example.zh: 工程師需要兩週時間製作新椅子的原型。

example.en: We will test a prototype with real customers before approving production.
example.zh: 我們會先讓真實顧客測試原型，再核准量產。

example.en: Investors asked to see a working prototype before they signed the agreement.
example.zh: 投資人在簽約前要求看可運作的原型。

example.en: Prototype testing showed that the handle broke under heavy use.
example.zh: 原型測試顯示把手在重度使用下會斷裂。

examples.en: Our prototype weighs less than any model currently on the market.
examples.zh: 我們的原型比目前市面上任何機型都輕。

examples.en: The design team will present the first prototype at Monday's meeting.
examples.zh: 設計團隊將在週一的會議中展示第一件原型。

examples.en: Please send me photos of the prototype by the end of the day.
examples.zh: 請在今天下班前把原型的照片寄給我。

confusable.diff: protocol 是「通訊協定／標準作業程序」，開頭拼法相似，但和產品試作品無關。

example.en: All staff must follow the safety protocol when entering the factory.
example.zh: 所有員工進入工廠時都必須遵守安全規範。

similar.diff: sample 通常是從已完成的產品或供應商拿到的樣品；prototype 是還在開發階段的試作品。

example.en: The supplier sent us a sample of the new fabric yesterday.
example.zh: 供應商昨天寄給我們新布料的樣品。

similar.diff: model 可以指模型或產品款式，不一定是試作品，語意比 prototype 廣。

example.en: This model is lighter than last year's version, but it costs more.
example.zh: 這個款式比去年的版本輕，但價格比較高。

example.en: The design of the new handle is simple and comfortable.
example.zh: 新把手的設計簡單又舒適。

example.en: The launch of the product is scheduled for early June.
example.zh: 產品預定在六月初上市。

example.en: Each part must meet the specification in the contract.
example.zh: 每個零件都必須符合合約中的規格。

derived.link: prototype + -ing，把「做原型」這個過程變成名詞，像 marketing、planning

items.tag: 1. Introduction & folding

level.why: 口說簡報，句子短而清楚，以 instead of、before folding、but 等簡單結構說明產品特色與折疊步驟；字彙如 carbon fiber、cutout、fasten、guidelines 屬產品與操作的常見詞，整體負擔不高。

items.passage:
Next, I'd like to introduce our Super Lite, a lightweight, compact stroller.

The main feature of this stroller is its carbon fiber frame.

Instead of traditional metal tubes, we use carbon fiber tubes to reduce the overall weight.

We also added some cutouts to the plastic parts to remove unnecessary material and make them lighter.

As a result, the stroller weighs only around 4.3 kilograms.

Let me show you how it folds.

The stroller can fold with the backrest either upright or fully reclined.

Before folding, we recommend fastening the rear backrest panel.

This helps keep the panel close to the frame when folded, so it doesn't hang down and touch the ground.

You can also fasten it after folding, but it's easier to do it beforehand.

Then, simply press the folding button on the handlebar to fold the stroller.

When folded, it meets the IATA cabin baggage size guidelines, but you need to remove the bumper bar first.
items.zh:
接下來，我想向大家介紹我們的 Super Lite，一款輕量、小巧的嬰兒推車。

這款推車的主要特色是碳纖維車架。

我們不使用傳統的金屬管，而是改用碳纖維管，以降低整體重量。

我們也在塑膠零件上加了一些鏤空設計，去除不必要的材料，讓它們更輕。

因此，這款推車的重量只有大約 4.3 公斤。

讓我示範給大家看它如何折疊。

無論椅背是直立或是完全放平，這款推車都可以折疊。

折疊之前，我們建議先扣上後方的椅背面板。

這有助於讓面板在折疊時緊貼車架，不會垂下來碰到地面。

您也可以在折疊後再扣上，但事先扣好會比較容易。

接著，只要按下手把上的折疊按鈕，就能將推車折起來。

折疊後，它符合 IATA 機艙行李尺寸規範，但您必須先拆下防護扶手（bumper bar）。

vocab.col: carbon fiber frame / carbon fiber tube

questions.q: How did the company reduce the overall weight of the Super Lite?
opts: By using carbon fiber tubes instead of metal tubes
By making the folded size smaller
By replacing plastic parts with metal ones
why: 背靠面板是用來說明折疊時如何固定，與減重無關。
正解：講者說用碳纖維管取代傳統金屬管，以降低整體重量。
折疊尺寸與是否符合機艙規範有關，並非減重的方式。
文中是在塑膠零件上加鏤空來減輕重量，被取代的是金屬管，並非把塑膠換成金屬。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend doing before folding the stroller?
why: 文中沒有提到要拆下手把，手把上的按鈕反而是用來折疊的。
文中只說按下折疊按鈕即可折疊，沒有說要按兩次。
文中說椅背直立或完全放平都可以折疊，並非必要步驟。
正解：講者建議折疊前先扣上後方的椅背面板。

questions.q: What must users do for the folded stroller to meet the cabin baggage size guidelines?
why: 正解：講者說折疊後要符合 IATA 機艙行李尺寸規範，必須先拆下防護扶手。
文中沒有提到要拆輪子。
折疊後也可以扣上面板，但這是方便程度的問題，與機艙尺寸規範無關。
文中說椅背直立或放平都可以折疊，並未說必須維持放平。

questions.q: Our engineers chose carbon fiber because it is much ______ than steel.
why: light 是原級，不能與 than 搭配成比較結構。
lightly 是副詞，不能放在 is 之後作補語。
正解：than 前面需要比較級形容詞，lighter 表示「更輕」。
lightness 是名詞，不能與 much ... than 形成比較。

questions.q: The new stroller can be folded ______ one hand, so parents can hold their child at the same time.
why: by 後面接 one hand 不是慣用說法，使用身體部位時應用 with。
正解：with 表示「用（身體部位或工具）」，with one hand 即「單手」。
at 不用於表示使用工具或身體部位完成動作。
for 表示目的或對象，語意不通。

questions.q: All carry-on items must ______ with the airline's size restrictions.
why: complain 指抱怨，後面接 about，不接 with。
compete 指競爭，搭配 with 時意思是「與……競爭」，語意不符。
compare 指比較，與航空公司尺寸規定的語意不符。
正解：comply with 表示「遵守、符合（規定）」，符合句意。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, I'd like to introduce ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接下來，我想介紹……
presentation_phrases.usage: 進入下一個產品或主題時的轉場開場句

presentation_phrases.phrase: The main feature of this product is ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這項產品的主要特色是……
presentation_phrases.usage: 點出產品最核心的賣點

presentation_phrases.phrase: Instead of ..., we use ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們不使用……，而是改用……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計上的改變與取代方案

presentation_phrases.phrase: As a result, it weighs only around ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 因此，它的重量只有大約……
presentation_phrases.usage: 以具體數字呈現成果

presentation_phrases.usage: 由說明轉入實際操作示範

presentation_phrases.phrase: Before folding, we recommend ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 折疊之前，我們建議……

presentation_phrases.usage: 說明簡單的操作步驟

presentation_phrases.phrase: When folded, it meets ..., but you need to ...

extra_vocab.en: not heavy; weighing very little
extra_vocab.note: 文中用來形容 Super Lite 推車，是簡報開場的主要賣點。lightweight 強調產品被刻意設計得輕，常出現在產品介紹與廣告用語中。

example.en: The lightweight design makes this suitcase easy to carry through airports.
example.zh: 輕量化設計讓這個行李箱很容易帶著穿過機場。

example.en: We switched to a lightweight material to cut shipping costs.
example.zh: 我們改用輕量材料以降低運費。

example.en: The frame is lightweight and durable, so customers love it.
example.zh: 這個車架輕又耐用，所以顧客很喜歡。

examples.en: Our new laptop is lightweight and easy to carry on trips.
examples.zh: 我們的新筆電很輕，出差攜帶很方便。

examples.en: The supplier offers lightweight materials at a competitive price.
examples.zh: 供應商以具競爭力的價格提供輕量材料。

examples.en: Please recommend a lightweight bag for our sales team.
examples.zh: 請為我們的業務團隊推薦一款輕量的包包。

similar.diff: light 是一般的「輕」；lightweight 更強調產品設計得很輕，常當賣點。

example.en: This tablet is light enough to carry around all day.
example.zh: 這台平板夠輕，可以整天帶著走。

similar.diff: portable 強調方便攜帶、可以搬動，不一定真的很輕。

example.en: A portable charger is useful during long business trips.
example.zh: 可攜式充電器在長途出差時很有用。

example.en: Our compact printer fits easily on any small desk.
example.zh: 我們的小型印表機可以輕鬆放在任何小桌上。

example.en: The new phone has a slim body and a large screen.
example.zh: 這款新手機機身纖薄，螢幕很大。

example.en: Customers want a durable product that lasts for many years.
example.zh: 顧客想要能使用多年的耐用產品。

extra_vocab.en: a very light and strong material made from thin carbon threads
extra_vocab.note: 文中放在 frame、tubes 前面當形容詞，說明推車用碳纖維製作，是減重的關鍵材料。碳纖維常用在自行車、汽車與運動用品。
extra_vocab.pattern: carbon fiber + N（frame／tube／panel）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: carbon fiber 當材料名稱時是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s，例如 made of carbon fiber；放在名詞前面修飾時也不加 s（carbon fiber frame）。

examples.en: The bike frame is made of carbon fiber to save weight.
examples.zh: 這輛自行車的車架以碳纖維製成，以節省重量。

examples.en: We compared carbon fiber with aluminum before choosing a material.
examples.zh: 我們在選材料之前比較了碳纖維和鋁。

examples.en: Carbon fiber is strong, but it costs more than metal.
examples.zh: 碳纖維很堅固，但成本比金屬高。

similar.diff: carbon fibre 是英式拼法，意思與 carbon fiber 完全相同。

example.en: The British supplier sells carbon fibre sheets in several sizes.
example.zh: 這家英國供應商販售多種尺寸的碳纖維板。

similar.diff: composite material 是「複合材料」的總稱，碳纖維是其中一種。

example.en: Carbon fiber is a composite material used in many sports products.
example.zh: 碳纖維是一種複合材料，用在許多運動產品上。

confusable.diff: fiberglass 是玻璃纖維，比碳纖維便宜也比較重；兩者外觀可能相似但性能不同。

example.en: The boat hull is made of fiberglass, which is heavier and cheaper.
example.zh: 這艘船的船身以玻璃纖維製成，比較重但便宜。

extra_vocab.en: a part that is cut out of something, leaving an open space
extra_vocab.note: 文中 cutouts 指塑膠零件上被切掉、鏤空的區域，目的是去除不必要的材料來減輕重量。這是產品設計與製造常用的名詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞 cutout 寫成一個字；動詞片語 cut out 要分開寫，而且過去式仍是 cut out（cut 的三態不變）。

example.en: The engineers added three cutouts to the plastic cover.
example.zh: 工程師在塑膠外蓋上加了三個鏤空。

example.en: The panel has a rectangular cutout for the power cable.
example.zh: 這片面板有一個供電源線穿過的長方形切口。

example.en: The factory can make a cutout in each metal sheet.
example.zh: 工廠可以在每片金屬板上做出鏤空。

example.en: A small cutout in the panel reduces the total weight.
example.zh: 面板上的小鏤空可以減輕總重量。

examples.en: We added a cutout to the handle to save material.
examples.zh: 我們在把手上加了鏤空以節省材料。

examples.en: The cutout must match the size of the screen exactly.
examples.zh: 鏤空的尺寸必須和螢幕大小完全吻合。

examples.en: The store placed a cardboard cutout near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 這家店把一個紙板立牌放在主要入口附近。

confusable.diff: cut out 分開寫是動詞片語，意思是「切除、刪減」；cutout 是名詞。
confusable.usage: cutout 是名詞，指被切掉的部分；cut out 是動詞片語，後面要接受詞。

example.en: We need to cut out unnecessary costs this quarter.
example.zh: 我們這一季需要刪減不必要的成本。

confusable.diff: cutback 是預算、人力等的「削減」；cutout 是實體上被切掉的孔洞。

example.en: The company announced a cutback in travel spending this year.
example.zh: 公司宣布今年縮減差旅支出。

example.en: There is a small hole in the side of the box.
example.zh: 盒子側面有一個小洞。

example.en: The opening at the top is too narrow for the cable.
example.zh: 上方的開口對這條電線來說太窄。

example.en: Insert the card into the slot on the front panel.
example.zh: 把卡片插入前面板上的插槽。

senses.en: an open space that is cut into a part

example.en: The cutout lets air flow through the device more easily.
example.zh: 這個鏤空讓空氣更容易流過裝置。

senses.en: a flat picture or shape cut out of cardboard
senses.distinguish: 談到行銷、展示或店面佈置時，通常指紙板立牌。

example.en: A life-size cardboard cutout will attract customers to our booth.
example.zh: 真人大小的紙板立牌會吸引顧客來我們的攤位。

extra_vocab.en: to close or attach something firmly
extra_vocab.note: 文中 recommend fastening 的意思是建議先把後方椅背面板扣好，折疊時才不會垂下碰地。這裡是操作說明的語氣，簡單直接。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fasten 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞（fasten the strap）；固定到某物上時用 fasten A to B。字中的 t 不發音。

example.en: The clip fastens the cable to the frame.
example.zh: 這個夾子把電線固定在車架上。

example.en: She fastened the strap before lifting the box.
example.zh: 她在抬起箱子之前先扣好了束帶。

example.en: He is fastening the panel to the base.
example.zh: 他正在把面板固定到底座上。

example.en: Please fasten your seat belt before the car moves.
example.zh: 車子開動之前，請繫好安全帶。

example.en: Make sure the cover is fastened securely before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨之前，請確認外蓋已牢牢扣緊。

collocations.zh: 把 A 固定在 B 上

example.en: Use two screws to fasten the bracket to the wall.
example.zh: 用兩顆螺絲把支架固定在牆上。

examples.en: Fasten the strap tightly so the baby stays safe.
examples.zh: 把束帶扣緊，讓寶寶保持安全。

examples.en: All passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff.
examples.zh: 所有乘客在起飛時都必須繫好安全帶。

examples.en: Fasten the two parts together before you turn on the machine.
examples.zh: 開機之前，先把兩個零件固定在一起。

confusable.diff: fast 是形容詞或副詞，意思是「快的」；fasten 是動詞「扣緊」，拼法相近但 t 不發音。
confusable.usage: fast 描述速度，不接受詞；fasten 是動詞，後面要接受詞。

example.en: The fast delivery service saved us two days this month.
example.zh: 快速配送服務這個月替我們省下了兩天。

similar.diff: secure 當動詞是「使牢固、確保」，範圍比 fasten 廣。

example.en: Please secure the load before the truck leaves the factory.
example.zh: 卡車離開工廠之前，請先把貨物固定好。

similar.diff: attach 強調把東西附加或接上去，不一定要扣緊。

example.en: Please attach the invoice to this email before you send it.
example.zh: 請把發票附在這封電子郵件上。

example.en: The workers secure each box with strong tape.
example.zh: 工人用堅固的膠帶把每個箱子封好。

example.en: Attach the label to the front of the package.
example.zh: 把標籤貼在包裹正面。

example.en: Buckle the belt around the seat before you start.
example.zh: 開始之前，先把帶子扣在座椅上。

derived.link: fasten + -er，做固定這件事的東西，像 opener、printer
un- + fasten，相反動作，像 lock → unlock

extra_vocab.en: leaning back; not sitting straight
extra_vocab.note: 文中 fully reclined 指椅背完全放平，與 upright（直立）形成對比，說明推車不論椅背在哪種位置都能折疊。reclined 在這裡是過去分詞當形容詞，描述椅背的狀態。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: recline 當動詞可以是及物（recline the seat）或不及物（She reclined in the chair）；reclined 放在 be 或 fully 之後，表示椅背「已被放平」的狀態。

example.en: The seat reclines when you press the lever.
example.zh: 你按下拉桿時，座椅會向後傾斜。

example.en: The passenger is reclining his seat to rest.
example.zh: 那位乘客正放倒座椅休息。

example.en: The seat can stay fully reclined during the long flight.
example.zh: 座椅在長途飛行中可以一直保持完全放平。

example.en: The baby sleeps well in the reclined position.
example.zh: 寶寶在放平的位置上睡得很好。

example.en: Please do not recline the seat during meal service.
example.zh: 用餐服務期間請勿放倒座椅。

examples.en: The chair can be used upright or in a reclined position.
examples.zh: 這張椅子可以直立使用，也可以放平使用。

examples.en: You may recline your seat once the plane reaches cruising altitude.
examples.zh: 飛機到達巡航高度後，您可以放倒座椅。

examples.en: Press the button to adjust the backrest to a reclined angle.
examples.zh: 按下按鈕，把椅背調整到傾斜的角度。

confusable.diff: decline 是「下降、婉拒」，拼法相近但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: recline 是向後靠；decline 當動詞可以是不及物（下降），也可以是及物（婉拒邀請）。

example.en: Sales may decline if we raise our prices too quickly.
example.zh: 如果我們太快漲價，銷售可能會下滑。

confusable.diff: incline 是「使傾斜、使傾向」，常用 be inclined to，不是指椅背放平。

example.en: We are inclined to accept the offer if the price drops.
example.zh: 如果價格下降，我們傾向於接受這個報價。

example.en: Please tilt the screen so everyone can see it.
example.zh: 請把螢幕傾斜，讓每個人都看得到。

example.en: Do not lean on the glass door near the entrance.
example.zh: 請不要倚靠在玻璃門上。

example.en: Keep the seat in an upright position during takeoff.
example.zh: 起飛期間，請讓座椅保持直立。

derived.link: recline + -er，可以讓人往後躺的東西，像 printer、trainer

example.en: The reclined seat gives the child more room to rest.
example.zh: 放平的座椅讓孩子有更多空間休息。

example.en: Passengers can recline their seats after the meal service.
example.zh: 乘客可以在餐點服務之後放倒座椅。

senses.en: to make a seat or backrest lean back

example.en: The backrest can recline to several different angles.
example.zh: 這個椅背可以向後傾斜到好幾個不同角度。

senses.en: to lean back in a relaxed way
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人時，表示人自己往後靠；主詞是座椅時，表示座椅本身傾斜。

example.en: He reclined in his chair and read the report.
example.zh: 他靠在椅背上讀報告。

extra_vocab.en: rules or advice that tell you how to do something correctly
extra_vocab.note: 文中 IATA cabin baggage size guidelines 指國際航空運輸協會（IATA）對機艙行李尺寸的建議規範。meets the guidelines 表示折疊後的尺寸符合規範。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: guideline 是可數名詞，常用複數 guidelines；常搭配 follow、meet、comply with，注意 comply 後面要加 with。

example.en: All staff must follow the safety guidelines at the factory.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守工廠的安全準則。

example.en: This bag meets the airline's size guidelines for carry-on items.
example.zh: 這個包包符合航空公司對隨身行李的尺寸規範。

example.en: Our suppliers must comply with the environmental guidelines.
example.zh: 我們的供應商必須遵循環保準則。

example.en: The agency issued new guidelines for product safety last month.
example.zh: 該機構上個月發布了產品安全的新準則。

examples.en: Please review the attached guidelines before you submit your report.
examples.zh: 請在提交報告之前，先看過附上的準則。

examples.en: The new guidelines will take effect at the beginning of next month.
examples.zh: 新準則將在下個月初生效。

examples.en: Check the airline's baggage guidelines before you pack for the trip.
examples.zh: 打包行李之前，請先查看航空公司的行李規定。

confusable.diff: guidance 是「指導、建議」，是不可數名詞；guideline 是可數的具體準則。
confusable.usage: guidance 是不可數名詞，不加 s；guideline 是可數名詞，常用 guidelines。

example.en: She asked her manager for guidance on the new project.
example.zh: 她就新專案向經理尋求指導。

similar.diff: regulations 是正式的法規或規定，約束力較強；guidelines 較像建議的準則。

example.en: All visitors must follow the safety regulations at the factory.
example.zh: 所有訪客都必須遵守工廠的安全規定。

similar.diff: policy 是公司或組織的政策；guidelines 是具體執行時的準則。

example.en: The company policy requires approval for travel expenses over $500.
example.zh: 公司政策規定超過五百美元的差旅費需要核准。

example.en: Every employee must follow the rules of the company.
example.zh: 每位員工都必須遵守公司的規則。

example.en: The product meets the international safety standard for children's items.
example.zh: 這項產品符合國際安全標準。

example.en: Please follow the procedure for submitting a refund request.
example.zh: 請依照申請退款的流程辦理。

derived.link: guideline = guide + line，一條引導方向的線，像 headline、deadline

items.tag: 2.Unfolding

level.why: 口說簡報，句子較長且含 which 子句與 instead of、to 不定詞等結構；字彙如 hidden folding lock、integrated the locking mechanism 偏產品設計用語，需要理解操作步驟的前後關係。

items.passage:
To unfold the stroller, you need to press the folding button on the handlebar and another button on the side of the joint.

This second button releases our hidden folding lock, which automatically locks the stroller when folded.

Instead of adding a separate carry hook, we integrated the locking mechanism into the joint to keep the frame design cleaner and simpler.
items.zh:
若要展開推車，您需要按下手把上的折疊按鈕，以及接頭側邊的另一個按鈕。

第二個按鈕會解除我們隱藏式的折疊鎖，這個鎖會在推車折疊時自動將推車鎖定。

我們沒有另外加裝獨立的手提掛鉤，而是將鎖定機構整合到接頭中，讓車架設計更簡潔俐落。

vocab.col: unfold a stroller / unfold the map
frame joint / connect at the joint
attach a carry hook / carry hook design

questions.q: What must a user do to unfold the stroller?
opts: Press only the folding button on the handlebar
Press the handlebar button and a button on the side of the joint
why: 只按手把上的按鈕不夠，還需要按接頭側邊的另一個按鈕。
文中提到的是沒有另外加裝手提掛鉤，並未用它來展開推車。
正解：講者說要同時按下手把上的折疊按鈕與接頭側邊的另一個按鈕。
第二個按鈕是用來解除隱藏式折疊鎖，並不是要把鎖拆掉。

questions.q: Why did the company integrate the locking mechanism into the joint?
opts: To add a separate carry hook
To reduce the price of the stroller
To keep the frame design cleaner and simpler
why: 文中說的是不另外加裝手提掛鉤，而不是新增。
文中完全沒有提到價格。
這段文字沒有說明整合鎖定機構與重量的關係。
正解：講者說將鎖定機構整合到接頭中，是為了讓車架設計更簡潔。

questions.q: The folding lock engages ______ when the stroller is folded, so no extra step is needed.
why: 正解：此處需要副詞修飾動詞 engages，automatically 表示「自動地」。
automatic 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞。
automate 是動詞，不能放在這個位置。
automation 是名詞，無法修飾動詞 engages。

questions.q: Parents should make sure the lock is fully ______ before lifting the stroller.
why: engage 是原形動詞，不能放在 is fully 之後作被動結構。
正解：is fully engaged 為被動結構，表示鎖「已被完全扣上」。
engaging 作形容詞表示「吸引人的」，語意不符。
engagement 是名詞，不符合 is fully 後的語法。

extra_vocab.grammar_note: unfold 當及物動詞要接受詞（unfold the map）；事情或計畫自己逐步展開時是不及物（The plan unfolded as expected）。

example.en: The table unfolds in seconds and seats six people.
example.zh: 這張桌子幾秒鐘就能展開，可坐六個人。

senses.en: to open something that was folded

extra_vocab.en: the place where two parts are connected

extra_vocab.grammar_note: joint 當名詞是可數名詞（a joint、two joints）；當形容詞表示「共同的」時只能放在名詞前（a joint venture），不能說 be joint。

example.en: The engineer checked all the joints for cracks before shipping.
example.zh: 工程師在出貨前檢查了所有接頭有沒有裂縫。

example.en: Please check the connection between the two tubes before testing.
example.zh: 測試之前，請檢查兩根管子之間的連接。

similar.diff: hinge 是鉸鏈，是一種可以轉動的 joint。

example.en: The designer hid the screws under a small plastic cover.

example.en: The cover is hiding all the cables behind the desk.

example.en: Please check the contract for any hidden costs before signing.

confusable.usage: hid 只能當動詞過去式，不能放在名詞前修飾；要說「隱藏的鎖」要寫 hidden lock，不是 hid lock。

example.zh: 我們的自動化系統會檢查每一筆訂單有沒有錯誤。

items.tag: 3-Newborn Set

level.why: 口說簡報，包含安裝步驟、功能優點與設計限制的說明，句型多為 once installed、however、so there's no need for 等轉折與因果結構；需整合多處細節並理解尚待改善的設計問題。

items.passage:
To make Super Lite suitable for newborns, we've also developed a Newborn Set.

Let me show you how it works.

First, fully recline the seat backrest and remove the bumper bar.

Then, attach the Newborn Set to the footrest tube.

Another nice feature is that you can reuse the stroller's original canopy.

Simply remove it from the stroller and attach it directly to the Newborn Set, so there's no need for a separate canopy.

Once installed, the Newborn Set faces the parent, which is a more suitable arrangement for newborns.

However, the backrest doesn't recline quite far enough yet, so the baby's legs are still a little too high.

We could make the backrest recline further, but we'll need to evaluate this together with the stroller's overall stability.

Another nice feature is that you can still fold the stroller with the Newborn Set attached.

However, with the Newborn Set attached, the folded size exceeds the IATA cabin baggage size guidelines. So it's too large to meet those guidelines.

And even with the Newborn Set, the total weight is only around 4.8 kilograms.
items.zh:
為了讓 Super Lite 適合新生兒使用，我們另外開發了新生兒套件。

讓我示範給大家看它如何運作。

首先，將座椅椅背完全放平，並拆下防護扶手。

接著，將新生兒套件裝到腳踏管上。

另一個很棒的特色是，您可以重複使用推車原本的遮陽罩。

只要把它從推車上拆下來，直接裝到新生兒套件上即可，所以不需要另外準備一個遮陽罩。

安裝完成後，新生兒套件會面向家長，這對新生兒來說是更合適的配置。

不過，椅背目前還沒辦法放得夠平，所以寶寶的雙腳還是稍微偏高。

我們可以讓椅背放得更平，但需要連同推車的整體穩定性一起評估。

另一個很棒的特色是，裝上新生兒套件後，您仍然可以折疊推車。

不過，裝上新生兒套件後，折疊尺寸會超出 IATA 機艙行李尺寸規範。所以它太大，無法符合該規範。

而且即使加上新生兒套件，總重量也只有大約 4.8 公斤。

vocab.col: newborn baby / care for a newborn

questions.q: What should users do before attaching the Newborn Set?
opts: Fully recline the backrest and remove the bumper bar
why: 文中沒有說要先折疊推車，折疊是另一個展示的功能。
正解：講者說首先要將椅背完全放平並拆下防護扶手，接著才裝上新生兒套件。
原本的遮陽罩是在套件裝上之後才轉移使用，並非裝套件前要更換。
新生兒套件是裝到腳踏管上，並不是要先裝腳踏管。

questions.q: What is one advantage of the Newborn Set mentioned by the speaker?
opts: It has its own separate canopy
It makes the folded stroller smaller
It lets the baby face away from the parent
The original canopy can be reused

questions.q: Luggage that ______ the size limit may not be allowed in the cabin.

items.tag: Customer Q&A-1.connect the carbon fiber tubes

level.why: 口說問答，含 because 子句、as much as possible、we'll still need to validate 等結構；字彙如 adhesive、structural strength、long-term durability 偏製造與材料專業用語。

items.passage:
How do you connect the carbon fiber tubes to the plastic parts?
Currently, we're using a two-part adhesive to bond the carbon fiber tubes to the plastic parts in our prototypes.

We also try to avoid drilling holes in the carbon fiber tubes as much as possible, because this could weaken the tubes and affect their structural strength.

For mass production, we're planning to follow the same general approach, but we'll still need to validate the bonding strength and long-term durability.
items.zh:
你們是如何把碳纖維管連接到塑膠零件上的？
目前，我們在原型機中使用雙液型黏著劑，將碳纖維管與塑膠零件黏合在一起。

我們也盡可能避免在碳纖維管上鑽孔，因為這可能會削弱管材，並影響其結構強度。

進入量產階段時，我們計畫沿用相同的大致做法，但仍需要驗證黏合強度與長期耐用性。

vocab.col: weaken the structure / weaken over time
begin mass production / ready for mass production

questions.q: How are the carbon fiber tubes currently attached to the plastic parts in the prototypes?
why: 文中沒有提到使用金屬螺絲。
文中說盡量避免在管材上鑽孔，所以不是用鑽孔搭配螺栓固定。
正解：講者說目前原型機使用雙液型黏著劑，將碳纖維管黏合到塑膠零件上。
文中沒有提到熱熔焊接。

questions.q: Why does the company try to avoid drilling holes in the carbon fiber tubes?
opts: It could weaken the tubes and affect their structural strength
It would take too much production time
It would make the stroller heavier
It is not allowed by safety regulations
why: 正解：講者說鑽孔可能削弱管材，並影響結構強度。
文中沒有提到鑽孔會花太多時間。
文中沒有提到鑽孔會增加重量。
文中沒有提到法規禁止鑽孔。

questions.q: Repeated heavy loads can ______ the frame over time.
why: weak 是形容詞，不能放在 can 之後作動詞。
weakness 是名詞，不能放在 can 之後作動詞。
weakly 是副詞，不能放在 can 之後作動詞。
正解：can 後面需接原形動詞，weaken 表示「削弱」。

questions.q: Before mass production, the team must ______ the adhesive under different temperatures.
why: tested 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在助動詞 must 之後。
正解：must 後面需接原形動詞，test 表示「測試」。
testing 是現在分詞或動名詞，不能接在 must 之後。
tests 是第三人稱單數或複數名詞，不能接在 must 之後。

presentation_phrases.phrase: How do you connect ... to ...?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 你們如何把……連接到……？
presentation_phrases.usage: 聽眾詢問結構或組裝方式時的提問句

presentation_phrases.phrase: Currently, we're using ... to ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 目前，我們使用……來……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明現階段採用的做法

presentation_phrases.phrase: We try to avoid ... as much as possible, because ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們盡可能避免……，因為……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計上刻意避免的做法與原因

presentation_phrases.phrase: This could weaken ... and affect ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這可能削弱……並影響……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明潛在風險

presentation_phrases.phrase: For mass production, we're planning to ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 進入量產階段，我們計畫……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明量產階段的規劃

presentation_phrases.phrase: We'll still need to validate ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們仍需要驗證……
presentation_phrases.usage: 坦承尚待確認的項目

presentation_phrases.phrase: That's a good question.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這是個好問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 回答聽眾提問前的緩衝句

presentation_phrases.phrase: Does that answer your question?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這樣有回答到您的問題嗎？
presentation_phrases.usage: 回答後確認聽眾是否滿意

extra_vocab.en: a substance used to stick things together
extra_vocab.note: 本句的 two-part adhesive 指要把兩種成分混合後才能使用的黏著劑（如環氧樹脂），用來把碳纖維管黏到塑膠零件上。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: adhesive 當名詞時可數，指「一種黏著劑」可說 an adhesive；two-part 是形容詞，兩個字中間要加連字號。同字族的動詞 adhere 表示「遵守」時要接介系詞 to（adhere to the rules／policies／standards），後面接名詞，不接 with。

example.en: Our supplier offers several adhesives for metal and plastic parts.
example.zh: 我們的供應商提供數種適用於金屬與塑膠零件的黏著劑。

example.en: The panels were attached with a strong adhesive instead of screws.
example.zh: 這些面板是用強力黏著劑固定，而不是用螺絲。

example.en: Apply adhesive evenly to both surfaces before pressing them together.
example.zh: 壓合之前，請把黏著劑均勻塗在兩個表面上。

example.en: Please bring adhesive tape to seal the boxes before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨前請帶膠帶來封箱。

example.en: This industrial adhesive works well at high temperatures.
example.zh: 這種工業用黏著劑在高溫下效果很好。

examples.en: The adhesive needs about two hours to dry completely.
examples.zh: 這種黏著劑需要大約兩小時才會完全乾。

examples.en: We are looking for an adhesive that is safe for children's products.
examples.zh: 我們在找對兒童產品安全的黏著劑。

examples.en: The test showed that the adhesive lost strength in humid conditions.
examples.zh: 測試顯示這種黏著劑在潮濕環境下會失去黏性。

confusable.diff: adhesion 是名詞「附著力、黏著」，指黏住的狀態；adhesive 是黏住用的材料。
confusable.usage: adhesive 是黏著劑（東西），adhesion 是附著力（性質）。

example.en: Poor adhesion between the layers caused the product to fail.
example.zh: 層與層之間附著力不佳，導致產品失效。

similar.diff: glue 較口語、日常，常指一般膠水；adhesive 較正式，多用於工業與技術文件。

example.en: Use a little glue to fix the loose label on the box.
example.zh: 用一點膠水把箱子上鬆脫的標籤黏好。

example.en: The glue dried quickly, so we could ship the samples today.
example.zh: 膠水乾得很快，所以我們今天就能出貨樣品。

example.en: Apply sealant around the edges to keep water out.
example.zh: 在邊緣塗上密封膠，防止水滲入。

derived.link: adhere 是詞幹，意思是「黏附」。再加 -sive 變成「會黏的」，所以 adhesive 是黏著劑。
adhere 的名詞，像 decide → decision，把「黏住」變成名詞。

example.en: Choose an adhesive that works on both carbon fiber and plastic.
example.zh: 請選擇同時適用於碳纖維與塑膠的黏著劑。

example.en: Attach the adhesive label to the top of each package.
example.zh: 把有黏性的標籤貼在每個包裹的上方。

extra_vocab.en: to join two things together firmly
extra_vocab.note: 本句 bond A to B 表示用黏著劑把碳纖維管「黏合」到塑膠零件上。這是技術文件常見的動詞用法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bond A to B 或 bond A and B 表示把 A 黏到 B；bond with 則多用在人與人之間建立情感連結。

example.en: This adhesive bonds metal to plastic in under ten minutes.
example.zh: 這種黏著劑不到十分鐘就能把金屬黏到塑膠上。

example.en: The two layers were bonded together before the final test.
example.zh: 最後測試前，這兩層已經黏合在一起。

example.en: We are bonding the new parts in the lab this week.
example.zh: 我們這週在實驗室黏合這批新零件。

example.en: Workers bond the metal frame to the plastic cover by hand.
example.zh: 工人用手工把金屬框架黏到塑膠外殼上。

example.en: The new glue bonds strongly even on smooth surfaces.
example.zh: 這種新膠即使在光滑表面也黏得很牢。

example.en: The retreat helped new employees bond with their teammates.
example.zh: 這次研習營幫助新進員工與同事建立情誼。

examples.en: It takes at least a day for the parts to bond fully.
examples.zh: 零件至少要一天才能完全黏牢。

examples.en: We tested how well the new material bonds to carbon fiber.
examples.zh: 我們測試了新材料與碳纖維的黏合程度。

confusable.diff: bound 是 bind（綁）的過去式，或表示「一定會、前往」；bond 才是「黏合」。
confusable.usage: bound 常見於 be bound to V（一定會）與 bound for（開往）。

example.en: The shipment is bound for Rotterdam and should arrive on Friday.
example.zh: 這批貨運往鹿特丹，應該週五抵達。

similar.diff: attach 是「附上、固定」，方式不限（螺絲、夾子都可以）；bond 專指用黏合方式接合。

example.en: Please attach the handle to the frame with two screws.
example.zh: 請用兩顆螺絲把把手固定到框架上。

similar.diff: glue 當動詞較口語，指用膠水黏；bond 較正式，常用於技術與工程。

example.en: Glue the label to the back of the sample box.
example.zh: 把標籤黏到樣品盒的背面。

example.en: Attach the receipt to the expense report before sending it.
example.zh: 寄出前，請把收據附在費用報告上。

example.en: This tool can join two pipes without welding.
example.zh: 這個工具不用焊接就能連接兩根管子。

example.en: Fasten the cover securely before moving the machine.
example.zh: 移動機器之前，請把蓋子固定好。

example.en: The glue is designed to bond wood and metal together.
example.zh: 這種膠是設計來把木頭與金屬黏在一起的。

example.en: The company plans to issue bonds to fund its new factory.
example.zh: 公司打算發行債券來為新工廠籌資。

senses.en: to join two things firmly using glue or heat

example.en: The two plastic parts bond tightly under high heat.
example.zh: 這兩個塑膠零件在高溫下會緊密接合。

senses.en: to build a close relationship with other people
senses.distinguish: 後面接人或團體（bond with colleagues）就是情感意思；後面接物品與 to 就是黏合。

example.en: Team events help staff bond with one another quickly.
example.zh: 團隊活動能幫助員工快速建立彼此的情誼。

extra_vocab.en: to make a hole in something with a special tool
extra_vocab.note: 本句 avoid drilling holes 的意思是盡量不要在碳纖維管上鑽孔，因為鑽孔會破壞纖維、降低強度。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: avoid 後面要接 V-ing（avoid drilling），不接 to V；drill a hole in 後面接被鑽的物體。

example.en: The machine drills ten holes in each panel automatically.
example.zh: 這台機器會自動在每片面板上鑽十個孔。

example.en: The technician drilled two holes in the wall for the cables.
example.zh: 技術人員在牆上鑽了兩個孔來走線。

example.en: They are drilling the final holes before the frame is painted.
example.zh: 框架上漆之前，他們正在鑽最後幾個孔。

example.en: You must drill a hole here before installing the bracket.
example.zh: 安裝支架之前，你必須在這裡鑽一個孔。

example.en: Do not drill into the pipe behind this wall.
example.zh: 不要鑽到這面牆後面的管線。

example.en: Please bring a power drill to the installation site.
example.zh: 請把電鑽帶到安裝現場。

example.en: All employees must take part in the fire drill on Friday.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須參加週五的消防演習。

examples.en: We drill the holes after the frame is fully assembled.
examples.zh: 我們在框架完全組裝好之後才鑽孔。

examples.en: It is easy to drill through plastic but harder through carbon fiber.
examples.zh: 塑膠很容易鑽穿，但碳纖維就比較難。

examples.en: The manager drilled the new staff on safety rules all week.
examples.zh: 經理整個星期反覆訓練新進員工安全規定。

confusable.diff: drive 是「駕駛、驅動、打入」，drill 是「用鑽頭鑽孔」，兩者動作不同。
confusable.usage: drive a screw 是把螺絲旋進去，drill a hole 是先鑽出孔。

example.en: Drive the screws into the holes after they are drilled.
example.zh: 孔鑽好之後，再把螺絲旋入孔中。

example.en: Each technician must return the tools to the cabinet after work.
example.zh: 每位技術人員下班後都必須把工具放回櫃子。

example.en: The new machine can cut and drill parts at the same time.
example.zh: 這台新機器可以同時切割與鑽孔。

derived.link: drill + -er，做這件事的人，像 worker、manager。

example.en: Do not drill too close to the edge of the board.
example.zh: 不要在太靠近板子邊緣的地方鑽孔。

example.en: The drill is on the shelf next to the toolbox.
example.zh: 電鑽放在工具箱旁邊的架子上。

senses.en: to make a hole with a tool that turns

example.en: The workers drill holes in the steel plates every morning.
example.zh: 工人每天早上都在鋼板上鑽孔。

senses.en: to teach someone by making them repeat something many times
senses.distinguish: 後面接人加 on／in 某技能（drill staff on safety）就是訓練；接 holes 或物體就是鑽孔。

example.en: The coach drilled the sales team on the new pricing rules.
example.zh: 教練反覆訓練業務團隊熟悉新的定價規則。

extra_vocab.en: to make something less strong
extra_vocab.note: 本句用 this could weaken the tubes，說明在管子上鑽孔會降低它的強度，所以要盡量避免。could 表示「有可能」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: weaken 可作及物動詞（weaken the tubes）也可作不及物動詞（Demand weakened）；它本身已有「變弱」的意思，不需要再加 more。

example.en: Frequent bending weakens the cable over time.
example.zh: 經常彎折會讓電纜隨時間變弱。

example.en: The heavy rain weakened the old storage building.
example.zh: 大雨使這棟老舊倉庫變得不牢固。

example.en: A weakening economy is reducing demand for our products.
example.zh: 走弱的經濟正在減少市場對我們產品的需求。

example.en: Cutting the beam could weaken the structure of the whole frame.
example.zh: 切割這根橫樑可能會削弱整個框架的結構強度。

example.en: Higher prices may weaken demand for our entry-level models.
example.zh: 價格調漲可能會使入門款的需求減弱。

example.en: Late deliveries could weaken our position in the negotiation.
example.zh: 延遲交貨可能會削弱我們在談判中的地位。

examples.en: Too much heat can weaken the plastic and cause cracks.
examples.zh: 過多的熱會使塑膠變弱並造成裂痕。

examples.en: The strong dollar has weakened our export sales this quarter.
examples.zh: 強勢美元使我們本季的出口銷售變弱。

confusable.diff: 發音相近（/ˈwiːkɛnd/），但 weekend 是名詞「週末」，weaken 是動詞「削弱」。

example.en: We will test the new design over the weekend.
example.zh: 我們會在週末測試新設計。

similar.diff: undermine 多指暗中損害信心、基礎或計畫，語氣較強；weaken 是一般的「變弱」。

example.en: Frequent delays can undermine customers' trust in our company.
example.zh: 頻繁延誤可能會損害客戶對公司的信任。

similar.diff: reduce 是「減少」數量或程度；weaken 強調力量、強度變弱。

example.en: We want to reduce the weight of the frame by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們想把框架減輕百分之十的重量。

example.en: Rough handling may damage the tubes during shipping.
example.zh: 粗魯搬運可能會在運送途中損壞管子。

example.en: New packaging will reduce the risk of broken parts.
example.zh: 新包裝會降低零件破損的風險。

derived.link: weak 是詞幹；加 -en 表示「使變得…」，像 strengthen、shorten、widen。
weak + -ness，把形容詞變成名詞，像 kindness、business。
weak + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、slowly。

extra_vocab.en: related to how something is built or put together
extra_vocab.note: structural strength 指零件或整體「結構強度」，在產品開發與工程對話中很常見。這裡強調鑽孔會影響管子的承重能力。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: structural 是形容詞，只能放在名詞前（structural strength）；要修飾動詞時用副詞 structurally。

example.en: The tests confirmed the structural strength of the new frame.
example.zh: 測試確認了新框架的結構強度。

example.en: Any crack could damage the structural integrity of the bridge.
example.zh: 任何裂縫都可能破壞橋梁的結構完整性。

example.en: The merger will lead to major structural changes in the company.
example.zh: 這次合併會讓公司產生重大的結構性改變。

example.en: A structural engineer will inspect the building next week.
example.zh: 結構工程師下週會檢查這棟建築。

examples.en: The design team found a structural problem in the first prototype.
examples.zh: 設計團隊在第一個原型中發現了結構問題。

examples.en: We need to review the structural requirements before choosing materials.
examples.zh: 選擇材料之前，我們需要檢視結構上的要求。

examples.en: The company announced structural reforms to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了結構性改革以降低成本。

confusable.diff: structured 是「有條理、有組織的」，常形容計畫、訓練；structural 是「結構上的」，指物體或系統的構造。
confusable.usage: structured 是 structure 的過去分詞形容詞，structural 則用 -al 表示「與結構有關」。

example.en: The company offers a structured training program for new hires.
example.zh: 公司為新進員工提供一套有組織的訓練計畫。

confusable.diff: 拼法有些相似，但 constructive 是「有建設性的」，常形容意見或批評。

example.en: Thank you for your constructive feedback on our proposal.
example.zh: 謝謝你對我們提案給的建設性意見。

example.en: The contract sets out a clear framework for cooperation.
example.zh: 合約訂出了清楚的合作架構。

derived.link: structure 是詞幹；加 -al 變成形容詞「結構上的」，像 national、personal。
structure + -d，被安排出結構的，像 organized。
structural + -ly，變成副詞，像 financially、technically。
re- 是「重新」，像 rebuild、redesign。
un- 是「不」，像 unable、unclear。

extra_vocab.en: making a very large number of the same product, usually in a factory
extra_vocab.note: For mass production 說明「進入量產階段時」的計畫。對照前面的 prototypes（原型），這裡指產品從樣品走向工廠大量製造，是新產品開發會議常見的說法。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + be ready for / go into mass production
extra_vocab.grammar_note: mass production 是不可數名詞，前面不加 a，也不加 s；動詞是 mass-produce，形容詞是 mass-produced，兩者都要加連字號。

examples.en: The new model will go into mass production next spring.
examples.zh: 新型號將在明年春天進入量產。

examples.en: Please confirm the final design before we begin mass production.
examples.zh: 在我們開始量產之前，請確認最終設計。

examples.en: The supplier must be able to support mass production by June.
examples.zh: 供應商必須能在六月前支援量產。

examples.en: Quality problems often appear only after mass production starts.
examples.zh: 品質問題常常在量產開始之後才出現。

similar.diff: 意思相近，強調「規模大」；mass production 更強調標準化、重複大量製造。

example.en: Large-scale production will require a bigger factory and more workers.
example.zh: 大規模生產需要更大的工廠與更多工人。

similar.diff: 較偏工廠與供應鏈用語，指達到一定數量的生產，語氣比 mass production 更中性。

example.en: Volume production is scheduled to start in the third quarter.
example.zh: 量產預定在第三季開始。

similar.diff: 指一批一批地生產，數量比量產少，可隨時更換產品；mass production 則是持續大量製造同一種產品。

example.en: We use batch production for custom orders with different colors.
example.zh: 我們用分批生產來處理不同顏色的客製訂單。

confusable.diff: 是形容詞「大量生產的」，用來修飾產品，不是名詞；要加連字號。
confusable.usage: mass production 是名詞片語（before mass production），mass-produced 放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（a mass-produced item）。

example.en: Mass-produced items are usually cheaper than handmade ones.
example.zh: 大量生產的商品通常比手工製品便宜。

confusable.diff: mass market 是「大眾市場」，指賣給大量一般消費者的市場；mass production 是生產方式。

example.en: We plan to sell this product in the mass market.
example.zh: 我們打算在大眾市場銷售這項產品。

level.why: 口說問答，句子較長且含 because 子句、including 分詞構句與 would 假設語氣；內容涵蓋結構要求、製造流程與工裝，字彙偏製造專業用語，需整合多處細節。

items.passage:
Can you also use carbon fiber tubes for the handlebar and the front bumper bar?

For the handlebar, we're currently using conventional aluminum tubes.

The handlebar needs to accommodate several mechanisms, including the one-hand operating controls mounted on the upper handlebar tube. Using carbon fiber here would make the structural design and manufacturing more challenging.

For the front bumper bar, switching to carbon fiber is a possibility because it doesn't have the same structural requirements as the main frame.

However, our current bumper bar is made from bent aluminum tubing. To make it from carbon fiber, we'd need a different manufacturing process and probably a dedicated mold or tooling.

The carbon fiber tubes used in the current prototype are straight, off-the-shelf tubes, so we can source them directly without developing custom tooling.

So, it's technically possible, but we'd need to evaluate the cost and manufacturing feasibility before making a decision.
items.zh:
手把和前方防護扶手也能使用碳纖維管嗎？

手把的部分，我們目前使用的是傳統鋁管。

手把需要容納數個機構，包括安裝在上方手把管上的單手操作控制裝置。在這裡使用碳纖維會讓結構設計與製造變得更具挑戰性。

至於前方防護扶手，改用碳纖維是有可能的，因為它不像主車架那樣有相同的結構要求。

不過，我們目前的防護扶手是以彎折的鋁管製成。若要改用碳纖維製作，我們需要不同的製造流程，而且很可能需要專用的模具或工裝。

目前原型機使用的碳纖維管是直管、現成品，所以我們可以直接採購，不需要開發客製化工裝。

所以，技術上是可行的，但在做出決定之前，我們需要先評估成本與製造可行性。

questions.q: Why would using carbon fiber for the handlebar be challenging?
opts: The tubes are not strong enough
Carbon fiber tubes are not sold in the right length
The handlebar must accommodate several mechanisms
why: 文中沒有說碳纖維強度不足。
文中說的原型機用管是現成的直管，並沒有說長度不合。
正解：講者說手把需要容納數個機構，包括單手操作控制裝置，使用碳纖維會讓結構設計與製造更具挑戰性。
文中沒有提到客戶偏好。

questions.q: Why is switching the front bumper bar to carbon fiber possible?
opts: It does not have the same structural requirements as the main frame
It is already made from carbon fiber
It is currently made from straight tubes
why: 正解：講者說前方防護扶手不像主車架那樣有相同的結構要求，所以改用碳纖維是有可能的。
文中說目前的防護扶手是以彎折的鋁管製成。
直管是原型機所用的碳纖維管，並不是目前的防護扶手。
文中說還需要評估成本，沒有說比鋁便宜。

questions.q: What would be needed to make the bumper bar from carbon fiber?
opts: A new supplier of straight tubes
A different process and probably a dedicated mold or tooling
why: 文中沒有提到要用更粗的鋁管。
直管是現成品，可以直接採購，與防護扶手的製作需求無關。
文中沒有提到要讓主車架更重。
正解：講者說需要不同的製造流程，而且很可能需要專用模具或工裝。

questions.q: Before approving new tooling, the manager asked the team to ______ the cost.
why: estimation 是名詞，不能放在 to 之後作動詞。
正解：to 後面需接原形動詞，estimate 表示「估算」。
estimated 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在 to 之後。
estimating 是動名詞，不能接在不定詞 to 之後。

questions.q: Please ask the supplier to send a ______ quotation for the custom parts.
why: detail 是名詞，不能直接修飾 quotation。
details 是複數名詞，無法放在冠詞 a 與 quotation 之間作修飾。
正解：此處需要形容詞修飾名詞 quotation，detailed 表示「詳細的」。
detailing 是動名詞或現在分詞，語意不符。

questions.q: The production line can only start ______ the mold has been approved.
why: 正解：once 作連接詞，表示「一旦」，連接子句 the mold has been approved。
during 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句，語意也不符。
although 表示讓步，語意不符。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Can you also use ... for ...?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 你們也能把……用在……嗎？
presentation_phrases.usage: 聽眾詢問材料或設計是否可延伸應用

presentation_phrases.phrase: For ..., we're currently using ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 關於……，我們目前使用的是……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明現階段採用的材料或做法

presentation_phrases.phrase: ... needs to accommodate ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: ……需要容納／配合……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計上的限制條件

presentation_phrases.phrase: Switching to ... is a possibility because ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 改用……是有可能的，因為……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明替代方案的可行性與理由

presentation_phrases.phrase: We'd need a different ... and probably a dedicated ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們需要不同的……，而且很可能需要專用的……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明改變所需的條件

presentation_phrases.phrase: So, it's technically possible, but ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 所以，技術上是可行的，但……
presentation_phrases.usage: 先肯定可能性再提出但書

presentation_phrases.phrase: We'd need to evaluate the cost before making a decision.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 在做出決定之前，我們需要先評估成本。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明決策前需要完成的評估

presentation_phrases.phrase: Does that answer your question?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這樣有回答到您的問題嗎？
presentation_phrases.usage: 回答後確認聽眾是否滿意

extra_vocab.en: done in the usual or most common way
extra_vocab.note: conventional aluminum tubes 指手把目前使用的「一般常見的鋁管」，與較新、較特殊的碳纖維管形成對比。語氣中性，不一定表示過時。

example.en: Conventional methods take longer and cost more than the new process.
example.zh: 傳統方法比新流程更花時間，也更花錢。

example.en: Conventional materials are heavier than the carbon fiber we tested.
example.zh: 傳統材料比我們測試過的碳纖維更重。

example.en: Conventional wisdom says customers prefer lower prices over new features.
example.zh: 普遍看法認為，比起新功能，客戶更喜歡低價。

example.en: The team chose a conventional approach to reduce project risk.
example.zh: 團隊選擇傳統做法來降低專案風險。

examples.en: Most factories still use conventional machines for cutting metal tubes.
examples.zh: 大多數工廠仍用傳統機器來切割金屬管。

examples.en: This design is lighter than conventional models in the same price range.
examples.zh: 這個設計比同價位的一般型號更輕。

examples.en: The new plan is very different from our conventional marketing strategy.
examples.zh: 新計畫和我們傳統的行銷策略很不一樣。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 convenient 是「方便的」，conventional 是「傳統的、慣用的」。
confusable.usage: convenient 常接 for + 人（convenient for you）；conventional 常修飾方法、材料、做法。

example.en: Is Thursday afternoon a convenient time for the site visit?
example.zh: 週四下午適合安排現場參訪嗎？

confusable.diff: 拼法有些相似，但 conversational 是「對話式的、口語的」，常形容語氣或風格。

example.en: The manual uses a simple, conversational style for new users.
example.zh: 這本手冊為新使用者採用簡單、口語化的風格。

similar.diff: traditional 強調長久流傳的「傳統」，常帶文化與歷史感；conventional 強調「通行的標準做法」。

example.en: The restaurant is famous for its traditional recipes.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以傳統食譜聞名。

similar.diff: standard 是「標準的、一般的」，語氣更中性；conventional 則暗示和較新的做法相對。

example.en: Standard shipping takes five working days to arrive.
example.zh: 標準運送需要五個工作天才會送達。

example.en: Traditional stores are changing as more customers shop online.
example.zh: 隨著更多客戶在網路購物，傳統商店也在改變。

example.en: A standard warranty covers repairs for the first two years.
example.zh: 標準保固涵蓋前兩年的維修。

derived.link: convention 是詞幹，意思是「大家都接受的慣例」；加 -al 變成形容詞，像 tradition → traditional。
conventional + -ly，變成副詞，像 traditionally、normally。
un- 是「不」，像 unusual、unclear。

extra_vocab.zh: 安裝在……上的、固定在……上的
extra_vocab.en: fixed onto a surface or another part
extra_vocab.note: 文中 mounted on the upper handlebar tube 是過去分詞後置修飾 controls，說明單手操作控制裝置裝在上方手把管上，所以手把必須容納多種機構。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: controls mounted on the tube 等於 controls that are mounted on the tube，過去分詞放在名詞後面修飾；安裝的位置多用 on（mounted on the wall），不用 in。

example.en: The technician mounts each sensor on the metal frame.
example.zh: 技術人員把每個感測器裝在金屬車架上。

example.en: They are mounting the screen on the wall now.
example.zh: 他們現在正在把螢幕裝到牆上。

example.en: The projector is mounted on the wall of the meeting room.
example.zh: 投影機安裝在會議室的牆上。

example.en: We ordered a wall-mounted display for the new showroom.
example.zh: 我們為新的展示間訂了一台壁掛式螢幕。

example.en: The marketing team will mount a campaign for the new model.
example.zh: 行銷團隊將為新機型發起一項宣傳活動。

examples.en: The battery is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.
examples.zh: 電池安裝在車輛後方。

examples.en: We need a bracket for the camera mounted above the door.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個支架給裝在門上方的攝影機。

examples.en: Make sure the panel is firmly mounted before you test it.
examples.zh: 測試之前，請確認面板已牢牢固定。

confusable.diff: mountain 是名詞「山」，拼法相近但跟安裝無關。

example.en: The factory is located at the foot of a large mountain.
example.zh: 這間工廠位於一座大山的山腳下。

confusable.diff: amount 是「數量、金額」，字裡含有 mount，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The total amount of the invoice is $2,400.
example.zh: 這張發票的總金額是 2,400 美元。

similar.diff: installed 是「裝好、設置好」，範圍較廣；mounted 強調固定在某個表面上。

example.en: The security cameras were installed on the ceiling last week.
example.zh: 保全攝影機上週已裝在天花板上。

similar.diff: attached 是「附接、連接」，不一定固定在表面上。

example.en: The label is attached to the side of the shipping box.
example.zh: 標籤貼在出貨箱的側面。

example.en: Our team will install the new equipment on Monday.
example.zh: 我們的團隊星期一會安裝新設備。

example.en: Please attach the drawing to your purchase request.
example.zh: 請把圖面附在你的採購申請上。

example.en: This metal bracket holds the control panel in place.
example.zh: 這個金屬支架能固定控制面板的位置。

example.en: The mounted camera records every shipment leaving the warehouse.
example.zh: 裝好的攝影機會記錄離開倉庫的每一批貨。

example.en: Please mount the sign above the main entrance.
example.zh: 請把招牌裝在主要入口上方。

example.en: The monitor comes with a wall mount and two screws.
example.zh: 這台螢幕附有壁掛支架和兩顆螺絲。

senses.en: to fix something onto a surface or frame

example.en: Technicians will mount the sensors on the production line.
example.zh: 技術人員會把感測器裝在生產線上。

senses.en: to start and organize an event or effort
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 campaign、challenge 等活動時，指發起；受詞是實體物品時，指安裝。

example.en: The union plans to mount a challenge to the new policy.
example.zh: 工會打算對新政策提出挑戰。

senses.en: to grow in amount or strength
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 pressure、costs 等抽象名詞時，指逐漸上升。

example.en: Costs continue to mount as the project falls behind schedule.
example.zh: 隨著專案進度落後，成本持續攀升。

extra_vocab.en: made or kept for one special purpose
extra_vocab.note: 文中 a dedicated mold or tooling 指「專門為這個零件製作的模具或工裝」，說明改用碳纖維需要額外投資。dedicated 也常用來形容「敬業的」人。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be dedicated to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形，例如 dedicated to improving quality。

example.en: The company dedicates one floor to research and testing.
example.zh: 公司把一整層樓專門用於研究與測試。

example.en: She is dedicating her time to improving customer service.
example.zh: 她正投入時間改善客戶服務。

example.en: We set up a dedicated team to handle customer complaints.
example.zh: 我們成立了專責團隊來處理客戶投訴。

example.en: Customers can call a dedicated line for technical support.
example.zh: 客戶可以撥打專線取得技術支援。

example.en: Our staff are dedicated to providing fast and reliable service.
example.zh: 我們的員工致力於提供快速可靠的服務。

examples.en: We need a dedicated mold for each new design.
examples.zh: 每個新設計都需要一套專用的模具。

examples.en: The company is looking for a dedicated project manager.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位專職的專案經理。

examples.en: A dedicated server will keep our customer data secure.
examples.zh: 專用伺服器能確保我們的客戶資料安全。

confusable.diff: delicate 是「精細易損的」，拼法有點像，但跟專用無關。

example.en: Carbon fiber parts are delicate and need careful handling during shipping.
example.zh: 碳纖維零件很精細，出貨時需要小心處理。

similar.diff: specialized 強調專業、特殊化；dedicated 強調專門用於某一目的。

example.en: The factory uses specialized equipment for carbon fiber parts.
example.zh: 這間工廠使用專門的設備來製作碳纖維零件。

similar.diff: devoted 帶有感情，常指人的熱忱投入；dedicated 更偏中性、專用。

example.en: She is devoted to improving the quality of our products.
example.zh: 她全心投入提升我們產品的品質。

example.en: Members receive exclusive access to the new product line.
example.zh: 會員可以獨家取得新產品系列。

example.en: Our team is committed to delivering on time.
example.zh: 我們的團隊致力於準時交貨。

example.en: This tool is designed for a specific type of tube.
example.zh: 這個工具是為特定種類的管子設計的。

derived.link: dedicate + -ion，變成名詞，像 educate → education

example.en: A dedicated support team answers questions around the clock.
example.zh: 專責的支援團隊全天候回答問題。

example.en: We will dedicate more resources to product testing this year.
example.zh: 我們今年會投入更多資源在產品測試上。

senses.en: to give time or money to one purpose

example.en: The firm will dedicate a new line to carbon fiber parts.
example.zh: 公司將把一條新產線專門用於碳纖維零件。

senses.en: to officially name something to honor a person or event
senses.distinguish: 談到典禮、建築、書籍時指獻給，談到資源與時間時指專門投入。

example.en: The company dedicated its new library to the founder.
example.zh: 公司把新圖書館獻給創辦人。

extra_vocab.en: the tools and equipment used to make a product
extra_vocab.note: 文中 custom tooling 指為特定零件量身打造的模具與加工設備；說話者強調使用現成直管，就能省下開發這些設備的成本。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tooling 是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s；說「模具費」時用 tooling cost，cost 保持單數。

example.en: Custom tooling can add months to the development schedule.
example.zh: 客製化工裝可能讓開發時程多出好幾個月。

example.en: The tooling cost for this part is around $15,000.
example.zh: 這個零件的模具費用大約是一萬五千美元。

example.en: We must invest in tooling before starting mass production.
example.zh: 我們在開始量產之前必須先投資工裝。

examples.en: The supplier quoted separately for tooling and unit prices.
examples.zh: 供應商把工裝與單價分開報價。

examples.en: New tooling will take about eight weeks to complete.
examples.zh: 新工裝大約需要八週才能完成。

examples.en: Changing the design now would require expensive new tooling.
examples.zh: 現在更改設計會需要昂貴的新工裝。

confusable.diff: tool 是單一工具，可數；tooling 是整套加工設備，不可數。
confusable.usage: tool 是可數名詞（a tool、tools）；tooling 是不可數名詞，不加 s。

example.en: A hand tool is cheap, but tooling for mass production is expensive.
example.zh: 手工具很便宜，但量產用的工裝很昂貴。

similar.diff: equipment 泛指各種設備；tooling 專指製造零件所需的模具與工具。

example.en: The factory needs new equipment to produce the carbon fiber frames.
example.zh: 這間工廠需要新設備來生產碳纖維車架。

similar.diff: molds and dies 專指模具與沖模，是 tooling 的一部分。

example.en: The supplier will build the molds and dies within six weeks.
example.zh: 供應商會在六週內完成模具與沖模。

example.en: The mold must be cleaned after every production run.
example.zh: 每次生產之後，模具都必須清潔。

example.en: A worn die can cause defects in the final product.
example.zh: 磨損的沖模可能讓成品出現瑕疵。

example.en: This fixture holds the tube steady during drilling.
example.zh: 這個治具能在鑽孔時固定管子。

derived.link: tooling = tool + -ing，把「工具」整體變成不可數名詞
tool + box，裝工具的箱子，像 lunchbox

extra_vocab.en: ready to buy and use without special changes
extra_vocab.note: 文中 off-the-shelf tubes 指市面上現成的標準管材，不需要客製加工，所以能直接採購、降低成本。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 放在名詞前當形容詞時要加連字號（off-the-shelf parts）；放在 be 動詞後可寫成 off the shelf，例如 These parts are available off the shelf。

example.en: Off-the-shelf software is cheaper than a fully custom system.
example.zh: 現成軟體比完全客製的系統便宜。

example.en: An off-the-shelf solution may not fit our special requirements.
example.zh: 現成的解決方案可能不符合我們的特殊需求。

example.en: Using off-the-shelf parts shortens the overall development schedule.
example.zh: 使用現成零件能縮短開發時程。

examples.en: We chose an off-the-shelf motor to keep the cost low.
examples.zh: 我們選用現成的馬達以壓低成本。

examples.en: Off-the-shelf products are available immediately, so delivery is fast.
examples.zh: 現成產品可以立即取得，所以交貨很快。

examples.en: Please check whether an off-the-shelf option meets our needs.
examples.zh: 請確認現成的選項是否符合我們的需求。

confusable.diff: on the shelf 是「在架上」，也可指「被擱置」，和「現成」的意思不同。

example.en: The project has been on the shelf since last spring.
example.zh: 這個專案從去年春天起就被擱置了。

similar.diff: ready-made 也是現成的，用法更口語，常指成品或現成的答案。

example.en: The company bought ready-made components instead of building its own.
example.zh: 公司買了現成的零件，而不是自己製造。

similar.diff: standard 強調規格統一、是常規款，不一定是現貨。

example.en: We chose a standard part to keep the price low.
example.zh: 我們選用標準零件以壓低價格。
