example.en: Please reply today; otherwise, we will give the seat to someone else.
example.zh: 請今天回覆；否則我們會把座位讓給別人。

example.en: We can substitute a similar model if this one is sold out.
example.zh: 如果這款賣完了，我們可以用類似的型號替代。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，指「換成另一個」，像 alternate days（隔天）
alternate 去掉 e 加 -ive，有…性質的，像 create → creative；再加 -ly 就是 alternatively

extra_vocab.en: a letter you send with your resume to explain why you want a job
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a resume and a cover letter 指應徵者除了履歷，還要附上一封說明自己為何適合這個職位的信。cover letter 是求職時搭配履歷一起寄出的信，內容多是自我介紹與應徵動機。
extra_vocab.pattern: submit / attach + a cover letter (explaining why + S + V)
extra_vocab.grammar_note: cover letter 是可數名詞，單數前要加 a；複數是 cover letters（變複數的是 letter，不是 cover）。

examples.en: Please attach a cover letter to your online application.
examples.zh: 請在你的線上申請中附上一封求職信。

examples.en: Her cover letter explained why she wanted to work in logistics.
examples.zh: 她的求職信說明了她為何想從事物流工作。

examples.en: Recruiters often read the cover letter before they open the resume.
examples.zh: 招募人員常常先讀求職信，再打開履歷。

examples.en: Keep your cover letter to one page and mention the job title.
examples.zh: 求職信請控制在一頁內，並提到應徵的職稱。

similar.diff: letter of application 較正式，英式英語較常見；cover letter 是美式英語最常用的說法。

example.en: She sent a letter of application together with her certificates.
example.zh: 她連同證書一起寄出了應徵信。

similar.diff: personal statement 多用於申請學校或獎學金，偏重個人經歷與目標；cover letter 是針對特定職缺寫的信。

example.en: The program requires a personal statement of about five hundred words.
example.zh: 這個計畫要求一份約五百字的自述。

confusable.diff: resume 是條列學經歷的履歷，cover letter 則是用信件文字說明應徵動機，兩者通常一起寄出。

example.en: The resume lists your jobs, while the cover letter explains your goals.
example.zh: 履歷列出你的工作經歷，求職信則說明你的目標。

confusable.diff: cover page 是報告或傳真的「封面頁」，只有標題與日期等資訊；cover letter 是求職時附上的信。

example.en: Add a cover page with the report title and the date.
example.zh: 請加上一張寫有報告標題與日期的封面頁。

extra_vocab.en: something that must be done or exist before something else can happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the only prerequisite is a working knowledge of our scheduling software 指應徵時唯一「必須先具備」的條件是熟悉排程軟體；辦公室經驗只是加分，不是必要條件。prerequisite 語氣正式，常見於職缺、課程與申請資格。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prerequisite 當「先決條件」是可數名詞，用 a prerequisite for + 事物；有兩項以上時用 prerequisites。

example.en: Please check the prerequisites before registering for the advanced course.
example.zh: 報名進階課程前，請先確認先修條件。

example.en: A valid license is a prerequisite for driving company vehicles.
example.zh: 有效的駕照是駕駛公司車輛的先決條件。

example.en: Finance 101 is listed as a prerequisite course for the advanced class.
example.zh: 財務概論被列為進階課程的先修課程。

example.en: Applicants who meet the prerequisites will be invited to interview.
example.zh: 符合先決條件的應徵者將受邀面試。

example.en: Trust is an essential prerequisite for strong teamwork.
example.zh: 信任是良好團隊合作不可或缺的先決條件。

examples.en: A degree in accounting is a prerequisite for this senior position.
examples.zh: 會計學位是這個高階職位的先決條件。

examples.en: Basic computer skills are a prerequisite for the training program.
examples.zh: 基本電腦技能是這個培訓計畫的先決條件。

examples.en: Budget approval is a prerequisite before any work can begin.
examples.zh: 在任何工作開始之前，預算核准是先決條件。

confusable.diff: requirement 是任何「要求、規定」，涵蓋範圍較廣；prerequisite 是要「先」滿足才能進行下一步的條件，是 requirement 中比較特別的一種。

example.en: The program has several requirements, and passing basic accounting is a prerequisite.
example.zh: 這個計畫有數項要求，而通過基礎會計是先決條件。

confusable.diff: precaution 是為了避免危險或問題而「事先採取的預防措施」；prerequisite 是「必須先具備的條件」。

example.en: Wearing a helmet is a basic precaution on the construction site.
example.zh: 戴安全帽是工地上基本的預防措施。

similar.diff: precondition 比 prerequisite 更正式，常用於協議與談判，指一方提出的前提條件。

example.en: The investors set one precondition: full access to the financial records.
example.zh: 投資人提出了一項前提條件：能完整查閱財務紀錄。

similar.diff: condition 範圍最廣，可指任何條件或狀況；prerequisite 明確指「必須先具備」的那一項。

example.en: The loan has one condition: it must be repaid within two years.
example.zh: 這筆貸款有一項條件：必須在兩年內還清。

example.en: Only full-time employees are eligible for the training fund.
example.zh: 只有全職員工有資格使用培訓基金。

example.en: Attendance at the safety briefing is mandatory for all staff.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須出席安全說明會。

example.en: The committee reviewed each proposal against the selection criteria.
example.zh: 委員會依照選拔標準審查每一份提案。

example.en: Good communication is essential for anyone working with clients.
example.zh: 對於任何與客戶接觸的人來說，良好的溝通是必要的。

example.en: Strong communication skills are a prerequisite for any customer service role.
example.zh: 良好的溝通能力是任何客服職務的先決條件。

example.en: She completed all prerequisite classes before moving to the senior program.
example.zh: 她在進入高階課程之前修完了所有先修課程。

extra_vocab.en: in a private way, so that other people will not know
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sent to me in confidence 指推薦資料要「保密」地寄給行政人員，不讓其他同事知道。in confidence 語氣正式，常見於人事、法律與機密資訊，表示對方出於信任而要求保密。
extra_vocab.pattern: V + N + in confidence（tell / send / share + N + in confidence）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: in confidence 是固定說法，前面不加 the、後面不加 s，通常放在動詞片語之後，如 tell someone in confidence。

examples.en: Employees may report concerns in confidence to the human resources department.
examples.zh: 員工可以向人力資源部門保密地反映問題。

examples.en: Please treat everything we discuss today in confidence.
examples.zh: 請將我們今天討論的一切內容保密。

examples.en: The client shared the merger plan with us in confidence.
examples.zh: 客戶私下保密地與我們分享了合併計畫。

examples.en: All personal information will be handled in strict confidence.
examples.zh: 所有個人資訊都會以嚴格保密的方式處理。

similar.diff: confidentially 是單字副詞，較簡短，也可放句首；in confidence 是片語，語氣更正式，常放句尾。

example.en: Please send your feedback confidentially to the human resources office.
example.zh: 請將你的意見以保密方式寄給人力資源辦公室。

similar.diff: in secret 強調「不讓別人知道」，可能帶有隱瞞的負面意味；in confidence 是出於信任而保密，語氣中性。

example.en: The two companies negotiated the deal in secret for months.
example.zh: 這兩家公司祕密地談判這筆交易達數個月之久。

confusable.diff: with confidence 是「有信心地」，與 in confidence（秘密地）意思完全不同。

example.en: She presented the plan with confidence in front of the board.
example.zh: 她很有信心地在董事會面前報告了這項計畫。

confusable.diff: confidential 是形容詞，意思是「機密的」；in confidence 是副詞片語，意思是「秘密地」。
confusable.usage: confidential 放在名詞前修飾名詞（confidential files）；in confidence 修飾動詞（tell … in confidence）。

example.en: Keep the confidential files in the locked cabinet.
example.zh: 請把機密檔案放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to help someone with their work
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Subject 行的 Temporary Assistant Position 指「臨時助理」職缺，因為出現在標題，所以首字母大寫；內文以 temporary assistant 出現，負責在旺季支援前台。assistant 是辦公室常見的職稱字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: assistant 字尾是 -ant（人），不是 -ent；它也可放在職稱前當修飾語，如 assistant manager（副理）。

example.en: Two assistants will cover the front desk while Maria is away.
example.zh: 瑪麗亞不在時，兩位助理會負責前台。

example.en: She works as a personal assistant to the company president.
example.zh: 她擔任公司總裁的私人助理。

example.en: The administrative assistant books rooms and schedules meetings for the team.
example.zh: 行政助理負責為團隊預訂會議室與安排會議。

example.en: The assistant manager will lead today's training session.
example.zh: 副理將主持今天的培訓課程。

example.en: Each sales assistant receives a short training course on the first day.
example.zh: 每位銷售助理在第一天都會接受一堂簡短的培訓課程。

examples.en: The company hired an assistant to help organize client files.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了一位助理來協助整理客戶檔案。

examples.en: Please ask my assistant to book a meeting room for Tuesday.
examples.zh: 請請我的助理預訂星期二的會議室。

examples.en: The research assistant collected survey data from over two hundred customers.
examples.zh: 研究助理從兩百多位顧客那裡蒐集了問卷資料。

confusable.diff: assistance 是抽象的「協助、幫忙」；assistant 是「提供協助的人」。
confusable.usage: assistance 是不可數名詞，不加 s（need assistance）；assistant 是可數的人，可加 s。

example.en: Please contact the front desk if you need assistance with the system.
example.zh: 如果你在系統操作上需要協助，請聯絡前台。

similar.diff: associate 較正式，常用於職稱（如 sales associate），地位接近同僚；assistant 偏重協助他人完成工作。

example.en: She joined the firm as a junior sales associate last year.
example.zh: 她去年以初階銷售專員的身分加入這家公司。

example.en: The secretary sent the meeting notes to all department managers.
example.zh: 秘書把會議紀錄寄給了所有部門主管。

example.en: The receptionist asked every visitor to sign in at the desk.
example.zh: 接待人員請每位訪客在櫃檯簽到。

example.en: Our summer intern will help the marketing team with research.
example.zh: 我們的暑期實習生會協助行銷團隊做研究。

example.en: The event coordinator confirmed the schedule with every speaker.
example.zh: 活動協調人員與每位講者確認了時程。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；assist + -ant，做事的人，像 participant、applicant
assist + -ance，變成抽象名詞，像 attend → attendance

example.en: The new assistant will answer calls and update the visitor schedule.
example.zh: 新來的助理會接電話並更新訪客行程。

example.en: The assistant director will present the budget at tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 副主任將在明天的會議上報告預算。

items.tag: 團體訂房回覆：獎勵活動優惠價與入住條件

level.why: 以 although、which、分詞構句（Having reviewed…）與被動語態組成較長的書面句，需整合房價條件、文件要求、期限與附加福利等多項資訊；halted、favorable 等字彙較抽象，且干擾項（如 renovation 完成與否）更接近正解。

items.passage:
Subject: Group Booking for Your Sales Retreat

Dear Ms. Lin,

Thank you for your inquiry about hosting your company's annual retreat for top achievers. Having reviewed your request, we are pleased to confirm that we can welcome your 48 guests from March 14 to 16. We were impressed by the scale of the event, and we would like to make it as smooth as possible.

Although renovation work in our east wing was halted last week because of a permit dispute, all rooms in that section are now available, which allows us to offer a favorable group rate of 140 dollars per night. To receive this rate, please send us a reference letter confirming that every guest is employed by your company, together with the signed booking form, by February 10. We cannot guarantee the rate after that date.

As a courtesy to your group, we will run a free shuttle between the airport and the hotel every thirty minutes. Guests may also use the spa on the second evening at no additional charge.

Best regards,
Daniel Cho
Group Sales Manager, Harbor View Hotel
items.zh:
主旨：業務獎勵活動團體訂房

林小姐，您好：

感謝您來信詢問貴公司年度頂尖業績人員獎勵活動的舉辦事宜。在審閱過您的需求後，我們很高興確認，我們可以在 3 月 14 日至 16 日接待您的 48 位賓客。我們對活動的規模印象深刻，也希望盡可能讓整個過程順利。

雖然我們東翼的整修工程因許可證糾紛而在上週暫停，但該區所有房間現已可供使用，因此我們得以提供每晚 140 美元的優惠團體價格。若要享有這個價格，請在 2 月 10 日前寄給我們一封推薦信，證明每位賓客都受雇於貴公司，並附上已簽名的訂房表。逾期後我們無法保證這個價格。

為了向貴團體表達禮遇，我們將提供每三十分鐘一班、往返機場與飯店的免費接駁車。賓客也可以在第二天晚上免費使用水療中心。

敬上
丹尼爾．趙
團體業務經理，海景飯店

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To announce that a renovation project has been completed
To respond to a booking inquiry and explain the conditions for a group rate
To ask a company to pay a deposit for a reserved event hall
To invite a manager to a free tour of the hotel spa
why: 錯誤：信中提到的是東翼整修「暫停」，不是完成，也不是寫信的主要目的。
正解：信件回覆林小姐的詢問，確認接待日期，並說明取得團體優惠價所需的文件與期限。
錯誤：信中沒有要求付訂金，也沒有提到活動宴會廳。
錯誤：水療中心只是附帶提供的福利，並不是邀請參觀飯店的邀請函。

questions.q: What is indicated about the east wing?
opts: Its rooms will be unavailable during the retreat
Its renovation was finished by last week
It includes the spa that guests may use
Its rooms can now be offered to the group
why: 錯誤：信中說該區房間現在已可使用，所以不是無法使用。
錯誤：文中說工程是「暫停」，並非已經完工，這是與 halted 容易混淆的干擾項。
錯誤：文中沒有說水療中心位於東翼，這是未提及的資訊。
正解：整修暫停後，該區所有房間現已可供使用，因此飯店能提供給林小姐的團體。

questions.q: What must Ms. Lin do by February 10?
opts: Send a letter and a signed form to the hotel
Pay for the use of the spa
Submit a permit for the east wing
why: 正解：要享有優惠價，須在 2 月 10 日前寄出證明賓客受雇的推薦信與已簽名的訂房表。
錯誤：接駁車是每三十分鐘一班的固定服務，不需要她選擇時間。
錯誤：水療中心的使用在第二天晚上免費，不需要付費。
錯誤：許可證糾紛是飯店的整修問題，與林小姐無關。

questions.q: The hotel's ______ location near the convention center makes it popular with business travelers.
why: 錯誤：convenience 是名詞，放在 location 前面需要形容詞來修飾。
錯誤：conveniently 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 location。
正解：空格位於 The hotel's 與名詞 location 之間，需要形容詞 convenient。
錯誤：conveniences 是名詞複數，意思是便利設施，文法與語意都不合。

questions.q: ______ the airport shuttle was fully booked, several guests took taxis to the venue.
why: 正解：後面接完整子句，且前後是因果關係，所以用連接詞 Because。
錯誤：Despite 是介系詞，後面要接名詞，且語意是「儘管」，不合邏輯。
錯誤：Due to 是介系詞片語，後面要接名詞，不能接完整子句。
錯誤：Unless 表示「除非」，語意不符，接駁車客滿與搭計程車是因果關係。

questions.q: Rooms ______ before March 1 will receive a free upgrade, subject to availability.
why: 錯誤：booking 表主動，但房間是「被訂」的，語意不符。
正解：Rooms booked before March 1 是縮減的關係子句，過去分詞 booked 表被動，意思是「在 3 月 1 日前被訂下的房間」。
錯誤：to book 表目的或未來，不能直接放在名詞後面這樣修飾 Rooms。
錯誤：are booked 已是完整動詞，會使句子出現兩個主要動詞 are booked 與 will receive。

extra_vocab.en: good or better than usual for you
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 favorable group rate 指對團體客人有利的優惠房價，是飯店業務信常見的正面說法，語氣客氣又帶一點促銷意味。

example.en: We negotiated a favorable rate for the conference rooms.
example.zh: 我們談到了會議室的優惠費率。

example.en: The bank offered us favorable terms on the new loan.
example.zh: 銀行提供我們新貸款的有利條件。

example.en: The new manager made a favorable impression on the whole team.
example.zh: 新經理給整個團隊留下良好的印象。

example.en: The hotel received a favorable review in a travel magazine.
example.zh: 這家飯店在旅遊雜誌上獲得好評。

examples.en: The supplier gave us a favorable price for the first order.
examples.zh: 供應商給了我們首批訂單一個優惠的價格。

examples.en: Customer feedback on the new menu has been very favorable so far.
examples.zh: 到目前為止，顧客對新菜單的回應非常正面。

examples.en: Weather conditions are favorable for the outdoor event this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末的天氣條件適合舉辦戶外活動。

confusable.diff: favorite 是「最喜歡的」，favorable 是「有利的、讚許的」，兩者發音和拼法很像但意思不同。

example.en: Pasta is the favorite dish among our visiting clients.
example.zh: 義大利麵是來訪客戶最喜歡的菜色。

similar.diff: reasonable 是「價格合理、不貴」，favorable 則是「比一般更有利」，語氣更正面。

example.en: The hotel offers a reasonable price for large groups.
example.zh: 這家飯店對大型團體提供合理的價格。

example.en: The audit gave us positive results this quarter.
example.zh: 這一季的稽核給了我們正面的結果。

example.en: The new schedule is beneficial to all staff.
example.zh: 新的時程表對所有員工都有益。

example.en: Your proposal is acceptable to the board.
example.zh: 你的提案董事會可以接受。

derived.link: favorable 的詞幹；favor 是「好意、幫忙」，加 -able 就變成「值得讚許的、有利的」
favorable + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly
un- 表示否定，像 unable、unclear
favor + -ite，「被偏愛的」，也可當名詞「最愛」

senses.en: good or better than usual for you
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 rate、price、terms 等商業字眼。

example.en: Our favorable rate is available only to groups of ten or more.
example.zh: 我們的優惠費率只提供十人以上的團體。

senses.en: showing that you like or approve of something
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 opinion、review、response，表示人的看法。

example.en: Most customers gave a favorable opinion of the new service.
example.zh: 大多數顧客對新服務給予正面的評價。

senses.en: helping something to go well
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 conditions，說明環境適合做某件事。

example.en: Market conditions are favorable for launching a new product.
example.zh: 市場情勢適合推出新產品。

extra_vocab.en: a kind or polite thing that you do for someone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 As a courtesy to your group 表示飯店出於好意、額外提供的免費服務。常見於飯店、航空公司的客氣說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: courtesy 是名詞，要形容人時用 courteous；表示「由…提供」要用 courtesy of。

example.en: Free parking and coffee are small courtesies that guests appreciate.
example.zh: 免費停車和咖啡是客人很欣賞的小服務。

example.en: As a courtesy, we will hold your room until six o'clock.
example.zh: 出於好意，我們會替您保留房間到六點。

example.en: A courtesy shuttle takes guests to the convention center every hour.
example.zh: 免費接駁車每小時載客人到會議中心。

example.en: The manager made a courtesy call to thank the client.
example.zh: 經理打了一通禮貌性電話向客戶道謝。

example.en: The tickets were provided courtesy of our main sponsor.
example.zh: 這些票券由我們的主要贊助商提供。

examples.en: The fee waiver is a courtesy, not something guests can expect.
examples.zh: 免收費用是一種好意，不是客人可以期待的權利。

examples.en: Thank you for your courtesy and patience during the system upgrade.
examples.zh: 感謝您在系統升級期間的體諒與耐心。

examples.en: Our staff treat every guest with courtesy and respect.
examples.zh: 我們的員工以禮貌和尊重對待每位客人。

confusable.diff: courtesy 是名詞（禮貌、好意），courteous 是形容詞（有禮貌的）。
confusable.usage: 形容人或態度要用 courteous，例如 a courteous driver；不能說 a courtesy driver（那是「接駁服務的司機」）。

example.en: All of our drivers are courteous and arrive on time.
example.zh: 我們所有的司機都很有禮貌而且準時抵達。

similar.diff: complimentary 是形容詞，意思是「免費贈送的」，用來修飾 breakfast、upgrade 等名詞。

example.en: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 客人每天早上都有免費早餐。

similar.diff: favor 是幫別人的忙，較個人化；courtesy 偏向機構或服務上的禮遇。

example.en: As a favor, the vendor delivered the parts on Sunday.
example.zh: 供應商特別幫忙，在星期日送來了零件。

example.en: Politeness is important when you speak with customers.
example.zh: 與顧客交談時，禮貌很重要。

example.en: She earned the respect of her colleagues quickly.
example.zh: 她很快就贏得同事的尊重。

example.en: Thank you for your kindness during our visit.
example.zh: 感謝您在我們拜訪期間的親切招待。

derived.link: courtesy 的形容詞，字尾 -ous 像 curious、serious
courteous + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: something extra that is given to be kind
senses.distinguish: 常和 free、as a courtesy 一起出現，指額外給的服務。

example.en: Free coffee in the lobby is a courtesy of the hotel.
example.zh: 大廳的免費咖啡是飯店提供的一項禮遇。

senses.en: polite behavior toward other people
senses.distinguish: 常接 with courtesy，指待人的態度。

example.en: Please answer every customer call with courtesy.
example.zh: 請以禮貌的態度接聽每一通客戶來電。

extra_vocab.en: a place where people go to relax with massage and other treatments
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指飯店內的水療設施，信中提到客人第二晚可免費使用，是額外的招待。spa 前面通常加 the 指飯店內的那間。

example.en: Several hotels in the area have spas open to the public.
example.zh: 這一區有好幾家飯店的水療中心對外開放。

example.en: Each guest receives one free spa treatment during the stay.
example.zh: 每位客人住宿期間可獲得一次免費水療護理。

example.en: We booked a spa package for the entire sales team.
example.zh: 我們替整個業務團隊訂了水療套裝方案。

example.en: The hotel's spa facilities include a sauna and a pool.
example.zh: 飯店的水療設施包括三溫暖和泳池。

example.en: The company organized a spa day to thank its staff.
example.zh: 公司安排了一天水療日來感謝員工。

examples.en: Guests can book a massage at the hotel spa this weekend.
examples.zh: 客人這個週末可以預約飯店水療中心的按摩。

examples.en: The resort spa offers special packages for corporate groups.
examples.zh: 度假村的水療中心為企業團體提供特別方案。

examples.en: The spa will be closed for cleaning on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 水療中心星期一早上將因清潔而關閉。

similar.diff: health club 以健身房和運動課程為主，spa 則以放鬆的按摩和護理為主。

example.en: The hotel health club has a gym and a swimming pool.
example.zh: 飯店的健身俱樂部有健身房和游泳池。

similar.diff: wellness center 範圍較廣，除了放鬆還包含健康諮詢和運動課程，語氣較正式。

example.en: The wellness center offers yoga classes and massage services.
example.zh: 健康中心提供瑜伽課程和按摩服務。

example.en: The hotel offers a one-hour massage for guests.
example.zh: 飯店為客人提供一小時的按摩。

example.en: The sauna is open from six to ten every evening.
example.zh: 三溫暖每天晚上六點到十點開放。

example.en: Guests may use the gym at any time of day.
example.zh: 客人可以在一天中任何時間使用健身房。

senses.en: a place with massage and other treatments for relaxing
senses.distinguish: 常出現在飯店設施介紹，後面接 treatment、package。

example.en: The spa on the top floor has a view of the harbor.
example.zh: 頂樓的水療中心可以看到海港景色。

senses.en: a town with natural hot water where people go for their health
senses.distinguish: 指整個地區，常有 spa town、spa resort 的說法。

example.en: The town is a famous spa known for its hot springs.
example.zh: 這個小鎮是以溫泉聞名的療養勝地。

extra_vocab.en: to promise that something will happen or be true
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 We cannot guarantee the rate after that date 是委婉但明確的提醒：二月十日之後不保證仍是這個價格。用 cannot guarantee 比直接說 will change 更客氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: guarantee 後面可接名詞、that 子句或 to V，例如 guarantee delivery、guarantee that it will arrive、guarantee to reply；也可用雙受詞 guarantee you a seat。

example.en: The contract guarantees delivery within five business days.
example.zh: 這份合約保證在五個工作天內交貨。

example.en: We offer written guarantees on all of our office equipment.
example.zh: 我們對所有辦公設備都提供書面保證。

example.en: The airline guaranteed every passenger a seat on the next flight.
example.zh: 航空公司保證每位乘客在下一班飛機有座位。

example.en: Customers receive guaranteed delivery within two days of ordering.
example.zh: 顧客下單後兩天內保證送達。

example.en: Guaranteeing on-time delivery is our top priority this year.
example.zh: 保證準時交貨是我們今年的首要任務。

example.en: The software comes with a thirty-day money-back guarantee.
example.zh: 這套軟體附有三十天退款保證。

example.en: We guarantee delivery to any address in the country.
example.zh: 我們保證送達全國任何地址。

example.en: A credit card number will guarantee your reservation overnight.
example.zh: 提供信用卡號可以擔保您整晚的訂房。

example.en: There is no guarantee that prices will stay the same.
example.zh: 無法保證價格會維持不變。

examples.en: Please book early, because we cannot guarantee a room later.
examples.zh: 請及早預訂，因為之後我們無法保證有房間。

examples.en: The supplier guarantees that all parts will arrive by Friday.
examples.zh: 供應商保證所有零件在星期五前送到。

examples.en: This printer comes with a two-year guarantee against defects.
examples.zh: 這台印表機附有兩年的瑕疵保固。

confusable.diff: ensure 是「確保、設法使一定發生」，著重做法；guarantee 是「保證」，著重承諾。
confusable.usage: ensure 後面通常接 that 子句，不用於「保固」這種名詞意思；guarantee 可當名詞，ensure 只能當動詞。

example.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請確認所有的門都已上鎖。

confusable.diff: insure 是「投保、為…保險」，和 guarantee 的「承諾」不同。

example.en: The company insured the shipment against damage during transport.
example.zh: 公司為這批貨物投保運送途中的損壞險。

similar.diff: promise 是日常的「答應」，語氣較個人；guarantee 更正式，常有合約或書面保證的感覺。

example.en: The vendor promised to send the samples on Monday.
example.zh: 廠商答應星期一寄出樣品。

similar.diff: assure 後面接人再接 that 子句，意思是「向某人保證、使放心」。

example.en: She assured the client that the work would finish on time.
example.zh: 她向客戶保證工作會準時完成。

example.en: The warranty covers repairs for two years.
example.zh: 保固涵蓋兩年的維修。

example.en: We promise to reply to every email within a day.
example.zh: 我們承諾每封電子郵件一天內回覆。

example.en: The company has a strong commitment to quality.
example.zh: 這家公司對品質有堅定的承諾。

example.en: We guarantee that every order will ship within two days.
example.zh: 我們保證每筆訂單兩天內出貨。

example.en: Do you offer a guarantee on installation work?
example.zh: 你們的安裝工程有提供保證嗎？

senses.en: to promise that something will happen
senses.distinguish: 後面接事情或 that 子句，重點在承諾結果。

example.en: The manager guarantees that the report will be ready tomorrow.
example.zh: 經理保證報告明天會準備好。

senses.en: to promise to fix or replace a product if it breaks
senses.distinguish: 受詞是產品，常接 for + 期間 或 against + 瑕疵。

example.en: The company guarantees its laptops against defects for three years.
example.zh: 公司對筆記型電腦提供三年瑕疵保固。

extra_vocab.zh: 有成就的人、表現傑出的人（複數）
extra_vocab.en: people who do very well and reach their goals
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，top achievers 指業績最優秀、被公司邀請參加獎勵活動（retreat）的員工。achiever 指的是「人」，不是成就本身。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: achiever 是可數名詞，指「人」；成就本身是 achievement，動詞 achieve 是及物動詞，後面直接接 goal、target，不加 to。

example.en: She was named the top achiever in the sales department this year.
example.zh: 她今年被選為業務部門表現最優異的人。

example.en: Our recruiters look for high achievers who work well in teams.
example.zh: 我們的招募人員在尋找善於團隊合作的高成就者。

examples.en: The award ceremony honors the achievers from every regional office.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮表揚各區域分公司的傑出人員。

examples.en: Top achievers receive a bonus and an invitation to the annual retreat.
examples.zh: 頂尖表現者會獲得獎金，並受邀參加年度活動。

examples.en: The training program is designed for achievers who want to become managers.
examples.zh: 這項培訓計畫是為想成為主管的傑出人員設計的。

confusable.diff: achiever 是「有成就的人」，achievement 是「成就、成果」這件事。

example.en: Winning the national award was a major achievement for the company.
example.zh: 贏得全國大獎是公司的一大成就。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 archive 是「檔案館、存檔」，與成就無關。

example.en: Please store the old reports in the company archive after the audit.
example.zh: 稽核結束後，請把舊報告存放在公司檔案庫。

similar.diff: 常用在人資與績效評估，指工作表現好的人；achiever 帶有「達成目標」的意味。

example.en: The manager praised the high performers on the sales team.
example.zh: 經理稱讚了業務團隊中表現優異的人。

example.en: The recipient of this year's award will be announced on Friday.
example.zh: 今年的獲獎者將在週五公布。

example.en: The winner of the sales contest will receive a trip to Bali.
example.zh: 業績競賽的優勝者將獲得峇里島旅遊。

example.en: Her performance this quarter was well above the team average.
example.zh: 她這一季的表現遠高於團隊平均。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞；achieve + -er，做這件事的人，像 worker、manager
achieve + -ment，變成名詞「成果」，像 payment、agreement
achieve + -able，可以被達成的，像 reasonable、available

extra_vocab.en: feeling that something is very good and deserves respect
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，were impressed by the scale of the event 是飯店客氣地表示對活動規模印象深刻，帶有正面、禮貌的語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 人感到印象深刻用 impressed（be impressed by / with + 事物）；造成印象的事物或結果用 impressive，不能說 The result is impressed。

example.en: Her careful planning always impresses the senior managers at our company.
example.zh: 她縝密的規劃總是讓公司的高階主管印象深刻。

example.en: Impressing a new client takes more than a good presentation.
example.zh: 要讓新客戶留下深刻印象，不只需要一場好的簡報。

example.en: Customers were impressed by how quickly the staff solved the problem.
example.zh: 顧客對員工解決問題的速度之快印象深刻。

example.en: The board was impressed with her clear and confident presentation.
example.zh: 董事會對她清楚又自信的簡報印象深刻。

example.en: We were highly impressed with the quality of the samples.
example.zh: 我們對樣品的品質印象非常深刻。

examples.en: The interviewers were impressed by her experience in international sales.
examples.zh: 面試官對她的國際業務經驗印象深刻。

examples.en: Our client was impressed that the team finished the work early.
examples.zh: 我們的客戶對團隊提早完工印象深刻。

examples.en: Everyone in the meeting was impressed after seeing the test results.
examples.zh: 看到測試結果後，會議中的每個人都印象深刻。

confusable.diff: impressed 形容「感到」印象深刻的人；impressive 形容「令人」印象深刻的事物。
confusable.usage: 主詞是人用 impressed（The client was impressed），主詞是事物或結果用 impressive（The result is impressive）。

example.en: The company reported an impressive increase in online orders last quarter.
example.zh: 公司報告上一季網路訂單有令人印象深刻的成長。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 expressed 是 express（表達）的過去式。

example.en: The manager expressed her thanks to the whole team.
example.zh: 經理向全體團隊表達了謝意。

similar.diff: 只是滿意、高興，語氣比 impressed 弱，不一定有佩服的意思。

example.en: We are pleased with the results of the customer survey.
example.zh: 我們對顧客調查的結果感到滿意。

similar.diff: 語氣更強烈，常指被某個特點吸引注意。

example.en: She was struck by the friendly atmosphere in the new office.
example.zh: 她對新辦公室友善的氣氛印象深刻。

example.en: Many employees admire the director's honest and open leadership style.
example.zh: 許多員工很欣賞總監坦率開放的領導風格。

example.en: The client praised the team for meeting every deadline.
example.zh: 客戶稱讚團隊趕上了每一個期限。

example.en: Most customers said they were satisfied with the new delivery service.
example.zh: 大多數顧客表示對新的配送服務感到滿意。

derived.link: impress + -ion，變成名詞「印象」，像 discussion、decision
impress + -ive，「令人…的」，像 active、attractive
impressive + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quickly、clearly
un- + impressed，「不…的」，像 unhappy、unable

example.en: The investors were impressed by the firm's steady growth over three years.
example.zh: 投資人對這家公司三年來的穩定成長印象深刻。

example.en: The new design impressed everyone who attended the trade show.
example.zh: 新設計讓每位參加貿易展的人都印象深刻。

extra_vocab.en: paid by a company to work for it
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動句 is employed by your company，指每位賓客都是這家公司的在職員工，作為申請優惠價的資格證明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: employ 是及物動詞，表示「受僱於某公司」用被動：be employed by + 公司（或 at + 地點）；employed 也可當形容詞，表示「有工作的」，反義是 unemployed。

example.en: The factory employs more than two hundred workers in the region.
example.zh: 這間工廠在當地僱用了兩百多名員工。

example.en: Employing local staff helps the company understand its customers better.
example.zh: 僱用當地員工有助於公司更了解自己的顧客。

example.en: All sales staff are employed by the regional office, not headquarters.
example.zh: 所有業務人員都受僱於區域辦公室，而不是總公司。

example.en: The new plant will employ workers from nearby towns.
example.zh: 新工廠會僱用附近城鎮的工人。

example.en: We decided to employ a consultant to review the budget.
example.zh: 我們決定聘請一位顧問來審查預算。

examples.en: We plan to employ three more engineers before the product launch.
examples.zh: 我們打算在產品上市前再僱用三位工程師。

examples.en: Applicants must be employed full time to qualify for the loan.
examples.zh: 申請人必須是全職受僱，才符合貸款資格。

examples.en: Retail is the industry that employs the largest number of people here.
examples.zh: 零售業是這裡僱用人數最多的產業。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 deployed 是「部署、調派」人員或資源。

example.en: Extra security staff were deployed at the entrance during the event.
example.zh: 活動期間，額外的保全人員被調派到入口處。

similar.diff: hire 強調「聘用」這個動作與決定，口語、常用；employ 較正式，也指持續僱用的狀態。

example.en: We will hire two new analysts after the budget is approved.
example.zh: 預算核准後，我們會聘用兩位新的分析師。

family.zh: 資遣（因業務縮減，不是員工的錯）

example.en: The company had to lay off fifty workers after sales dropped.
example.zh: 銷售下滑後，公司不得不資遣五十名員工。

family.zh: 解僱（因表現或過失，較正式）

example.en: He was dismissed after breaking the company's safety rules.
example.zh: 他因為違反公司安全規定而被解僱。

example.en: The manager fired the contractor for missing every deadline.
example.zh: 經理因為承包商每次都沒趕上期限而把他開除。

example.en: She resigned to start her own consulting business.
example.zh: 她辭職去開創自己的顧問公司。

derived.link: employ + -er，僱用人的人，像 worker、manager
employ + -ee，被僱用的人，像 trainee、interviewee
employ + -ment，變成名詞，像 payment、agreement
un- + employed，不被僱用的，像 unhappy、unable
un- + employment，沒有就業，也就是「失業（率）」

example.en: The company plans to employ twenty new technicians this summer.
example.zh: 公司計畫今年夏天僱用二十位新技術人員。

example.en: Over ninety percent of our graduates are employed within six months.
example.zh: 我們超過九成的畢業生在六個月內就有工作。

senses.en: to pay someone to work for you

example.en: The hotel employs a full-time manager for its guest events.
example.zh: 這間飯店僱用一位全職經理負責住客活動。

senses.en: to use something for a purpose
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人就是「僱用」；受詞是方法、技術就是「使用」，語氣較正式。

example.en: The team employs a new method to test every product.
example.zh: 團隊採用新的方法來測試每一項產品。

extra_vocab.en: stopped, often for a while
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動句 was halted，指東翼整修工程因許可證糾紛被迫暫停，不是自願停工，之後有可能再開始。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: halt 的過去式與過去分詞都是 halted；當及物動詞時受詞常是 work、production 等（halt production），被動 be halted 表示被迫暫停。

example.en: Heavy snow halts train service along the northern line every winter.
example.zh: 每年冬天，大雪都會讓北線的火車停駛。

example.en: Halting production for repairs cost the plant nearly a full day.
example.zh: 為了維修而停止生產，使工廠損失了將近一整天。

example.en: The plant had to halt production because of a parts shortage.
example.zh: 工廠因為零件短缺而不得不停止生產。

example.en: Traffic may come to a halt near the airport during the evening rush hour.
example.zh: 傍晚尖峰時段，機場附近的交通可能會完全停下來。

example.en: Storms forced the airline to halt operations at two airports.
example.zh: 暴風雨迫使航空公司暫停兩座機場的營運。

examples.en: The council halted the road project until the budget was approved.
examples.zh: 市議會在預算核准前叫停了這項道路工程。

examples.en: A customs problem halted the shipment at the border for two days.
examples.zh: 海關問題讓貨物在邊境停留了兩天。

examples.en: Updates were halted when the server suddenly stopped responding.
examples.zh: 伺服器突然沒有回應時，更新作業就被中止了。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 halve 是「使減半」，不是停止。

example.en: The new system will halve our processing time by next year.
example.zh: 新系統將在明年把我們的處理時間減半。

similar.diff: suspend 較正式，多指有計畫地暫時停止；halted 常是被意外或外力叫停。

example.en: The airline suspended flights to the island because of the storm.
example.zh: 航空公司因為暴風雨暫停了飛往該島的航班。

similar.diff: stall 指自己停滯、卡住（談判、引擎），不一定是被叫停。

example.en: Talks stalled when the two sides could not agree on price.
example.zh: 雙方無法在價格上達成共識，談判因而停滯。

example.en: Please pause the video so we can discuss the first slide.
example.zh: 請暫停影片，讓我們討論第一張投影片。

example.en: Bad weather may delay the delivery of the new equipment.
example.zh: 惡劣天氣可能會延遲新設備的送達。

example.en: A power failure interrupted the presentation for several minutes.
example.zh: 停電使簡報中斷了好幾分鐘。

example.en: The manager decided to halt the experiment until the results were checked.
example.zh: 經理決定在確認結果之前先中止這項實驗。

example.en: The strike brought all deliveries to a complete halt.
example.zh: 罷工使所有的配送完全停擺。

items.tag: 年度升遷審核新流程說明語音通知

level.why: 以被動、關係子句、不定詞片語與 so 引導的結果子句組成較長的口語句，需整合提名人數、年資、推薦信、評分標準、申訴期限與說明會時間等多項資訊；creativity、disagreement 等字彙較抽象，且干擾項（如兩位提名名額與兩年年資、本月底與週四）較接近正解。

items.passage: Good morning, everyone. This is Rachel Torres from Human Resources with an update on this year's promotion review. After last year's reviews were halted during the merger, the committee has revised the process to make decisions fairer and more consistent. Managers may nominate up to two employees who have been employed here for at least eighteen months, and each nominee must be supported by a reference letter from a current supervisor. We were impressed by how many top achievers stood out last quarter, so the committee will now consider creativity and teamwork as well as sales results. If there is a disagreement about a final rating, the employee may file an appeal within ten days. To answer your questions, we will hold an open forum on Thursday at two in the afternoon. Please submit all nominations by the end of this month.
items.zh: 大家早安。我是人力資源部的瑞秋．托瑞斯，要向大家說明今年升遷審核的最新消息。在去年的審核因合併案而暫停之後，委員會已修訂流程，讓決策更公平、更一致。主管可以提名最多兩位已在公司任職至少十八個月的員工，且每位被提名人都必須附上現任直屬主管所寫的推薦信。上一季有許多頂尖表現者脫穎而出，讓我們印象深刻，因此委員會現在除了業績之外，也會考量創意與團隊合作。如果對最終評等有任何歧見，員工可以在十天內提出申訴。為了回答大家的問題，我們將在週四下午兩點舉辦一場公開討論會。請在本月底前繳交所有提名資料。

vocab.col: nominate a candidate / nominate for an award
a disagreement over / resolve a disagreement

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To announce which employees will be promoted this year
To describe the results of a company merger
To explain changes to the promotion review process
To introduce a new sales training program
why: 錯誤：說話者只說明審核流程與提名方式，並沒有公布升遷人選。
錯誤：合併案只是去年審核暫停的原因，並不是這則通知的重點。
正解：說話者說明委員會已修訂今年升遷審核的流程，並交代提名、申訴與說明會等細節。
錯誤：文中沒有提到任何新的業務培訓課程。

questions.q: What is required for each nominee?
opts: A reference letter from a current supervisor
A written summary of last quarter's sales results
A recommendation from the Human Resources department
At least two years of service with the company
why: 正解：說話者表示每位被提名人都必須有現任直屬主管所寫的推薦信。
錯誤：業績不再是唯一標準，而且文中沒有要求繳交業績摘要。
錯誤：推薦信是由現任主管而非人資部門撰寫。
錯誤：文中要求的是至少十八個月的年資，不是兩年；「兩」是指每位主管可提名的人數。

questions.q: What will happen on Thursday?
opts: The committee will announce the winners
Employees will be able to ask questions
why: 錯誤：提名資料的期限是本月底，不是週四。
錯誤：申訴是在最終評等公布後十天內提出，與週四無關。
錯誤：文中沒有說委員會會在週四公布結果。
正解：說話者表示週四下午兩點會舉辦公開討論會，讓員工提出問題。

questions.q: Employees are evaluated on both their individual ______ and their contribution to team goals.
why: 錯誤：perform 是動詞，所有格 their individual 後面需要名詞。
錯誤：performer 是「表演者、表現者」，指人，語意不符，不能指個人表現。
正解：their individual 後面需要名詞，performance 表示「工作表現」，與 contribution 並列。
錯誤：performing 是現在分詞，放在這裡無法當名詞表示工作表現。

questions.q: Employees ______ performance reviews are completed on time will be eligible for this year's bonus.
why: 正解：先行詞 Employees 與後面的 performance reviews 是所有關係，需用所有格關係代名詞 whose。
錯誤：who 在子句中當主詞，但後面已有主詞 performance reviews。
錯誤：which 指事物，不能指人，也不表示所有關係。
錯誤：whom 是受格，但這裡需要表示「…的」的所有格。

questions.q: The company is committed to ______ talented employees by offering clear career paths.
why: 錯誤：committed to 的 to 是介系詞，後面不能接原形動詞。
正解：be committed to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 retaining，後面還有受詞 talented employees。
錯誤：retention 是名詞，但後面又接了受詞 talented employees，文法不通。
錯誤：retained 是過去分詞，無法在這裡表示「致力於留住」。

extra_vocab.en: to officially suggest someone for a job, prize, or promotion
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 managers may nominate up to two employees 指主管可以正式推薦最多兩位員工參加升遷審核，是人資公告中的正式用字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: nominate someone for 後面接獎項或職位，nominate someone as 後面接身分或職稱。

example.en: Each manager nominates one employee for the annual training program.
example.zh: 每位主管提名一名員工參加年度訓練計畫。

example.en: Three staff members were nominated for the innovation award.
example.zh: 有三位員工被提名角逐創新獎。

example.en: Nominating the right person takes careful thought and honest feedback.
example.zh: 提名對的人需要仔細思考和誠實的意見。

example.en: The team nominated Paul for the customer service award.
example.zh: 團隊提名保羅角逐客戶服務獎。

collocations.zh: 提名 A 擔任 B

example.en: The board nominated her as the next company president.
example.zh: 董事會提名她擔任下一任公司總裁。

example.en: Our design was nominated for an industry prize.
example.zh: 我們的設計被提名角逐業界獎項。

example.en: Each department must nominate one candidate by Friday.
example.zh: 每個部門必須在星期五前提名一位候選人。

examples.en: I would like to nominate Ms. Chen for the leadership award.
examples.zh: 我想提名陳小姐角逐領導獎。

examples.en: Employees may nominate a colleague for the Team Player Award.
examples.zh: 員工可以提名一位同事角逐最佳團隊合作獎。

examples.en: Staff are invited to nominate candidates before the end of May.
examples.zh: 歡迎員工在五月底前提名候選人。

confusable.diff: nominal 是形容詞，意思是「微小的、象徵性的」，和動詞 nominate 意思不同，只是長得像。
confusable.usage: nominal 是形容詞，常見於 nominal fee（象徵性費用）；nominate 是動詞，後面要接人。

example.en: We charge only a nominal fee for the training materials.
example.zh: 我們對訓練教材只收象徵性的費用。

similar.diff: appoint 是真的任命某人擔任職位，nominate 只是提名，還要經過決定。

example.en: The board appointed Mr. Kim as the new director.
example.zh: 董事會任命金先生擔任新的主管。

similar.diff: recommend 較口語，只是推薦；nominate 是正式程序，通常要填表或送審。

example.en: I recommend Ms. Lee for the sales manager position.
example.zh: 我推薦李小姐擔任業務經理一職。

example.en: The company will appoint a new manager next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月將任命一位新經理。

example.en: Can you recommend a good caterer for the event?
example.zh: 你能推薦活動用的好外燴業者嗎？

example.en: The final candidate will meet the whole team on Monday.
example.zh: 最後一位應徵者星期一會和整個團隊見面。

derived.link: nominate 去掉 -e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 create → creation
nominate + -ee，表示「被…的人」，像 employee、trainee

senses.en: to officially suggest someone for a prize or promotion
senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 獎項或機會，表示推薦對方參加。

example.en: Managers can nominate staff for the yearly service award.
example.zh: 主管可以提名員工角逐年度服務獎。

senses.en: to choose someone to do a job or role
senses.distinguish: 後面接 to V 或 as + 職稱，表示指定去做某件事。

example.en: The committee nominated Mr. Kim to lead the meeting.
example.zh: 委員會指定金先生主持這場會議。

extra_vocab.en: the ability to think of new and interesting ideas
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 creativity 和 teamwork 並列，表示升遷審核除了業績，也會評估員工的創意與合作。屬於人資與徵才文章常見的能力用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: creativity 是不可數名詞，不加 s，前面也不加 a。

example.en: Open offices can encourage creativity among team members.
example.zh: 開放式辦公室能鼓勵團隊成員發揮創意。

example.en: She showed great creativity when she solved the shipping problem.
example.zh: 她解決出貨問題時展現了很大的創意。

example.en: Creativity and innovation drive growth in our industry.
example.zh: 創意與創新推動我們產業的成長。

examples.en: Our design team is known for its creativity and attention to detail.
examples.zh: 我們的設計團隊以創意和注重細節聞名。

examples.en: This position requires creativity, strong writing skills, and teamwork.
examples.zh: 這個職位需要創意、優秀的寫作能力和團隊合作。

examples.en: The workshop helps employees develop their creativity at work.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊協助員工培養工作上的創造力。

confusable.diff: creativity 是「創造的能力」，creation 是「創造的行為」或「被創造出來的東西」。
confusable.usage: creativity 不可數；creation 當「作品」時可數，如 a new creation。

example.en: The creation of the new logo took three weeks.
example.zh: 製作新標誌花了三個星期。

similar.diff: innovation 指把新點子或新方法實際用出來的「創新」；creativity 是想出點子的能力。

example.en: Innovation helped the company enter a new market.
example.zh: 創新幫助公司進入了新市場。

similar.diff: imagination 是「想像力」，偏向腦中想像；creativity 更強調做出新東西。

example.en: The ad needs more imagination to attract young customers.
example.zh: 這則廣告需要更多想像力來吸引年輕顧客。

example.en: Innovation is the key to staying ahead of competitors.
example.zh: 創新是領先競爭對手的關鍵。

example.en: Good marketing needs imagination as well as data.
example.zh: 好的行銷除了數據也需要想像力。

example.en: We hire young talent from the best universities.
example.zh: 我們從最好的大學聘用年輕人才。

derived.link: creativity 的詞幹，create 是「創造」
create + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor
create 去掉 -e 加 -ion，變名詞，像 relate → relation
create + -ive，形容詞字尾，像 active、attractive
creative + -ly，形容詞變副詞

extra_vocab.en: a situation in which people have different opinions
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 a disagreement about a final rating 指員工與評分結果之間的歧見，後面接申訴程序，是說明申訴流程的客氣、中性說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: disagreement 是可數名詞，要寫 a disagreement；意見不合的事情用 about 或 over，對象用 with。

example.en: Small disagreements are normal when a team works on a new project.
example.zh: 團隊進行新專案時，出現小意見不合是正常的。

example.en: The two departments met to resolve a disagreement over costs.
example.zh: 兩個部門開會解決費用上的歧見。

example.en: He had a disagreement with his supervisor about the deadline.
example.zh: 他和主管對截止日期意見不合。

example.en: There is a disagreement between the two reports.
example.zh: 這兩份報告之間有出入。

examples.en: The two managers had a disagreement about the budget.
examples.zh: 兩位經理對預算意見不合。

examples.en: Any disagreement about the schedule should be reported to Ms. Lee.
examples.zh: 對時程有任何歧見，應向李小姐報告。

examples.en: A disagreement over the price delayed the signing of the contract.
examples.zh: 價格上的歧見延後了合約的簽署。

confusable.diff: disagreeable 是形容詞，意思是「令人不愉快的」，不是「不同意」。
confusable.usage: disagreement 是名詞（意見不合）；disagreeable 形容人或事「討厭的」，不能用來說某人不同意。

example.en: The client was disagreeable and rejected every proposal we made.
example.zh: 那位客戶很難相處，否決了我們所有的提案。

similar.diff: dispute 的語氣較強，常指正式爭議，像價格或合約的糾紛。

example.en: The two companies are in a dispute over payment.
example.zh: 這兩家公司因為付款問題陷入爭議。

similar.diff: argument 是「爭論、爭吵」，語氣比 disagreement 更激烈，也可指「論點」。

example.en: The argument between the two teams lasted an hour.
example.zh: 兩個團隊之間的爭論持續了一個小時。

example.en: Her argument for a larger budget convinced the board.
example.zh: 她要求增加預算的論點說服了董事會。

example.en: The dispute with the supplier was solved last week.
example.zh: 和供應商的爭議上週已經解決。

example.en: A conflict of schedules forced us to cancel the meeting.
example.zh: 時間上的衝突迫使我們取消會議。

derived.link: disagreement 的詞幹，agree 是「同意」
agree + -ment，變成名詞，像 payment、movement
dis- 表示相反，像 dislike、disappear
agree + -able，「可以同意的」，像 comfortable

senses.en: a situation in which people do not have the same opinion
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人，後面接 about、over 說明歧見的內容。

example.en: We had a short disagreement about who should lead the project.
example.zh: 我們對誰該帶領專案有過一小段歧見。

senses.en: a difference between two sets of facts or numbers
senses.distinguish: 主詞是報告或數字，表示兩邊不一致。

example.en: Our audit found a disagreement between the invoice and the order.
example.zh: 我們的稽核發現發票與訂單之間有出入。

extra_vocab.en: a meeting or place where people talk about a topic
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 open forum 指任何人都可以參加、提問的公開說明會，用來讓員工發問。open forum 是公司公告很常見的說法。

example.en: Our website has two forums for customers and for dealers.
example.zh: 我們的網站有兩個論壇，分別給顧客和經銷商。

example.en: The meeting ended with an open forum for staff questions.
example.zh: 會議最後以讓員工發問的公開討論會作結。

example.en: We plan to hold a forum on workplace safety in June.
example.zh: 我們計畫在六月舉辦一場職場安全討論會。

example.en: I found the answer on an online forum for engineers.
example.zh: 我在一個工程師的網路論壇上找到了答案。

example.en: The mayor spoke at a public forum about the new bridge.
example.zh: 市長在一場公開論壇上談論新橋。

examples.en: The company will hold a forum for all new employees.
examples.zh: 公司將為所有新進員工舉辦一場討論會。

examples.en: Many customers ask questions on the product's online forum.
examples.zh: 許多顧客在產品的網路論壇上發問。

examples.en: The city is hosting a forum on public transportation next week.
examples.zh: 市政府下週將舉辦一場大眾運輸討論會。

confusable.diff: form 是「表格」或「形式」，forum 是「討論會、論壇」，字形相近但意思不同。

example.en: The form must be signed and returned by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 這份表格必須在星期五下午前簽名並交回。

similar.diff: town hall meeting 常指公司或社區的全體說明會，由主管回答大家問題；forum 範圍更廣。

example.en: The CEO answered questions at the town hall meeting.
example.zh: 執行長在全體說明會上回答問題。

similar.diff: panel discussion 是由幾位專家上台討論，聽眾以聽為主；forum 更強調公開交流。

example.en: Three experts joined the panel discussion on remote work.
example.zh: 三位專家參加了關於遠距工作的座談。

example.en: I attended a seminar on customer service last week.
example.zh: 我上週參加了一場客戶服務研討會。

example.en: The workshop teaches new staff how to use the system.
example.zh: 這場工作坊教新進員工如何使用系統。

example.en: She will present her findings at the conference in May.
example.zh: 她將在五月的會議上報告她的研究結果。

senses.en: a meeting where people can talk about a topic
senses.distinguish: 指現場舉辦的活動，常和 hold、host 一起用。

example.en: The forum gave employees a chance to ask about the new policy.
example.zh: 這場討論會讓員工有機會詢問新政策。

senses.en: a website where people post questions and answers
senses.distinguish: 指網站，常有 online、user 等字出現。

example.en: Users share tips on the support forum every day.
example.zh: 使用者每天在支援論壇上分享技巧。

items.tag: 進口發電機貨物延遲清關與文件更正報告郵件

level.why: 以分詞構句、關係子句、since／although／because 等多重連接詞與 it is imperative that 的虛擬語氣句型組成較長的書面句，需整合文件不符、更正期限、二次查驗風險、倉儲費與查驗人員費用等多項資訊；imperative、discrepancy 等字彙較抽象，且干擾項（如倉儲費、供應商與報關行的角色）更接近正解。

items.passage:
Subject: Update on the Generator Shipment

Dear Mr. Alvarez,

I am writing to update you on the 40 industrial generators that left Hamburg aboard the freighter Nordic Star on April 3. The vessel reached our port on schedule, but customs officials halted the release of the cargo after discovering that the certificate of origin did not match the commercial invoice. Since our assembly line cannot resume production until the units are delivered, it is imperative that this discrepancy be corrected before Friday.

Our broker has already contacted the supplier, who has promised to send a revised certificate by tomorrow morning. Although we were impressed by how quickly the supplier responded, we remain cautious, because a second inspection may be required once the new documents have been filed. If that happens, clearance could take up to three additional business days, and storage fees of 200 dollars per day would apply.

To reduce the risk, I recommend that we employ an independent inspector to verify all paperwork before it is resubmitted. This would cost 800 dollars, but it would likely prevent further delays. Please let me know by Wednesday if you approve.

Best regards,
Maria Chen
Logistics Manager
items.zh:
主旨：發電機貨物最新進度

阿爾瓦雷茲先生，您好：

我寫這封信是要向您報告 40 台工業用發電機的最新狀況，這批貨於 4 月 3 日由貨輪北極星號從漢堡出發。船隻已準時抵達我們的港口，但海關人員在發現原產地證明書與商業發票不一致後，暫停了貨物的放行。由於在貨物送達之前，我們的組裝線無法恢復生產，因此務必在週五前更正這項不一致之處。

我們的報關行已經聯絡供應商，對方承諾會在明天早上寄出更正後的證明書。雖然供應商回應得這麼快讓我們印象深刻，但我們仍保持謹慎，因為新文件送件後，可能還需要進行第二次查驗。若發生這種情況，清關最多可能再多花三個工作天，並且每天要支付 200 美元的倉儲費。

為了降低風險，我建議我們聘請一位獨立的查驗人員，在文件重新送件前核對所有文書資料。這會花費 800 美元，但很可能避免進一步的延誤。如果您同意，請在週三前告訴我。

敬上
瑪莉亞．陳
物流經理

vocab.col: it is imperative that / imperative to act

questions.q: Why did customs officials stop the release of the cargo?
opts: The freighter arrived at the port later than planned
The generators were damaged during the voyage
Two shipping documents contained conflicting information
The storage fees had not been paid in advance
why: 錯誤：信中說船隻準時抵達港口，所以不是延遲抵達。
錯誤：文中沒有提到發電機在運送途中受損。
正解：海關發現原產地證明書與商業發票不一致，因此暫停放行貨物。
錯誤：倉儲費只是若再延誤才會產生的費用，並不是暫停放行的原因。

questions.q: What does Ms. Chen recommend doing?
opts: Having an independent inspector check the paperwork
Hiring a second broker to contact the supplier
Moving the production line to a different site
Paying the storage fees before Friday
why: 正解：陳小姐建議聘請獨立的查驗人員，在重新送件前核對所有文書資料。
錯誤：與供應商聯絡的是現有的報關行，並不是建議再聘一位報關行。
錯誤：文中說組裝線要等貨物送達才能恢復生產，沒有提到遷移產線。
錯誤：倉儲費是延誤才會產生，信中並沒有建議先付費。

questions.q: What will happen if a second inspection is required?
opts: The supplier will pay the storage fees
The shipment will be returned to Hamburg
The production line will be moved to another factory
Clearance could be delayed and extra costs could be added
why: 錯誤：文中沒有說供應商會負擔倉儲費。
錯誤：貨物是否退回漢堡並未被提及，這是文中沒出現的資訊。
錯誤：產線遷移沒有出現在信中。
正解：若需第二次查驗，清關最多可能再多花三個工作天，並且每天要付 200 美元倉儲費。

questions.q: All imported goods must be accompanied by documents ______ the country of origin and the value of the shipment.
why: 錯誤：specify 是原形動詞，放在名詞 documents 後面無法修飾名詞。
正解：documents specifying … 是現在分詞片語修飾名詞，表示「註明…的文件」，後面接受詞。
錯誤：specified 是過去分詞表被動，但後面直接接受詞 the country of origin，文法不通。
錯誤：specification 是名詞，後面不能再接 the country of origin 當受詞。

questions.q: The shipment will be released ______ the customs officer has verified all the required paperwork.
why: 錯誤：unless 表示「除非」，語意變成「除非海關已查驗，否則放行」，邏輯相反。
錯誤：during 是介系詞，後面要接名詞，不能接完整子句。
錯誤：despite 是介系詞，且語意是「儘管」，不合邏輯。
正解：once 當連接詞表示「一旦」，後面接完整子句，符合「查驗完成後即放行」的語意。

questions.q: The new tariff is expected to ______ the cost of imported steel by almost ten percent.
why: 錯誤：rise 是不及物動詞，後面不能直接接受詞 the cost。
錯誤：arise 表示「發生」，也是不及物動詞，語意不符。
正解：raise 是及物動詞，表示「提高」，後面接受詞 the cost。
錯誤：rose 是 rise 的過去式，不能接在 to 後面。

extra_vocab.en: a large ship or plane that carries goods, not passengers
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 the freighter Nordic Star 指載運四十台發電機從漢堡到港口的貨輪。freighter 專指運貨的船或飛機，比 ship 更明確。

example.en: Several freighters were waiting outside the port because of the strong winds.
example.zh: 因為強風，好幾艘貨輪在港外等候。

example.en: An ocean freighter takes about three weeks to cross the Pacific.
example.zh: 遠洋貨輪橫越太平洋約需三個星期。

example.en: Urgent spare parts will be sent by air freighter tonight.
example.zh: 緊急的備用零件今晚會用貨機送出。

example.en: Workers need two full days to load a freighter this size.
example.zh: 工人需要整整兩天才能裝完這種大小的貨輪。

examples.en: The freighter will arrive at the port on Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 貨輪將在星期四早上抵達港口。

examples.en: Your order left the factory aboard a freighter last week.
examples.zh: 您的訂單上週已搭乘貨輪離開工廠。

examples.en: A freighter carrying electronics was delayed by a storm at sea.
examples.zh: 一艘載運電子產品的貨輪被海上風暴耽誤。

confusable.diff: ferry 是載人與車輛的渡輪，freighter 是專門載貨的貨輪。

example.en: Staff take the ferry to the island office every morning.
example.zh: 員工每天早上搭渡輪到島上的辦公室。

similar.diff: cargo ship 是較通用的說法，只能指船；freighter 也可指貨機。

example.en: A large cargo ship delivered the steel to our factory.
example.zh: 一艘大型貨輪把鋼材運到我們的工廠。

similar.diff: container ship 專門裝貨櫃，是 freighter 的一種。

example.en: The container ship holds more than ten thousand containers.
example.zh: 這艘貨櫃船可裝超過一萬個貨櫃。

example.en: The vessel reached the harbor two hours ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 這艘船比預定時間早兩小時抵達港口。

example.en: All cargo must be inspected before it leaves the dock.
example.zh: 所有貨物離開碼頭前都必須檢查。

example.en: The next shipment is expected to arrive on Monday.
example.zh: 下一批貨預計星期一抵達。

derived.link: freighter 的詞幹，freight 是「貨運」；加 -er 變成「運貨的東西」，像 computer、printer

senses.en: a large ship that carries goods across the sea
senses.distinguish: 文中有 aboard、port、vessel，可判斷是船。

example.en: The freighter docked at Kaohsiung Port at dawn.
example.zh: 貨輪在黎明時靠泊高雄港。

senses.en: a plane that carries goods instead of passengers
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 air 或 cargo，或情境提到機場。

example.en: The freighter lands at the airport every night at eleven.
example.zh: 這架貨機每晚十一點降落在機場。

extra_vocab.en: a machine that makes electricity
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡出現在主旨 Update on the Generator Shipment，指進口的四十台工業用發電機。商業信件的主旨常用名詞片語，所以 Generator 首字母大寫。

example.en: Both generators were tested before they were sent to the plant.
example.zh: 兩台發電機在送往工廠前都經過測試。

example.en: The hospital switched to its backup generator during the blackout.
example.zh: 停電期間醫院改用備用發電機。

example.en: A diesel generator supplies power to the construction site.
example.zh: 柴油發電機為工地供電。

example.en: We rented a portable generator for the outdoor event.
example.zh: 我們為戶外活動租了一台可攜式發電機。

examples.en: We need to order three new generators before the summer season.
examples.zh: 夏季之前我們需要訂購三台新的發電機。

examples.en: The factory cannot run without a generator during a power failure.
examples.zh: 停電時，工廠沒有發電機就無法運轉。

examples.en: Please confirm the delivery date for the industrial generator.
examples.zh: 請確認這台工業用發電機的交貨日期。

confusable.diff: generator 是「發電機、產生器」，generation 是「世代」或「產生、發電的過程」。
confusable.usage: generator 指機器，可數；generation 指世代或過程，兩者詞尾不同，不能互換。

example.en: The new generation of engineers prefers cleaner power sources.
example.zh: 新一代的工程師偏好更乾淨的能源。

similar.diff: power plant 是供應大量電力的發電廠；generator 是單一機器。

example.en: The new power plant will supply electricity to the whole city.
example.zh: 新的發電廠將為整個城市供電。

example.en: The engine needs regular maintenance every six months.
example.zh: 引擎每六個月需要定期保養。

example.en: The motor stopped working after the power surge.
example.zh: 電力突波後馬達就停止運轉了。

example.en: The battery lasts about ten hours on a full charge.
example.zh: 這個電池充滿電可用約十小時。

derived.link: generator 的詞幹，generate 是「產生」；加 -or 變成「產生的機器」，像 operator
generate 去掉 -e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 create → creation

senses.en: a machine that makes electricity
senses.distinguish: 文中有 industrial、assembly line，指的是實體機器。

example.en: The generator provides power when the main supply fails.
example.zh: 主電源中斷時，發電機提供電力。

senses.en: a tool or program that makes something automatically
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 report、password 等字，指軟體工具。

example.en: Use the report generator to create the monthly sales summary.
example.zh: 用報表產生器製作每月銷售摘要。

extra_vocab.en: very important and needing action right now
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 it is imperative that this discrepancy be corrected 表示「這個差異一定要在星期五前更正」，語氣比 important 強，帶有緊迫感，適合在報告中向主管強調急迫性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: it is imperative that 後面的 that 子句用原形動詞（可加 should），不隨主詞變化，如 it is imperative that he be present；也可接 to V。

example.en: It is imperative that every shipment be checked before departure.
example.zh: 每批貨在出發前都必須檢查，這一點絕對必要。

example.en: It is imperative to back up all files before the upgrade.
example.zh: 升級之前務必備份所有檔案。

example.en: Cutting costs has become a business imperative for the company.
example.zh: 削減成本已成為公司的當務之急。

examples.en: It is imperative that we receive the payment before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們必須在截止日前收到款項。

examples.en: Safety training is imperative for everyone working on the factory floor.
examples.zh: 安全訓練對在工廠現場工作的每個人都是必要的。

examples.en: It is imperative to report any equipment problem to your supervisor.
examples.zh: 任何設備問題都務必向主管回報。

confusable.diff: imperial 是形容詞，意思是「帝國的」或「英制的」，和 imperative 只是拼法相近。

example.en: The old factory still uses imperial units for all measurements.
example.zh: 這間老工廠的所有測量仍使用英制單位。

similar.diff: essential 強調「不可缺少」，imperative 強調「急迫、必須馬上處理」。

example.en: Clear communication is essential when we manage a large project.
example.zh: 管理大型專案時，清楚的溝通不可或缺。

similar.diff: crucial 強調對結果「關鍵」，imperative 強調「必須採取行動」。

example.en: The next two weeks are crucial for the product launch.
example.zh: 接下來兩週對產品上市至關重要。

example.en: I need an urgent reply to the customer's complaint.
example.zh: 我需要儘快回覆這位顧客的客訴。

example.en: Accurate records are vital for every customs filing.
example.zh: 準確的紀錄對每次報關都至關重要。

example.en: Is it necessary to resend the whole document?
example.zh: 有必要重寄整份文件嗎？

example.en: It is imperative that we confirm the order today.
example.zh: 我們今天一定要確認這筆訂單。

example.en: Customer safety is the first imperative for any airline.
example.zh: 顧客安全是任何航空公司的首要之務。

extra_vocab.en: careful because you think something bad may happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 we remain cautious 表示雖然供應商回應很快，但第二次檢查的風險還在，所以團隊不敢掉以輕心。語氣是理性、保留的專業用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: cautious 常接 about + 名詞／V-ing 或 of + 名詞，如 be cautious about signing；不要寫成 cautious to sign。

example.en: The bank takes a cautious approach when it approves large loans.
example.zh: 銀行核准大額貸款時採取謹慎的做法。

example.en: Investors showed cautious optimism after the quarterly results came out.
example.zh: 季報公布後，投資人表現出審慎樂觀。

example.en: We should be cautious about promising an exact delivery date.
example.zh: 我們對承諾確切的交貨日期應該要謹慎。

examples.en: The board is cautious about expanding into a new market this year.
examples.zh: 董事會對今年拓展新市場態度謹慎。

examples.en: We remain cautious until the supplier sends the signed contract.
examples.zh: 在供應商寄來簽署的合約之前，我們仍保持謹慎。

examples.en: Cautious investors prefer safe options with steady returns.
examples.zh: 謹慎的投資人偏好報酬穩定的安全選項。

confusable.diff: conscious 是「意識到的、有意識的」，發音和 cautious 相近，但意思不是「小心」。
confusable.usage: conscious 常用 be conscious of，表示「察覺到」；cautious 常用 be cautious about，表示「對…小心」。

example.en: We are conscious of the problem and are working on a fix.
example.zh: 我們已意識到這個問題，正在處理修正。

similar.diff: careful 是日常的「小心」，cautious 更強調為了避免風險而保守、不冒險。

example.en: Please be careful when you move the heavy equipment.
example.zh: 搬運重型設備時請小心。

similar.diff: wary 帶有「不信任、有戒心」的意思，後面常接 of。

example.en: Customers are wary of offers that sound too good to be true.
example.zh: 顧客對好得不像真的優惠心存戒心。

example.en: A careful review can prevent costly mistakes.
example.zh: 仔細的檢查可以避免代價高昂的錯誤。

example.en: The manager is wary of changing suppliers so late.
example.zh: 經理對這麼晚才更換供應商有所戒心。

example.en: It is prudent to keep some money in reserve.
example.zh: 保留一些備用資金是明智的。

derived.link: cautious 的詞幹，caution 是「小心」；加 -ous 變形容詞，像 nervous、serious
cautious + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 careful → carefully

items.tag: 網站故障後客服處理與防止再發說明郵件

level.why: 以 after、until、which 引導的關係子句與多重因果、被動語態組成較長的書面句，需整合故障原因、受影響交易數、客服處理時間、退款期限與預防措施等多項資訊；delicate、convey 等字彙較抽象，且干擾項（如退款是財務部門、測試是新工程師）更接近正解。

items.passage:
Subject: Weekend Website Problem and Next Steps

Dear team,

As you know, our online commerce platform went offline for nearly five hours on Saturday after a software bug caused some customers to be charged twice at checkout. Orders were halted until the engineers corrected the error, and we estimate that about 300 transactions were affected.

I was impressed by how quickly the customer service team responded. Several top achievers on the night shift handled more than forty complaints each, which allowed us to convey a sincere apology to every affected customer before noon on Sunday. Because the matter remains delicate, please continue to use the approved message template when you contact customers.

To prevent a similar problem, we will take two steps. First, the finance department will refund all duplicate charges by Wednesday, and affected customers will receive a ten percent coupon. Second, we will employ two additional engineers to test every update before it goes live.

Thank you again for your hard work.

Best regards,
Paul Weston
Head of Online Sales
items.zh:
主旨：週末網站問題與後續步驟

各位同仁好：

如大家所知，我們的線上商務平台在週六因為一個軟體錯誤，導致部分顧客在結帳時被重複扣款，平台因此離線了將近五個小時。在工程師修正錯誤之前，訂單處理一度暫停，我們估計約有 300 筆交易受到影響。

客服團隊反應迅速，讓我印象深刻。夜班有幾位表現頂尖的同仁，每人處理了四十多件客訴，讓我們得以在週日中午前向每位受影響的顧客表達誠摯的歉意。由於這件事仍相當敏感，請在聯絡顧客時繼續使用核准的訊息範本。

為了避免類似問題再次發生，我們將採取兩項措施。第一，財務部門會在週三前退還所有重複扣款，受影響的顧客也會收到一張九折優惠券。第二，我們會再聘請兩位工程師，在每次更新上線前先進行測試。

再次感謝大家的辛勞。

敬上
保羅．韋斯頓
線上銷售主管

questions.q: What caused the problem on Saturday?
opts: A heavy increase in website traffic
A software error that charged some customers twice
A shipping mistake made by a supplier
A power failure at the engineers' office
why: 錯誤：信中沒有提到流量暴增，這是未出現的資訊。
正解：一個軟體錯誤使部分顧客在結帳時被重複扣款，導致平台離線。
錯誤：信中完全沒有提到供應商或運送問題。
錯誤：信中沒有提到停電，離線是因為軟體錯誤。

questions.q: What did the night shift staff do before noon on Sunday?
opts: They tested every update before it went live
They apologized to the affected customers
why: 錯誤：退還重複扣款是財務部門預計在週三前完成的事。
錯誤：測試每次更新是新聘工程師要做的事，不是夜班客服。
錯誤：聘請工程師是公司之後的措施，不是夜班同仁做的。
正解：夜班同仁處理大量客訴，在週日中午前向每位受影響的顧客表達歉意。

questions.q: What will the company do to avoid a similar problem?
opts: Add engineers to test updates before release
Give a coupon to every customer on the site
Reduce the number of orders accepted each day
why: 正解：公司會再聘請兩位工程師，在每次更新上線前先進行測試。
錯誤：信中是要求繼續使用核准的範本，並沒有要更換。
錯誤：優惠券只給受影響的顧客，且是補償措施，不是預防措施。
錯誤：文中沒有提到限制每日接受的訂單數量。

questions.q: The website was updated at midnight ______ customers would not be affected during peak hours.
why: 錯誤：in case of 後面要接名詞，不能接完整子句。
錯誤：even if 表示「即使」，語意不符更新時間的目的。
正解：so that 引導表示目的的子句，意思是「以便」，說明在午夜更新的目的。
錯誤：in spite of 是介系詞片語，後面要接名詞，且語意是「儘管」。

questions.q: Management is considering ______ the return period from thirty to sixty days.
why: 正解：consider 後面接動名詞，所以用 extending。
錯誤：consider 不接不定詞 to V。
錯誤：原形動詞不能直接接在 considering 之後。
錯誤：extended 是過去分詞，無法接受詞 the return period。

questions.q: Customers who are dissatisfied with a purchase may exchange it ______ the original packaging is undamaged.
why: 錯誤：owing to 是介系詞片語，後面接名詞，不能接完整子句。
錯誤：as to 是介系詞片語，意思是「關於」，不能引導條件子句。
錯誤：in case of 後面要接名詞，且語意是「萬一」，不符條件。
正解：provided that 引導條件子句，意思是「只要」，表示換貨的條件。

extra_vocab.en: the buying and selling of goods and services
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 online commerce platform 指線上購物或電商平台。commerce 比 business 更強調「買賣交易」本身，常見於電商相關的文章。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: commerce 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a。

example.en: E-commerce sales grew by twenty percent during the holiday season.
example.zh: 電子商務的銷售額在假期期間成長了兩成。

example.en: The local chamber of commerce will host a networking event.
example.zh: 當地商會將舉辦一場交流活動。

example.en: Online commerce has changed how small shops reach customers.
example.zh: 線上商務改變了小商店接觸顧客的方式。

examples.en: International commerce slowed after the new tax rules took effect.
examples.zh: 新稅制生效後，國際貿易趨緩。

examples.en: Our company specializes in software for mobile commerce.
examples.zh: 我們公司專門開發行動商務的軟體。

examples.en: The Department of Commerce released its annual trade report today.
examples.zh: 商務部今天發布了年度貿易報告。

confusable.diff: commence 是動詞，意思是「開始」（正式用法），拼法和 commerce 很像但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: commerce 是名詞（商業），commence 是動詞（開始），後者常見於正式通知，如 The meeting will commence at nine。

example.en: The training session will commence at nine o'clock sharp.
example.zh: 訓練課程將在九點整開始。

similar.diff: trade 常指國與國之間或業者之間的貨物買賣；commerce 範圍更廣，包含整體商業活動。

example.en: Trade between the two countries has increased this year.
example.zh: 兩國之間的貿易今年有所增加。

similar.diff: business 是最通用的「生意、公司」；commerce 較正式，強調買賣交易。

example.en: Her business sells handmade furniture to customers overseas.
example.zh: 她的生意把手工家具賣給海外顧客。

example.en: Free trade helps small companies sell their products abroad.
example.zh: 自由貿易幫助小公司把產品賣到國外。

example.en: She has ten years of experience in retail management.
example.zh: 她有十年的零售管理經驗。

example.en: Each transaction is recorded in the system automatically.
example.zh: 每一筆交易都會自動記錄在系統中。

derived.link: commerce 去掉 -e 加 -ial，變形容詞「商業的」，像 office → official
commercial + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: a mistake in a computer program that makes it work wrongly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 a software bug 指造成顧客重複扣款的程式錯誤。bug 是資訊相關文章的高頻字，比 error 更口語，也更偏向「程式本身的缺陷」。

example.en: The testers found several bugs in the latest version of the app.
example.zh: 測試人員在最新版本的應用程式中找到數個錯誤。

example.en: Our engineers worked all night to fix a bug in the payment page.
example.zh: 我們的工程師徹夜工作，修正付款頁面的錯誤。

example.en: A software bug deleted some files from the customer database.
example.zh: 一個軟體錯誤刪除了客戶資料庫中的部分檔案。

example.en: Please attach a screenshot when you submit a bug report.
example.zh: 提交錯誤回報時，請附上螢幕截圖。

examples.en: The bug only appears when users pay with a credit card.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤只有在使用者以信用卡付款時才會出現。

examples.en: We apologize for the bug and have already released a patch.
examples.zh: 我們為這個錯誤致歉，並且已經發布修補程式。

examples.en: Customers reported a bug that prevented them from logging in.
examples.zh: 顧客回報有個錯誤讓他們無法登入。

similar.diff: glitch 是暫時性的小故障，可能自己消失；bug 是程式本身的缺陷，要修改程式才會好。

example.en: A brief glitch interrupted the live video stream this morning.
example.zh: 今早一個短暫的小故障中斷了直播串流。

similar.diff: defect 通常指產品或設備的瑕疵，bug 專指軟體。

example.en: The inspector found a defect in the battery pack.
example.zh: 檢驗員在電池組中發現了瑕疵。

example.en: An error message appeared when I tried to save the file.
example.zh: 我嘗試存檔時出現了錯誤訊息。

example.en: Any defect must be reported within seven days of delivery.
example.zh: 任何瑕疵都必須在到貨後七天內回報。

example.en: The company released a security patch on Friday evening.
example.zh: 公司在星期五晚上發布了一個安全修補程式。

senses.en: a mistake in a computer program
senses.distinguish: 文中有 software、engineers、corrected the error，判斷是程式問題。

example.en: The new update fixed a bug that slowed down the website.
example.zh: 新的更新修正了讓網站變慢的錯誤。

senses.en: a small insect
senses.distinguish: 和農業、食品、環境清潔等情境一起出現。

example.en: The restaurant was closed after inspectors found bugs in the kitchen.
example.zh: 檢查人員在廚房發現小蟲後，這家餐廳被勒令停業。

senses.en: a mild illness that spreads easily
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 a stomach bug 或 catch a bug，出現在請病假的情境。

example.en: Half the office stayed home because of a stomach bug.
example.zh: 辦公室有一半的人因為腸胃型感冒待在家。

extra_vocab.en: to make ideas or feelings known to someone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 convey a sincere apology 指把誠摯的歉意傳達給顧客。convey 比 say 或 give 更正式，常用於道歉、感謝、訊息，是客氣得體的書面用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: convey 的句型是 convey + 事物 + to + 人，不能說 convey someone something；例如 convey our thanks to the team。

example.en: The logo conveys a sense of trust and quality.
example.zh: 這個標誌傳達出信賴與品質的感覺。

example.en: She conveyed the client's concerns to the project team.
example.zh: 她把客戶的疑慮傳達給專案團隊。

example.en: Conveying bad news in person shows respect to the customer.
example.zh: 當面傳達壞消息是對顧客的尊重。

example.en: The poster should convey a message that is clear and simple.
example.zh: 海報應該傳達清楚又簡單的訊息。

example.en: Please convey our thanks to everyone who joined the event.
example.zh: 請向所有參加活動的人轉達我們的謝意。

example.en: Charts help us convey information to the board quickly.
example.zh: 圖表幫助我們快速向董事會傳達資訊。

examples.en: I would like to convey my sincere apology for the delay.
examples.zh: 我想為延遲一事表達我誠摯的歉意。

examples.en: A good presentation conveys complex ideas in simple language.
examples.zh: 好的簡報用簡單的語言傳達複雜的概念。

examples.en: A belt conveys the boxes from the warehouse to the trucks.
examples.zh: 輸送帶把箱子從倉庫運到卡車上。

confusable.diff: convince 是「說服、使相信」，後面接人；convey 是「傳達」，後面接訊息或感受。
confusable.usage: convince + 人 + of / that，如 convince the client that…；convey + 事物 + to + 人。

example.en: Her report convinced the board to approve the new budget.
example.zh: 她的報告說服董事會核准了新預算。

confusable.diff: convene 是「召集、召開（會議）」，和傳達訊息無關。

example.en: The committee will convene on Monday to review the proposals.
example.zh: 委員會將在星期一召開會議審查提案。

similar.diff: communicate 是溝通，可不接受詞（communicate with 人）；convey 一定要接被傳達的內容。

example.en: We communicate with our overseas clients by email every day.
example.zh: 我們每天用電子郵件與海外客戶溝通。

similar.diff: express 強調把自己的感受說出來；convey 強調讓對方收到並理解。

example.en: Several customers expressed concern about the new fees.
example.zh: 幾位顧客對新的費用表示擔憂。

example.en: He expressed his thanks to the whole sales team.
example.zh: 他向整個業務團隊表達謝意。

example.en: Please deliver this message to the manager today.
example.zh: 請今天把這則訊息轉交給經理。

example.en: Trucks transport the goods to stores across the country.
example.zh: 卡車把貨物運到全國各地的商店。

derived.link: convey + -or，做事的東西或人，像 operator、visitor；常見於 conveyor belt（輸送帶）

senses.en: to let someone know an idea or a feeling
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 apology、message、thanks 等抽象的東西。

example.en: The manager conveyed his concerns to the head office.
example.zh: 經理向總公司傳達了他的疑慮。

senses.en: to carry people or things from one place to another
senses.distinguish: 受詞是貨物、水、電等實物，主詞常是輸送帶或管線。

example.en: The pipeline conveys oil from the port to the refinery.
example.zh: 這條管線把石油從港口輸送到煉油廠。

extra_vocab.en: needing careful handling because it could easily go wrong
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 the matter remains delicate 表示重複扣款一事仍然敏感，溝通時稍有不慎就會讓顧客不滿，所以要求同仁使用核准的訊息範本。

example.en: We are in a delicate situation after the contract dispute.
example.zh: 合約爭議之後，我們處於微妙的處境。

example.en: Salary is a delicate matter that should be discussed in private.
example.zh: 薪資是敏感的事，應該私下討論。

example.en: Managers must keep a delicate balance between cost and quality.
example.zh: 經理必須在成本與品質之間保持微妙的平衡。

examples.en: The negotiation is at a delicate stage, so please stay quiet.
examples.zh: 談判正處於微妙的階段，所以請保持安靜。

examples.en: Delicate equipment must be packed in special boxes for shipping.
examples.zh: 精密設備必須用特製的箱子包裝運送。

examples.en: This is a delicate issue, so I will call you directly.
examples.zh: 這是敏感的問題，所以我會直接打電話給你。

confusable.diff: delicious 是「美味的」，拼法開頭相近但意思和 delicate 完全不同。

example.en: The caterer prepared a delicious lunch for all of the guests.
example.zh: 外燴業者為所有賓客準備了美味的午餐。

similar.diff: sensitive 強調「容易引起情緒反應」的議題；delicate 強調「需要小心處理」。

example.en: Customer data is sensitive, so only a few staff can see it.
example.zh: 顧客資料屬於敏感資訊，所以只有少數員工能看到。

similar.diff: tricky 是口語的「棘手、不好處理」，delicate 更正式、帶有需要技巧與禮貌的意味。

example.en: Scheduling a meeting across three time zones is tricky.
example.zh: 安排橫跨三個時區的會議很棘手。

example.en: Mark every box fragile before it goes onto the truck.
example.zh: 貨物上卡車前，請在每個箱子上標示易碎。

example.en: Use a gentle tone when you speak to upset customers.
example.zh: 和不開心的顧客說話時，請用溫和的語氣。

example.en: Be careful when you handle the original contract.
example.zh: 處理合約正本時請小心。

derived.link: delicate 的 -ate 換成 -acy，變成抽象名詞，像 accurate → accuracy
delicate + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 careful → carefully

senses.en: needing careful handling so that nothing goes wrong
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 matter、situation、issue 等抽象的事。

example.en: Layoffs are a delicate issue for any growing company.
example.zh: 裁員對任何成長中的公司都是敏感的議題。

senses.en: easy to damage or break
senses.distinguish: 主詞是儀器、布料、零件等實物。

example.en: The delicate parts were wrapped in soft paper before shipping.
example.zh: 精密的零件在出貨前用軟紙包好。

senses.en: light and soft in color, taste, or smell
senses.distinguish: 常修飾 color、flavor、scent，帶正面的感覺。

example.en: The hotel lobby has a delicate scent of fresh flowers.
example.zh: 飯店大廳有淡淡的鮮花香氣。

items.tag: 辦公室租賃申請審核與推薦信需求語音留言

level.why: 以 since、because、which 引導的多重子句與分詞構句組成較長的口語句，需整合辦公室容納人數、推薦信期限、租金扣款方式、安全隱患與簽約日期等多項資訊；downsize、hazard 等字彙較抽象，且干擾項（週四、每月一號、下週一）較接近正解。

items.passage: Hello, Mr. Evans. This is Laura Kim from Westgate Properties, calling about your application for Suite 210. Since your design firm plans to downsize from its current office, this suite should suit you well, because it is designed for companies employing up to thirty people. We were impressed by your company profile, but before we can prepare the lease, the owner requires a reference letter from your current landlord confirming that your rent has always been paid on time. Please send it by Thursday. The monthly rent is 2,800 dollars, which will be collected by automatic debit on the first day of each month. During yesterday's inspection, our staff also found that the storage closet is a fire hazard because of the boxes left by the previous tenant, so we will clear it before you move in. If everything is in order, we can sign the lease next Monday.
items.zh: 您好，伊凡斯先生，我是西門地產的蘿拉．金，來電是想談談您申請 210 號辦公室的事。由於貴設計公司打算縮減目前的辦公規模，這間辦公室應該很適合您，因為它是為最多三十人的公司所設計的。我們對貴公司的簡介印象深刻，但在我們準備租約之前，屋主要求您提供一封現任房東寫的推薦信，證明您一向準時繳納租金。請在週四前寄給我們。每月租金是 2,800 美元，將在每月一號自動扣款。昨天檢查時，我們的人員還發現儲藏室因為前一位房客留下的箱子而有火災隱憂，所以我們會在您搬進來之前清空。如果一切沒問題，我們可以在下週一簽租約。

vocab.col: downsize the office / plan to downsize

questions.q: What is Mr. Evans asked to provide?
opts: A copy of his company profile
A list of the firm's employees
A letter from his current landlord
why: 錯誤：說話者說已看過公司簡介，並沒有再要求提供。
錯誤：文中沒有要求提供員工名單，三十人只是辦公室的容納人數。
正解：屋主要求一封現任房東所寫、證明租金一向準時繳納的推薦信。
錯誤：2,800 美元是每月租金，不是要先繳的訂金。

questions.q: Why will the staff clear the storage closet?
opts: Mr. Evans has requested more space
The owner wants to rent it separately
It is needed for a safety inspection
why: 正解：因為前一位房客留下的箱子讓儲藏室有火災隱憂，所以會在搬入前清空。
錯誤：文中沒有說伊凡斯先生要求更多空間。
錯誤：文中沒有提到屋主打算另外出租儲藏室。
錯誤：檢查已在昨天進行，清空是為了排除隱患，不是為了檢查。

questions.q: When can the lease be signed if everything is in order?
opts: On the first day of next month
why: 錯誤：週四是寄出推薦信的期限，不是簽約日。
錯誤：每月一號是自動扣款日，不是簽約日。
錯誤：昨天是檢查日，與簽約無關。
正解：說話者表示一切沒問題的話，下週一就可以簽租約。

questions.q: The lease cannot be terminated early ______ both parties give written consent.
why: 正解：unless 表示「除非」，意思是除非雙方書面同意，否則不能提前終止。
錯誤：if 會使語意變成「如果雙方同意就不能終止」，邏輯相反。
錯誤：because 表示原因，語意不符。
錯誤：although 表示讓步，語意不符。

questions.q: The property manager asked all tenants to ______ with the new fire safety regulations by June.
why: 錯誤：adhere 要搭配 to（adhere to），不是 with。
正解：comply 要搭配 with，表示「遵守」規定。
錯誤：abide 要搭配 by（abide by），不是 with。
錯誤：adapt 要搭配 to（adapt to），表示「適應」，語意也不符遵守規定。

questions.q: ______ the security deposit in full is required before tenants receive their keys.
why: 錯誤：Payment 是名詞，後面不能直接接受詞 the security deposit。
錯誤：Paid 是過去分詞，不能當句子的主詞。
錯誤：Pay 是原形動詞，不能直接當主詞。
正解：Paying 是動名詞，可當主詞並接受詞 the security deposit。

extra_vocab.en: to make a company or an office smaller, often by using less space or fewer workers
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡指設計公司打算從目前的辦公室搬到較小的空間，也就是縮減辦公規模，不是單純的裁員。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: downsize 可當不及物動詞（plans to downsize），也可當及物動詞（downsize the office / the staff）。

example.en: The firm downsizes its office space whenever more staff work from home.
example.zh: 每當更多員工在家工作，這家公司就會縮減辦公空間。

example.en: Our company downsized its warehouse last year to cut rental costs.
example.zh: 我們公司去年縮減了倉庫規模，以降低租金成本。

example.en: Downsizing the sales team was a difficult decision for management.
example.zh: 縮編業務團隊對管理階層來說是個艱難的決定。

example.en: We decided to downsize the office after the lease expired.
example.zh: 租約到期後，我們決定縮減辦公室的規模。

example.en: Several tenants plan to downsize because fewer employees come to the office.
example.zh: 有幾位房客打算縮減規模，因為進辦公室的員工變少了。

example.en: The manufacturer had to downsize its workforce when orders dropped sharply.
example.zh: 訂單大幅下滑時，這家製造商不得不精簡人力。

examples.en: We asked the landlord for a smaller suite because we need to downsize.
examples.zh: 我們因為需要縮減規模，所以請房東提供較小的辦公室。

examples.en: The company may downsize if sales do not recover next quarter.
examples.zh: 如果下一季業績沒有回升，公司可能會縮編。

examples.en: Management agreed to downsize the regional branch rather than close it.
examples.zh: 管理階層同意縮減區域分公司的規模，而不是關閉它。

confusable.diff: downgrade 是降低等級或品質，downsize 是縮小規模或人數。

example.en: The airline downgraded our tickets from business class to economy.
example.zh: 航空公司把我們的機票從商務艙降為經濟艙。

similar.diff: 較口語，常接 on + 項目（cut back on staff），不限於縮小空間。

example.en: We had to cut back on staff after sales fell last year.
example.zh: 去年業績下滑後，我們不得不縮減人力。

similar.diff: 強調把整體規模調小，語氣中性，常用於計畫、營運或產量。

example.en: The retailer plans to scale down its operations in two regions.
example.zh: 這家零售商計畫縮減在兩個地區的營運規模。

example.en: The new policy should reduce travel costs by about ten percent.
example.zh: 新政策應該能把差旅費用降低約百分之十。

example.en: The firm will relocate to a smaller office near the station.
example.zh: 這家公司將搬到車站附近較小的辦公室。

example.en: The company plans to expand its team once the contract is signed.
example.zh: 簽約後，公司打算擴編團隊。

senses.en: to move to a smaller place or make something smaller

example.en: Many firms downsize their offices because remote work is now common.
example.zh: 許多公司因為遠端工作變普遍而縮減辦公室規模。

senses.en: to reduce the number of workers in a company
senses.distinguish: 看受詞：space、office 指縮小規模；staff、workforce 指精簡人力。

example.en: The plant will downsize its staff by fifty workers this spring.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年春天將精簡五十名員工。

extra_vocab.en: money taken directly from a bank account
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，automatic debit 指每月租金會自動從房客的銀行帳戶扣款，不必另外匯款。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示付款方式時用 by + 無冠詞名詞，如 by automatic debit、by debit card，不加 a 或 the。

example.en: Please check your statement for any debits you do not recognize.
example.zh: 請檢查對帳單上是否有你不認得的扣款。

example.en: The bank debited the monthly fee from our company account on Friday.
example.zh: 銀行在週五從我們公司帳戶扣除了月費。

example.en: The supplier apologized for debiting the account twice by mistake.
example.zh: 供應商為誤將帳戶重複扣款而道歉。

example.en: Many tenants prefer automatic debit because it prevents late payments.
example.zh: 許多房客偏好自動扣款，因為這樣不會遲繳。

example.en: You can pay the registration fee with a debit card or cash.
example.zh: 你可以用簽帳金融卡或現金支付報名費。

example.en: Utility bills are paid by direct debit every month.
example.zh: 水電費每個月都是用直接扣款的方式繳納。

examples.en: The landlord set up a monthly debit so rent is never late.
examples.zh: 房東設定了每月扣款，所以租金絕不會遲繳。

examples.en: The statement shows a debit of 120 dollars for office supplies.
examples.zh: 對帳單顯示有一筆 120 美元的辦公用品扣款。

examples.en: Each debit must match a receipt before the accountant approves it.
examples.zh: 每一筆扣款都必須與收據相符，會計才會核准。

confusable.diff: debit 是從帳戶扣錢，credit 是把錢記入帳戶（入帳）。

example.en: The refund appeared as a credit on our account yesterday.
example.zh: 退款昨天以入帳的形式出現在我們的帳戶中。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 debt 是「欠的債」，字中的 b 不發音（/det/）；debit 是帳戶扣款。

example.en: The company paid off its debt ahead of schedule this year.
example.zh: 公司今年提前還清了債務。

similar.diff: deduction 泛指從薪水、稅額等金額中扣除；debit 專指從銀行帳戶扣款。

example.en: A small deduction was made from each paycheck for insurance.
example.zh: 每張薪資單都被扣除了一小筆保險費。

example.en: Daily cash withdrawals are limited to five hundred dollars per account.
example.zh: 每個帳戶每日提領現金上限為五百美元。

example.en: Your bank statement is mailed to the office on the fifth.
example.zh: 你的銀行對帳單會在五號寄到辦公室。

example.en: Please check the balance before approving the monthly payment.
example.zh: 請在核准每月付款前先確認餘額。

example.en: The statement lists every debit made during the month.
example.zh: 對帳單列出了這個月的每一筆扣款。

example.en: The company will debit your account on the fifteenth.
example.zh: 公司會在十五日從你的帳戶扣款。

extra_vocab.en: something that may cause danger or harm
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，fire hazard 指前一位房客留下的箱子堆在儲藏室，可能引發火災的隱患，所以房東會先清空。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hazard 是可數名詞，常用 a hazard / hazards；「對…有危害」用 a hazard to + 對象。

example.en: Workers must report all safety hazards to the supervisor immediately.
example.zh: 員工必須立即向主管回報所有安全隱患。

example.en: Blocking the exit with boxes creates a serious fire hazard.
example.zh: 用箱子堵住出口會造成嚴重的火災隱患。

example.en: The broken stairs are a safety hazard for all visitors.
example.zh: 損壞的樓梯對所有訪客都是安全隱患。

example.en: Dust in the warehouse can become a health hazard for staff.
example.zh: 倉庫裡的灰塵可能成為員工的健康危害。

example.en: Loose cables pose a hazard to anyone walking through the hallway.
example.zh: 散亂的電線對走過走廊的人構成危險。

examples.en: The inspector found a hazard near the loading dock and reported it.
examples.zh: 檢查員在裝卸區附近發現一處隱患並加以通報。

examples.en: Please report any hazard in the building to the facilities office.
examples.zh: 請將大樓內的任何隱患回報給設施管理室。

examples.en: Staff must wear helmets to avoid injury from falling objects and other hazards.
examples.zh: 員工必須戴安全帽，以避免被掉落物與其他危險因素傷害。

confusable.diff: hazard 是造成危險的「來源」（物品或狀況）；risk 是危險發生的「可能性」。

example.en: Without regular checks, the risk of equipment failure increases.
example.zh: 若沒有定期檢查，設備故障的風險就會提高。

similar.diff: danger 較口語、泛指危險狀態；hazard 常指檢查或規定中具體的隱患。

example.en: The old wiring is a danger to everyone in the building.
example.zh: 老舊的電線對大樓裡的每個人都是危險。

example.en: The annual fire inspection will take place on Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 年度消防檢查將在週二早上進行。

example.en: New safety regulations require all exits to be kept clear.
example.zh: 新的安全規定要求所有出口都必須保持暢通。

example.en: As a precaution, the lobby was closed during the repairs.
example.zh: 基於預防，大廳在維修期間關閉。

derived.link: hazard + -ous，變成形容詞「有危險的」，像 dangerous、famous、various

extra_vocab.en: a written agreement to rent a building or space for a set time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，prepare the lease 指準備租賃合約；屋主在簽約前，要先收到現任房東寫的推薦信。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: lease 當動詞時雙向都可用：lease A from B 是向 B 承租，lease A to B 是把 A 租給 B，要看介系詞判斷。

example.en: All office leases in this building end on the same date in June.
example.zh: 這棟大樓所有的辦公室租約都在六月的同一天到期。

example.en: She leases a small studio near the station for her design work.
example.zh: 她在車站附近租了一間小工作室做設計工作。

example.en: We leased the equipment instead of buying it to save cash.
example.zh: 我們選擇租設備而不是買，以節省現金。

example.en: Leasing a larger office would increase our monthly costs significantly.
example.zh: 承租較大的辦公室會大幅增加我們的每月成本。

example.en: Please sign a lease before we hand over the keys.
example.zh: 請先簽租約，我們才會交出鑰匙。

example.en: Tenants may renew a lease up to sixty days before it ends.
example.zh: 房客最早可在租約結束前六十天辦理續約。

example.en: You may terminate a lease only with thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 你必須以三十天的書面通知才能終止租約。

example.en: The lease agreement states that rent increases once a year.
example.zh: 租賃合約註明租金每年調漲一次。

examples.en: The lease for Suite 210 begins on the first of next month.
examples.zh: 210 號辦公室的租約從下個月一號開始。

examples.en: Our firm leases its copiers from a local supplier.
examples.zh: 我們公司向一家本地供應商租用影印機。

examples.en: The owner leases the ground floor to a small coffee shop.
examples.zh: 屋主把一樓出租給一家小咖啡店。

examples.en: Legal will review the lease before we make a final decision.
examples.zh: 在我們做出最後決定前，法務部會先審閱租約。

confusable.diff: lease 是正式、通常較長期且有書面合約的租約；rent 泛指租用，也指「租金」本身。

example.en: The lease runs for three years, and the rent is due monthly.
example.zh: 租約為期三年，租金每月繳納。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，且 leased 與 least 同音（/liːst/）；least 是「最少」。
confusable.usage: lease 是名詞或動詞；least 是形容詞或副詞，常見用法是 at least（至少）。

example.en: Please send at least three references with your application.
example.zh: 請隨申請資料附上至少三位推薦人。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，rental agreement 較口語，常用於住宅或短期租賃；lease 較正式、長期。

example.en: The rental agreement for the apartment lasts twelve months.
example.zh: 這間公寓的租賃合約為期十二個月。

example.en: The tenant must give notice thirty days before leaving.
example.zh: 房客必須在搬離前三十天提出通知。

example.en: The landlord agreed to repair the heating system this week.
example.zh: 房東同意本週修理暖氣系統。

example.en: A security deposit is returned after the final inspection.
example.zh: 押金會在最後檢查後退還。

example.en: The lease renewal notice arrives sixty days before the end date.
example.zh: 續約通知會在結束日前六十天寄達。

example.en: The lease must be signed by both parties before move-in.
example.zh: 租約必須在入住前由雙方簽署。
