example.en: We plan to lease a larger warehouse near the port.
example.zh: 我們打算在港口附近租一間較大的倉庫。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：港口街區再造與舊倉庫社區中心提案簡報

level.why: 以分詞構句、非限定關係子句、被動與未完成案件的因果說明組成較長的口語句，並附議員提問與回覆；需整合歷史背景、時程、就業人數、預算比例計算與議會下一步等多項資訊，且 halted、underway、assurance 等字彙較抽象，干擾項（如 5.4 與 3.6 million dollars）更接近正解。

items.passage:
Ms. Torres: Good evening, council members. Today I would like to present our proposal for revitalizing the Harbor Street district.

Let me begin with the background. Traditionally, Harbor Street has been the center of our city's fishing trade, but over the past decade many shops have closed, and the area has lost much of its foot traffic. Work on the old warehouse conversion was halted two years ago because of funding problems, and that unfinished building has been a source of frustration for residents.

Now, about the plan. With your approval, we will convert the warehouse into a community center that includes a market hall, a small theater, and an archive of local photographs. Construction should be underway by March and take eighteen months. The project will employ about one hundred and twenty local workers, and forty permanent jobs will be created once the center opens.

Next, let me turn to cost. The total budget is 9 million dollars, and 60 percent will come from a state grant. We believe the city's share is a worthwhile investment, because similar projects in neighboring cities have raised nearby property values by about twelve percent. A survey of residents last spring was also encouraging, and we were impressed that more than eighty percent of respondents supported the plan.

Based on these findings, we recommend that the council approve the proposal at next month's meeting. That concludes my presentation, and I would be glad to take your questions.

Mr. Reed: The plan sounds promising, but I worry about another delay. What assurance can you give us that work will not be halted again?

Ms. Torres: That is an important point. The state grant has already been approved, and the contract allows the city to replace the contractor if progress falls behind.
items.zh:
托瑞斯女士：各位議員晚安。今天我想向各位提出港口街區的再造提案。

讓我先從背景說起。港口街一向是本市漁業貿易的中心，但過去十年間，許多商店歇業，這個地區也失去了大部分人潮。舊倉庫改建工程在兩年前因資金問題而暫停，那棟未完工的建築也一直讓居民感到沮喪。

接著談談計畫內容。在各位核准後，我們將把倉庫改建成社區中心，內有市集大廳、一間小型劇院，以及一座在地照片檔案館。工程預計在三月前動工，並需要十八個月完成。這個專案將聘用約一百二十位當地工人，中心開幕後也會創造四十個長期職缺。

接下來，讓我談談成本。總預算為 900 萬美元，其中 60% 將來自州政府補助。我們相信市府負擔的部分是值得的投資，因為鄰近城市的類似計畫已使附近房價上漲約百分之十二。去年春天對居民所做的調查結果也令人鼓舞，超過百分之八十的受訪者支持這項計畫，讓我們印象深刻。

根據這些調查結果，我們建議議會在下個月的會議中核准這項提案。我的報告到此結束，我很樂意回答各位的問題。

里德先生：這項計畫聽起來很有前景，但我擔心又會再次延宕。您能提供什麼保證，讓我們相信工程不會再被叫停？

托瑞斯女士：您提出了重要的一點。州政府的補助已經核准，而且合約規定，如果進度落後，市府可以更換承包商。

questions.q: What happened to the warehouse project two years ago?
opts: It was completed ahead of schedule
It was stopped because of funding problems
It was canceled by local residents
It was moved to another district
why: 錯誤：說話者說那是一棟未完工的建築，不是已完工。
正解：舊倉庫改建工程在兩年前因資金問題而暫停。
錯誤：文中說居民對未完工的建築感到沮喪，並沒有說是居民取消的。
錯誤：文中沒有提到計畫被移到其他街區。

questions.q: How much will the city contribute to the project?
why: 正解：總預算 900 萬美元中，60% 來自州政府補助，所以市府負擔其餘 40%，也就是 360 萬美元。
錯誤：540 萬美元是州政府補助的金額（60%），不是市府負擔。
錯誤：900 萬美元是整體預算，不是市府的出資。
錯誤：文中沒有出現這個金額，百分之十二是房價漲幅。

questions.q: What is Mr. Reed's main concern?
opts: The survey results may be inaccurate
The project may create too few jobs
The work could be delayed again
why: 錯誤：里德先生沒有質疑調查結果的準確性。
錯誤：職缺數量不是他擔心的事，文中說明會創造四十個長期職缺。
正解：他說擔心又會再次延宕，並詢問工程不會再被叫停的保證。
錯誤：房價預期會上漲，里德先生沒有提到房價下跌。

questions.q: What does Ms. Torres ask the council to do next month?
why: 錯誤：文中沒有邀請議員參觀舊倉庫。
錯誤：更換承包商只是合約中的備案，不是她要求議會做的事。
錯誤：調查是已經完成的資料，她沒有要求議會重新檢視。
正解：她建議議會在下個月的會議中核准這項提案。

questions.q: The new community center, ______ will include a library and a market hall, is scheduled to open in two years.
why: 錯誤：whose 後面要接名詞，表示「…的」，這裡後面是動詞 will include。
錯誤：what 不能引導補充說明先行詞的非限定關係子句。
正解：非限定關係子句用 which 補充說明 center，並在子句中當主詞。
錯誤：where 用於地點關係，後面需要完整子句，這裡缺少主詞。

questions.q: The proposal received ______ support from local business owners, who expect more customers.
why: 錯誤：overwhelmed 表示人「不堪負荷」，不能修飾 support。
正解：overwhelming 是形容詞，意思是「壓倒性的」，放在名詞 support 前面修飾。
錯誤：overwhelmingly 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞。
錯誤：overwhelm 是動詞原形，不能放在名詞前面。

questions.q: ______ the proposal is approved, the city will be able to begin the project as early as March.
why: 正解：Provided that 意思是「只要」，引導條件子句，符合語意。
錯誤：If only 表示「但願」，用於願望，不能引導條件。
錯誤：Even though 表示「雖然」，語意是讓步，不合邏輯。
錯誤：Whereas 表示對比，不是條件。

questions.q: By the time the new station opens, the old terminal ______ for more than a year.
why: 錯誤：has been closed 是現在完成式，無法搭配未來的 By the time … opens。
錯誤：is closed 是現在簡單式，沒有表示「已持續一年以上」。
錯誤：had been closed 是過去完成式，用於過去時間，與未來開幕不符。
正解：By the time + 現在式，主要子句用未來完成式 will have been closed，表示到那時已關閉超過一年。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Today I would like to present ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 今天我想提出…
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報開場，說明這次要提出的提案主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me begin with the background.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我先從背景說起。
presentation_phrases.usage: 進入第一個主要段落，交代現況或問題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Now, about the plan.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接著談計畫內容。
presentation_phrases.usage: 從背景轉換到計畫，提示聽眾重點改變。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, let me turn to cost.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接下來，讓我談談成本。
presentation_phrases.usage: 轉到下一個要點，引出預算與費用說明。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Based on these findings, we recommend that ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 根據這些調查結果，我們建議…
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明調查或數據之後，提出具體建議。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes my presentation.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我的報告到此結束。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報結尾，表示正式報告已完成。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I would be glad to take your questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我很樂意回答各位的問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 邀請聽眾提問，進入問答時間。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That is an important point.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 您提出了重要的一點。
presentation_phrases.usage: 回答提問前的緩衝語，表示認同對方的疑慮。

extra_vocab.en: a promise that makes someone feel sure that something will happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 Mr. Reed 問 What assurance can you give us，意思是「你能給我們什麼保證」，希望對方提出具體的擔保，讓議員放心工程不會再停擺。語氣禮貌但帶有質疑。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: assurance 表示「保證」時是可數名詞（an assurance、assurances），後面接 that 子句或 of；表示「自信」時是不可數名詞。

example.en: The supplier gave us several assurances about the delivery schedule.
example.zh: 供應商就交貨時程向我們做了好幾項保證。

example.en: Can you give an assurance that the costs will not rise?
example.zh: 你能保證成本不會上漲嗎？

example.en: The client asked for written assurance before signing the contract.
example.zh: 客戶在簽約前要求書面保證。

example.en: Investors sought assurance that the project would stay on budget.
example.zh: 投資人尋求專案不會超出預算的保證。

example.en: The quality assurance team tests every product before it ships.
example.zh: 品質保證團隊在每項產品出貨前都會測試。

examples.en: The manager offered his assurance that the report would be ready.
examples.zh: 經理保證報告會準備好。

examples.en: We need your assurance that the repairs will finish by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們需要你保證維修會在星期五前完成。

examples.en: Without clear assurance from the bank, the board refused to proceed.
examples.zh: 沒有銀行明確的保證，董事會拒絕繼續進行。

confusable.diff: insurance 是「保險」，assurance 是「口頭或書面的保證」，兩字拼法和發音很像。

example.en: The company bought insurance to cover damage during shipping.
example.zh: 公司購買保險以涵蓋運送途中的損壞。

similar.diff: guarantee 更正式，常有合約或保固的約束力；assurance 是讓對方放心的說法。

example.en: The contract includes a guarantee that work will finish on time.
example.zh: 合約中包含工程會準時完成的保證。

similar.diff: commitment 強調「承諾去做」，assurance 強調「讓對方確信」。

example.en: The mayor made a strong commitment to complete the project.
example.zh: 市長強力承諾會完成這項計畫。

example.en: Strong sales results gave investors more confidence in the firm.
example.zh: 強勁的銷售成績讓投資人對公司更有信心。

example.en: We cannot say with certainty when the work will finish.
example.zh: 我們無法確定工程何時會完成。

example.en: The company made a pledge to reduce its waste.
example.zh: 公司承諾要減少廢棄物。

derived.link: assurance 的詞幹，assure 是「保證」；去掉 -ance 就是動詞，像 insure → insurance
re-（再次）+ assure，再保證一次，像 rebuild、restart
reassure + -ance，變成名詞，像 assure → assurance

senses.en: a promise that something will happen or is true
senses.distinguish: 常和 give、seek 一起用，後面接 that 子句。

example.en: The contractor gave us his assurance that the roof was safe.
example.zh: 承包商向我們保證屋頂是安全的。

senses.en: a feeling of being sure about yourself
senses.distinguish: 不可數，常用 with assurance 或 self-assurance 表示態度。

example.en: She spoke with assurance during the investor presentation.
example.zh: 她在投資人簡報中說話很有自信。

extra_vocab.en: in the way that has been done for a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在句首，先說明街區「一向」的角色，後面再用 but 帶出近十年的改變，形成今昔對比。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 句首的 traditionally 後面要加逗號，修飾整個句子，常和現在完成式（has been）連用，再用 but 帶出對比。

example.en: Wool is traditionally used for winter uniforms in this region.
example.zh: 在這個地區，羊毛傳統上用來製作冬季制服。

example.en: The district is traditionally known as the city's financial center.
example.zh: 這個街區向來被稱為本市的金融中心。

example.en: The annual fair is traditionally held in the first week of May.
example.zh: 年度市集傳統上在五月第一週舉行。

examples.en: Traditionally, our company has sold its products through local retail stores.
examples.zh: 傳統上，我們公司一向透過當地零售店銷售產品。

examples.en: Traditionally, customers paid in cash, but most now use mobile payments.
examples.zh: 傳統上顧客以現金付款，但現在大多使用行動支付。

examples.en: Traditionally, the sales department has handled all client complaints.
examples.zh: 傳統上，所有客戶投訴都由業務部門處理。

confusable.diff: traditional 是形容詞，修飾名詞；traditionally 是副詞，修飾動詞或整個句子。
confusable.usage: traditional 放在名詞前（a traditional market）；traditionally 修飾動詞或整句（Traditionally, …）。

example.en: The traditional market in the old district still attracts many visitors.
example.zh: 舊城區的傳統市場仍然吸引許多遊客。

similar.diff: historically 強調歷史事實與時間脈絡；traditionally 強調長期形成的慣例與做法。

example.en: Historically, the port has been the region's main source of jobs.
example.zh: 歷史上，這座港口一直是該地區主要的就業來源。

example.en: It is customary to exchange business cards at the start of a meeting.
example.zh: 會議一開始交換名片是慣例。

example.en: The firm uses conventional advertising rather than social media campaigns.
example.zh: 這家公司使用傳統廣告，而不是社群媒體活動。

example.en: The building was formerly used as a warehouse for textiles.
example.zh: 這棟建築以前被當作紡織品倉庫使用。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，像 addition、condition 這類 -tion 名詞
tradition + -al，變成形容詞，像 national、additional

extra_vocab.en: a place or collection where old records or documents are kept
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，an archive of local photographs 指社區中心內保存在地老照片的檔案館，呼應街區的歷史。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「…的檔案庫」常用 an archive of + 所收藏的資料，例如 an archive of photographs。

example.en: The city archives are open to the public on weekdays.
example.zh: 市立檔案館平日開放給大眾。

example.en: The system automatically archives emails older than two years.
example.zh: 系統會自動把超過兩年的電子郵件存檔。

example.en: All signed contracts were archived at the end of the year.
example.zh: 所有已簽署的合約都在年底存檔了。

example.en: Archiving old files frees up space on the company server.
example.zh: 把舊檔案存檔可以釋出公司伺服器的空間。

example.en: The public archive keeps maps and records from the last century.
example.zh: 公共檔案館保存著上個世紀的地圖與紀錄。

example.en: A digital archive makes old reports easy to search.
example.zh: 數位檔案庫讓舊報告很容易搜尋。

example.en: Please archive old files before the server upgrade on Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五伺服器升級前，把舊檔案存檔。

examples.en: The museum's archive contains thousands of photographs from the early twentieth century.
examples.zh: 博物館的檔案庫收藏了數千張二十世紀初的照片。

examples.en: Please archive the signed contracts before the audit begins next week.
examples.zh: 請在下週稽核開始前，把已簽署的合約存檔。

examples.en: Emails older than two years will be moved to the archive automatically.
examples.zh: 超過兩年的電子郵件會自動移到存檔區。

examples.en: Researchers visited the city archive to study old maps of the harbor.
examples.zh: 研究人員前往市立檔案館研究港口的舊地圖。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 achieve 是「達成目標」，archive 是「存放舊資料」或「檔案館」。

example.en: We hope to achieve our sales target by the end of June.
example.zh: 我們希望在六月底前達成銷售目標。

similar.diff: records 泛指各種記錄資料；archive 強調長期保存舊資料的地方或系統。

example.en: Employee records must be kept for seven years under company policy.
example.zh: 依公司政策，員工記錄必須保存七年。

example.en: Please scan each document before sending it to the archive.
example.zh: 請在把每份文件送到檔案庫前先掃描。

example.en: The company keeps a record of every customer order.
example.zh: 公司保存了每一筆客戶訂單的紀錄。

example.en: The library has a large collection of local newspapers.
example.zh: 圖書館有大量的本地報紙館藏。

example.en: The company archive stores every annual report since the year 1990.
example.zh: 公司檔案庫保存了 1990 年以來的每一份年度報告。

example.en: Staff should archive project files once the work is complete.
example.zh: 工作完成後，員工應該將專案檔案存檔。

extra_vocab.en: already started and still happening
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，be underway by March 表示「到三月時工程應該已經開始動工、正在進行」，by + 時間強調最晚的開工時點。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: underway 多放在 be 動詞後面當補語（is underway），通常不放在名詞前；也可寫成 under way。

example.en: The annual sales conference will get underway at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 年度業務會議將在九點開始。

example.en: Renovation work on the lobby is already underway.
example.zh: 大廳的整修工程已經在進行中。

collocations.zh: 進展順利、已進行一段時間

example.en: Preparations for the trade fair are well underway this month.
example.zh: 貿易展的籌備工作這個月已進行得相當順利。

examples.en: The software upgrade is underway, so some systems may be slow.
examples.zh: 軟體升級正在進行中，所以部分系統可能會變慢。

examples.en: The conference is scheduled to be underway by nine in the morning.
examples.zh: 會議預定在早上九點前開始進行。

examples.en: Road repairs are underway near the station, so expect delays this week.
examples.zh: 車站附近正在進行道路修繕，所以本週預期會有延誤。

similar.diff: ongoing 可放在名詞前（an ongoing project），underway 通常放在 be 之後。

example.en: We have several ongoing projects in the Asia-Pacific region.
example.zh: 我們在亞太地區有好幾個進行中的專案。

similar.diff: in progress 較通用，也能放在名詞後面（work in progress）。

example.en: The inspection is in progress, so please wait outside.
example.zh: 檢查正在進行中，請在外面等候。

example.en: The firm will launch the new service next quarter.
example.zh: 公司將在下一季推出新服務。

example.en: Construction will commence once the permit is approved.
example.zh: 許可證核准後，工程就會開始。

example.en: Work will be completed before the end of September.
example.zh: 工作將在九月底前完成。

example.en: The audit is underway, and the final report is due soon.
example.zh: 稽核正在進行中，最終報告很快就要提出。

example.en: The new training program got underway last Monday morning.
example.zh: 新的培訓計畫上週一早上開始進行。

extra_vocab.en: good enough to be worth the time, money, or effort
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，worthwhile investment 說明市府出資是值得的，理由是鄰近城市類似計畫使房價上漲約百分之十二。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: worth 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing（worth visiting），不接 to V；worthwhile 則可用 it is worthwhile to + V。

example.en: Training the new staff was a worthwhile investment for the team.
example.zh: 培訓新進人員對團隊來說是值得的投資。

example.en: The extra hour of planning proved well worthwhile in the end.
example.zh: 事後證明，多花一小時規劃非常值得。

example.en: We hope the new system will prove worthwhile within a year.
example.zh: 我們希望新系統在一年內就能證明是值得的。

examples.en: Management felt the new training program was worthwhile for all employees.
examples.zh: 管理階層認為新的培訓計畫對所有員工都是值得的。

examples.en: It is worthwhile to book early because flight prices rise quickly.
examples.zh: 提早訂位是值得的，因為機票價格漲得很快。

examples.en: The workshop was long, but many participants found it worthwhile.
examples.zh: 工作坊雖然很長，但許多參加者覺得很值得。

examples.en: Upgrading the equipment is worthwhile only if it reduces repair costs.
examples.zh: 只有在能降低維修成本時，升級設備才是值得的。

confusable.diff: worth 是介系詞或形容詞，不能直接放在名詞前修飾；worthwhile 可以修飾名詞。
confusable.usage: worth 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing（worth reading），不說 a worth investment；要說 a worthwhile investment。

example.en: This report is worth reading before the meeting starts on Monday.
example.zh: 這份報告在週一開會前值得先讀。

confusable.diff: worthy 較正式，常用 worthy of，表示「配得上、值得被…」。

example.en: Her proposal is worthy of serious consideration by the board.
example.zh: 她的提案值得董事會認真考慮。

similar.diff: valuable 強調事物本身有價值；worthwhile 強調花時間、金錢或努力是否值得。

example.en: The survey gave us valuable information about local customers.
example.zh: 這份調查給了我們關於本地顧客的寶貴資訊。

similar.diff: rewarding 常指帶來滿足感或收穫，帶有情感色彩。

example.en: Training new employees is a rewarding part of my job.
example.zh: 培訓新進員工是我工作中很有成就感的一部分。

example.en: Flexible hours are one benefit of working for this company.
example.zh: 彈性工時是在這家公司工作的好處之一。

example.en: The company's investment in new software paid off within a year.
example.zh: 公司在新軟體上的投資在一年內就回本了。

example.en: Our location gives us a clear advantage over competitors.
example.zh: 我們的地點讓我們比競爭對手有明顯優勢。

derived.link: worthwhile = worth + while（一段時間），意思是「值得花時間」
worth + -less，沒有價值，像 useless、careless
worth + -y，變成形容詞，常用 worthy of

items.tag: 面試時程調整與應徵者推薦語音留言

level.why: 以 because、as、since 等連接詞組成長句，搭配被動語態與分詞修飾（praised as…、verified by…），並出現 prospective、contrary to 等較抽象的字彙；需整合時程變更、候選人推薦與文件要求三項資訊，干擾項多取自文中出現過的細節，比上週同日略難。

items.passage: Hello Alan, this is Diane Cho from Human Resources, returning your call about tomorrow's interviews. Because the road work downtown has caused heavy congestion, the prospective employees may arrive late, so I have moved the first session to ten thirty. As you requested, every candidate invited is someone who specializes in logistics software. One of them, praised as a diligent worker in a reference letter from her former supervisor, appealed to me especially, and I suggest that you meet her first. Contrary to my earlier email, applicants do not need to bring their diplomas, since the originals have already been verified by our office. Please call me back before five today if you would like any changes to the schedule or the interview rooms.
items.zh: 艾倫您好，我是人力資源部的黛安・周，回覆您關於明天面試的來電。由於市中心的道路施工造成嚴重壅塞，前來應徵的人選可能會遲到，所以我已把第一場面談改到十點半。依照您的要求，所有受邀的應徵者都是專精於物流軟體的人。其中一位曾在前主管寫的推薦信中被稱讚為勤勉的員工，特別吸引我的注意，我建議您先與她面談。與我先前的電子郵件所說相反，應徵者不需要攜帶畢業證書，因為我們辦公室已經核實過正本。如果您想更動時程或面談會議室的任何安排，請在今天五點前回電給我。

vocab.zh: 未來的、有望成為的、潛在的

vocab.col: high school diploma / earn a diploma

questions.q: Why has the first interview session been moved?
opts: A candidate asked for a later time.
Heavy traffic may cause people to arrive late.
Alan is unavailable earlier in the morning.
The applicants' documents are still being verified.
why: 錯誤：文中沒有提到任何應徵者要求延後時間。
正解：因為市中心道路施工造成壅塞，應徵者可能遲到，所以把第一場改到十點半。
錯誤：改時間的原因與艾倫的行程無關，文中沒有這樣說。
錯誤：文件已經核實完畢，而且那是免帶畢業證書的理由，不是改時間的原因。

questions.q: What has changed since Diane's earlier email?
opts: The interviews will take place in a different office.
Candidates must now submit a reference letter.
One of the interviews has been canceled.
Applicants no longer have to bring their diplomas.
why: 錯誤：文中只調整了第一場的時間，沒有提到更換辦公室。
錯誤：推薦信是某位應徵者的既有資料，並不是新增給所有人的要求。
錯誤：文中沒有任何一場面談被取消。
正解：與先前郵件相反，因為辦公室已核實正本，應徵者不必再攜帶畢業證書。

questions.q: What does Diane suggest that Alan do?
opts: Meet a particular applicant before the others
Postpone all interviews until traffic improves
Ask the applicants to bring their diplomas
Contact the supervisor who wrote the letter
why: 正解：黛安建議艾倫先與那位被推薦信稱讚勤勉、也特別吸引她的應徵者面談。
錯誤：她只是把第一場改到十點半，並沒有建議全部延期。
錯誤：她說應徵者不需要帶畢業證書，與此建議相反。
錯誤：推薦信是文中提到的資料，但黛安並沒有要求艾倫聯絡該主管。

questions.q: The receptionist asked the visitor ______ in at the front desk before entering the building.
why: 錯誤：ask 後面接「人 + to V」，不能直接用原形動詞。
錯誤：動名詞 signing 不能放在 ask somebody 之後表示請求。
正解：ask + 受詞 + to V 表示「請某人做某事」，故用 to sign。
錯誤：過去分詞 signed 有被動意味，與「訪客自己簽到」的語意不符。

questions.q: ______ the late notice, nearly all of the staff attended the briefing on Monday.
why: 正解：Despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞片語 the late notice，表示「儘管」。
錯誤：Although 是連接詞，後面必須接完整子句，不能直接接名詞片語。
錯誤：Unless 表示「除非」，語意不通，且後面也要接子句。
錯誤：Whereas 表示「然而（對比）」，需接子句，語意也不符。

questions.q: Please submit a ______ explanation of the delay to the project manager by Monday.
why: 錯誤：detail 是名詞或動詞，不能直接放在 a 與 explanation 之間修飾名詞。
正解：空格需要形容詞修飾 explanation，detailed 意為「詳細的」。
錯誤：detailing 是現在分詞，語意是「正在詳述」，不適合修飾這個名詞。
錯誤：detailedly 不是常用的副詞形式，且副詞不能修飾名詞。

extra_vocab.zh: 預期的、未來可能成為…的
extra_vocab.en: likely to become something in the future
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 prospective employees 指「可能會被錄用的人」，也就是明天來面試的應徵者，不是現在已在公司上班的員工。prospective 放在名詞前面，表示這個人或事物「將來有可能成為」該身分。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prospective 只放在名詞前面修飾（a prospective client），不能說 The client is prospective。

collocations.zh: 準員工、可能被錄用的人

example.en: We pay travel costs for prospective employees who live far away.
example.zh: 我們替住得遠的準員工支付交通費。

example.en: Her job is to follow up with every prospective client weekly.
example.zh: 她的工作是每週追蹤每一位潛在客戶。

example.en: The agent showed the prospective buyer around the building yesterday.
example.zh: 仲介昨天帶可能的買家參觀了這棟大樓。

examples.en: Please send the schedule to all prospective employees by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前把時程表寄給所有可能被錄用的人。

examples.en: Our sales team is meeting prospective customers in Osaka next week.
examples.zh: 我們的業務團隊下週要在大阪拜訪潛在顧客。

examples.en: The prospective merger will be announced after the board meeting.
examples.zh: 預定中的合併案將在董事會後公布。

confusable.diff: perspective 是名詞「觀點、看法」，prospective 是形容詞「預期的、潛在的」，拼法很像但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: perspective 是名詞（from a different perspective）；prospective 是形容詞，放在名詞前。

example.en: Her perspective on the problem helped the team find a solution.
example.zh: 她對這個問題的看法幫助團隊找到了解決辦法。

similar.diff: potential 也是「潛在的」，更常用在客戶、風險、問題；prospective 較強調「預期將成為」某個身分。

example.en: We identified several potential customers during the trade show.
example.zh: 我們在展覽中找到了幾位潛在客戶。

similar.diff: future 只是「未來的」，不一定表示可能性；prospective 帶有「很可能會成為」的意思。

example.en: Please send this notice to all future tenants of the building.
example.zh: 請把這份通知寄給大樓所有未來的房客。

example.en: Poor weather is a potential risk for the outdoor event.
example.zh: 天氣不好是戶外活動的潛在風險。

example.en: Each applicant must complete the online form before the interview.
example.zh: 每位應徵者面試前都必須填完線上表格。

example.en: The final candidate will meet the team on Monday.
example.zh: 最後一位候選人星期一會和團隊見面。

derived.link: prospective 的詞幹，prospect 是「前景」；加 -ive 變形容詞，像 act → active

extra_vocab.en: a situation where too many people or vehicles fill a place and move slowly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 heavy congestion 指市區道路施工造成的嚴重塞車，所以應徵者可能遲到。這是描述交通狀況的常用說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: congestion 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a；要說「一次塞車」可用可數的 a traffic jam。

example.en: Traffic congestion costs local businesses millions of dollars each year.
example.zh: 交通壅塞每年讓當地企業損失數百萬美元。

example.en: A new subway line should ease congestion on the main roads.
example.zh: 新的地鐵線應該能紓解主要道路的壅塞。

example.en: Drivers entering the city center must pay a congestion charge.
example.zh: 開車進入市中心的駕駛必須繳交擁擠費。

examples.en: Heavy congestion on the highway delayed the delivery trucks this morning.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的嚴重壅塞讓貨車今早延誤。

examples.en: The city plans to reduce congestion in the downtown area.
examples.zh: 市府打算減少市中心的壅塞。

examples.en: Port congestion has slowed down shipments from Asia to Europe.
examples.zh: 港口壅塞拖慢了從亞洲到歐洲的貨運。

confusable.diff: suggestion 是「建議」，結尾和 congestion 很像（-gestion），但意思無關。

example.en: The manager welcomed every suggestion about improving the morning commute.
example.zh: 經理歡迎任何改善早晨通勤的建議。

similar.diff: traffic jam 是口語、可數的「塞車」；congestion 較正式，是不可數的整體狀況。

example.en: A traffic jam on the bridge delayed the client's arrival.
example.zh: 橋上的塞車讓客戶晚到。

similar.diff: gridlock 指車流完全動彈不得，比 congestion 更嚴重。

example.en: Gridlock around the stadium lasted for nearly two hours after the game.
example.zh: 比賽結束後，體育場周邊的車陣癱瘓了近兩個小時。

example.en: Traffic is lighter after eight o'clock in the evening.
example.zh: 晚上八點後車流比較少。

example.en: We apologize for the delay in processing your order.
example.zh: 我們為處理您的訂單延誤致歉。

example.en: A large crowd gathered outside the convention center.
example.zh: 一大群人聚集在會議中心外面。

derived.link: congestion 去掉 -ion 就是動詞，像 suggestion → suggest
congest + -ed，變成「被塞住的」，像 crowded

senses.en: a state in which a place is too full and things move slowly
senses.distinguish: 旁邊常出現 traffic、road、port 等字。

example.en: Airport congestion caused long delays for several international flights.
example.zh: 機場壅塞造成幾班國際航班嚴重延誤。

senses.en: a blocked nose or chest when you are ill
senses.distinguish: 出現在感冒、藥品、請病假的情境。

example.en: Cold medicine can relieve congestion and help you sleep better.
example.zh: 感冒藥可以緩解鼻塞，幫助你睡得更好。

extra_vocab.en: opposite to what was said or expected
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 Contrary to my earlier email 表示「和我先前信上說的相反」，是更正自己先前說法的客氣用語，後面緊接新的正確資訊。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: contrary to 後面接名詞、代名詞或 what 子句（contrary to what I said），介系詞是 to，不是 with。

example.en: The final cost was far higher, contrary to our estimate.
example.zh: 與我們的估計相反，最後的成本高出許多。

example.en: The delay did not hurt us; on the contrary, it helped.
example.zh: 這次延誤沒有傷到我們，正好相反，還有幫助。

example.en: Unless you hear anything to the contrary, the meeting starts at nine.
example.zh: 除非你聽到相反的消息，否則會議九點開始。

examples.en: Contrary to last year's rule, staff may now work from home.
examples.zh: 與去年的規定相反，員工現在可以在家工作。

examples.en: The two reports reached contrary conclusions about the new product.
examples.zh: 兩份報告對這項新產品得出相反的結論。

confusable.diff: contrast 是「對比」（in contrast to），強調兩者的差別；contrary to 是「與…相反、矛盾」。
confusable.usage: in contrast to 用來比較兩件事的不同；contrary to 用來說明和某個說法、預期完全相反。

example.en: In contrast to last year, this year's budget is much smaller.
example.zh: 和去年相比，今年的預算小很多。

similar.diff: unlike 只是「和…不同」，不一定相反；contrary to 強調和說法或預期相反。

example.en: Unlike our competitors, we offer free shipping on every order.
example.zh: 和競爭對手不同，我們每筆訂單都免運費。

example.en: The two teams took opposite sides in the discussion.
example.zh: 兩個團隊在討論中持相反的立場。

example.en: We received conflicting reports about the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們收到對交貨日期互相矛盾的報告。

example.en: Please read the instructions on the reverse side.
example.zh: 請閱讀背面的說明。

example.en: Contrary to rumors, the company has no plan to close the plant.
example.zh: 與傳言相反，公司沒有關閉工廠的計畫。

example.en: The client gave us contrary instructions in two separate emails.
example.zh: 客戶在兩封不同的信裡給了我們相反的指示。

example.en: I expected delays, but the contrary happened: everything arrived early.
example.zh: 我原本預期會延誤，結果正好相反，全都提早到了。

extra_vocab.en: an official paper that shows you finished a course of study
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 diplomas 指應徵者的畢業證書。因為學歷已由人資查核過，所以面試時不必攜帶正本。

example.en: The office keeps copies of all diplomas in a locked cabinet.
example.zh: 辦公室把所有畢業證書的影本放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

example.en: The position requires a high school diploma and two years of experience.
example.zh: 這個職位要求高中畢業證書和兩年經驗。

example.en: It took him three years to earn a diploma in nursing.
example.zh: 他花了三年才取得護理文憑。

example.en: The college offers a one-year diploma program in business.
example.zh: 這所學院開設一年期的商業文憑課程。

examples.en: Applicants must show their original diploma on the first day of work.
examples.zh: 應徵者上班第一天必須出示畢業證書正本。

examples.en: She is studying for a diploma in graphic design at night.
examples.zh: 她晚上在進修平面設計的文憑。

examples.en: Please upload a copy of your diploma to the online form.
examples.zh: 請把畢業證書的影本上傳到線上表格。

confusable.diff: diplomat 是「外交官」，字形和 diploma 很像，但指的是人。

example.en: The diplomat attended a trade meeting with several business leaders.
example.zh: 這位外交官出席了和幾位企業領袖的貿易會議。

similar.diff: degree 是大學以上的「學位」；diploma 是畢業證書，也可以是程度較低的文憑。

example.en: A bachelor's degree is required for the senior engineer position.
example.zh: 資深工程師的職位需要學士學位。

similar.diff: certificate 是修完某項課程或通過考試的「證書」，通常比 diploma 短期。

example.en: The training center gives each participant a certificate at the end.
example.zh: 訓練中心在最後會發給每位參加者一張證書。

example.en: Her main qualification is five years of experience in logistics.
example.zh: 她主要的資歷是五年的物流經驗。

example.en: Most graduates from this program find jobs within three months.
example.zh: 這個課程的多數畢業生三個月內就找到工作。

example.en: Please submit your official transcript with the application form.
example.zh: 請連同申請表一起繳交正式成績單。

senses.en: an official paper that shows you finished school or a course
senses.distinguish: 指實體的證明文件，常和 show、bring、copy 等動詞一起出現。

example.en: He hung his diploma on the wall of his new office.
example.zh: 他把畢業證書掛在新辦公室的牆上。

senses.en: a qualification you get from a course that is shorter than a degree
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 a diploma in + 領域，指課程或資格本身。

example.en: The diploma in logistics takes about one year to complete.
example.zh: 物流文憑課程大約一年可以修完。

extra_vocab.en: working carefully and with a lot of effort
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 a diligent worker 是前主管推薦信裡對應徵者的稱讚，表示她做事認真、有責任感。diligent 是推薦信和績效評語的常用字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: diligent 後面可接 in 或 about + V-ing，例如 be diligent in checking the data。

example.en: We are looking for a diligent worker for the night shift.
example.zh: 我們在找一位勤奮的員工來上夜班。

example.en: After diligent effort, the team solved the shipping problem.
example.zh: 經過勤奮的努力，團隊解決了出貨問題。

example.en: Diligent research helped us find the best supplier.
example.zh: 認真的調查幫助我們找到最好的供應商。

examples.en: Her supervisor described her as a diligent and reliable employee.
examples.zh: 她的主管形容她是認真又可靠的員工。

examples.en: He is diligent about answering every customer email within a day.
examples.zh: 他很認真，每封顧客來信都在一天內回覆。

examples.en: A diligent assistant checked every figure before the meeting started.
examples.zh: 一位認真的助理在會議開始前核對了每一個數字。

confusable.diff: intelligent 是「聰明的」，diligent 是「勤勉的」，兩字結尾相似，但一個說能力、一個說態度。

example.en: He is intelligent, but he often forgets to finish his tasks.
example.zh: 他很聰明，但常常忘記完成工作。

similar.diff: hardworking 是最通用、口語的「努力工作的」；diligent 更正式，也帶有細心的意思。

example.en: The hardworking staff stayed late to finish the quarterly report.
example.zh: 認真工作的員工留到很晚完成季報告。

similar.diff: conscientious 強調「有責任感、一絲不苟」，語氣比 diligent 更偏重細心與責任。

example.en: A conscientious clerk always double-checks the numbers before sending invoices.
example.zh: 認真負責的職員在寄出發票前總會再核對數字。

example.en: She is a reliable colleague who always meets deadlines.
example.zh: 她是個可靠的同事，總是準時交件。

example.en: Our dedicated team works around the clock during the sale.
example.zh: 促銷期間，我們盡心投入的團隊日夜工作。

example.en: An efficient process saves both time and money.
example.zh: 有效率的流程能同時節省時間和金錢。

derived.link: diligent 去掉 -t 加 -ce，變成名詞，像 patient → patience
diligent + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 careful → carefully

extra_vocab.zh: 吸引、有吸引力（appeal 的過去式）
extra_vocab.en: to be interesting or attractive to someone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 appealed to me especially 表示這位應徵者特別吸引我、讓我印象深刻。appeal to + 人 是「對某人有吸引力」，主詞是事物或人，不是主動去吸引的動作。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「吸引」的 appeal 一定要接 to + 人（appeal to me），不能直接接受詞（✗ appeal me）；要直接接受詞可用 attract。

example.en: This design appeals to younger customers around the world.
example.zh: 這個設計吸引了世界各地較年輕的顧客。

example.en: The court rejected two appeals from the former employees.
example.zh: 法院駁回了前員工的兩項上訴。

example.en: We are appealing the decision to the review committee.
example.zh: 我們正向審查委員會對這項決定提出申訴。

example.en: The company offered an appealing salary and flexible hours.
example.zh: 公司提供有吸引力的薪資和彈性的工作時間。

example.en: Low prices appeal to customers who shop online every week.
example.zh: 低價吸引每週上網購物的顧客。

example.en: The product has broad appeal across all age groups.
example.zh: 這項產品對各年齡層都有廣泛的吸引力。

example.en: Employees may file an appeal within ten days of the decision.
example.zh: 員工可以在決定後十天內提出申訴。

examples.en: The idea of a four-day week appealed to most of the staff.
examples.zh: 一週工作四天的構想吸引了大部分員工。

examples.en: Bright packaging appeals to children, but parents choose the product.
examples.zh: 亮眼的包裝吸引小孩，但選擇產品的是家長。

examples.en: Her experience in logistics appealed to the hiring manager immediately.
examples.zh: 她的物流經驗立刻吸引了招聘經理。

confusable.diff: appear 是「出現、似乎」，拼法和發音都和 appeal 很像，但意思不同。
confusable.usage: appear 是不及物動詞，不需要接 to 表示吸引；appeal 要接 to + 人 才是「吸引」。

example.en: A new error message appeared on the screen this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上螢幕上出現了新的錯誤訊息。

confusable.diff: apply 是「申請、應用」，如 apply for a job；appeal 是「吸引、上訴」。

example.en: Please apply for the position before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前申請這個職位。

similar.diff: attract 直接接受詞（attract customers）；appeal 要加 to（appeal to customers）。

example.en: The festival attracts thousands of visitors from other countries.
example.zh: 這個節慶吸引了數千名來自其他國家的訪客。

example.en: A strong brand can attract talented employees.
example.zh: 強大的品牌能吸引有才華的員工。

example.en: The new proposal did not interest the board.
example.zh: 新的提案沒有引起董事會的興趣。

example.en: The company made an attractive offer to the engineer.
example.zh: 公司向這位工程師開出了有吸引力的條件。

derived.link: un-（否定）+ appealing，像 unhappy、unclear

example.en: This job offer does not appeal to me at all.
example.zh: 這份工作邀約完全吸引不了我。

example.en: The appeal of the new phone is its long battery life.
example.zh: 這款新手機的吸引力在於電池續航力久。

senses.en: to be attractive or interesting to someone
senses.distinguish: 後面接 to + 人，主詞是事物或人，常見於行銷與招聘。

example.en: The flexible schedule appealed to many experienced applicants.
example.zh: 彈性的時程吸引了許多有經驗的應徵者。

senses.en: to ask people strongly to do something
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 to + 人 + to V，出現在公告與新聞。

example.en: The manager appealed to staff to save energy during the summer.
example.zh: 經理呼籲員工在夏季節約能源。

senses.en: to ask a higher authority to change a decision
senses.distinguish: 常接 against 或直接接 a decision，出現在法律、人事申訴。

example.en: The supplier appealed against the fine but lost the case.
example.zh: 供應商對罰款提出上訴，但敗訴了。

extra_vocab.zh: 專攻、專門從事（specialize 的第三人稱單數）
extra_vocab.en: to work mainly in one particular area or field
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 someone who specializes in logistics software 指受邀的應徵者都是專攻物流軟體的人，符合 Alan 的要求。who 後面的動詞要配合 someone，所以用 specializes。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: specialize 後面接 in（不是 on 或 at）+ 名詞或 V-ing；主詞是第三人稱單數時要加 s。

example.en: She specialized in tax law before she joined our firm.
example.zh: 她在加入我們事務所之前專攻稅法。

example.en: Specialized training is required for anyone who operates this machine.
example.zh: 任何操作這台機器的人都需要專業訓練。

example.en: We are specializing in cold storage for food products now.
example.zh: 我們現在專門從事食品的冷藏儲存。

example.en: Many small shops specialize in handmade leather goods.
example.zh: 許多小店專門販售手工皮製品。

example.en: We specialize in repairing industrial printers and copy machines.
example.zh: 我們專門維修工業用印表機和影印機。

example.en: Technicians receive specialized training before using the new equipment.
example.zh: 技術人員在使用新設備前會接受專業訓練。

examples.en: Our consulting firm specializes in helping small businesses grow online.
examples.zh: 我們的顧問公司專門協助小型企業在網路上成長。

examples.en: I specialize in customer service for the financial industry.
examples.zh: 我專攻金融業的客戶服務。

examples.en: We need an engineer who specializes in network security.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位專攻網路安全的工程師。

confusable.diff: specify 是「明確指定、說明」，拼法相近，但不是「專攻」。

example.en: Please specify the delivery date in your reply email.
example.zh: 請在回信中明確指出交貨日期。

similar.diff: focus on 是「把重心放在」，可以是暫時的；specialize in 表示長期專長。

example.en: The company will focus on logistics software next year.
example.zh: 公司明年將專注於物流軟體。

similar.diff: concentrate on 強調「集中精神或資源」，不一定是專業領域。

example.en: We plan to concentrate on markets in Southeast Asia.
example.zh: 我們打算集中在東南亞市場。

example.en: An expert in customs law will join the meeting.
example.zh: 一位海關法規專家將參加會議。

example.en: The staff gave us professional advice on shipping.
example.zh: 員工就運送問題給了我們專業的建議。

example.en: We hired an experienced manager to lead the project.
example.zh: 我們聘請了一位有經驗的經理來帶領專案。

derived.link: specialize 的詞幹，special 是「特別的」；加 -ize 變動詞，像 modern → modernize
special + -ist，做專門領域的人，像 artist、scientist
special + -ty，變成名詞，指「特別擅長的事」
specialize 去掉 -e 加 -ation，變名詞，像 organize → organization

items.tag: 颱風警報下的出差行程調整通知

level.why: 以 although、because、since、provided that 等連接詞組成多層複合句，搭配被動語態、分詞片語（followed by…）與 apprehensive、occupation 等較抽象的字彙；需整合班機、住宿、行程與保險四類資訊，干擾項多取自文中出現過的細節，比上週同日略難。

items.passage:
To: Overseas Conference Attendees
From: Helen Park, Travel Coordination
Subject: Revised Itinerary Due to Typhoon Warning

The national weather bureau has issued a typhoon warning for the Osaka region, and flights scheduled to depart on Thursday morning are expected to be canceled. Although some of you may feel apprehensive about traveling at all, the executive committee has wisely decided to postpone the departure until Friday afternoon rather than cancel the trip altogether. Hotel rooms in Osaka have been extended by one night at no cost to you, and the airline will rebook everyone automatically, provided that your passport details are already on file.

Because the storm is predicted to weaken by Friday, the factory tour will be held on Saturday instead, followed by the opening dinner. Since all employees on the payroll are covered by the company's travel insurance, no additional paperwork is required. However, when completing the arrival card, you must still state your occupation clearly, so please review the form before boarding. Once you reach the hotel, gather in the hallway beside the lobby at seven, where a coordinator will hand out your revised schedules.
items.zh:
收件人：海外研討會與會者
寄件人：海倫・朴，差旅協調組
主旨：因颱風警報而修訂的行程

國家氣象局已針對大阪地區發布颱風警報，原訂週四上午出發的班機預計將被取消。雖然你們當中有些人可能對出行感到憂心，但執行委員會明智地決定把出發時間延後到週五下午，而不是整趟行程直接取消。大阪的飯店房間已免費為各位多延長一晚，而且只要你們的護照資料已經登錄在案，航空公司會自動為所有人重新訂位。

由於預測暴風雨會在週五前減弱，工廠參訪改在週六舉行，接著是開幕晚宴。因為所有在公司薪資名單上的員工都已納入公司的旅遊保險，所以不需要額外的文件作業。不過，填寫入境卡時，你們仍須清楚填寫自己的職業，因此登機前請先檢查表格。抵達飯店後，請在七點到大廳旁的走廊集合，屆時會有一位協調人員發放修訂後的行程表。

vocab.zh: 薪資名單、員工薪資總額

vocab.col: hotel hallway / wait in the hallway

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To announce that the trip to Osaka has been canceled
To explain how to claim travel insurance
To inform attendees of schedule changes caused by a storm
To introduce a new factory tour for employees
why: 錯誤：委員會是延後出發，並非取消整趟行程。
錯誤：保險只是順帶一提，而且說明不需要額外文件。
正解：信件通知與會者因颱風警報而調整的出發日期與後續行程。
錯誤：工廠參訪只是改期到週六，並不是新增的活動。

questions.q: According to the email, what is scheduled for Saturday?
opts: The factory tour and the opening dinner
A meeting of the executive committee
The return flight to the home office
why: 正解：工廠參訪改在週六舉行，之後是開幕晚宴。
錯誤：出發時間延後到週五下午，不是週六。
錯誤：執行委員會只是做出了決定，文中沒有提到週六開會。
錯誤：文中沒有提到回程班機。

questions.q: What condition must be met for the airline to rebook everyone automatically?
opts: Attendees must pay for an extra hotel night.
Attendees must complete the arrival card early.
Attendees must be covered by travel insurance.
Attendees' passport details must already be on file.
why: 錯誤：多出的一晚住宿是免費的，與重新訂位無關。
錯誤：入境卡是抵達時要填的，不是重新訂位的條件。
錯誤：保險是涵蓋在薪資名單上的員工，並不是訂位的條件。
正解：只要護照資料已登錄在案，航空公司就會自動重新訂位。

questions.q: The flight was delayed ______ the heavy fog that covered the entire airport.
why: 錯誤：despite 表示「儘管」，與延誤的因果關係相反。
正解：because of 是介系詞片語，後接名詞片語 the heavy fog，表示原因。
錯誤：although 是連接詞，後面要接完整子句，且語意不符。
錯誤：so that 表示目的，後面接子句，語意不符。

questions.q: Passengers are advised to ______ their reservations at least one day before departure.
why: 錯誤：advised to 後面要接原形動詞，不能用動名詞。
錯誤：confirmation 是名詞，不能放在 to 之後當動詞。
正解：be advised to 後面接原形動詞 confirm，意為「確認」。
錯誤：confirmed 是過去式或過去分詞，不能直接接在 to 後面。

questions.q: The outdoor tour will go ahead as planned ______ the weather improves by noon.
why: 正解：provided that 引導條件子句，表示「只要…」，後面接完整子句。
錯誤：in case of 後面接名詞，而且表示「萬一」，語意不符。
錯誤：in spite of 是介系詞片語，後面接名詞，語意也相反。
錯誤：as well as 表示「以及」，不能引導條件子句。

extra_vocab.en: worried that something bad may happen
extra_vocab.note: 文中指部分人員對颱風天出差感到不安。語氣比 afraid 輕，常用在對未來的事情有點擔心時，後面多接 about。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: apprehensive 後面常接 about + 名詞或 V-ing，也可接 that 子句；介系詞用 about，不用 for。

example.en: Some new hires feel apprehensive about speaking in front of clients.
example.zh: 有些新進員工對在客戶面前發言感到憂慮。

example.en: The team was apprehensive about the outcome of the contract negotiation.
example.zh: 團隊擔心合約協商的結果。

example.en: He gave the auditor an apprehensive look before opening the files.
example.zh: 他打開檔案前，向稽核員投以憂慮的眼神。

examples.en: Several staff members felt apprehensive about the sudden change in schedule.
examples.zh: 幾位員工對突然的行程變動感到憂慮。

examples.en: The manager looked apprehensive as she opened the quarterly sales report.
examples.zh: 經理打開季度銷售報告時顯得憂心忡忡。

examples.en: Many travelers are apprehensive about flying during bad weather.
examples.zh: 許多旅客對在惡劣天氣下搭機感到不安。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像，但 comprehensive 是「全面的、完整的」，和擔心無關。

example.en: We offer a comprehensive insurance plan for all full-time employees.
example.zh: 我們為所有全職員工提供全面的保險方案。

similar.diff: nervous 較口語，常指上台或面試前的緊張；apprehensive 較正式，多指擔心未來的結果。

example.en: I was nervous before my first presentation to the board.
example.zh: 我在第一次向董事會簡報前很緊張。

similar.diff: worried 最常用、語氣最直接；apprehensive 帶有預感不妙的意味，較書面。

example.en: She is worried that the shipment will arrive late.
example.zh: 她擔心貨物會延遲到達。

example.en: Customers are anxious to hear about the refund policy.
example.zh: 客戶急著想知道退款政策。

example.en: Some employees felt uneasy about the proposed merger.
example.zh: 有些員工對合併提案感到不安。

example.en: The board is concerned about rising shipping costs.
example.zh: 董事會擔心運費不斷上漲。

derived.link: apprehensive 去掉 -ive 改成 -ion，變成名詞「擔心」，像 tension、decision 的字尾
apprehensive + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quickly、carefully

extra_vocab.zh: 薪資名冊、員工名單；薪資總額
extra_vocab.en: a list of the people who work for a company and get paid by it
extra_vocab.note: 文中 on the payroll 指「在公司編制內領薪的員工」，所以這些人都受公司旅遊保險保障。這個說法強調員工身分正式、有領薪水。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: on the payroll 的介系詞固定用 on，不說 in the payroll；payroll 也常放在名詞前當修飾，如 payroll department。

example.en: Both subsidiaries manage their payrolls through the same software system.
example.zh: 兩家子公司透過同一套軟體系統管理各自的薪資作業。

collocations.zh: 受雇於公司、列入薪資名單

example.en: We added three engineers to the payroll last quarter.
example.zh: 我們上一季新增了三名工程師到編制內。

example.en: Please send your bank details to the payroll department.
example.zh: 請把你的銀行帳戶資料寄給薪資部門。

example.en: The new payroll system reduced errors in monthly salary payments.
example.zh: 新的薪資系統減少了每月發薪的錯誤。

example.en: The startup struggled to meet payroll during its first year.
example.zh: 這家新創公司第一年很難籌出員工薪水。

examples.en: All full-time staff members are currently on the company payroll.
examples.zh: 所有全職員工目前都在公司編制內。

examples.en: The finance team processes the payroll on the last day of every month.
examples.zh: 財務團隊在每月最後一天處理薪資。

examples.en: Payroll is the largest expense for most service companies.
examples.zh: 薪資是多數服務業公司最大的支出。

confusable.diff: paycheck 是個人領到的薪水（支票或入帳）；payroll 是公司全體員工的薪資名冊或總額。

example.en: Your paycheck will be deposited into your account every Friday.
example.zh: 你的薪水每週五會存入你的帳戶。

confusable.diff: salary 是個人的固定薪資金額；payroll 指整個公司的發薪名單或總支出。

example.en: Her annual salary increased by five percent after the promotion.
example.zh: 她升職後年薪增加了百分之五。

similar.diff: on staff 泛指是公司的在職員工；on the payroll 強調列入薪資名單、有領薪水。

example.en: Our firm has six full-time accountants on staff.
example.zh: 我們公司有六位全職會計師在職。

example.en: The factory raised the hourly wage for night shift workers.
example.zh: 工廠提高了夜班員工的時薪。

example.en: Every employee received a year-end bonus this December.
example.zh: 今年十二月每位員工都領到了年終獎金。

example.en: Health insurance is one of the main benefits we provide.
example.zh: 健康保險是我們提供的主要福利之一。

senses.en: a list of the workers a company employs and pays

example.en: Only permanent employees appear on the company's official payroll list.
example.zh: 只有正式員工會出現在公司的正式薪資名單上。

senses.en: the total amount of money a company pays its workers
senses.distinguish: 看到 rising、cut、reduce 等和金額一起出現時，通常是「薪資總額」；看到 on the payroll 則是「員工名單」。

example.en: Rising labor costs pushed our monthly payroll above budget.
example.zh: 人力成本上升，使我們每月的薪資總額超出預算。

extra_vocab.en: the kind of work a person does to earn money
extra_vocab.note: 文中指入境卡上要填寫的「職業」欄位。occupation 是表格和官方文件常用的正式字，日常聊天多說 job。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「職業」時是可數名詞（填表常寫 What is your occupation?）；表示「占用、入住」時是不可數名詞。

example.en: Teaching and nursing are among the most respected occupations in the country.
example.zh: 教學和護理是該國最受尊敬的職業之一。

example.en: Applicants must state their occupation on the visa application.
example.zh: 申請人必須在簽證申請表上填寫職業。

example.en: Welding is a skilled occupation with strong demand.
example.zh: 焊接是需求強勁的技術性職業。

example.en: Students should explore different fields before they choose an occupation.
example.zh: 學生在選擇職業前應該先探索不同領域。

examples.en: Please write your name, address, and occupation on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫姓名、地址和職業。

examples.en: The survey asked respondents about their age, income, and occupation.
examples.zh: 這份調查詢問受訪者的年齡、收入和職業。

examples.en: The lease allows occupation of the warehouse starting in July.
examples.zh: 租約允許從七月起使用這座倉庫。

confusable.diff: 字尾 -ation 和發音很像，但 vacation 是「假期」，和工作種類無關。

example.en: Employees can take a paid vacation after one year of service.
example.zh: 員工服務滿一年後可以請有薪假。

similar.diff: job 口語、指一份具體的工作；occupation 較正式，用在表格與統計。

example.en: She found a good job at a logistics company.
example.zh: 她在一家物流公司找到了好工作。

similar.diff: profession 指需要專業訓練或資格的職業，如律師、醫師；occupation 範圍更廣。

example.en: Law is a profession that requires years of training.
example.zh: 法律是需要多年訓練的專業職業。

example.en: She built a successful career in the shipping industry.
example.zh: 她在航運業打造了成功的職涯。

example.en: The company has an open position in accounting.
example.zh: 公司在會計部門有一個職缺。

derived.link: occupation 去掉 -ation 就是 occupy，像 apply → application
occupy + -ant，做動作的人，像 assistant、participant
occupy + -ancy，表示狀態，像 vacancy（空房）
occupation + -al，變成形容詞，像 national、traditional

senses.en: the kind of work a person does to earn money

example.en: Her occupation is listed as marketing consultant on the registration form.
example.zh: 她的職業在登記表上寫的是行銷顧問。

senses.en: the act of living or working in a building or place
senses.distinguish: 和 building、office、apartment 等地點一起出現時，指「入住、使用」，不是職業。

example.en: The tenants took occupation of the new office last week.
example.zh: 租戶上週搬進了新辦公室。

extra_vocab.en: in a way that shows good judgment
extra_vocab.note: 文中 wisely 表達寫信者對委員會決定的正面評價：延後出發是明智之舉。這種放在動詞前、帶評價意味的副詞，在正式公告裡很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wisely 放在助動詞和過去分詞之間（has wisely decided），表示對整個決定的評價；放句尾（decided wisely）則只描述做法。

example.en: Please choose wisely, because this vendor will serve us for years.
example.zh: 請明智選擇，因為這家供應商會長期為我們服務。

example.en: Companies that invest wisely in training often keep their best staff.
example.zh: 明智投資在培訓上的公司，通常能留住最好的員工。

example.en: Using your time wisely helps you finish tasks before the deadline.
example.zh: 善用時間能幫助你在截止日前完成工作。

example.en: The committee acted wisely by consulting the legal team first.
example.zh: 委員會先諮詢法務團隊，做法十分明智。

examples.en: The board wisely chose to wait until the market became stable.
examples.zh: 董事會明智地選擇等到市場穩定後再行動。

examples.en: We should spend our marketing budget wisely this quarter.
examples.zh: 我們這一季應該明智地運用行銷預算。

examples.en: She wisely asked for a written contract before starting the project.
examples.zh: 她在開始專案前明智地要求書面合約。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音很像，但 widely 是「廣泛地」，不是「明智地」。

example.en: This software is widely used in the logistics industry.
example.zh: 這套軟體在物流業被廣泛使用。

similar.diff: sensibly 強調合乎常理、不浮誇；wisely 強調有判斷力、有遠見，語氣更正面。

example.en: The manager sensibly kept some funds aside for emergencies.
example.zh: 經理合理地預留了一些資金以備緊急之需。

similar.diff: with good judgment 是較長的說法，常放句尾；wisely 是單字，可放在動詞前。

example.en: She handled the complaint with good judgment and patience.
example.zh: 她以良好的判斷力和耐心處理了這項客訴。

example.en: The supplier offered a reasonable price for bulk orders.
example.zh: 供應商對大量訂單提出了合理的價格。

example.en: Be careful when you enter the customer data.
example.zh: 輸入客戶資料時請小心。

example.en: Thank you for your thoughtful comments on the proposal.
example.zh: 謝謝你對提案提出的深思熟慮的意見。

derived.link: wisely 去掉 -ly 就是形容詞 wise；形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quick → quickly
wise + -dom，表示狀態或領域，像 freedom、kingdom
un- 表示否定，加在 wise 前，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: a long space inside a building with rooms on its sides
extra_vocab.note: 文中請大家抵達飯店後在大廳旁的走廊集合。hallway 指建築物內連接各房間的通道，常用來描述集合或指引地點。

example.en: The hotel's hallways were quiet after the evening conference ended.
example.zh: 晚間會議結束後，飯店的走廊很安靜。

example.en: A few colleagues were chatting in the hallway after lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後有幾位同事在走廊上聊天。

example.en: Signs along the hallway direct visitors to each department.
example.zh: 走廊沿途的標示會引導訪客前往各部門。

example.en: The narrow hallway made it hard to move the heavy boxes.
example.zh: 狹窄的走廊讓搬運重箱子變得很困難。

example.en: The restrooms are just down the hallway on your left.
example.zh: 洗手間就在走廊前方的左手邊。

examples.en: Please leave your luggage in the hallway outside the meeting room.
examples.zh: 請把行李放在會議室外的走廊上。

examples.en: The photocopier is located at the end of the hallway.
examples.zh: 影印機在走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: Keep the hallway clear so everyone can exit safely during a fire.
examples.zh: 請保持走廊暢通，火災時大家才能安全離開。

confusable.diff: hall 可指大廳、會堂，也可指走廊；hallway 專指建築物內的通道。

example.en: The annual meeting will be held in the main hall.
example.zh: 年度會議將在主禮堂舉行。

confusable.diff: aisle 是座位之間或貨架之間的通道；hallway 是建築物內連接房間的走廊。

example.en: Please keep the aisle clear so staff can walk through.
example.zh: 請保持走道暢通，讓員工可以通行。

similar.diff: corridor 較正式，常指長而連接多個空間的走廊；hallway 也可指入口處的通道。

example.en: Offices line both sides of the long corridor on the third floor.
example.zh: 三樓長長的走廊兩側都是辦公室。

example.en: Visitors must sign in at the front lobby before entering.
example.zh: 訪客進入前必須先在大廳簽到。

example.en: The main entrance will be closed for repairs next week.
example.zh: 主入口下週將因維修而關閉。

example.en: Use the stairway if the elevator is out of service.
example.zh: 電梯停用時請走樓梯。

items.tag: 職涯發展顧問徵才公告

level.why: 以分詞構句（Reporting directly to…、those having…）、被動語態、provided that 與關係子句組成長句，並出現 attain、subsidized 等較抽象的字彙；需整合職責、資格、應徵文件與福利四類資訊，干擾項多取自文中出現過的細節，比上週同日略難。

items.passage:
Harlow Group Seeks Career Development Counselor

Harlow Group, a rapidly expanding logistics firm, is recruiting a career development counselor to join its Human Resources division. Reporting directly to the executive director, the successful candidate will design training pathways, advise employees seeking promotion, and help the company attain its goal of filling most senior positions from within. Applicants should hold a degree in psychology or a related field, and those having at least three years of counseling experience will be given priority.

To apply, please submit a resume, a cover letter explaining why the role would be meaningful to you, and a reference letter written by a former supervisor, which must be sent directly to our office rather than through the applicant. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer flextime, which allows staff to begin work anywhere between seven and ten in the morning, provided that the core hours are observed, as well as subsidized training courses. Applications received before the end of the month will be reviewed first, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews, which are expected to take place in early spring.
items.zh:
哈洛集團徵求職涯發展顧問

哈洛集團是一家快速擴張的物流公司，目前正在招募一名職涯發展顧問，加入人力資源部門。這位錄取者將直接向執行董事報告，負責設計培訓路徑、輔導有意晉升的員工，並協助公司達成大部分高階職位由內部人員升任的目標。應徵者應具備心理學或相關領域的學位，擁有至少三年諮商經驗者將優先考慮。

申請時，請提交履歷、一封說明這份職務對你有何意義的求職信，以及一封由前主管撰寫的推薦信，該推薦信必須直接寄到我們辦公室，而不是經由應徵者轉交。除了具競爭力的薪資之外，我們也提供彈性工時制，只要遵守核心工作時段，員工可在上午七點到十點之間任選時間開始上班，另外還有補助的培訓課程。本月底前收到的申請將優先審閱，入圍的應徵者將受邀面試，面試預計在初春舉行。

vocab.col: attain a goal / attain a level

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To describe changes to the company's promotion policy
To recruit a new employee for the Human Resources division
To report the results of an internal training program
To invite applicants to attend an interview
why: 錯誤：公告提到協助員工晉升是職務內容，並不是在說明晉升政策的變更。
正解：公告是在徵求一位職涯發展顧問加入人力資源部門。
錯誤：培訓只是這個職位的工作與福利之一，沒有報告任何培訓成果。
錯誤：面試是之後會聯絡入圍者的安排，並不是公告的主要目的。

questions.q: What is required of the reference letter?
opts: It must be written by an executive of the company.
It must describe the applicant's counseling skills.
It must be attached to the application documents.
It must be sent directly to the office by its writer.
why: 錯誤：推薦信要由前主管撰寫，執行董事只是新人的報告對象。
錯誤：文中沒有規定推薦信必須談論諮商技巧。
錯誤：履歷與求職信由應徵者提交，推薦信則不經由應徵者轉交。
正解：推薦信必須直接寄到公司辦公室，而不是經由應徵者。

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a benefit of the position?
opts: Flexible starting hours within certain limits
A guaranteed promotion after one year
Full reimbursement of all training courses
why: 正解：彈性工時制讓員工可在七點到十點之間開始上班，但須遵守核心時段。
錯誤：文中只說協助員工晉升，沒有保證任何人升遷。
錯誤：文中沒有提到出國的帶薪假。
錯誤：文中說的是補助培訓課程，並非全額報銷。

questions.q: Candidates who have ______ the final round of interviews will be notified by phone.
why: 錯誤：who have 之後需要過去分詞，不能用動名詞 passing。
錯誤：have 後面接原形動詞不構成完成式。
正解：who have passed 是現在完成式，表示「已通過」。
錯誤：to pass 是不定詞，不能接在 have 之後構成完成式。

questions.q: The company offers its employees a wide range of opportunities for professional ______.
why: 錯誤：develop 是動詞，不能放在形容詞 professional 之後當名詞。
正解：professional development 是固定搭配，意為「專業成長、進修」。
錯誤：developed 是過去分詞或形容詞，不能當名詞。
錯誤：developing 當名詞語意不符，與 professional 的搭配也不自然。

questions.q: Applicants are required to submit their documents ______ the online portal rather than by mail.
why: 錯誤：at 不能與 the online portal 搭配表示「透過」。
錯誤：within 表示「在…範圍內」，語意不符。
錯誤：toward 表示「朝向」，不是提交文件的方式。
正解：through 表示透過某個管道，submit through the online portal 即「經由線上入口提交」。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to give advice and help to others
extra_vocab.note: 標題中的 career development counselor 是人資部門中替員工規劃職涯、提供晉升建議的顧問。這裡是「給建議、做輔導的人」，不是法律上的律師。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: counselor 是美式拼法，英式拼法是 counsellor；同一份文件請統一用一種。

example.en: Our two counselors meet new employees during the first week.
example.zh: 我們的兩位顧問會在第一週與新進員工面談。

example.en: A career counselor helped him prepare for the promotion interview.
example.zh: 一位職涯顧問協助他準備升遷面試。

example.en: Employees may see a counselor during working hours at no cost.
example.zh: 員工可以在上班時間免費找顧問諮詢。

example.en: Following the counselor's advice, she joined a leadership workshop.
example.zh: 她聽從顧問的建議，參加了領導力工作坊。

examples.en: The firm is hiring a counselor to support its younger staff.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在招募顧問來協助年輕員工。

examples.en: Each counselor handles about thirty employees every quarter.
examples.zh: 每位顧問每一季負責大約三十名員工。

examples.en: The counselor explained which courses lead to a management role.
examples.zh: 顧問說明了哪些課程可以通往管理職。

confusable.diff: 發音相近，但 council 是「議會、委員會」這種團體，不是個人。
confusable.usage: council 是團體名詞；counselor 是做輔導工作的「人」。

example.en: The city council approved the plan for the new warehouse.
example.zh: 市議會核准了新倉庫的興建計畫。

confusable.diff: councilor 是議會的議員，和 counselor 發音幾乎一樣，但工作完全不同。

example.en: The local councilor visited our factory last week.
example.zh: 當地議員上週參觀了我們的工廠。

similar.diff: advisor 泛指提供建議的人，範圍較廣；counselor 多指長期、一對一的輔導。

example.en: She works as a financial advisor at a small bank.
example.zh: 她在一家小銀行擔任理財顧問。

similar.diff: consultant 通常是外聘的專家，按專案收費；counselor 多為組織內的輔導人員。

example.en: We hired a consultant to review our shipping process.
example.zh: 我們聘請了顧問來檢視我們的出貨流程。

example.en: Every new manager is assigned a mentor for six months.
example.zh: 每位新任經理都會被分配一位導師，為期六個月。

example.en: The sales coach gave useful tips on client meetings.
example.zh: 業務教練針對客戶會議給了很實用的建議。

example.en: Please ask your supervisor to approve the leave request.
example.zh: 請你的主管核准這份請假申請。

derived.link: counsel 是詞幹；counsel + -or，做這件事的人，像 actor、visitor
counsel + -ing，把「輔導」這件事變成名詞，像 training、meeting

items.tag: 發票數量不符與倉庫盤點稽核說明

level.why: 以分詞構句（Having reviewed…）、被動語態、which 非限定子句與 It is advisable that… 的假設語氣句型組成長句，並出現 auditor、advisable 等較抽象的字彙；需整合稽核原因、錯誤成因、加班工資與新進人員作業四項資訊，干擾項多取自文中出現過的細節，比上週同日略難。

items.passage: Good morning, everyone. Before the quarterly stock count begins, I would like to explain why an outside auditor will visit our warehouse next week. Several invoices from our packaging supplier, issued for bulk orders placed in August, show quantities that do not match the stock recorded in our system. Having reviewed the delivery notes, we believe that some cartons were counted twice, which means we may have overpaid by about four thousand two hundred dollars. Because the recount will require overtime, the wages for those extra hours will be approved by the executive team in advance. It is also advisable that every newcomer on the receiving crew be paired with an experienced colleague, and that each shipment be checked against its purchase order before anyone signs for it. A revised procedure will be circulated by Friday, so please read it carefully.
items.zh: 各位早安。在季度盤點開始之前，我想先說明為什麼下週會有一位外部稽核員到我們的倉庫來。我們包裝材料供應商針對八月下的大宗訂單所開立的幾張發票，顯示的數量與系統中記錄的庫存不符。檢視過交貨單之後，我們認為有些紙箱被重複計算了，這表示我們可能多付了大約四千兩百美元。因為重新盤點需要加班，那些額外工時的工資會事先由主管團隊核准。另外，建議每位進入收貨組的新進人員都搭配一位有經驗的同事，而且每批貨在簽收之前都要對照採購單檢查。修訂後的作業程序會在週五前發送給大家，請務必仔細閱讀。

vocab.col: it is advisable to / strongly advisable
circulate a memo / circulate among staff

questions.q: Why will an auditor visit the warehouse next week?
opts: To train the newcomers on the receiving crew
To look into mismatches between invoices and recorded stock
To approve the overtime wages for the recount
To inspect the quality of the packaging materials
why: 錯誤：新進人員是搭配有經驗的同事，並不是由稽核員訓練。
正解：發票上的數量與系統記錄的庫存不符，所以外部稽核員要來查核。
錯誤：加班工資是由主管團隊事先核准，不是稽核員的工作。
錯誤：問題出在數量不符，與包裝材料的品質無關。

questions.q: What do the managers believe caused the problem?
opts: The supplier delivered fewer cartons than ordered.
A purchase order was lost in the system.
why: 錯誤：文中沒有說供應商少交貨，反而是我們可能多付了款。
錯誤：加班是重新盤點之後才會發生，並非問題的原因。
錯誤：文中提到要對照採購單，但沒有說採購單遺失。
正解：檢視交貨單後，主管們認為有些紙箱被重複計算。

questions.q: What is recommended for new members of the receiving crew?
opts: Working together with an experienced colleague
Attending the auditor's briefing next week
Reading the revised procedure aloud to the team
Avoiding overtime work during the recount
why: 正解：建議每位新進人員搭配一位有經驗的同事。
錯誤：稽核員會來訪，但文中沒有提到要新進人員參加說明會。
錯誤：修訂的程序是發送給大家閱讀，並沒有要大聲朗讀。
錯誤：文中說加班工資會事先核准，並未要求新進人員避免加班。

questions.q: The finance department asked all suppliers to ______ their invoices within seven days of delivery.
why: 錯誤：asked ... to 後面要接原形動詞，不能用動名詞。
錯誤：過去式或過去分詞不能直接接在 to 之後。
正解：ask + 受詞 + to V，故空格填原形動詞 issue，意為「開立」。
錯誤：issues 是第三人稱單數或複數名詞，不能接在 to 之後。

questions.q: The shipment arrived ______ the agreed date, so the invoice was paid without any penalty.
why: 正解：ahead of 表示「早於」，貨物提早到，所以沒有罰款，語意通順。
錯誤：owing to 表示「由於」，不能表示時間早於約定日期。
錯誤：in spite of 表示「儘管」，語意不符。
錯誤：as to 表示「關於」，不能表示時間先後。

questions.q: Payment will be released only after the purchasing manager has ______ the discrepancies between the invoice and the order.
why: 錯誤：has 之後需要過去分詞，不能用原形。
正解：has reconciled 是現在完成式，reconcile 意為「核對並使一致」。
錯誤：reconciling 是現在分詞，不能與 has 構成完成式。
錯誤：reconciliation 是名詞，不能接在 has 之後當動詞。

items.tag: 海港貿易展攤位人員配置與徵才博覽會應對備忘錄

level.why: 句子多為含 which、provided that、since 的複合句與被動結構，並需整合班次、服裝、應徵者應對與去年成果等多項資訊；干擾項取自文中同時出現的概念（job fair、reference letter、loyalty app）。

items.passage:
To: Marketing and Sales Team
Subject: Staffing Plan for the Harbor Trade Expo

Our booth at the Harbor Trade Expo, which opens on November 18, has been enlarged to nine meters in width, allowing us to demonstrate the new loyalty app while reserving a small corner for recruitment. Because the organizers are running a job fair alongside the exhibition, Human Resources has asked us to promote our trainee program, provided that doing so does not distract from the product demonstrations.

Each shift will be led by one sales executive, supported by two associates, and all staff are expected to wear business attire in the company's navy colors. Anyone who wishes to change shifts must contact Ms. Alvarez by Friday, since the available slots are already almost full. Please steer applicants who approach the booth toward the HR desk instead of discussing salary yourselves, and remind them that candidates are being evaluated against published criteria, including relevant experience and a reference letter from a previous employer.

Last year's expo generated tremendous interest, with more than 1,200 leads collected over three days. To maintain that momentum, we will review the first day's results at a short briefing, after which the demonstration schedule may be adjusted accordingly.
items.zh:
收件人：行銷與業務團隊
主旨：港灣貿易展人員配置計畫

我們在 11 月 18 日開幕的港灣貿易展攤位已擴大為寬九公尺，讓我們既能展示新的會員忠誠度應用程式，也能保留一小塊角落做招募。由於主辦單位在展覽期間同步舉辦徵才博覽會，人力資源部已要求我們宣傳公司的儲備受訓計畫，但前提是這麼做不能妨礙產品展示。

每個班次將由一位業務主管帶領，並由兩位助理協助，所有人員都應穿著公司海軍藍色系的商務服裝。任何想換班的人，請在週五前聯絡艾瓦雷茲女士，因為可選的時段幾乎都已排滿。請把前來攤位詢問的應徵者引導到人資櫃檯，而不要自己討論薪資，並提醒他們，應徵者將依公布的標準接受評估，包括相關經驗以及前雇主所寫的推薦信。

去年的展覽引起極大的關注，三天內共蒐集到超過 1,200 筆潛在客戶資料。為了維持這股氣勢，我們將在簡短的簡報會上檢視第一天的成果，之後可能會據此調整展示時程。

vocab.col: steer customers toward / steer a conversation

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To announce the launch date of a loyalty app
To explain staffing arrangements and expectations for the company's expo booth
To invite job seekers to a recruitment event
To report the results of last year's expo
why: 文中提到 loyalty app，但只是展示項目，非信件主旨。
正解：信件說明攤位的人員配置、服裝、換班與應對應徵者的要求。
job fair 由主辦單位舉辦，信件並非對求職者的邀請，而是給內部團隊。
去年成果只在最後一段簡短帶過，不是主要目的。

questions.q: What are booth staff asked to do when applicants approach?
opts: Collect reference letters on the spot
Direct them to the HR desk
why: 文中明言不要自己討論薪資（instead of discussing salary）。
推薦信是評估標準之一，但並未要求現場收取。
正解：steer applicants toward the HR desk，即引導至人資櫃檯。
主辦單位舉辦 job fair，但並未要求轉介給主辦單位。

questions.q: What is mentioned about last year's expo?
opts: It featured a demonstration of a loyalty app
It lasted for a full week
It resulted in more than 1,200 leads
why: 忠誠度應用程式是今年要展示的，並非去年。
文中說去年是三天，不是一週。
job fair 是今年主辦單位的安排，文中未說去年也有。
正解：三天內蒐集到超過 1,200 筆 leads。

questions.q: Candidates for the position will be assessed against clearly defined ______.
why: 正解：criteria 為 criterion 的複數，前面無冠詞，作 against 的受詞。
criterion 為單數，前面需有冠詞 a／each。
critic 指評論家，語意不符。
critically 為副詞，不能作介系詞受詞。

questions.q: The demonstration schedule will be revised ______ the feedback gathered from visitors on the first day.
why: basing on 不是慣用搭配，且不符合此句結構。
based 單獨使用後須接 on 才能表示根據。
正解：on the basis of + 名詞，表示「根據…」。
base for 語意與結構皆不通。

questions.q: Customers who are dissatisfied with a purchase may request a refund ______ they present the original receipt.
why: in spite of 是介系詞片語，後不能接子句。
as to 後接名詞，不能引導條件子句。
正解：provided that 引導條件子句，意為「只要…」。
rather than 表示「而不是」，語意不符。
